Question: 睡眠時無呼吸症候群による高血圧について、正しくないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not true regarding hypertension caused by sleep apnea?

Question: 妊娠末期の腟分泌物細菌培養検査でB 群連鎖球菌（GBS）が陽性となった妊婦に対する母子感染予防対策として、ペニシリン系抗菌薬の投与を開始する適切な時期はどれか。
Question_EN: When is the appropriate time to start administering penicillin antibiotics to a pregnant woman whose vaginal secretion bacterial culture test during the final stages of pregnancy is positive for group B streptococcus (GBS) as a measure to prevent mother-to-child transmission?

Question: 中心性漿液性脈絡網膜症について誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect regarding central serous chorioretinopathy?

Question: 単剤の内服で低血糖の原因になる可能性が高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which drug taken alone is most likely to cause hypoglycemia?

Question: 我が国での成人心臓移植について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding adult heart transplants in Japan?

Question: 高カリウム血症の原因となるのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following causes hyperkalemia?

Question: 逆流性食道炎の誘因とならないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not a cause of gastroesophageal reflux disease?

Question: 心不全で来院した患者において心サルコイドーシスの所見に合致しないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not consistent with cardiac sarcoidosis in a patient who came to the hospital with heart failure?

Question: 骨壊死のリスクファクターでないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not a risk factor for osteonecrosis?

Question: 全身性強皮症による続発性Raynaud 現象の特徴はどれか。
Question_EN: What is a characteristic of secondary Raynaud phenomenon due to systemic sclerosis?

Question: 自閉スペクトラム症の特徴でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not a characteristic of autism spectrum disorder?

Question: 急激な血圧上昇を認める患者で、高血圧緊急症の病態として考えにくいのはどれか。
Question_EN: In a patient experiencing a sudden rise in blood pressure, which of the following is unlikely to be a hypertensive emergency?

Question: 76 歳の女性。高血糖と尿蛋白を指摘されて来院した。退職前の健診で血糖値が高めであることを指摘されていたが、そのままにしていた。60 歳で退職後は健診を受診していなかった。退職後の年間で体重が10 kg 増加した。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。姉に糖尿病がある。現在はひとり暮らしである。運動習慣はない。視力低下のために眼科を受診したところ、増殖性糖尿病網膜症と診断され、高血糖と尿蛋白も指摘されて紹介された。身長154 cm、体重70 kg。脈拍72/分、整。血圧142/80 mmHg。胸腹部に異常を認めない。両下に軽度の圧痕性浮腫を認める。尿所見：蛋白、糖、潜血。随時尿の尿蛋白/Cr 比は1.2 g/gCr。尿沈渣に赤血球、白血球、円柱を認めない。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.1 g/dL、アルブミン4.2 g/dL、尿素窒素16 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL、eGFR 72.3 mL/分/1.73 m2、随時血糖値201 mg/dL、HbA1c 10.2 %、Na 142 mEq/L、K 4.5 mEq/L、Cl 100 mEq/L、Ca 9.2 mg/dL。抗GAD 抗体陰性。尿蛋白の原因を調べるための腎生検は患者が希望しなかった。本患者の蛋白尿の原因が糖尿病性腎症であることを最も示唆する所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 76-year-old woman came to our hospital because of hyperglycemia and proteinuria. A pre-retirement health check had pointed out that her blood glucose level was high, but she had left it untreated. She had not undergone a health check since she retired at age 60. She had gained 10 kg in weight in the year since she retired. There was nothing notable about her medical history. Her older sister has diabetes. She currently lives alone. She does not exercise regularly. She visited an ophthalmologist because of declining vision, and was diagnosed with proliferative diabetic retinopathy. She was also found to have hyperglycemia and proteinuria, and was referred to us. Height 154 cm, weight 70 kg. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 142/80 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the chest or abdomen. Mild pitting edema was present in both lower extremities. Urine findings: protein, sugar, occult blood. Spot urine protein/Cr ratio was 1.2 g/gCr. No red blood cells, white blood cells, or casts were found in the urinary sediment. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.1 g/dL, albumin 4.2 g/dL, urea nitrogen 16 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, eGFR 72.3 mL/min/1.73 m2, random blood glucose 201 mg/dL, HbA1c 10.2%, Na 142 mEq/L, K 4.5 mEq/L, Cl 100 mEq/L, Ca 9.2 mg/dL. Anti-GAD antibodies were negative. The patient did not wish to undergo a renal biopsy to determine the cause of the urinary protein. Which finding most likely suggests that the cause of this patient's proteinuria is diabetic nephropathy?

Question: 23 歳の男性。仕事中居眠りが多く、重要な商談や会議中でも発作的に眠ってしまうことが多いため来院した。数年前から夜間十分に眠っても日中に何回も急に強い眠気を認めるようになり、最近は大笑いや驚いた後に急に全身の力が抜けることが増えてきたという。神経診察に異常を認めない。この患者にみられる可能性が高い特徴はどれか。
Question_EN: A 23-year-old man visits the hospital because he often falls asleep at work and often falls asleep suddenly even during important business negotiations or meetings. For the past few years, he has experienced sudden, intense feelings of sleepiness several times during the day, even when he has had sufficient sleep at night. Recently, he has been experiencing sudden, full-body relaxation after laughing loudly or being startled. No abnormalities are found in the neurological examination. Which of the following is most likely to be present in this patient?

Question: 62 歳の女性。息切れと全身倦怠感を主訴に来院した。7日前に発作性心房細動に対してカテーテルアブレーションが施行されており、3日前に退院していた。退院翌日に息切れと全身倦怠感が出現し、症状が徐々に増悪するため受診した。意識は清明。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍112/分、整。血圧88/72 mmHg。血圧は吸気時に収縮期血圧が18 mmHg 低下する。呼吸数18/分。SpO2 95 %(room air)。呼吸音に異常を認めない。心音は微弱だが雑音は聴取しない。頸静脈は怒張している。血液所見：赤血球462 万、Hb 13.2 g/dL、Ht 39 %、白血球9,700、血小板39 万。血液生化学所見：尿素窒素44 mg/dL、クレアチニン1.7 mg/dL、Na 141 mEq/L、K 4.2 mEq/L、Cl 110 mEq/L。最も考えられる病態はどれか。
Question_EN: A 62-year-old woman came to the hospital complaining of shortness of breath and general fatigue. Seven days earlier, she had undergone catheter ablation for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, and had been discharged three days earlier. The day after discharge, she developed shortness of breath and general fatigue, and her symptoms gradually worsened, so she visited the hospital. She was conscious and alert. Body temperature was 36.2°C. Pulse rate was 112 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure was 88/72 mmHg. Systolic blood pressure decreased by 18 mmHg during inspiration. Respiratory rate was 18 beats per minute. SpO2 was 95% (room air). There were no abnormalities in the breath sounds. Heart sounds were weak, but no murmurs were audible. The jugular vein was distended. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.62 million, hemoglobin 13.2 g/dL, hematocrit 39%, white blood cells 9,700, and platelets 390,000. Blood biochemistry findings: urea nitrogen 44 mg/dL, creatinine 1.7 mg/dL, Na 141 mEq/L, K 4.2 mEq/L, Cl 110 mEq/L. Which is the most likely pathology?

Question: 13 歳の女子。バスケットボールの試合中に気分不快と腹痛が出現したため、教師に付き添われ来院した。会場で用意された弁当を食べて約4時間後に試合に出場した。試合開始10 分後に気分不快と全身の皮膚瘙痒及び強い腹痛が現れた。弁当の主な副食材はイカであり、最近4年ほどは食べていなかったという。診察時には気分不快や腹痛のピークは過ぎていた。意識は清明。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍80/分。呼吸数18/分。SpO2 100 % (room air)。血圧110/76 mmHg。呼吸音に異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、軽度の紅斑と膨疹を認める。血液所見：赤血球430 万、Hb 12.5 g/dL、白血球4,800(分葉核好中球42 %、好酸球2%、リンパ球56 %)、血小板21 万。CRP 0.3 mg/dL。今後の対応として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 13-year-old girl was accompanied by a teacher to the hospital because she had developed nausea and abdominal pain during a basketball game. She ate a boxed lunch prepared at the venue and played in the game about 4 hours later. Ten minutes after the start of the game, she developed nausea, generalized skin itching, and severe abdominal pain. The main side ingredient in the boxed lunch was squid, which she had not eaten in the last 4 years. At the time of examination, the peak of her nausea and abdominal pain had passed. She was conscious and alert. Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse 80 beats/min. Respiratory rate 18 breaths/min. SpO2 100% (room air). Blood pressure 110/76 mmHg. No abnormalities were noted in her breath sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, with mild erythema and wheals. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.3 million, hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL, white blood cells 4,800 (segmented neutrophils 42%, eosinophils 2%, lymphocytes 56%), platelets 210,000. CRP 0.3 mg/dL. Which of the following is the most appropriate future course of action?

Question: 30 歳の男性。｢3か月くらい前から、仕事の能率が悪いのが気になる｣と訴えて産業医面談を希望した。新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）の流行に伴い、約半年前から会議もオンラインで行う在宅勤務となった。妻と3歳の男児との3人暮らしだが、自宅周囲の騒音や男児の世話のためにイライラして仕事に集中できないという。約1か月前から寝酒を飲んで眠るようになったが、その頃から朝の起床時に気持ちが沈んでいることが多くなった。毎日疲れが残り、気がつくと取り留めなく考え事をしているという。産業医の対応として適切でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 30-year-old man requested an interview with an industrial physician, complaining that "for about three months, I've been concerned about my poor work efficiency." Due to the COVID-19 outbreak, he has been working from home, even conducting meetings online, for about six months. He lives with his wife and three-year-old son, but says that he is irritated by the noise around the house and the need to take care of the boy, and is unable to concentrate on his work. About a month ago, he started drinking before bed, and since then, he has often felt depressed when he wakes up in the morning. He says that he is still tired every day, and when he realizes it, he is thinking about random things. Which of the following is not an appropriate response from an industrial physician?

Question: 23 歳の男性。全身倦怠感、食欲不振、悪心を主訴に来院した。1 週間前から症状が出現し、昨日から褐色調の尿が出るようになった。下痢はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。1か月前に同性間の性交渉歴がある。意識は清明。体温37.2 ℃。眼球結膜の黄染を認める。肝を右季肋部に2 cm 触知し、軽度の圧痛を認める。血液所見：赤血球490 万、Hb 14.5 g/dL、Ht 42 %、白血球6,300( 好中球42 %、好酸球1%、好塩基球1 %、単球9%、リンパ球45 %、異型リンパ球2 %)、血小板28 万、PT-INR 1.1 (基準0.9〜1.1)。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.2 g/dL、アルブミン3.9 g/dL、IgG 1,140 mg/dL (基準960〜1,960)、IgM 473 mg/dL (基準65〜350)、総ビリルビン8.1 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン5.7 mg/dL、AST 984 U/L、ALT 822 U/L、LD 423 U/L (基準120〜245)、ALP 143 U/L (基準38〜113)、γ-GT 266 U/L (基準8〜50)。免疫血清学所見：HBs 抗原陰性、IgM 型HBc 抗体陰性、HCV 抗体陰性、HCV-RNA 陰性、IgM 型HA 抗体陽性、IgA 型HEV 抗体陰性、RPR1 倍未満 (基準1 倍未満)、TPHA 320 倍 (基準80 倍未満)。この患者で考えられる疾患はどれか。
Question_EN: A 23-year-old male came to the hospital complaining of general malaise, loss of appetite, and nausea. The symptoms began one week ago, and brown urine began yesterday. There is no diarrhea. He drinks alcohol on an occasional basis. He has had homosexual intercourse one month ago. He is conscious and alert. Temperature is 37.2°C. Yellowing of the conjunctiva is observed. The liver is palpated 2 cm into the right hypochondrium, and mild tenderness is observed. Blood findings: RBC 4.9 million, Hb 14.5 g/dL, Ht 42%, WBC 6,300 (neutrophils 42%, eosinophils 1%, basophils 1%, monocytes 9%, lymphocytes 45%, atypical lymphocytes 2%), platelets 280,000, PT-INR 1.1 (normal 0.9-1.1). Blood biochemistry: total protein 7.2 g/dL, albumin 3.9 g/dL, IgG 1,140 mg/dL (standard 960-1,960), IgM 473 mg/dL (standard 65-350), total bilirubin 8.1 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 5.7 mg/dL, AST 984 U/L, ALT 822 U/L, LD 423 U/L (standard 120-245), ALP 143 U/L (standard 38-113), γ-GT 266 U/L (standard 8-50). Immunoserological findings: HBs antigen negative, IgM HBc antibody negative, HCV antibody negative, HCV-RNA negative, IgM HA antibody positive, IgA HEV antibody negative, RPR less than 1:1 (reference value: less than 1:1), TPHA 1:320 (reference value: less than 1:80). Which of the following is the possible disease in this patient?

Question: 40 歳の男性。字がうまく書けないことを主訴に来院した。3年前から書類にサインするときに字がうまく書けないことに気づいていたが、徐々に仕事にも支障をきたすようになった。それ以外の日常生活に支障はない。神経診察では筋トーヌスは正常で不随意運動はみられない。四肢筋力低下はなく腱反射は正常である。協調運動障害と感覚障害は認めない。鉛筆で字を書くように指示すると、示指と中指の近位指節間関節と遠位指節間関節が強く屈曲し、歪んだ形の字となった。考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 40-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of poor handwriting. Three years ago, he noticed that he could not write well when signing documents, but it gradually began to interfere with his work. Other than that, there is no interference with daily life. Neurological examination reveals normal muscle tonus and no involuntary movement. There is no weakness in the limbs, and tendon reflexes are normal. No coordination or sensory impairments were noted. When asked to write with a pencil, the proximal and distal interphalangeal joints of the index and middle fingers were strongly flexed, resulting in distorted handwriting. Which of the following is possible?

Question: 42 歳の男性。下腹部痛と悪心を主訴に来院した。生来健康で、半年前の定期健診でも異常は指摘されなかった。朝食後に右側腹部に張る感じがあり、次第に痛みへと変わり、急速に激痛となった。うずくまってじっとしているうちに数分で痛みは一旦改善したが10 分ほどで悪化し、悪心とともに嘔吐した。その後も数分から10 数分の周期で痛みと悪心があり、タクシーで来院した。発熱は認めない。痛みは下方へと少しずつ移動しており来院時には右下腹部痛を認めるが、右側腹部から背部のこわばるような違和感も持続している。予想される所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 42-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of lower abdominal pain and nausea. He had been healthy since birth, and no abnormalities were found during a regular medical check-up six months ago. After breakfast, he felt a tightness in his right abdomen, which gradually turned into pain and then rapidly became severe. The pain improved after a few minutes while he was crouched down and still, but it worsened within about 10 minutes, and he vomited along with nausea. He continued to experience pain and nausea every few minutes to 10 minutes, so he came to the hospital by taxi. He did not have a fever. The pain was gradually moving downward, and at the time of his visit, he had pain in the lower right abdomen, but he also had a persistent stiffness-like discomfort from the right abdomen to his back. Which of the following findings would be expected?
ensemble_location: 右下腹部; 右側腹部; 背部
ensemble_pain_type: 張る感じ; 激痛; 違和感

Question:
48 歳の女性。口渇と全身倦怠感を主訴に来院した。5日前に発熱と腹痛があっ た。食事はいつも通り摂取している。意識は清明。体温 36.8 °C。脈拍 84/分、整。 血圧 108/68 mmHg。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜に異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、 肝・脾を触知しない。尿所見:蛋白(ー)、糖3+、ケトン体3+、潜血(ー)。血液 所見:Hb 13.2 g/dL、白血球 9,500、血小板 24 万。血液生化学所見:血糖 440 mg/dL、HbA1c 5.8 %(基準 4.6〜6.2)、C ペプチド 0.2 ng/mL(基準 0.8〜2.5)。
患者への説明として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 48-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of dry mouth and general fatigue. She had had fever and abdominal pain five days previously. She was eating as usual. She was conscious and alert. Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse 84 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 108/68 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. Urine findings: protein (-), glucose 3+, ketone bodies 3+, occult blood (-). Blood findings: Hb 13.2 g/dL, white blood cells 9,500, platelets 240,000. Blood chemistry findings: Blood glucose 440 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.8% (normal: 4.6-6.2), C-peptide 0.2 ng/mL (normal: 0.8-2.5).
Which of the following is the most appropriate explanation to give to the patient?

Question:
生後 10 時間の男児。在胎 39 週、体重 2,960 g、Apgar スコア7点(1分)、8点
(5分)で出生した。助産師がチアノーゼに気づき医師に報告した。出生時にはチア
ノーゼに気づかなかったという。体温 36.9 °C。心拍数 128/分。呼吸数 38/分。
SpO2(room air)76 %(上肢)、75 %(下肢)。高濃度酸素を投与してもチアノーゼは持続した。心エコー検査では4つの心腔が確認されるが、右心室から肺動脈への駆出血流は確認できない。動脈管から肺動脈に流入している少量の血流を認めた。
この児に適切な初期対応はどれか。
Question_EN:
A male infant 10 hours after birth. He was born at 39 weeks gestation, weighed 2,960 g, and had an Apgar score of 7 (1 min) and 8 (5 min). A midwife noticed the infant's cyanosis and reported it to the doctor. The infant's cyanosis was not noticed at birth. Body temperature 36.9 °C. Heart rate 128/min. Respiratory rate 38/min.

SpO2 (room air) 76 % (upper limbs) and 75 % (lower limbs). Cyanosis persisted despite administration of high-concentration oxygen. Echocardiography confirmed four cardiac chambers, but no ejection flow from the right ventricle to the pulmonary artery was observed. A small amount of blood flow was observed entering the pulmonary artery from the ductus arteriosus.

Which initial response would be appropriate for this infant?

Question: 73 歳の男性。歩行時の左下肢痛を主訴に来院した。2か月前から400 m 程度の歩行で左ふくらはぎに痛みが出現し、立ち止まって休憩すると消失していた。最近200 m 程度で症状を認めるため来院した。43 歳から糖尿病に対して定期的な投薬治療が行われている。7年前に狭心症に対して冠動脈内ステント留置術が行われており、5年前から透析治療を受けている。喫煙は20 歳から現在まで20 本/日、飲酒は機会飲酒。意識は清明。身長169 cm、体重57 kg。体温35.9 ℃。脈拍84/分、整。血圧158/92 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 95 %(room air)。足関節上腕血圧比＜ABI＞は右側で0.91、左側で0.65 であった。研修医と指導医の会話を示す。指導医：「この患者さんの症状をどう表現しますか」研修医：「①間欠性跛行だと思います」指導医：「背景にある病態として、どのようなものがありますか」研修医：「②神経性のものとして腰部脊柱管狭窄症などがあり、③血管性のものとして浅大腿動脈の狭窄などがあります」指導医：「この患者さんのABI 値からは何が疑われますか」研修医：「④閉塞性動脈硬化症の可能性が高いと思います」指導医：「今後、どのような検査を行いますか」研修医：「⑤ガドリニウム造影MRI 検査を予定します」下線部のうち誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 73-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of left leg pain while walking. For the past two months, he had been experiencing pain in his left calf when walking about 400 m, but this pain disappeared when he stopped to rest. He visited the hospital because he had been experiencing symptoms after walking about 200 m recently. He has been taking regular medication for diabetes since the age of 43. Seven years ago, he underwent intracoronary stent placement for angina pectoris, and has been undergoing dialysis treatment for the past five years. He has smoked 20 cigarettes per day since the age of 20, and drinks alcohol occasionally. He is conscious and alert. Height 169 cm, weight 57 kg. Body temperature 35.9°C. Pulse 84/min, regular. Blood pressure 158/92 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20/min. SpO2 95% (room air). His ankle-brachial index (ABI) was 0.91 on the right and 0.65 on the left. A conversation between a resident and a supervising physician is shown below. Supervisor: "How would you describe this patient's symptoms?" Resident: "I think it is (1) intermittent claudication." Supervisor: "What are the underlying pathologies?" Resident: "(2) Neurological conditions include lumbar spinal canal stenosis, and (3) vascular conditions include superficial femoral artery stenosis." Supervisor: "What do you suspect based on this patient's ABI value?" Resident: "I think there is a high possibility of (4) arteriosclerosis obliterans." Supervisor: "What tests will you perform next?" Resident: "(5) We plan to perform a gadolinium-enhanced MRI." Which of the underlined parts is incorrect?

Question:
52 歳の男性。全身倦怠感を主訴に来院した。6週間前に進行肺腺癌と診断され、3週間前に免疫チェックポイント阻害薬による初回治療を受けた。全身倦怠感が出現したため受診した。意識は清明であるが受け答えは緩慢である。体温 36.8 °C。 脈拍 108/分、整。血圧 72/50 mmHg。呼吸数 20/分。SpO 97 %(room air)。軽度腫大した甲状腺を触知する。血液所見:赤血球 320 万、Hb 12.0 g/dL、Ht 38 %。
血液生化学所見:血糖 104 mg/dL、TSH 0.1 μU/mL(基準 0.2〜4.0)、ACTH 2.0
pg/mL(基準60以下)、FT4 1.8ng/dL(基準0.8〜2.2)、コルチゾール0.1μg/dL(基準 5.2〜12.6)であった。胸部エックス線写真で原発巣の縮小を認める。甲状腺超音波検査では軽度の甲状腺腫大以外は異常を認めない。
治療として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 52-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of general fatigue. He had been diagnosed with advanced lung adenocarcinoma 6 weeks ago and had received initial treatment with an immune checkpoint inhibitor 3 weeks ago. He visited the hospital because he had developed general fatigue. He was conscious but had a slow response. Body temperature 36.8 °C. Pulse 108 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 72/50 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20 breaths/min. SpO 97 % (room air). A mildly enlarged thyroid gland was palpable. Blood findings: red blood cells 3.2 million, Hb 12.0 g/dL, Ht 38 %. Blood biochemistry findings: Blood glucose 104 mg/dL, TSH 0.1 μU/mL (normal: 0.2-4.0), ACTH 2.0 pg/mL (normal: below 60), FT4 1.8 ng/dL (normal: 0.8-2.2), cortisol 0.1 μg/dL (normal: 5.2-12.6). Chest X-ray shows shrinkage of the primary lesion. Thyroid ultrasound shows no abnormalities other than mild thyroid enlargement.
Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

Question: 62 歳の男性。下行結腸癌と診断され、開腹による左半結腸切除を予定している。28 歳時に虫垂炎による腹膜炎で1か月の入院歴がある。身長175 cm、体重60 kg。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍76/分、整。血圧120/70 mmHg。呼吸数14/分。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜に異常を認めない。心音と呼吸音に異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。右下腹部と腹部正中に手術痕を認める。血液所見：赤血球410 万、Hb 13.8 g/dL、Ht 42 %、白血球5,200、血小板16 万。PT-INR 1.0(基準0.9-1.1)、APTT 29.0 秒(基準対象32.2)。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.4 g/dL、アルブミン4.0 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.8 mg/dL、AST 18 U/L、ALT 20 U/L、LD 196 U/L (基準120〜245)、ALP 102 U/L (基準38〜113)、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL、Na 140 mEq/L、K 3.8 mEq/L、Cl 100 mEq/L、CEA 5.2 ng/mL(基準5以下)。この患者の周術期管理で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 62-year-old man was diagnosed with descending colon cancer and was scheduled to undergo laparotomy to remove the left hemicolectomy. At the age of 28, he had been hospitalized for one month due to peritonitis caused by appendicitis. Height 175 cm, weight 60 kg. Body temperature 36.2°C. Pulse 76 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 120/70 mmHg. Respiratory rate 14 beats per minute. No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva. No abnormalities were found in the heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. There were surgical scars in the right lower quadrant and midline of the abdomen. Blood findings: RBC 4.1 million, Hb 13.8 g/dL, Ht 42%, WBC 5,200, platelets 160,000. PT-INR 1.0 (reference 0.9-1.1), APTT 29.0 seconds (reference 32.2). Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.4 g/dL, albumin 4.0 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 18 U/L, ALT 20 U/L, LD 196 U/L (standard 120-245), ALP 102 U/L (standard 38-113), creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, Na 140 mEq/L, K 3.8 mEq/L, Cl 100 mEq/L, CEA 5.2 ng/mL (standard 5 or less). Which of the following is appropriate for the perioperative management of this patient?

Question: 15 歳の男子。下肢の痛みと赤褐色尿のため家族とともに来院した。3日前に野球部の練習に参加し、炎天下での激しいトレーニング中に頭痛と下肢の脱力を認めたが飲水と休憩で改善した。2日前から両大腿前面に筋肉痛を感じながら練習を続けていた。昨晩から赤褐色尿が出現したため受診した。意識は清明。身長167 cm、体重62 kg。体温37.1 ℃。脈拍84/分、整。血圧134/62 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音に異常を認めない。腰背部痛と両大腿の筋痛を認める。神経診察に異常を認めない。尿所見：色調は暗褐色、比重1.022、pH 6.5、蛋白（−）、潜血（3+）、沈渣に赤血球1〜4/HPF を認める。血液所見：赤血球536 万、Hb 16.0 g/dL、Ht 45 %、白血球9,000、血小板28 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.7 g/dL、アルブミン4.2 g/dL、AST 1,927 U/L、ALT 366 U/L、CK 155,150 U/L（基準30〜140）、尿素窒素8.7 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL、尿酸4.6 mg/dL、Na 142 mEq/L、K 4.0 mEq/L、Cl 105 mEq/L。最初に行う輸液の組成として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 15-year-old boy visited the hospital with his family because of pain in the lower limbs and reddish brown urine. Three days ago, he participated in baseball practice, and during intense training under the hot sun, he experienced headaches and weakness in the lower limbs, but these symptoms improved with water and rest. For the past two days, he had been practicing despite muscle pain in the anterior part of both thighs. He visited the hospital because he had been producing reddish brown urine since last night. He was conscious and alert. Height 167 cm, weight 62 kg. Body temperature 37.1°C. Pulse 84/min, regular. Blood pressure 134/62 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16/min. SpO2 98% (room air). Heart sounds and respiratory sounds were normal. He had low back pain and muscle pain in both thighs. Neurological examination showed no abnormalities. Urine findings: dark brown in color, specific gravity 1.022, pH 6.5, protein (-), occult blood (3+), and 1-4 red blood cells/HPF in the sediment. Blood findings: RBC 5.36 million, Hb 16.0 g/dL, Ht 45%, WBC 9,000, platelets 280,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 6.7 g/dL, albumin 4.2 g/dL, AST 1,927 U/L, ALT 366 U/L, CK 155,150 U/L (normal 30-140), urea nitrogen 8.7 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, uric acid 4.6 mg/dL, Na 142 mEq/L, K 4.0 mEq/L, Cl 105 mEq/L. Which of the following is the most appropriate composition for the initial infusion?
ensemble_location: 下肢; 大腿; 腰背部

Question: 28 歳の男性。心窩部痛を主訴に来院した。2 週間前から空腹時に軽度の心窩部痛を自覚していたが、昨日から増悪するため受診した。20 歳から十二指腸潰瘍で繰り返し薬物治療を受けている。25 歳時に下垂体腺腫摘出術を受けている。身長 176 cm、体重 64 kg。体温 36.2 ℃。脈拍 96/分、整。血圧 98/62 mmHg。腹部は平坦、軟で、上腹部に軽度の圧痛を認める。直腸指診で黒色便の付着を認める。血液所見：赤血球 360 万、Hb 11.5 g/dL、Ht 36 %、白血球 8,800、血小板 29 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白 6.9 g/dL、アルブミン 3.6 g/dL、ALP 192 U/L (基準 38〜113)、尿素窒素 20 mg/dL、クレアチニン 0.8 mg/dL、Ca 11.6 mg/dL、P 2.2 mg/dL。上部消化管内視鏡検査で多発胃潰瘍および十二指腸潰瘍を認めた。頸部超音波検査で甲状腺背側に径 0.5 cm の腫瘤を認めた。腹部造影 CT 動脈相で膵体部に強く造影される径1cm の腫瘤を認めた。この患者で上昇していると考えられるホルモンはどれか。
Question_EN: A 28-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of epigastric pain. He had been aware of mild epigastric pain when fasting for the past 2 weeks, but it had worsened since yesterday, so he visited the hospital. He had been receiving repeated drug treatment for duodenal ulcers since the age of 20. He had a pituitary adenoma removal surgery at the age of 25. Height 176 cm, weight 64 kg. Body temperature 36.2°C. Pulse 96 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 98/62 mmHg. The abdomen was flat and soft, with mild tenderness in the upper abdomen. Digital rectal examination revealed black stool. Blood findings: red blood cells 3.6 million, hemoglobin 11.5 g/dL, hematocrit 36%, white blood cells 8,800, platelets 290,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.9 g/dL, albumin 3.6 g/dL, alkaline phosphatase 192 U/L (normal: 38-113), urea nitrogen 20 mg/dL, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, calcium 11.6 mg/dL, phosphorus 2.2 mg/dL. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed multiple gastric and duodenal ulcers. Cervical ultrasound revealed a 0.5 cm mass on the posterior side of the thyroid gland. Arterial phase abdominal contrast CT revealed a 1 cm mass in the body of the pancreas that was strongly enhanced. Which hormone is thought to be elevated in this patient?

Question: 22 歳の女性。無月経を主訴に来院した。初経は12 歳。13 歳から不規則月経となり14 歳から無月経となった。特に困っていることはなかったが、職場の同僚にすすめられて産婦人科を受診した。家族歴、既往歴に特記すべきことはない。身長164 cm、体重56 kg。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧106/76 mmHg。甲状腺腫大は認めない。乳房発育は不良。乳頭の圧迫で乳汁分泌を両側に認める。外性器は女性型。陰毛と腋毛に異常を認めない。子宮長は 3cm、子宮内膜は薄い。両側卵巣は正常大。基礎体温は1相性である。高値が予想されるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 22-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of amenorrhea. Her first menstruation was at age 12. She began having irregular menstruation at age 13, and amenorrhea continued from age 14. Although she was not particularly bothered by anything, she visited an obstetrician-gynecologist on the recommendation of a colleague at work. There is nothing of note in her family history or medical history. Height 164 cm, weight 56 ​​kg. Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 106/76 mmHg. There is no evidence of thyroid enlargement. Breast development is poor. Milk secretion is observed on both sides when the nipples are pressed. The external genitalia are female. There are no abnormalities in the pubic and axillary hair. The uterine length is 3 cm, and the endometrium is thin. Both ovaries are of normal size. Basal body temperature is monophasic. Which of the following would be expected to be high?

Question: 53 歳の男性。家族からいびきを指摘されたことを主訴に来院した。10 年ぶりに会った友人に鼻が大きくなって顔つきが変わったと言われた。最近靴が窮屈になってきている。2年前に手根管症候群で手術。身長173 cm、体重72 kg。体温36.4℃。脈拍56/分、整。血圧156/90 mmHg。血液生化学検査：AST 38 U/L、ALT 42 U/L、ALP 256 U/L（基準38〜113）、空腹時血糖126 mg/dL、総コレステロール254 mg/dL、トリグリセリド216 mg/dL、HDL コレステロール48 mg/dL。この患者の確定診断に必要な内分泌検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 53-year-old man visits the hospital complaining that his family has pointed out his snoring. A friend he hadn't seen in 10 years said that his nose has gotten bigger and his face has changed. His shoes have become too tight recently. He had surgery for carpal tunnel syndrome two years ago. His height is 173 cm, his weight is 72 kg. His body temperature is 36.4°C. His pulse is 56 beats per minute and is regular. His blood pressure is 156/90 mmHg. His blood chemistry test results are AST 38 U/L, ALT 42 U/L, ALP 256 U/L (normal range 38-113), fasting blood glucose 126 mg/dL, total cholesterol 254 mg/dL, triglycerides 216 mg/dL, and HDL cholesterol 48 mg/dL. Which endocrine test is necessary to make a definitive diagnosis for this patient?

Question: 32 歳の女性。昨晩同意のない性行為を強要され、本日警察官に付き添われて受診した。警察官から被害状況の説明を受け、診察をすることになった。月経周期は28 日型、整、順。最終月経は12 日前から5日間。対応として適切でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 32-year-old woman was forced to have sex without her consent last night and visited the doctor today accompanied by a police officer. The police officer explained the situation to her and decided to examine her. Her menstrual cycle is 28 days, regular, and regular. Her last menstrual period occurred 12 days before and 5 days after. Which of the following is not an appropriate response?

Question: 10 か月の男児。嘔吐と血便を主訴に母親に連れられて来院した。今朝から急に嘔吐が続き、時折激しく泣くこともあり、昼間から血便が複数回みられた。意識は清明だが不機嫌で激しく泣いている。体温37.2 ℃。脈拍160/分、整。血圧84/52 mmHg。呼吸数30/分。毛細血管再充満時間1秒。SpO2 99 %(room air)。心音と呼吸音に異常を認めない。腹部は軟で、右上腹部に腫瘤を触知する。血液検査所見に異常を認めない。腹部エックス線写真では右上腹部に腸管ガス像がなく、鏡面像や腹腔内遊離ガス像は認めなかった。腹部超音波像ではtarget sign を認めた。保護者への説明として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 10-month-old boy was brought to the hospital by his mother complaining of vomiting and bloody stools. He started vomiting suddenly this morning and occasionally cried violently. He had several episodes of bloody stools during the day. He is conscious but in a bad mood and has been crying violently. Temperature 37.2°C. Pulse 160 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 84/52 mmHg. Respiratory rate 30 breaths/min. Capillary refill time 1 second. SpO2 99% (room air). No abnormalities were found in heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen is soft, and a mass is palpable in the right upper quadrant. No abnormalities were found in blood test results. An abdominal X-ray showed no signs of intestinal gas in the right upper quadrant, and no signs of air-fluid content or free gas in the abdominal cavity. An abdominal ultrasound showed a target sign. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation for the parents?

Question: 45 歳の男性。労作時の息切れ、全身倦怠感を主訴に来院した。5年前からサイクリングで遠出をすると息切れを自覚していた。徐々により軽い労作で症状が出現するようになり、半年前からは15 分程度の通勤でも息切れが出現し、駅の階段を一気に昇れないこともあった。会社の健診では、以前から心雑音を指摘されていたが精査は行っていない。家族歴に特記すべきことはない。意識は清明。体温36.0℃。脈拍88/分、整。血圧124/72 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 95 %(room air)。呼吸音に異常を認めない。Levine 4/6 の収縮期雑音を聴取する。心電図では左室高電位、心室期外収縮の3連発を認めた。心エコー検査では左室拡張末期径は60 mm、左室駆出率は40 %であり、大動脈弁は二尖弁と判断された。連続波ドプラ法による測定では大動脈弁最大血流速度は5.0 m/秒であり、大動脈弁口面積は0.65 cm2 と推定された。適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 45-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of shortness of breath on exertion and general fatigue. Five years ago, he noticed shortness of breath when cycling long distances. Gradually, the symptoms appeared with lighter exertion, and six months ago, he became short of breath even during a 15-minute commute, and was sometimes unable to climb the stairs at the station in one go. A cardiac murmur had been noted in company health checkups, but no detailed examination was performed. There was nothing of note in his family history. He was conscious and alert. Body temperature was 36.0°C. Pulse rate was 88 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure was 124/72 mmHg. Respiratory rate was 16 beats/min. SpO2 was 95% (room air). No abnormalities were noted in his breath sounds. A systolic murmur of Levine 4/6 was heard. An electrocardiogram showed left ventricular high voltage and three consecutive ventricular premature contractions. Echocardiography revealed that the left ventricular end-diastolic diameter was 60 mm, the left ventricular ejection fraction was 40%, and the aortic valve was determined to be bicuspid. Continuous wave Doppler measurements showed that the maximum aortic valve blood flow velocity was 5.0 m/s, and the aortic valve orifice area was estimated to be 0.65 cm2. Which is the appropriate response?

Question: 19 歳の男性。実験中に水酸化ナトリウム液を右眼に浴び、救急受診した。意識は清明。右眼の結膜浮腫が著明であり、角膜が白濁している。まず行うべきなのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 19-year-old male was exposed to sodium hydroxide solution in his right eye during an experiment and visited the emergency room. He was fully conscious. He had significant conjunctival edema in his right eye and a cloudy cornea. What should be done first?

Question: 24 歳の医療職。採血中に患者に使用した注射針を誤って指に刺した。患者と医療職の検査結果を示す。患者：HBs 抗原(+)、HBs 抗体(-)、HCV 抗体(-) 医療職：HBs 抗原(-)、HBs 抗体(-)、HCV 抗体(-) 医療職への対応として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 24-year-old medical professional. While taking blood, he accidentally pricked his finger with the needle used on a patient. The test results of the patient and medical professional are shown below. Patient: HBs antigen (+), HBs antibody (-), HCV antibody (-) Medical professional: HBs antigen (-), HBs antibody (-), HCV antibody (-) Which of the following is the appropriate response for the medical professional?

Question: 18 歳の男子。全身倦怠感と発熱を主訴に来院した。2 週間前から労作時の息切れを自覚していた。3 日前から38 ℃台の発熱と全身倦怠感があり受診した。身長 170 cm、体重 60 kg。体温 38.3 ℃。脈拍 100/分、整。血圧 118/64 mmHg。両下肢に点状出血を認める。眼瞼結膜は貧血様であるが、眼球結膜に黄染を認めない。胸骨右縁第 2 肋間を最強点とする Levine 2/6 の収縮期駆出性雑音を聴取する。呼吸音に異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。圧痛を認めない。血液所見：赤血球 230 万、Hb 6.8 g/dL、Ht 20 %、白血球 1,400 (分葉核好中球 24 %、単球 2 %、リンパ球 74 %)、血小板 1.2 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白 6.8 g/dL、アルブミン 3.4 g/dL、総ビリルビン 0.7 mg/dL、AST 56 U/L、ALT 71 U/L、LD 158 U/L（基準 120〜245）、尿素窒素 14 mg/dL、クレアチニン 0.7 mg/dL、血糖 98 mg/dL。CRP 4.2 mg/dL。骨髄生検では著明な低形成所見を認める。この患者で低下するのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 18-year-old boy was admitted to the hospital complaining of general fatigue and fever. He had been aware of shortness of breath on exertion for the past two weeks. He visited the hospital because he had had a fever of 38°C and general fatigue for the past three days. Height 170 cm, weight 60 kg. Body temperature 38.3°C. Pulse 100 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 118/64 mmHg. Petechia was present in both lower limbs. The palpebral conjunctiva appeared anemic, but there was no yellowing of the bulbar conjunctiva. A systolic ejection murmur of Levine 2/6 was heard, with the strongest point at the second intercostal space on the right sternal border. No abnormalities were noted in the breath sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. There was no tenderness. Blood findings: Red blood cells 2.3 million, Hb 6.8 g/dL, Ht 20%, White blood cells 1,400 (segmented neutrophils 24%, monocytes 2%, lymphocytes 74%), platelets 12,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 6.8 g/dL, albumin 3.4 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.7 mg/dL, AST 56 U/L, ALT 71 U/L, LD 158 U/L (normal 120-245), urea nitrogen 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, blood glucose 98 mg/dL. CRP 4.2 mg/dL. Bone marrow biopsy shows significant hypoplasia. Which of the following is decreased in this patient?

Question: 2か月の女児。けいれん重積のため救急車で搬入された。母親によると夜間寝ていてけいれんが始まった。救急車内で心肺停止となり心肺蘇生を試みたが、来院時は心拍の再開がなく、対光反射は消失していた。蘇生を継続したが心拍の再開がなく死亡が確認された。母子手帳によると妊娠分娩歴に異常はないが、1か月健診は受診していない。顔面や体幹に新旧混在した皮下出血の散在を認めた。死後に行った頭部CT では両側に硬膜下血腫とびまん性脳浮腫を認めた。全身エックス線写真では左大骨骨折、右上腕骨骨折を認めた。母親は外傷に心当たりはないという。死亡に至った原因として最も考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 2-month-old girl was brought in by ambulance due to status epilepticus. According to her mother, the convulsions began while she was sleeping at night. She went into cardiac arrest in the ambulance and cardiopulmonary resuscitation was attempted, but by the time she arrived at the hospital, her heart had not resumed and her light reflex had disappeared. Resuscitation efforts continued, but her heart did not resume and she was confirmed dead. According to her maternal and child health handbook, there were no abnormalities in her pregnancy or delivery history, but she had not attended her one-month checkup. Scattered subcutaneous hemorrhages, both old and new, were noted on the face and trunk. A postmortem head CT scan revealed subdural hematomas and diffuse cerebral edema on both sides. A whole-body X-ray revealed a fracture of the left femur fracture, right humerus fracture The mother said she had no known trauma. Which of the following is the most likely cause of death?

Question: 78 歳の女性。1週間前から38 ℃台の発熱が持続し、全身倦怠感のため来院した。身長151 cm、体重42 kg。体温38.2 ℃。脈拍92/分、整。血圧84/50 mmHg。胸腹部に異常所見を認めない。皮膚の乾燥や四肢に浮腫を認めない。血液生化学所見：尿素窒素24 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、空腹時血糖65 mg/dL、Na 129 mEq/L、K 5.1 mEq/L、抗利尿ホルモン1.4 pg/mL（基準0.5〜2.0）。随時尿での尿中Na は16 mEq/L であった。この患者で認められる所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 78-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital one week ago due to a persistent fever of 38°C and general fatigue. Height 151 cm, weight 42 kg. Body temperature 38.2°C. Pulse 92 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 84/50 mmHg. No abnormal findings were noted in the chest and abdomen. No dry skin or edema was noted in the extremities. Blood biochemistry findings: urea nitrogen 24 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, fasting blood glucose 65 mg/dL, sodium 129 mEq/L, potassium 5.1 mEq/L, antidiuretic hormone 1.4 pg/mL (normal: 0.5-2.0). Urinary sodium in a random urine sample was 16 mEq/L. Which finding would be observed in this patient?

Question: 61 歳の男性。右膝痛を主訴に来院した。疼痛のため一本杖歩行をしている。2か月前に大腸癌の手術を受け、現在薬物による抗癌治療中である。余命は2年以上と考えられている。意識は清明。身長172 cm、体重75 kg。右膝は高度の内反変形があり、屈曲80 度、伸展-20 度の可動域制限がある。右膝関節の単純エックス線写真で変形性膝関節症を認め、人工膝関節置換術の適応とされた。今後の治療の組合せとして適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 61-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of right knee pain. He walks with one cane due to the pain. He underwent surgery for colon cancer two months ago and is currently undergoing drug treatment for cancer. His life expectancy is thought to be at least two years. He is conscious and alert. He is 172 cm tall and weighs 75 kg. His right knee has severe varus deformity, with a limited range of motion of 80 degrees flexion and -20 degrees extension. A plain X-ray of the right knee joint revealed osteoarthritis, and he was diagnosed with total knee replacement surgery. Which of the following would be the most appropriate combination of future treatments?

Question: 担当した患者の症例報告を論文発表することにした。適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: I decided to publish a paper on the case report of a patient I treated. Which of the following is appropriate?

Question: 異常呼吸あるいは息切れを主訴とする患者の所見と原因の組合せについて正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is a correct combination of findings and causes in a patient whose main complaint is abnormal breathing or shortness of breath?

Question: 患者の言葉のうち幻聴ではないと考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the patient's statements is not an auditory hallucination?

Question: 抗菌薬の適正使用について誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect regarding the appropriate use of antibiotics?

Question: 意識障害のある患者に行うことが困難な身体診察はどれか。
Question_EN: Which physical examination would be difficult to perform on a patient who is unconscious?

Question: 治療後の経過に関して主治医以外に相談を希望する場合、助言や情報提供を行う施設はどれか。
Question_EN: If a patient wishes to seek advice from someone other than their primary care physician regarding their progress after treatment, which facility can provide advice and information?

Question: 妊娠後期に比べ妊娠初期に高値を示すのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is higher in early pregnancy than in later pregnancy?

Question: 加齢に伴う変化について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is true regarding changes that occur with age?

Question: 医療面接において患者と良好なコミュニケーションを行うために適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is appropriate for establishing good communication with patients during a medical interview?

Question: 社会保障制度について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is true about the social security system?

Question: 咽頭痛を訴える患者に確認すべき緊急性の高い随伴症状はどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following symptoms should be checked urgently in a patient complaining of a sore throat?

Question: 幼児期以降に筋力低下が明らかになるのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following causes muscle weakness after early childhood?

Question: 高齢者の個性と尊厳を尊重する介護の在り方について適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is an appropriate way of providing care that respects the individuality and dignity of the elderly?

Question: 疾患・状態とそのリスクとなる行動との組合せについて誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect regarding the pairing of a disease/condition and the behavior that poses a risk for it?

Question: 成人の安静時所見のうち異常なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following resting findings in adults is abnormal?

Question: 経管栄養を目的とした仰臥位での経鼻胃管の挿入について適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is appropriate regarding insertion of a nasogastric tube in the supine position for the purpose of tube feeding?

Question: 小児の二次救命処置を2名で行う場合、人工呼吸と胸骨圧迫の比で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: When two people are performing advanced life support on a child, what is the correct ratio of artificial respiration to chest compressions?

Question: 57 歳の男性。21 歳から1日に20 本の喫煙をしている。45 歳から49 歳まで禁煙をしたが、1日に20 本の喫煙を再開した。喫煙指数はいくつか。
Question_EN: A 57-year-old man has been smoking 20 cigarettes a day since he was 21 years old. He quit smoking between the ages of 45 and 49, but resumed smoking 20 cigarettes a day. What is his smoking index?

Question: 乳房の悪性疾患を疑わせる所見として可能性が低いのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following findings is unlikely to suggest a malignant breast disease?

Question: 足関節背屈の徒手筋力テストにおいて、足関節の動きを認めず前脛骨筋の収縮のみを認めた。評価はどれか。
Question_EN: In manual muscle testing of ankle dorsiflexion, no movement of the ankle was observed, and only contraction of the tibialis anterior muscle was observed. Which is the evaluation?

Question: 脳脊髄液検査結果を評価する際、脳脊髄液の検査結果と血液の検査結果を比較すべきものはどれか。
Question_EN: When evaluating cerebrospinal fluid test results, which cerebrospinal fluid test results should be compared with which blood test results?

Question: インスリンに関する医学史で最も新しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: What is the most recent development in medical history regarding insulin?

Question: 息切れと下肢の浮腫を呈し、心不全が疑われる患者に医療面接を行っている。開放型質問はどれか。
Question_EN: A medical interview is being conducted on a patient who is experiencing shortness of breath and swelling in the lower extremities and is suspected to have heart failure. Which open-ended question would be appropriate?

Question: 退院時要約について誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect regarding discharge summaries?

Question: 48 歳の女性。右上肢の運動障害を主訴に来院した。昨晩飲酒後、食卓の椅子で右の肘掛けにもたれかかって寝たところ、目が覚めると右手関節の背屈ができなくなっていたため受診した。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。意識は清明。身長165 cm、体重53 kg。体温36.3 ℃。体表に外傷はない。橈骨動脈は両側で良好に触知する。頸部痛はない。右手背に感覚鈍麻がある。右手関節の背屈ができず、右手指のMP 関節の伸展ができない。上下肢の他の筋力は正常である。障害が疑われるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 48-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of motor disorders in her right upper limb. After drinking alcohol the night before, she had fallen asleep leaning against the right arm of a dining chair, and when she woke up, she was unable to dorsiflex her right wrist, so she visited the hospital. There is nothing notable in her medical history. She is conscious and alert. Her height is 165 cm, her weight is 53 kg, her body temperature is 36.3°C, and there is no trauma on the surface of her body. The radial arteries are well palpable on both sides. There is no neck pain. There is hypoesthesia on the dorsum of the right hand. She is unable to dorsiflex her right wrist, and is unable to extend the MP joints of her right fingers. Other muscle strength in the upper and lower limbs is normal. Which of the following is suspected to be a disorder?

Question: 54 歳の女性。3日前に子宮筋腫のため子宮摘出術を受け入院中である。本日、洗面所で洗顔していたところ突然呼吸困難が生じ、持続している。咳嗽はない。胸痛はない。喫煙歴はない。意識は清明。体温36.4 ℃。脈拍112/分、整。血圧102/62 mmHg。呼吸数24/分。SpO2 89 %(room air)。呼吸音に異常を認めない。最も可能性が高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 54-year-old woman has been hospitalized since undergoing a hysterectomy for uterine fibroid 3 days ago. Today, while washing her face in the bathroom, she suddenly experienced dyspnea, which has continued ever since. She has no cough. She has no chest pain. She has no history of smoking. She is alert and conscious. Body temperature 36.4°C. Pulse rate 112 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 102/62 mmHg. Respiratory rate 24 breaths/min. SpO2 89% (room air). No abnormalities were noted in her breath sounds. Which of the following is most likely?

Question: 83歳の女性。4日前からの右腰部痛と悪寒戦慄を伴う発熱を主訴に来院した。来院時、意識は清明。見当識障害はない。体温38.6℃。脈拍102/分、整。血圧138/88 mmHg。呼吸数24/分。SpO2 97%(room air)。頭頸部に異常を認めない。心臓の聴診で心尖部を最強点とするLevine 3/6の収縮期雑音を聴取する。呼吸音に異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。四肢・末端に皮疹を認めない。入院時に行った血液培養2セット(4本)からクラスター状に集簇するグラム陽性球菌が検出された。次に行うべき検査はどれか。
Question_EN: An 83-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital complaining of right lumbar pain and fever with chills and shivers for the past 4 days. On presentation, she was alert and had no disorientation. Temperature 38.6°C. Pulse 102 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 138/88 mmHg. Respiratory rate 24 beats/min. SpO2 97% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the head and neck. Cardiac auscultation revealed a Levine 3/6 systolic murmur with the apex being the strongest point. No abnormalities were found in the breath sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, with the liver and spleen not palpable. No rash was found on the extremities or extremities. Two sets of blood cultures (4 tubes) performed on admission revealed clusters of gram-positive cocci. Which test should be performed next?

Question: 84歳の男性。体重減少を主訴に来院した。妻と長男の3人暮らし。検査の結果、大腸を原発とする悪性腫瘍で遠隔転移を認めた。原発巣、転移巣ともに手術による切除は不可能である。本人は告知を望んでいるが、薬物による抗癌治療は望んでいない。長男は告知も積極的治療も望んでいない。主治医は薬物による抗がん治療を行いたいと考えている。認知機能は改訂長谷川式簡易知能評価スケールで22点(30点満点)。この患者の治療方針を決定する上で最も重要な因子はどれか。
Question_EN: An 84-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of weight loss. He lives with his wife and eldest son. Examination revealed a malignant tumor originating from the large intestine with distant metastasis. Surgical removal of both the primary and metastatic lesions is impossible. The patient wishes to be informed of the disease, but does not wish to undergo drug-based anti-cancer treatment. His eldest son does not wish to be informed of the disease or to undergo aggressive treatment. His doctor wishes to perform drug-based anti-cancer treatment. His cognitive function was 22 points (out of a possible 30 points) on the revised Hasegawa Dementia Scale. Which of the following is the most important factor in determining this patient's treatment plan?

Question: 40 歳の女性。1か月前に腹部膨満を主訴に婦人科外来を受診し、精査の結果卵巣腫瘍の診断を受け、摘出手術を受けるため2週間前に入院した。身長104 cm、体重25 kg。骨形成不全症のため、年1回整形外科を定期受診している。歩行困難があり日常的に電動車いすを用いている。夫と5歳の男児との3人暮らし。ネットショップを経営している。日常生活をサポートするため数人のボランティアが入れ替わりで支援している。術後経過は良好で術中病理診断の結果は良性であった。入院中に新たな機能障害は認めなかった。入院中の主治医として退院に向けて必要なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 40-year-old woman visited the gynecology outpatient clinic one month ago complaining of abdominal distension, and after detailed examination was diagnosed with an ovarian tumor. She was admitted to the hospital two weeks ago for surgery to remove the tumor. She is 104 cm tall and weighs 25 kg. She visits an orthopedic clinic once a year due to osteogenesis imperfecta. She has difficulty walking and uses an electric wheelchair on a daily basis. She lives with her husband and a 5-year-old son. She runs an online shop. Several volunteers take turns to support her in her daily life. The postoperative course was uneventful, and the results of the intraoperative pathological diagnosis were benign. No new functional disorders were noted during her hospitalization. As the attending physician during this hospitalization, which of the following is necessary to prepare for discharge?
ensemble_occupation: ネットショップを経営している

Question: 80 歳の女性。3日前、肺炎のため入院した。肺炎は改善傾向である。夜中にトイレに行こうとして病室内で転倒した。頭部打撲はなく痛みの訴えもない。トイレに行くときにはナースコールを押して知らせるように伝えていたが、ナースコールは押されていなかった。入院後は不眠のため、ベンゾジアゼピン系薬剤を内服していた。入院前のADL は自立していた。翌日行われたカンファレンスでの提案として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 80-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital with pneumonia three days ago. Her pneumonia is improving. She fell in her hospital room while trying to go to the toilet in the middle of the night. She did not suffer a head injury and is not complaining of pain. She had been instructed to press the nurse call button when going to the toilet, but this was not done. Since being admitted to the hospital, she has been taking benzodiazepines for insomnia. She was independent in her ADLs before being admitted to the hospital. Which of the following would be an appropriate suggestion to make at the conference held the following day?

Question: 54 歳の女性。半年前から駅の階段を昇るときに胸部に違和感が生じるようになったため来院した。検査の結果、冠動脈形成術が必要であると担当医から伝えられた。患者は｢病状は両親や兄弟、および勤務先には伝えないでほしい｣と希望を述べた。10 年前から会社で勤務しており、一人暮らしである。職場の健康診断では異常を指摘されていない。医師の患者への適切な説明はどれか。
Question_EN: A 54-year-old woman visited the hospital because she had been experiencing chest discomfort when climbing stairs at the station for the past six months. As a result of the examination, her doctor told her that she would need coronary angioplasty. The patient expressed her request that her parents, siblings, and workplace not be informed of her condition. She has been working at a company for the past 10 years and lives alone. No abnormalities were found in her workplace health checkups. Which of the following is the most appropriate explanation for the doctor to give to the patient?

Question: 78 歳の女性。左側が見えにくいことを主訴に来院した。本日、朝食時に左側にある味噌汁に気づかず、手をぶつけてこぼした。その後、部屋の戸口に左肩をぶつけた。高血圧症と心房細動で内服加療中である。意識は清明。体温36.5 ℃。脈拍80/分、不整。血圧154/94 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 96 %:room air)。対座法で左視野障害を認める。四肢の明らかな麻痺は認めない。血液所見：赤血球452万、Hb 13.1 g/dL、Ht 41 %、白血球8,000、血小板20 万、PT-INR 1.0(基準0.9〜1.1)。血液生化学所見：尿素窒素15 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL、血糖102 mg/dL、Na 139 mEq/L、K 3.8 mEq/L、Cl 99 mEq/L。障害部位はどこか。
Question_EN: A 78-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of difficulty seeing on the left side. Today, during breakfast, she did not notice the miso soup on her left side and bumped her hand into it, spilling it. Afterwards, she hit her left shoulder on the door of the room. She is currently receiving oral medication for hypertension and atrial fibrillation. She is conscious and alert. Body temperature 36.5°C. Pulse rate 80 beats/min, irregular. Blood pressure 154/94 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16 breaths/min. SpO2 96%: room air). Sitting face-to-face revealed impaired left visual field. No obvious paralysis of the limbs was noted. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.52 million, hemoglobin 13.1 g/dL, hematocrit 41%, white blood cells 8,000, platelets 200,000, PT-INR 1.0 (normal 0.9-1.1). Blood biochemistry: Urea nitrogen 15 mg/dL, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, blood glucose 102 mg/dL, Na 139 mEq/L, K 3.8 mEq/L, Cl 99 mEq/L. Where is the site of impairment?

Question:
26 歳の初妊婦。妊娠 24 週で妊婦健康診査のため来院した。既往歴に特記すべき ことはない。身長 160 cm、体重 66 kg(非妊時 58 kg)。体温 37.0 °C。脈拍 72/分、 整。血圧 134/72 mmHg。子宮底長 21 cm、腹囲 85 cm。下腿に軽度浮腫を認める。 尿所見:蛋白(-)、糖2+。空腹時血糖値 132 mg/dL。
まず行う対応として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 26-year-old primigravida woman visited the hospital for a prenatal checkup at 24 weeks pregnant. There was nothing notable in her medical history. Height 160 cm, weight 66 kg (58 kg when non-pregnant). Body temperature 37.0 °C. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 134/72 mmHg. Uterine fundus length 21 cm, abdominal circumference 85 cm. Mild edema was noted in the lower legs. Urine findings: protein (-), glucose 2+. Fasting blood glucose 132 mg/dL.
Which of the following would be the most appropriate first course of action?

Question:
19 歳の男性。交通外傷のため救急車で搬入された。河川沿いの堤防道路でオー トバイ運転中に対向車と接触し転倒、崖下に転落した。問いかけに対して名前は言える。心拍数 122/分。血圧 72/50 mmHg。呼吸数 28/分。SpO 96 %(room air)。
右前胸部に圧痛があり、右呼吸音が減弱している。腹部は膨満している。右下肢は外旋位で右下腿の変形と開放創を認める。大量輸液を行っても血圧の上昇がみられなかった。出血の持続と凝固障害の合併が懸念されるため、血液型の確定を待たずに院内にある輸血製剤を用いて輸血療法を行うことにした。投与が可能な濃厚赤血球液と新鮮凍結血漿の組合せはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 19-year-old male was brought to the hospital by ambulance due to injuries sustained during a traffic accident. While driving a motorcycle on a riverbank, he collided with an oncoming vehicle, fell over, and fell off a cliff. He was able to say his name when asked. Heart rate: 122 beats per minute. Blood pressure: 72/50 mmHg. Respiratory rate: 28 beats per minute. SpO2: 96% (room air).

There was tenderness in the right anterior chest, and right-sided breath sounds were weakened. The abdomen was distended. The right lower limb was in an externally rotated position, with a deformed right lower leg and an open wound. Despite administering a large volume of fluid, there was no increase in blood pressure. Due to concerns about continued bleeding and the possibility of coagulation disorders, it was decided to perform transfusion therapy using blood transfusion products available at the hospital without waiting for confirmation of the blood type. Which combination of packed red blood cell solution and fresh frozen plasma can be administered?"

Question: 88 歳の男性。長年の喫煙に起因する慢性閉塞性肺疾患と弁膜症による重症の呼吸不全および心不全のため入院した。疾患自体の改善は難しく、呼吸の苦しさや体幹のだるさなどの苦痛の訴えが強く、本人は緩和ケアを望んでいる。妻と二人暮らしで長男が近所に住んでおり家族関係は良好である。この患者に緩和ケアを行うにあたり、対応として誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 88-year-old man was hospitalized with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease caused by years of smoking and severe respiratory failure and heart failure due to valvular disease. The disease itself is difficult to improve, and he strongly complains of pain such as shortness of breath and trunk fatigue, and he wishes to receive palliative care. He lives with his wife and has a good family relationship with his eldest son, who lives nearby. Which of the following is the wrong response when providing palliative care to this patient?

Question: 35 歳の男性。登山道脇で動けなくなっているところを発見された。ドクターカーで出動した医師が登山口で待機していた。現地の天候は雨、気温は10 ℃。医師がこの男性に接触した時、意識レベルはJCSⅡ-30。体温(直腸温)31.4 ℃。脈拍58/分、整。血圧102/62 mmHg。呼吸数30/分。SpO2 は測定できず、末梢循環不全によるものと考えられた。病院前救護として誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 35-year-old man was found unable to move beside a hiking trail. A doctor was dispatched in a medical car and was waiting at the trailhead. The local weather was rainy, with an air temperature of 10°C. When the doctor made contact with the man, his level of consciousness was JCS II-30. Body temperature (rectal temperature) was 31.4°C. Pulse rate was 58 beats per minute and regular. Blood pressure was 102/62 mmHg. Respiratory rate was 30 breaths per minute. SpO2 could not be measured, and it was thought that the cause was peripheral circulatory failure. Which of the following is incorrect pre-hospital aid?

Question:
76 歳の男性。食欲低下と全身倦怠感を主訴に来院した。
現病歴 : 58 歳時に高血圧症と診断され、内服加療を受けていた。5年前から尿蛋白1g/日以上が持続するようになり、腎機能も徐々に増悪してきていた。1週間前から食欲が低下し、全身倦怠感が強くなってきたため、外来通院中の病院を受診した。
既往歴 : 72 歳時に狭心症で入院加療歴がある。
生活歴 : 喫煙歴は 20 歳から 40 本/日を 56 年間。飲酒は日本酒1合/日。

Family history: Her mother died of cerebral hemorrhage at the age of 85.
Current illness: Her consciousness level is JCSIII-300. Her height is 160 cm, her weight is 54 kg, and her body temperature is 36.0 °C. Heart rate 64 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 98/50 mmHg. Ventilation rate 10/min. SpO2 92% (controlled respiration using bag-valve-mask ventilation). The the tongue base collapse was observed. The pupils are 4 mm in diameter on both sides, and the light reflex is delayed on both sides. The electrocardiogram monitor shows sinus rhythm, but giant negative T waves are observed.
Which of the following should be done first when transporting the patient?

Question: 在宅医療を想定している患者・家族への説明で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is an appropriate explanation to give to patients and their families who are considering home medical care?

Question: 低栄養が疑われる高齢者(BMI 18 kg/m2、6か月で3kgの体重減少)で腎障害がない場合の栄養管理として適切でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not appropriate nutritional management for an elderly person suspected of malnutrition (BMI 18 kg/m2, weight loss of 3 kg in 6 months) who does not have renal impairment?

Question: 医療施設における感染制御チームが行わないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following does not an infection control team in a healthcare facility do?

Question: 地域保健医療について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding community health care?

Question: ｢新生児の出生直後の胃内容物を採取してピペットで吸排して泡立てる。その後4分間静置して、顕微鏡で1mm2 あたりの直径15 μm 未満の泡の数をカウントする｣上記の検査はどの疾患を診断するためのものか。
Question_EN: "The stomach contents of a newborn baby are collected immediately after birth and foamed by suction and withdrawal with a pipette.The sample is then left to sit for four minutes and the number of bubbles less than 15 μm in diameter per 1 mm2 are counted under a microscope."What disease is this test used to diagnose?

Question: パンデミックについて適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is true about pandemics?

Question: レム睡眠で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which is correct regarding REM sleep?

Question: 高額療養費制度において、患者の年齢に加えて月の自己負担限度額を規定する条件はどれか。
Question_EN: Under the High-Cost Medical Care Expenses System, in addition to the patient's age, which condition determines the monthly out-of-pocket payment limit?

Question: ｢がん対策推進基本計画(平成30 年3月) ｣において推進されるべきとされている緩和ケアについて誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect about palliative care, which is stated to be promoted in the "Basic Plan for Promoting Cancer Control (March 2018)" ?

Question: A医師は地域で禁煙を進めるための様々な活動をしている。定期的に地域の小学校に出向いて①小学生への禁煙教育を行い、近くの企業の②産業医として禁煙活動を行っている。また、自らの診療所で③喫煙者の健康診断や④慢性閉塞性肺疾患の患者の呼吸リハビリテーションも行っている。週末には近所の産婦人科に出かけ、母親学級で⑤喫煙妊婦の禁煙指導も行っている。①から⑤のうち、三次予防はどれか。
Question_EN: Doctor A is involved in various activities to promote smoking cessation in the community. He regularly visits local elementary schools to provide smoking cessation education to elementary school students, and he also works as an industrial physician for a nearby company, campaigning for smoking cessation. He also provides health checkups for smokers at his own clinic, and provides respiratory rehabilitation for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. On weekends, he visits a nearby obstetrics and gynecology clinic, where he teaches pregnant women who smoke to quit smoking at mother's classes. Which of the numbered items is an example of tertiary prevention?

Question: 滲出性胸水をきたす疾患に含まれないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not a disease that can cause exudative pleural effusion?

Question: ノロウイルスの不活化に有効なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is effective in inactivating norovirus?

Question: 尖足を認め、足関節底屈20 度の位置から他動的に背屈させることができない。関節可動域の足関節背屈角度の記載として正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: The patient has an equinus and is unable to achieve passive ankle dorsiflexion beyond 20 degrees of plantarflexion. Which of the following is a correct description of the ankle dorsiflexion angle in the range of motion of the joint?

Question: 総人口を分母とする指標はどれか。
Question_EN: Which indicator has the total population as the denominator?

Question: 痛みを主訴に受診するのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which patient would visit the hospital with the primary complaint of pain?

Question: 慢性炎症に伴う貧血で増加するのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following increases in anemia associated with chronic inflammation?

Question: 生理食塩液輸液下で2日間の絶食により上昇するのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following would increase after fasting for 2 days while receiving saline infusion?

Question: 我が国における近年の疾病や疾病リスクについて正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding diseases and disease risks in Japan in recent years?

Question: 炎症性疾患にみられるCRP 上昇に最も関与するサイトカインはどれか。
Question_EN: Which cytokine is most involved in the increase in CRP seen in inflammatory diseases?

Question: Which is the most likely personal information that can be used to identify an individual person?
Question_EN: Which is the most likely personal information that can be used to identify an individual person?

Question: 発声時に活動する内喉頭筋を支配する神経はどれか。
Question_EN: Which nerve controls the intrinsic laryngeal muscles that are active during phonation?

Question: 地方衛生研究所の業務でないのはどれか
Question_EN: Which of the following is not a task of local public health institutes?

Question: 2009 年に比較して 2019 年の数値が上昇しているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following has increased in 2019 compared to 2009?

Question: 75 歳の女性。血便を主訴に来院した。半年前から時折暗赤色の血便があったが、自然軽快するため様子をみていた。3日前から再び血便が出現したため受診した。受診日の朝には普通便に戻っていた。既往歴に特記すべきことはなく、現在内服薬はない。意識は清明。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍84/分、整。血圧116/84 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 96 % (room air) 。眼瞼結膜に軽度貧血を認める。腹部は平坦、軟で、圧痛を認めない。直腸指診で異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球345 万、Hb 8.6 g/dL、Ht 26 %、白血球7,400、血小板26 万、血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.8 g/dL、アルブミン3.6 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.9 mg/dL、AST 26 U/L、ALT 27 U/L、LD 265 U/L(基準値120〜245)、アミラーゼ65 U/L(基準37〜160) 、尿素窒素21 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL、Fe 23 μg/dL、フェリチン10 ng/mL(基準20〜120) 、TIBC 412 μg/dL(基準290〜390)、血糖101 mg/dL、Na 142 mEq/L、K 4.6 mEq/L、Cl 99 mEq/L。CRP 0.1 mg/dL。便潜血検査陽性。腹部造影CT、上部および下部消化管内視鏡検査を施行したが病変は認めなかった。次に行う検査として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 75-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of bloody stool. She had occasionally had dark red blood in her stool for the past 6 months, but the condition improved spontaneously, so the patient was monitored. She had had bloody stool again 3 days ago, so she visited the hospital. Her stool had returned to normal by the morning of the day of her visit. There was nothing notable in her medical history, and she was not currently taking any oral medications. She was conscious and alert. Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse rate 84 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 116/84 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16 breaths/min. SpO2 96% (room air). Mild anemia was noted in the palpebral conjunctiva. The abdomen was flat, soft, and not tender. Digital rectal examination revealed no abnormalities. Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.45 million, Hb 8.6 g/dL, Ht 26%, White blood cells 7,400, Platelets 260,000, Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 6.8 g/dL, Albumin 3.6 g/dL, Total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL, AST 26 U/L, ALT 27 U/L, LD 265 U/L (standard value 120-245), Amylase 65 U/L (standard value 37-160), Urea nitrogen 21 mg/dL, Creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, Fe 23 μg/dL, Ferritin 10 ng/mL (standard value 20-120), TIBC 412 μg/dL (standard value 290-390), Blood glucose 101 mg/dL, Na 142 mEq/L, K 4.6 mEq/L, Cl 99 mEq/L. CRP 0.1 mg/dL. Fecal occult blood test was positive. Abdominal contrast CT and upper and lower gastrointestinal endoscopy were performed, but no lesions were found. Which of the following tests should be performed next?

Question: 56 歳の男性。自宅火災があり、初期消火を行おうとしたところ顔面、両手に受傷し救急搬送された。咽頭痛と咳嗽を訴えている。意識は清明。体温36.0 ℃。心拍数124/分、整。血圧140/90 mmHg。呼吸数24/分、喘鳴を聴取する。SpO2 99%(マスク6L/分 酸素投与下) 。顔面および口腔に煤が付着しており、毛髪が焼けている。胸部エックス線写真では異常を認めない。次に行うべき検査として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 56-year-old man was rushed to the hospital after a fire broke out in his home and he sustained injuries to his face and both hands while attempting to put out the initial flames. He complained of a sore throat and cough. He was alert and conscious. Body temperature 36.0°C. Heart rate 124 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 140/90 mmHg. Respiratory rate 24 breaths/min, wheezing was heard. SpO2 99% (oxygen administered via mask at 6 L/min). Soot was found on his face and mouth, and his hair was burned. No abnormalities were found on his chest X-ray. Which of the following tests should be performed next?

Question: 64 歳の女性。1年前から徐々に物忘れがひどくなってきていることを心配した家族に伴われて来院した。最近は財布をしまったことや食事をしたことを思い出せないこともあるという。この患者の診断に有用な検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 64-year-old woman comes to the hospital accompanied by her family, who are concerned about her gradually worsening forgetfulness that began a year ago. Recently, she has been unable to remember putting her wallet away or having eaten. Which test would be useful in diagnosing this patient?

Question: 21 歳の女性。顔面の皮疹とふらつきを主訴に来院した。1か月前、海水浴に行った後から、微熱、顔面の皮疹、手指関節痛、ふらつきが出現し、改善がないため受診した。体温37.6 ℃。眼瞼結膜は貧血様で、眼球結膜に軽度黄染を認める。両頰部に紅斑を認める。硬口蓋粘膜に発赤とびらんを認める。両側の複数の近位指節間関節に腫脹と圧痛を認める。尿所見：蛋白2+、潜血3+、沈渣に赤血球、円柱を認めない。血液所見：赤血球298 万、Hb 7.9 g/dL、Ht 25 %、白血球2,800、血小板12 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.0 g/dL、アルブミン3.2 g/dL、AST 45 U/L、ALT 20 U/L、LD 298 U/L（基準120〜245）、ALP 98 U/L（基準38〜113）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL、Fe 42 μg/dL。免疫血清学所見：CRP 0.2 mg/dL、抗核抗体320 倍（基準20 以下）、抗dsDNA 抗体364 IU/mL（基準12 以下）、直接クームステスト陽性。この患者で予想される検査所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 21-year-old female presented to the clinic complaining of a facial rash and unsteadiness. One month prior, after swimming in the sea, she had developed a slight fever, facial rash, finger joint pain, and unsteadiness, and visited the hospital because there had been no improvement. Body temperature 37.6°C. The palpebral conjunctiva was anemic, and the bulbar conjunctiva was slightly yellowish. Erythema was present on both cheeks. Redness and erosion were present on the hard palate mucosa. Swelling and tenderness were present in multiple proximal interphalangeal joints on both sides. Urine findings: protein 2+, occult blood 3+, no red blood cells or casts in the sediment. Blood findings: red blood cells 2.98 million, hemoglobin 7.9 g/dL, hematocrit 25%, white blood cells 2,800, platelets 120,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.0 g/dL, albumin 3.2 g/dL, AST 45 U/L, ALT 20 U/L, LD 298 U/L (normal: 120-245), ALP 98 U/L (normal: 38-113), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, Fe 42 μg/dL. Immunoserological findings: CRP 0.2 mg/dL, antinuclear antibody titer: 1:320 (normal: ≤1:20), anti-dsDNA antibody 364 IU/mL (normal: 12 or less), direct Coombs test positive. Which of the following laboratory findings would be expected in this patient?

Question: 84 歳の女性。頭痛を主訴に来院した。今朝自宅内の段差で転倒し頭部を打撲し、頭痛を生じたため息子に付き添われて受診した。最近は歩行が小刻みになり自宅内でも転倒が多いという。息子とは同居しているが日中は仕事で不在である。自宅近くの診療所を不定期に受診しているが詳細は不明で、薬が自宅に多く残されているという。身長152 cm、体重46 kg。頭部以外に痛の訴えはない。歩行は小刻みで、両側上肢に筋強剛を認める。振戦はない。血液所見：赤血球421 万、Hb 12.0 g/dL、Ht 39 %、白血球7,600、血小板28 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.0 g/dL、アルブミン3.4 g/dL、尿素窒素25 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、血糖150 mg/dL、HbA1c 6.9 % (基準4.6〜6.2)、Na 143 mEq/L、K 4.3 mEq/L、Cl 108 mEq/L。頭部単純CT で頭蓋内出血を認めない。この患者への対応で適切でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 84-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of a headache. This morning she fell over a step at home, hit her head, and suffered a headache, so she was accompanied by her son. Recently, her gait has become choppy and she has been falling at home more often. She lives with her son, but he is away at work during the day. She visits a clinic near her home on an irregular basis, but the details are unknown, and she says that she has left a lot of her medication at home. She is 152 cm tall and weighs 46 kg. She has no complaints of pain other than in her head. She walks choppy, and there is rigidity in both upper limbs. There is no tremor. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.21 million, hemoglobin 12.0 g/dL, hematocrit 39%, white blood cells 7,600, platelets 280,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.0 g/dL, albumin 3.4 g/dL, urea nitrogen 25 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, blood glucose 150 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.9% (normal 4.6-6.2), Na 143 mEq/L, K 4.3 mEq/L, Cl 108 mEq/L. No intracranial bleeding was observed on plain head CT. Which of the following is not an appropriate treatment for this patient?

Question: 10 か月の男児。昨夜から血便、嘔吐を認め、機嫌も悪いため母親に連れられて来院した。①足底を刺激すると開眼し、②皮膚色はピンク色である。③ツルゴールは軽度低下しており、④口唇の乾燥は軽度である。⑤毛細血管再充満時間は3秒である。①から⑤のうち、この患児で循環不全を示す所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 10-month-old boy has had bloody stools and vomiting since last night, and has been in a bad mood, so his mother brought him to the hospital. His eyes open when the soles of his feet are stimulated, his skin is pink, his turgor is mildly decreased, and his lips are mildly dry. his capillary refill time is 3 seconds. Which of the numbered findings in this patient indicates circulatory insufficiency?

Question: 日齢3の男児。軽度の腹部膨満を認めると看護師から指摘があった。在胎40 週、3,100 g で出生。①胎便排泄は生後48 時間に認められた。②体重2,950 g。体温37.0 ℃。心拍数136/分、整。血圧74/46 mmHg。呼吸数40/分。③大泉門は2×2cmであった。④皮膚は黄疸を認める。腹部は⑤肝臓を右季肋下に1cm 触知した。①から⑤のうち、異常所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A male infant aged 3 days. The nurse noted mild abdominal distension. He was born at 40 weeks gestation and weighed 3,100 g. Meconium excretion was observed 48 hours after birth. Weight was 2,950 g. Body temperature 37.0°C. Heart rate 136/min, regular. Blood pressure 74/46 mmHg. Respiratory rate 40/min. The anterior fontanelle was 2 x 2 cm. The skin was jaundiced. In the abdomen, the liver was palpable 1 cm below the right hypochondrium. Which of the numbered items is an abnormal finding?

Question: 78 歳の男性。発汗と悪心を主訴に来院した。前日の朝、ソファに座って新聞を読んでいたところ、発汗と悪心が出現したが5分程度で改善した。当日朝、リビングで椅子に座ってテレビを見ていたところ発汗と悪心が出現したため、心配した家族に伴われて受診した。高血圧症、糖尿病、陳旧性心筋梗塞で自宅近くの医療機関に通院中である。体温35.8 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧128/86 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 96 %(room air)。胸部聴診で異常を認めない。来院時の簡易測定血糖は195 mg/dL であった。血液検査とともにまず行うべき検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 78-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of sweating and nausea. The previous morning, while sitting on the sofa and reading the newspaper, he began sweating and felt nauseous, but this improved within about 5 minutes. On the morning of the current day, while sitting in a chair in the living room watching TV, he began sweating and felt nauseous, so he visited the hospital accompanied by his concerned family. He was currently receiving treatment at a medical institution near his home for hypertension, diabetes, and old myocardial infarction. Body temperature 35.8°C. Pulse rate 96 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 128/86 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20 breaths per minute. SpO2 96% (room air). No abnormalities were found on chest auscultation. At the time of his visit, his blood glucose was 195 mg/dL. Which test should be performed first along with a blood test?

Question: 32 歳の女性。産褥3日目で入院中である。妊娠38 週6日に2,900 g の女児を経腟分娩した。分娩経過に異常は認めず、分娩時の出血量も正常であった。現時点までの産褥経過も順調である。本日の所見として正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 32-year-old woman is hospitalized on the third day of the puerperium. At 38 weeks and 6 days of pregnancy, she delivered a 2,900 g baby girl via vaginal delivery. No abnormalities were noted during the delivery, and the amount of blood loss during delivery was normal. The puerperium has progressed smoothly up to this point. Which of the following is a correct finding for today?

Question: 42 歳の女性。手のこわばりを主訴に来院した。手の症状には約3か月前から気付いている。厳格な菜食主義で魚介類や乳製品を10 年以上摂取していない。味覚に異常を認めない。神経診察に異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球414 万、Hb13.1 g/dL、白血球6,900、血小板18 万。血液生化学所見：アルブミン4.0 g/dL、Na 137 mEq/L、K 4.1 mEq/L、Cl 106 mEq/L、Ca 7.8 mg/dL、P 2.2 mg/dL。この患者で欠乏が考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 42-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of stiff hands. She had noticed the symptoms in her hands approximately 3 months earlier. She is a strict vegetarian and has not consumed seafood or dairy products for over 10 years. There were no abnormalities with her sense of taste. No abnormalities were found in the neurological examination. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.14 million, hemoglobin 13.1 g/dL, white blood cells 6,900, platelets 180,000. Blood biochemistry findings: albumin 4.0 g/dL, sodium 137 mEq/L, potassium 4.1 mEq/L, chloride 106 mEq/L, calcium 7.8 mg/dL, phosphorus 2.2 mg/dL. What is the likely deficiency in this patient?

Question: 28 歳の女性。悪心と怠感を主訴に受診した。最終月経は8週間前。無月経のため5日前に行った妊娠検査薬が陽性だった。軽度の下腹部痛を自覚している。最近食欲が低下しているという。内診で性器出血は認めず、経腟超音波検査で子宮内に頭殿長18 mm の心拍を有する胎児を認める。身長156 cm、体重48 kg（非妊時49 kg）。尿ケトンは陰性。飲食店勤務のため立ち仕事が多く勤務時間を短くしたいという相談があった。適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 28-year-old woman presented to the clinic complaining of nausea and fatigue. Her last menstrual period was 8 weeks ago. Due to amenorrhea, a pregnancy test taken 5 days ago was positive. She is aware of mild lower abdominal pain. She says that her appetite has decreased recently. A pelvic examination revealed no genital bleeding, and a transvaginal ultrasound revealed a fetus with a crown-rump length of 18 mm and a beating heart in the uterus. She is 156 cm tall and weighs 48 kg (49 kg when not pregnant). Urine ketones were negative. She works in a restaurant and does a lot of standing work, so she asked for a shorter working hours. Which is the appropriate response?

Question: 75 歳の女性。夜間に徘徊することに困った夫に付き添われて来院した。78 歳の夫と2人暮らしである。60 歳で発症したアルツハイマー型認知症が進行し、最近3カ月はひとりで出かけて自宅から離れた場所まで歩き回り、警察に保護されることが多くなった。徘徊や不眠などの原因精査と治療のため、精神科病棟に入院することになった。本人はほとんど言葉を発せず、意思も確認できない。夫の認知機能に低下は認めない。適切な入院形式はどれか。
Question_EN: A 75-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital accompanied by her husband, who was troubled by her wandering at night. She lives with her 78-year-old husband. Her Alzheimer's disease, which began at age 60, has progressed, and in the last three months she has been going out alone and wandering far from her home, often resulting in her being taken into protective custody by police. She has been admitted to a psychiatric ward to investigate the causes of her wandering and insomnia and to receive treatment. She barely speaks, and her will cannot be confirmed. There is no evidence of a decline in her husband's cognitive function. Which is the appropriate form of admission?

Question: 52 歳の男性。健康診断で肥満を指摘され来院した。3か月前の健康診断で異常をはじめて指摘された。20 歳時の体重は65 kg であった。既往歴と家族歴に特記すべき事項はない。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。健康診断以降、早朝1時間の散歩をしている。身長170 cm、体重74 kg。BMI 25.6。脈拍64/分、整。血圧128/82 mmHg。心音と呼吸音に異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。下肢に浮腫を認めない。この患者の行動変容のステージに基づく指導として適切なのはどれか。
