From the second day of taking the drug, he began to walk around the room more often when his legs felt restless, and at night he began to complain of insomnia due to the itchy sensation. Which of the following is correct regarding this restless sensation?

Question: 7 歳の男児。落ち着きのなさを心配した両親に連れられて来院した。学校の担任から、授業中じっと席に座っていることができず勝手に席から離れること、おせっかいが多く同級生の邪魔をしてしまうため喧嘩になること、忘れ物が多いことを指摘されている。自宅では後片付けや整理整頓が苦手だが、自分の好きなゲームには集中して取り組むことができる。外出時に車が来るのを確認せずに飛び出してしまうことがある。出生時に異常は指摘されなかった。乳幼児期の発達で明らかな遅れを指摘されたことはない。神経診察を含む身体所見に明らかな異常を認めない。現時点で考えられる疾患について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 7-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his parents, concerned about his restlessness. His teacher at school pointed out that he is unable to sit still during class and will leave his seat on his own, that he is overly intrusive and gets in the way of his classmates, which leads to fights, and that he often forgets things. He is not good at cleaning up or tidying up after himself at home, but he is able to concentrate on his favorite games. When going out, he sometimes runs out without checking for oncoming cars. No abnormalities were noted at birth. No obvious developmental delays were noted in his early childhood. No obvious abnormalities were found in the physical examination, including the neurological examination. Which of the following is correct regarding the possible diseases at this time?

Question: 3 歳4 か月の男児。眼位異常を主訴に両親に連れられて来院した。最近になって眼が内寄りになる頻度が増加していることに両親が気付いたという。細隙灯顕微鏡検査と眼底検査で異常を認めない。調節麻痺薬の点眼下に測定した屈折値は右＋6.00 D 左＋6.00 D であった。対応として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 3-year-4-month-old boy was brought to the hospital by his parents complaining of abnormal eye position. The parents noticed that the eyes had recently been turning inward more frequently. Slit-lamp examination and fundus examination revealed no abnormalities. Refraction measured after instillation of cycloplegic eye drops was +6.00 D on the right and +6.00 D on the left. Which of the following is the most appropriate response?

Question: 26歳の男性。腹痛を主訴に来院した。6年前から腹痛と下痢を自覚するようになった。就職後に症状が強くなり、遅刻や欠勤をするようになり受診した。その他の症状として、半年前から①食べ過ぎたときに胸やけがある。家族歴に特記すべきことはない。身長175 cm、②体重67 kg（1年間で4 kg 増加）。体温36.0 ℃。③脈拍96/分、整。血圧120/60 mmHg。眼瞼結膜に貧血を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦で、下腹部に軽度の圧痛を認める。肝・脾を触知しない。④腸蠕動音は軽度亢進している。血液所見：赤血球505 万、Hb 15.0 g/dL、Ht 45 %、白血球7,300、血小板26 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.9 g/dL、アルブミン5.0 g/dL、AST 17 U/L、ALT 13 U/L、LD 130 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 73 U/L（基準38～113）、γ-GT 15 U/L（基準8 ～50）、アミラーゼ60 U/L（基準37～160）、CK 61 U/L（基準30～140）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL、尿酸4.8 mg/dL、血糖98 mg/dL、Na 140 mEq/L、K 3.9 mEq/L、Cl 102 mEq/L。CRP 0.1 mg/dL。⑤便潜血検査陽性。原因検索のために下部消化管内視鏡検査を行うこととした。この患者で下部消化管内視鏡検査を行う根拠となるのは①から⑤の中でどれか。
Question_EN: A 26-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of abdominal pain. He began to experience abdominal pain and diarrhea six years ago. After starting work, the symptoms intensified, and he began to be late and absent from work, so he visited the hospital. Other symptoms include ① heartburn when he eats too much, which he started six months ago. There is no notable family history. Height 175 cm, ② weight 67 kg (4 kg increase in one year). Body temperature 36.0°C. ③ Pulse 96 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 120/60 mmHg. No anemia was observed in the palpebral conjunctiva. No abnormalities were noted in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat, and mild tenderness was observed in the lower abdomen. The liver and spleen were not palpable. ④ Intestinal peristalsis sounds were mildly increased. Blood findings: red blood cells 5.05 million, hemoglobin 15.0 g/dL, hematocrit 45%, white blood cells 7,300, platelets 260,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.9 g/dL, albumin 5.0 g/dL, AST 17 U/L, ALT 13 U/L, LD 130 U/L (standard 120-245), ALP 73 U/L (standard 38-113), γ-GT 15 U/L (standard 8-50), amylase 60 U/L (standard 37-160), CK 61 U/L (standard 30-140), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, uric acid 4.8 mg/dL, blood glucose 98 mg/dL, Na 140 mEq/L, K 3.9 mEq/L, Cl 102 mEq/L. CRP 0.1 mg/dL. ⑤ Fecal occult blood test was positive. It was decided to perform a lower gastrointestinal endoscopy to search for the cause. Which of ① to ⑤ is a reason to perform a lower gastrointestinal endoscopy in this patient?

Question: 35 歳の男性。「戸締りを確認していて毎日のように遅刻してしまう」という主訴で来院した。一人暮らしだが、約3 か月前に近所で空き巣があったというニュースを聞いてから、自分では過剰だと思いながらも戸締りの確認がやめられずに悩んでいる。仕事でも書類の紛失を心配して確認することが目立つようになった。集中力や意欲に問題はない。考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 35-year-old man came to the hospital complaining that he was always late because he kept checking that his doors were locked. He lives alone, but after hearing the news about a burglary in his neighborhood about three months ago, he has been unable to stop checking that his doors were locked, even though he knows that he is doing it excessively. He has also started to check his work documents more frequently, worried that they might get lost. He has no problems with his concentration or motivation. Which of the following is most likely?

Question: 32 歳の男性。発熱を主訴に救急外来を受診した。東南アジア各地に合計7 日間滞在した後に帰国し2 日目である。現地滞在6 日目から39 ℃台の発熱と全身倦怠感とが出現していたが、入国時には一時的に解熱していたため空港検疫では申し出なかったという。帰国後も発熱が続き、受診前日から頻繁に嘔吐している。下痢はない。四肢の筋肉痛を訴える。意識は清明。身長172 cm、体重60 kg。体温39.1 ℃。脈拍112/分、整。血圧92/52 mmHg。呼吸数24/分。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。口腔粘膜に点状出血を認める。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は肝を右肋骨弓下に4 cm 触知するが、脾は触知しない。血液所見：赤血球450 万、Hb 12.2 g/dL、Ht 60 %、白血球2,000、血小板8.0 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.5 g/dL、アルブミン4.1 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.8 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン0.3 mg/dL、AST 122 U/L、ALT 112 U/L、LD 222 U/L（基準120～245）、尿素窒素30 mg/dL、クレアチニン1.4 mg/dL。末梢血塗抹標本で赤血球に異常を認めない。最も考えられる疾患はどれか。
Question_EN: A 32-year-old man visited the emergency room complaining of fever. It was the second day since he returned to Japan after spending a total of seven days in Southeast Asia. He had a fever of 39°C and general fatigue since the sixth day of his stay there, but did not report it at the airport quarantine because the fever had temporarily subsided when he entered the country. The fever continued after returning to Japan, and he had been vomiting frequently since the day before the visit. He had no diarrhea. He complained of muscular pain in his limbs. He was conscious and clear-minded. Height 172 cm, weight 60 kg. Body temperature 39.1°C. Pulse 112 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 92/52 mmHg. Respiratory rate 24/min. No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctivae. Petechiae were found in the oral mucosa. No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The liver was palpable 4 cm below the right costal arch in the abdomen, but the spleen was not palpable. Blood findings: Red blood cells 4.5 million, Hb 12.2 g/dL, Ht 60%, White blood cells 2,000, Platelets 80,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 6.5 g/dL, Albumin 4.1 g/dL, Total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, Direct bilirubin 0.3 mg/dL, AST 122 U/L, ALT 112 U/L, LD 222 U/L (normal 120-245), Urea nitrogen 30 mg/dL, Creatinine 1.4 mg/dL. Peripheral blood smear shows no abnormalities in the red blood cells. Which of the following is the most likely disease?

Question: 63歳の女性。健診で低カリウム血症を指摘され来院した。40歳ごろから高血圧でカルシウム拮抗薬を内服している。両親と姉が高血圧症。身長147 cm、体重43 kg。脈拍72/分、整。血圧152/88 mmHg。胸腹部に異常を認めない。尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖（－）、潜血（－）。血液所見：Hb 12.9 g/dL、Ht 40 %、白血球5,400、血小板22 万。血液生化学所見：アルブミン4.2 g/dL、AST 21 U/L、ALT 16 U/L、尿素窒素20 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、血糖109 mg/dL、Na 143 mEq/L、K 2.5 mEq/L。スクリーニングとして、午前10時ごろの随時採血で、血漿アルドステロン濃度472 pg/mL（基準50～100）、血漿レニン活性0.1 ng/mL/時間（基準1.2～2.5）であった。カプトプリル負荷試験は陽性であった。腹部MRIで左副腎に径17 mmの境界明瞭な結節を認め、腺腫が疑われた。手術療法の適応を判断するために必要な検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 63-year-old woman visited the hospital after a medical checkup revealed that she had hypokalemia. She had been taking calcium antagonists for hypertension since she was about 40 years old. Both her parents and older sister had hypertension. Height 147 cm, weight 43 kg. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 152/88 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the chest or abdomen. Urine findings: protein (-), sugar (-), occult blood (-). Blood findings: Hb 12.9 g/dL, Ht 40%, white blood cells 5,400, platelets 220,000. Blood biochemistry findings: albumin 4.2 g/dL, AST 21 U/L, ALT 16 U/L, urea nitrogen 20 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, blood glucose 109 mg/dL, Na 143 mEq/L, K 2.5 mEq/L. As a screening test, blood was taken at around 10:00 a.m. and the plasma aldosterone concentration was 472 pg/mL (normal range: 50-100), and plasma renin activity was 0.1 ng/mL/hour (normal range: 1.2-2.5). A captopril loading test was positive. An abdominal MRI revealed a clearly demarcated nodule measuring 17 mm in diameter in the left adrenal gland, suggesting adenoma. Which test is necessary to determine whether surgical treatment is appropriate?

Question: 5 歳の男児。今後の治療方針を決定するために心臓カテーテル検査を受けることになった。1 歳6 か月健診で心雑音を指摘され、心エコー検査で心疾患と診断されたが、これまでは心疾患による症状を認めず、経過を観察されていた。心臓カテーテル検査の心腔内酸素飽和度に関する結果を示す。部位（酸素飽和度）: 上大静脈（82.8 %）, 下大静脈（86.8 %）, 右心房（84.5 %）, 右心室（83.9 %）, 右肺動脈（90.2 %）, 左肺動脈（92.6 %）, 左心室（ 98.9 %）, 大動脈（98.8 %）この児の心疾患として最も考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 5-year-old boy is undergoing cardiac catheterization to determine his future treatment plan. At his 18-month health check, a heart murmur was detected, and a cardiac echocardiogram revealed that he had heart disease. However, he had not shown any symptoms of heart disease and had been under observation. The results of the cardiac catheterization are shown below for intracardiac oxygen saturation. Location (oxygen saturation): superior vena cava (82.8%), inferior vena cava (86.8%), right atrium (84.5%), right ventricle (83.9%), right pulmonary artery (90.2%), left pulmonary artery (92.6%), left ventricle (98.9%), aorta (98.8%). Which of the following is the most likely cardiac disease in this child?

Question: インシデントレポートで正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding incident reports?

Question: 吐血よりも喀血を示唆する所見はどれか。
Question_EN: Which finding is more suggestive of hemoptysis than hematemesis?

Question: 医師の職業倫理に反するのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is against the professional ethics of a physician?

Question: 胎児期に血液酸素飽和度が最も低いのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which part of the fetus has the lowest blood oxygen saturation?

Question: 診療録における SOAP の A に該当するのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following corresponds to A in SOAP in medical records?

Question: 感染性心内膜炎を示唆する皮膚所見はどれか。
Question_EN: Which skin finding suggests infective endocarditis?

Question: 高齢者総合機能評価〈CGA〉において、復唱を用いて評価するのはどれか。
Question_EN: In the Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment (CGA), which of the following is assessed using repetition?

Question: Which of the following diseases needs airborne precautions?
Question_EN: Which of the following diseases needs airborne precautions?

Question: 妊娠高血圧症候群の重症化の指標となるのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is an indicator of the severity of pregnancy-induced hypertension?

Question: 患者の訴えのうち、抑うつ状態が最も考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the patient's complaints is most likely a symptom of depression?

Question: 処方箋について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which is true about prescriptions?

Question: 病歴聴取で、家族内に同じ疾患の患者が存在することが、診断に最も有用な疾患はどれか。
Question_EN: For which disease is it most useful to take a medical history to find out that a family member has the same disease?

Question: 介護保険の強制加入の開始年齢はどれか。
Question_EN: What is the age at which compulsory enrollment in long-term care insurance begins?

Question: 瘙痒をきたしにくいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is least likely to cause pruritus?

Question: 緊張性気胸で認める所見はどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following findings is seen in tension pneumothorax?

Question: 医療面接における傾聴で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding active listening in a medical interview?

Question: 治療薬物モニタリング〈TDM〉の対象となる抗菌薬はどれか。
Question_EN: Which antibiotic is subject to therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM)?

Question: 肺低形成を合併する胎児疾患はどれか。
Question_EN: Which fetal disease is associated with pulmonary hypoplasia?

Question: 失神をきたしうる疾患と失神の誘因との組合せで誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is an incorrect combination of a disease that can cause fainting and a trigger for syncope?

Question: 我が国の医療保険制度について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct about Japan's health insurance system?

Question: 治療薬の効果に関するランダム化比較試験の試験参加について被験者の同意を取得したとみなされるのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is considered to have obtained the subjects' consent to participate in a randomized controlled trial on the effectiveness of a therapeutic drug?

Question: 糸球体濾過量〈GFR〉について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding glomerular filtration rate (GFR)?

Question: 月経は何を排出するために起きているか。
Question_EN: What does menstruation occur to expel?

Question: リスボン宣言の内容で誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect about the content of the Lisbon Declaration?

Question: 86 歳の女性。10 年前に脳梗塞を発症して寝たきりとなった。重度の認知症があり、自宅で家族が介護してきたが、四肢関節の拘縮が徐々に進行し、最近は体位変換も困難である。訪問診療に訪れたところ、和室の布団に右側臥位で寝ている。股関節は90 度屈曲位で拘縮しており、うなり声をあげている。身長154 cm、体重42 kg。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍76/分、整。血圧122/68 mmHg。呼吸数18/分。診察に際して正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 86-year-old woman. She suffered a cerebral infarction 10 years ago and has become bedridden. She has severe dementia and her family has been caring for her at home, but contractures in the joints of her limbs have gradually progressed, and recently she has had difficulty changing position. When we visited her for a house call, we found her lying on her right side on a futon in a Japanese-style room. Her hip joints were contracted at 90 degrees flexion, and she was making a groaning noise. Her height was 154 cm and her weight was 42 kg. Her body temperature was 36.2°C. Her pulse rate was 76 beats/min and was regular. Her blood pressure was 122/68 mmHg. Her respiratory rate was 18 breaths/min. Which of the following is correct when examining her?

Question: 35 歳の男性。血尿を主訴に来院した。昨日初めてフルマラソンを完走し、その3 時間後から尿の色が赤黒くなり持続している。下肢の筋肉痛があるが、その他の症状はない。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。身長170 cm、体重68 kg。脈拍72/分、整。血圧132/60 mmHg。胸腹部に異常を認めない。両下肢全体に圧痛を認める。尿所見：蛋白（－）、ケトン体（－）、潜血3 ＋、沈渣に赤血球、白血球、円柱を認めない。血液検査の結果はまだ報告されていない。最も考えられる疾患はどれか。
Question_EN: A 35-year-old man visits the hospital complaining of hematuria. He completed his first full marathon yesterday, and three hours after the run, his urine has been dark red and has been persistent. He has muscle pain in his lower limbs, but no other symptoms. There is nothing notable in his medical history. Height 170 cm, weight 68 kg. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 132/60 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the chest or abdomen. There is tenderness in both lower limbs. Urine findings: protein (-), ketone bodies (-), occult blood 3+, no red blood cells, white blood cells, or casts in the sediment. Blood test results have not yet been reported. Which of the following is the most likely disease?

Question: 82 歳の女性。発熱を主訴に家族に連れられて来院した。誤嚥性肺炎の診断で入院となった。Alzheimer 型認知症があり、食事のむせこみで頻回の誤嚥性肺炎の既往がある。肺炎のため2 週間前に入院し、肺炎は改善したがADL が低下したため現在は全介助の状態である。認知機能障害のため嚥下訓練も進まず胃瘻の造設を検討することになった。認知症症状が悪化する前には、「ボケるくらいなら死んだほうがまし」、「胃に管を入れてまで生きたいと思わない」と発言していたという。息子は胃瘻を希望しているが娘は反対している。現在、意識は傾眠状態で、呼びかけに反応しない。この患者の胃瘻造設に関する意思決定について適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 82-year-old woman was brought to the hospital by her family complaining of a fever. She was admitted with a diagnosis of aspiration pneumonia. She has Alzheimer's dementia and a history of frequent aspiration pneumonia due to choking on food. She was admitted to the hospital two weeks ago due to pneumonia, and although the pneumonia has improved, her ADL has declined and she is currently in a state of total assistance. Due to cognitive impairment, swallowing training has not progressed and a gastrostomy was considered. Before her dementia symptoms worsened, she had said, "I would rather die than become senile," and "I don't want to live so much that I have to have a tube in my stomach." Her son wants a gastrostomy, but her daughter is against it. She is currently drowsy and unresponsive to calls. Which of the following is the most appropriate decision-making approach regarding a gastrostomy for this patient?

Question: 76 歳の女性。高血圧と慢性心不全のため入院していた。退院後は自宅近くの診療所に通院し、かかりつけ医の指導により自宅で毎朝体温、脈拍、血圧および体重の測定を行い、下腿浮腫の有無を確認している。体液の過剰状態を早期に判断するために最も信頼度が高い項目はどれか。
Question_EN: A 76-year-old woman was hospitalized for hypertension and chronic heart failure. After being discharged from the hospital, she went to a clinic near her home, and under the guidance of her family doctor, she measures her temperature, pulse, blood pressure, and weight at home every morning and checks for the presence of lower leg edema. Which of the following is the most reliable parameter for early detection of fluid overload?

Question: 40 歳の女性。心窩部痛を主訴に来院した。医療面接で解釈モデルを把握するための質問はどれか。
Question_EN: A 40-year-old woman visits the hospital complaining of epigastric pain. Which question would be most useful in a medical interview to understand her explanatory model?

Question: 18 歳の男子。鼻出血を主訴に来院した。自宅で特に誘引なく鼻出血が出現し、タオルで鼻を押さえて受診した。1 週間前に行われた大学の健康診断で異常は指摘されなかった。意識は清明。身長176 cm、体重68 kg。体温36.4 ℃。脈拍80/分、整。血圧120/64 mmHg。呼吸数12/分。SpO2 99 %（room air）。眼瞼結膜に貧血を認めない。胸部と腹部の診察で異常を認めない。適切な初期対応はどれか。
Question_EN: An 18-year-old male visited the hospital complaining of nosebleeds. The nosebleed had started at home without any particular trigger, and he visited the hospital holding his nose with a towel. No abnormalities were found in a university health check conducted one week earlier. He was conscious and alert. Height 176 cm, weight 68 kg. Body temperature 36.4°C. Pulse 80 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 120/64 mmHg. Respiratory rate 12 breaths/min. SpO2 99% (room air). No anemia was found in the palpebral conjunctiva. Chest and abdominal examination revealed no abnormalities. Which is the appropriate initial management?

Question: ある病棟で研修医A が担当患者数名の採血のために、1 つのトレイで全員分の採血管を運び採血を行った。しかし、指導医がそのうち2 名の患者の検査結果がそれぞれの病状経過に沿わないことに気付き、研修医A に再検査（2 回目の採血）を指示した。結果として、研修医A が1 回目の採血の際に2 名の患者の採血管を取り違えたことが明らかとなった。研修医A が次に行う対応として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: In one ward, medical intern A carried a single tray of blood collection tubes for several patients he was in charge of, and collected blood from them. However, the supervising physician noticed that the test results for two of the patients did not match the course of their illnesses, and instructed medical intern A to perform a retest (a second blood draw). As a result, it became clear that medical intern A had switched the blood collection tubes for the two patients when he took the first blood draw. What is the most appropriate next step for medical intern A to take?

Question: 60 歳の男性。右上肢筋力低下を主訴に来院した。徒手筋力テストで、前腕回外位で右肘屈曲させたところ、重力に抗して全可動域の運動が可能であったが、軽い抵抗が加わると不可能であった。右肘屈曲（上腕二頭筋）の徒手筋力テストの評価はどれか。
Question_EN: A 60-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of muscle weakness in the right upper extremity. In manual muscle testing, the right elbow was flexed with the forearm in a supinated position. The patient was able to move through a full range of motion against gravity, but was unable to do so when light resistance was applied. What is the assessment of the manual muscle testing of right elbow flexion (biceps brachii)?

Question: 36 歳の男性。全身けいれんのため救急車で搬入された。来院時にはけいれんは消失していた。15 歳からてんかんの既往があり、抗けいれん薬を処方されていたが、2 か月前から服薬を自己中断していた。意識レベルはJCSⅡ-10。心拍数98/分、整。血圧140/90 mmHg。呼吸数18/分。SpO2 98 %（リザーバー付マスク10 L/分　酸素投与下）。静脈路を確保して、頭部CT を撮影する準備をしていたところ、全身けいれんを起こした。この患者に直ちに静注すべき薬剤はどれか。
Question_EN: A 36-year-old man was brought to the hospital by ambulance because of generalized convulsions. The convulsions had disappeared by the time of arrival. He had a history of epilepsy since the age of 15 and had been prescribed anticonvulsants, but had voluntarily discontinued taking them two months prior. His level of consciousness was JCS II-10. His heart rate was 98 beats/min, regular. His blood pressure was 140/90 mmHg. His respiratory rate was 18 breaths/min. SpO2 was 98% (oxygen was administered via a mask with a reservoir at 10 L/min). After an intravenous line was established and preparations were being made to perform a head CT scan, the patient suffered a generalized convulsion. Which drug should be administered intravenously immediately to this patient?

Question: 18 歳の女子。呼吸困難を主訴に救急外来を受診した。通学途中に満員のバスの中で急に息苦しく、呼吸が促迫になった。パニック障害で自宅近くの診療所に通院しているが、それ以外の基礎疾患はない。意識は清明。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍104/分、整。血圧112/72 mmHg。呼吸数48/分。SpO2 100 %（room air）。頸静脈の怒張を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、圧痛を認めない。四肢にチアノーゼを認めない。患者は「息ができない。手の指先と口の周囲が痺れる」と言っている。この患者に救急外来で行う対応として正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 18-year-old girl visited the emergency room complaining of difficulty breathing. On her way to school, she suddenly felt short of breath and had difficulty breathing while riding a crowded bus. She visits a clinic near her home for panic disorder, but has no other underlying conditions. She is alert and conscious. Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse rate 104 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 112/72 mmHg. Respiratory rate 48 /min. SpO2 100% (room air). There is no distension of the jugular vein. There are no abnormalities in the heart sounds or respiratory sounds. The abdomen is flat, soft, and not tender. There is no cyanosis in the limbs. The patient states, "I can't breathe. My fingertips and the area around my mouth are numb." Which of the following would be the correct management to be given to this patient in the emergency room?

Question: 67 歳の男性。腹部膨満感、右季肋部痛およびふらつきを主訴に来院した。半年以上前から右季肋部痛を自覚していたが、3 か月前から痛みが増強するとともに腹部膨満感が出現、1 か月前から黒色の軟便が見られるようになり、2 週間前からふらつきが強まった。ここ3 か月で体重が5 kg 減少している。意識は清明だが、問診の意味が把握しにくいようで、聴覚障害と軽度の知的障害が疑われる。身長154 cm、体重53 kg。体温35.9 ℃。脈拍84/分、整。血圧112/72 mmHg。呼吸数13/分。眼瞼結膜は蒼白で眼球結膜に軽度黄染を認める。腹部は膨満しており、波動を認める。両下腿に強い浮腫を認める。一人暮らしで身寄りがなく、生活保護を受けている。民生委員が同伴で受診しており、問診の際も民生委員を介して聞き取りを行ったが、生活状況などについて十分な情報が聴取できない。まず取るべき対応で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 67-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of abdominal distension, right hypochondriac pain, and lightheadedness. He had been aware of right hypochondriac pain for over 6 months, but the pain had intensified 3 months ago, and he had abdominal distension. He had been passing black, loose stools 1 month ago, and his lightheadedness had intensified 2 weeks ago. He had lost 5 kg of weight in the past 3 months. He was conscious, but had difficulty understanding the meaning of the interview, so hearing impairment and mild intellectual disability were suspected. Height 154 cm, weight 53 kg. Body temperature 35.9°C. Pulse rate 84 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 112/72 mmHg. Respiratory rate 13 breaths/min. The palpebral conjunctiva was pale, and the bulbar conjunctiva was slightly jaundiced. The abdomen was distended and had a fluctuating waves. There was severe edema in both lower legs. He lives alone and has no relatives, and is receiving welfare assistance. The patient was accompanied by a welfare officer and the medical interview was also conducted through the welfare officer, but sufficient information about the patient's living conditions, etc. could not be obtained. Which of the following is the correct first action to be taken?

Question: 70 歳の男性。肺炎で入院加療を受けている。肺炎が治癒したため、自宅に退院予定であった。担当医が早朝に診察するために病室に入ったところ、点滴チューブの結合部が外れ、床面に逆流した血液が溜まっているのを発見した。患者の状態を確認したところ、既に患者の下顎に死後硬直を認め、死亡確認を行った。この状況で次に行うべき適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 70-year-old man was hospitalized for pneumonia and was scheduled to be discharged home after the pneumonia had been cured. When the attending physician entered the patient's room to examine him early in the morning, he discovered that the IV tube connection had become disconnected and blood had backed up and pooled on the floor. When he checked the patient's condition, he found that rigor mortis had already set in the patient's lower jaw and confirmed that the patient was dead. In this situation, what is the appropriate next step?

Question:

現病歴：半年前から胸やけと食欲不振、腰痛を自覚していた。2か月前から背部痛と呼吸困難が出現し、自宅近くの診療所を受診した。上部消化管内視鏡検査で胃体部に進行胃癌を認め、精査と治療のため入院となった。腰痛はみられるが、ADLは自立し歩行可能である。既往歴：特記すべきことはない。
生活歴：妻と小学生の娘2人と4人暮らし。職業は会社員、営業職で外回りの仕事が多い。喫煙は20歳から20本/日だが、2週間前から禁煙している。飲酒は機会飲酒。家族歴：特記すべきことはない。

検査所見：血液所見：赤血球390万、Hb 9.1 g/dL、Ht 39 %、白血球6,300、血小板26万。
血液生化学所見：総蛋白5.0 g/dL、アルブミン3.0 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.8 mg/dL、AST 16 U/L、ALT 18 U/L、LD 184 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 200 U/L（基準38～113）、クレアチニン1.0 mg/dL、Na 141 mEq/L、K 4.0 mEq/L、Cl 101 mEq/L、Ca 8.5 mg/dL。胸部エックス線写真で両肺に散在する腫瘤を認めた。腹部CT及び腰椎MRIで第1腰椎と第3腰椎に転移性骨腫瘍を認めた。肝転移は認めなかった。患者には病状が詳しく伝えられ、今後抗癌化学療法、放射線治療が計画された。患者から、「会社に迷惑をかけるので、仕事をやめようか悩んでいる。治療費もたくさんかかるし、小学生の娘2人を今後どうやって養っていったらよいかを考えると心配でしょうがない」と相談があった。
この患者への対応で誤っているのはどれか。

A 38-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of loss of appetite, lower back pain, and back pain.
History of current illness: He had been aware of heartburn, loss of appetite, and lower back pain for the past 6 months. He had been experiencing back pain and dyspnea for the past 2 months, and visited a clinic near his home. An upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed advanced gastric cancer in the body of the stomach, and he was hospitalized for further examination and treatment. Although he has lower back pain, he is independent in ADL and can walk. Medical history: Nothing of note.
Life history: He lives with his wife and two elementary school-aged daughters. He is an office worker and works in sales, and often does outside work. He has smoked 20 cigarettes a day since he was 20 years old, but has stopped smoking 2 weeks ago. He drinks alcohol occasionally. Family history: Nothing of note.
Current symptoms: He is conscious and clear-minded. Height 176 cm, weight 63 kg. Body temperature 36.4°C. Pulse 92 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 120/64 mmHg. Respiratory rate 18/min. SpO2 97% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the palpebral or bulbar conjunctiva. No abnormalities were found in the heart or respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable.

Laboratory findings: Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.9 million, Hb 9.1 g/dL, Ht 39%, white blood cells 6,300, platelets 260,000.
Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 5.0 g/dL, albumin 3.0 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 16 U/L, ALT 18 U/L, LD 184 U/L (normal: 120-245), ALP 200 U/L (normal: 38-113), creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, Na 141 mEq/L, K 4.0 mEq/L, Cl 101 mEq/L, Ca 8.5 mg/dL. Chest X-ray showed scattered masses in both lungs. Abdominal CT and lumbar MRI showed metastatic bone tumors in the first and third lumbar vertebrae. No liver metastasis was found. The patient was informed of his condition in detail, and anticancer chemotherapy and radiation therapy were planned. The patient consulted, saying, "I'm thinking about quitting my job because I'm causing trouble for my company. My medical expenses are high, and I'm really worried about how I'm going to support my two elementary school-aged daughters in the future."
Which of the following is incorrect in responding to this patient?

Question:
59 歳の男性。倦怠感、悪心、嘔吐および発熱を主訴に来院した。
現病歴：昨日から倦怠感を自覚していたが、本日、悪心、嘔吐および悪寒戦慄を伴う発熱が出現し、体動困難となったため救急外来を受診した。
既往歴：糖尿病でSGLT2 阻害薬を内服している。高血圧と脂質異常症で食事療法を行っている。
生活歴：妻と2 人暮らし。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。家族歴：父が糖尿病。母が大腸癌。
現症：意識は清明。身長165 cm、体重70 kg。体温38.5 ℃。脈拍92/分、整。血圧120/86 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。甲状腺腫と頸部リンパ節とを触知しない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部はやや膨満しており腸蠕動音は低下しているが、圧痛や腫瘤は認めない。肝・脾を触知しない。肋骨脊柱角叩打痛は両側とも認めない。

血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.9 g/dL、アルブミン4.1 g/dL、②総ビリルビン1.8 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン1.0 mg/dL、AST 23 U/L、ALT 33 U/L、LD 178 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 103 U/L（基準38～113）、γ-GT 85 U/L（基準8 ～50）、アミラーゼ45 U/L（基準37～160）、CK 144 U/L（基準30～140）、尿素窒素20 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.87 mg/dL、③eGFR 70.1 mL/分/1.73 m2、④尿酸6.0 mg/dL、血糖189 mg/dL、HbA1c 7.5 %（基準4.6 ～6.2）、⑤Na 136 mEq/L 、K 4.4 mEq/L 、Cl 98 mEq/L 。CRP 11.4 mg/dL。

History of current illness: He had been feeling fatigue since yesterday, but today he developed nausea, vomiting, and a fever accompanied by chills and shivers, and was unable to move, so he visited the emergency room.
Medical history: He has diabetes and is taking an SGLT2 inhibitor. He is on a diet for hypertension and dyslipidemia.
Life history: He lives with his wife. He has never smoked. He drinks alcohol occasionally. Family history: His father has diabetes, and his mother has colon cancer.
Current symptoms: He is conscious and alert. His height is 165 cm and his weight is 70 kg. His temperature is 38.5°C. His pulse is 92 beats per minute and is regular. His blood pressure is 120/86 mmHg. His respiratory rate is 20 breaths per minute. SpO2 is 98% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva. Goiter and cervical lymph nodes were not palpable. No abnormalities were noted in heart sounds or respiratory sounds. The abdomen was slightly distended and intestinal peristalsis sounds were decreased, but no tenderness or masses were noted. The liver and spleen were not palpable. There was no tenderness on either side of the costovertebral angle.

Laboratory findings: Urine findings: protein (-), glucose 2+, occult blood (-), ① no white blood cells were noted in the sediment.

Blood findings: RBCs 5.22 million, Hb 16.2 g/dL, Ht 47%, WBCs 19,600 (band neutrophils 3%, segmented neutrophils 79%, monocytes 6%, lymphocytes 12%), platelets 170,000, PT-INR 1.09 (normal 0.9-1.1).

CRP was 11.4 mg/dL.
It was considered necessary to perform an imaging test to identify the cause of the symptoms. Of the numbered items ① to ⑤, which piece of information is most important in determining whether or not to perform a contrast CT scan?

貧血あり（50 名）貧血なし（240 名）眼瞼結膜貧血様：貧血あり（24 名）貧血なし（50 名）　眼瞼結膜：正常（26 名）貧血なし（190 名）。 
眼瞼結膜の身体所見から貧血を診断する場合、この患者の貧血診断における尤度比を求めよ。
Question_EN:
A 39-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of palpitations and shortness of breath.
History of present illness: Her menstrual flow had increased 6 months ago, and she had been aware of palpitations and shortness of breath when going up and down stairs for the past 3 months, so she visited the hospital.
Past medical history: Nothing of note. Lifestyle: Company employee. Lives alone. No history of smoking. Drinks alcohol occasionally. Family history: Nothing of note.
Menstrual history: Menarche at age 13. 28-day cycle, lasting 10 days.
Present symptoms: Consciousness is clear. Height 154 cm, weight 57 kg. Body temperature 36.4°C. Pulse 96 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 126/80 mmHg. Respiratory rate 18 breaths/min. SpO2 98% (room air). The palpebral conjunctiva appears anemic. No goiter or cervical lymph nodes are palpable. No abnormalities were noted in heart sounds or respiratory sounds. The liver and spleen are not palpable. The lower abdomen is mildly distended. During pelvic examination, a palpable mass 10 cm in diameter is detected. No abnormalities are found in the neurological examination. The following table shows the number of patients with anemia by palpebral conjunctival findings.
With anemia (50 patients) Without anemia (240 patients) Palpebral conjunctival anemia-like: With anemia (24 patients) Without anemia (50 patients) Palpebral conjunctiva: Normal (26 patients) Without anemia (190 patients).
If anemia is diagnosed based on the physical findings of the palpebral conjunctiva, calculate the likelihood ratio of diagnosing this patient with anemia.

Question:
39 歳の女性。動悸と息切れを主訴に来院した。
現病歴：半年前から月経量が増え、3 か月前から階段昇降時に動悸と息切れを自覚するようになったため受診した。
既往歴：特記すべきことはない。生活歴：会社員。一人暮らし。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。家族歴：特記すべきことはない。
月経歴：初経13 歳。周期28 日型、持続10 日間。
現症：意識は清明。身長154 cm、体重57 kg。体温36.4 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧126/80 mmHg。呼吸数18/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。眼瞼結膜は貧血様である。甲状腺腫と頸部リンパ節とを触知しない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。肝・脾を触知しない。下腹部は軽度膨隆している。内診で、径10 cm の腫瘤を触知する。神経診察で異常を認めない。ある論文に掲載されている眼瞼結膜所見別の貧血患者数の表を示す。
貧血あり（50 名）貧血なし（240 名）眼瞼結膜貧血様：貧血あり（24 名）貧血なし（50 名）　眼瞼結膜：正常（26 名）貧血なし（190 名）。 
血液検査を行ったところ、以下の結果が得られた。血液所見：赤血球371 万、Hb 8.5 g/dL、Ht 29 %、白血球4,100、血小板29 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.9 g/dL、アルブミン4.5 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.9 mg/dL、AST 32 U/L、ALT 32 U/L、LD 173 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 106 U/L（基準38～113）、尿素窒素11 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL、血糖93 mg/dL、総コレステロール189 mg/dL、Na 139 mEq/L、K 4.0 mEq/L、Cl 102 mEq/L。CRP 0.7 mg/dL。この患者で認めるのはどれか。

Question:
65 歳の女性。呼吸困難を主訴に来院した。
現病歴：1 時間前、自転車で走行中に転倒した。左胸部を強打し、直後から呼吸困難、胸痛および血痰が出現した。当初、痰にわずかに血が混じる程度であったが、徐々に出血の量と回数が増加し呼吸困難も増悪したため、救急外来を受診した。
既往歴：特記すべきことはない。
生活歴：喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。
家族歴：母が高血圧症。
現症：意識は清明。身長159 cm、体重70 kg。体温37.2 ℃。脈拍104/分、整。血圧96/60 mmHg。呼吸数22/分。SpO2 94 %（room air）。皮膚は左側胸部に10 × 5 cm の出血斑を認める。眼瞼結膜は貧血様である。左側胸部に圧痛を認める。心音に異常を認めない。呼吸音は左上前胸部で減弱している。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。四肢に異常を認めない。胸部エックス線写真で左肺の虚脱と左胸腔に胸水の貯留を認めた。
次に行う検査として正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 65-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of dyspnea.
History of present illness: One hour earlier, she had fallen while cycling. She had hit her left chest hard, and immediately afterwards, she had dyspnea, chest pain, and bloody sputum. Initially, there was only a small amount of blood in the sputum, but the amount and frequency of bleeding gradually increased, and her dyspnea worsened, so she visited the emergency room.
Past medical history: Nothing of note.
Lifestyle history: No history of smoking. Alcohol intake is occasional.
Family history: Mother has hypertension.
Present symptoms: Conscious and alert. Height 159 cm, weight 70 kg. Body temperature 37.2°C. Pulse 104/min, regular. Blood pressure 96/60 mmHg. Respiratory rate 22/min. SpO2 94% (room air). A 10 × 5 cm hemorrhagic area was noted on the left side of the chest. The palpebral conjunctiva appeared anemic. There is tenderness in the left side of the chest. No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds. Breath sounds are decreased in the upper left anterior chest. The abdomen is flat and soft, and the liver and spleen cannot be palpated. No abnormalities were found in the limbs. A chest X-ray reveals a collapsed left lung and pleural effusion in the left thoracic cavity.
Which of the following should be the next test?

Question: 35 歳の男性。仕事中に、作業で使用していた液体の化学物質を全身に浴び、事故から2 時間後に来院した。2 年前に入職し、配置転換で2 週間前から現在の作業を始めたばかりだった。作業内容や使用していた化学物質の詳細については詳しくない。化学物質を浴びた後、すぐに緊急用のシャワーを浴び洗眼したという。意識は清明。身長171 cm、体重65 kg。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧136/82 mmHg。呼吸数17/分。眼瞼結膜、眼球結膜に充血を認める。顔面の皮膚に発赤を認める。この患者の治療方針を決定するため、患者の勤務先に照会するものとして有用でないのはどれか。なお、患者の同意は得ているものとする。
Question_EN: A 35-year-old man was doused in liquid chemicals used at work and visited the hospital two hours after the accident. He had joined the company two years ago and had been transferred to his current position two weeks ago. He is not familiar with the details of the work or the chemicals used. After being doused in the chemicals, he immediately took an emergency shower and washed his eyes. He is conscious and alert. Height 171 cm, weight 65 kg. Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse rate 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 136/82 mmHg. Respiratory rate 17 breaths per minute. Congestion is observed in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva. Redness is observed in the skin of the face. Which of the following would not be useful to inquire about from the patient's workplace in order to decide on a treatment plan for this patient? It is assumed that the patient's consent has been obtained.

Question: 6 月上旬のある日。午後1 時過ぎに、近所の小学校の校庭で遊んでいた児童数名が、頭痛、咽頭痛、咳、強い目の刺激を訴えて来院した。いずれの児童も意識清明、体温は36 ℃台。眼球結膜に軽度発赤を認める。発汗を認める。天気は快晴、気温31.2 ℃、湿度60 %、微風であった。小学校のある地域は、自動車の交通量が多く、市が指定するごみの焼却施設が10 km 離れたところにある。原因として最も可能性の高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: One day in early June, just after 1 p.m., several children who had been playing in the playground of a nearby elementary school came to the hospital complaining of headaches, sore throats, coughs, and strong eye irritation. All of the children were alert and awake, with temperatures in the 36°C range. There was mild redness of the conjunctiva. They were sweating. The weather was clear, with a temperature of 31.2°C, humidity of 60%, and a light breeze. The area in which the elementary school is located has a lot of automobile traffic, and a city-designated waste incineration facility is located 10 km away. Which of the following is the most likely cause?

Question: 55 歳の男性。高血圧症の定期診察のため来院した。3 年前に職場の健康診査で高血圧を指摘された。その後、降圧薬で治療を受けている。家庭血圧は適切な範囲で管理されている。1 日30 分のウォーキングをしている。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。身長168 cm、体重58 kg。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧122/68 mmHg。尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖（－）。血液生化学所見：AST 28 U/L、ALT 18 U/L、γ-GT 40 U/L（基準値8 ～50）、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL、血糖68 mg/dL、HbA1c 5.4 %（基準値4.6～6.2）、トリグリセリド70 mg/dL、HDL コレステロール62 mg/dL、LDL コレステロール102 mg/dL。この患者の日常生活指導として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 55-year-old male visited the hospital for a routine checkup for hypertension. Three years ago, high blood pressure was detected during a workplace health check. Since then, he has been receiving antihypertensive medication. His blood pressure at home is controlled within an appropriate range. He walks for 30 minutes a day. There is nothing particularly noteworthy in his medical history. He has no history of smoking. He drinks alcohol occasionally. His height is 168 cm and his weight is 58 kg. His body temperature is 36.2°C. His pulse rate is 72 beats per minute and is regular. His blood pressure is 122/68 mmHg. Urine findings: protein (-), sugar (-). Blood biochemistry findings: AST 28 U/L, ALT 18 U/L, γ-GT 40 U/L (normal range 8-50), creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, blood glucose 68 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.4% (normal range 4.6-6.2), triglycerides 70 mg/dL, HDL cholesterol 62 mg/dL, LDL cholesterol 102 mg/dL. Which of the following is the most appropriate daily living advice for this patient?

Question: 50 歳の女性。健康診断で初めて血圧高値を指摘され来院した。健康診断時の血圧は138/88 mmHg であった。体重は20 歳ごろから変わっていない。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。喫煙歴はない。飲酒はビール350 mL/日を週2 回。仕事は忙しく、運動する機会はほとんどない。身長162 cm、体重58 kg。BMI 22.0。脈拍68/分、整。血圧134/82 mmHg。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。下肢に浮腫を認めない。尿検査：蛋白（－）。血液生化学所見：クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL、尿酸6.0 mg/dL、空腹時血糖68 mg/dL、HbA1c 5.8 %（基準4.6～6.2）、総コレステロール196 mg/dL、トリグリセリド100 mg/dL、HDL コレステロール68 mg/dL。食事内容の評価で、食塩摂取量5.5 g/日、野菜摂取量350 g/日。この患者の生活習慣に対する指導として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 50-year-old woman was diagnosed with high blood pressure for the first time during a health check and visited the hospital. Her blood pressure at the time of the health check was 138/88 mmHg. Her weight has not changed since she was around 20 years old. There is nothing notable in her medical history. She has no history of smoking. She drinks 350 mL of beer twice a week. She is busy with work and has little opportunity to exercise. Her height is 162 cm and her weight is 58 kg. Her BMI is 22.0. Her pulse rate is 68 beats per minute and regular. Her blood pressure is 134/82 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in her heart and respiratory sounds. Her abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. No edema was found in the lower limbs. Urine test: protein (-). Blood biochemistry findings: creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, uric acid 6.0 mg/dL, fasting blood glucose 68 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.8% (normal 4.6-6.2), total cholesterol 196 mg/dL, triglycerides 100 mg/dL, HDL cholesterol 68 mg/dL. Dietary assessment reveals salt intake of 5.5 g/day and vegetable intake of 350 g/day. Which of the following lifestyle recommendations is appropriate for this patient?

Question_EN: A 6-year-old girl was brought to the hospital by her mother because she was worried about her enlarged breasts. Her height was 124.1 cm (+2.1 SD), and her weight was 29.5 kg (+2.2 SD). There was no pubic or axillary hair. Which of the following would not be an appropriate diagnostic test?

Question: 24 歳の男性。意識障害のため救急車で搬入された。3 か月前から職場の上司にパワハラを受けていると悩んでいた。今朝、自宅のガレージで倒れているのを母親が発見し、救急車を要請した。本人の着衣と口腔内からは強い有機溶媒臭がしており、ガレージには灯油が残ったコップがあった。搬入後、次第に呼吸状態の悪化を認めた。意識レベルはJCSⅢ-100。体温36.8 ℃。心拍数104/分、整。血圧120/80 mmHg。呼吸数32/分。SpO2 88 %（リザーバー付マスク10 L/分 酸素投与下）。次に行うべき適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 24-year-old man was brought in by ambulance due to impaired consciousness. He had been worried about being subjected to power harassment by his superior at work for the past three months. His mother found him collapsed in the garage this morning and called an ambulance. There was a strong odor of organic solvents coming from his clothes and mouth, and a glass of kerosene was found in the garage. After being brought in, his respiratory condition gradually worsened. His level of consciousness was JCS III-100. Body temperature was 36.8°C. Heart rate was 104/min, normal. Blood pressure was 120/80 mmHg. Respiratory rate was 32/min. SpO2 was 88% (oxygen was administered via a mask with a reservoir at 10 L/min). What is the next appropriate action?

Question: 16 歳の男子。約2 か月前から「部屋の中を誰かに覗かれている」、「自宅にいても、友達が自分の悪口を言っているのが聞こえる」などと訴えるため、心配した両親に連れられて精神科を受診した。診察した精神保健指定医は、本人に治療したいという気持ちがないため、両親の同意を得て医療保護入院とした。入院7 日目、「自分は病気じゃないから退院したい」と言い、担当医が入院の継続を勧めると「退院請求というのを聞いたので手続きをしたい」と訴えた。退院請求について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 16-year-old boy. About two months ago, he complained that "someone was looking into my room" and "even when I was at home, I could hear my friends talking bad about me", so his concerned parents took him to a psychiatrist. The designated mental health doctor who examined him decided that he had no desire to receive treatment, so with his parents' consent, he was admitted under medical protection. On the seventh day of hospitalization, he said, "I'm not sick, so I want to be discharged," and when the attending physician in charge recommended that he continue hospitalization, he said, "I heard about requesting discharge, so I want to go through the procedure." Which of the following is correct regarding requests for discharge?

Question: 32 歳の女性。無月経を主訴に来院した。最終月経は、令和4 年1 月1 日から6日間。同年2 月1 日に人工授精し、3 月7 日に受診した。最近1 年間の性交渉歴はない。妊娠判定試薬は陽性であった。この時点で適切な経腟超音波検査所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 32-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of amenorrhea. Her last menstrual period was from January 1 to 6, 2022. She underwent artificial insemination on February 1 of the same year and visited the hospital on March 7. She has not had sexual intercourse in the past year. A pregnancy test kit was positive. Which of the following would be an appropriate transvaginal ultrasound finding at this point?

Question: 36 歳の女性。多発関節痛を主訴に来院した。3 か月前から微熱が出現し、脱毛が増加した。2 か月前から両手のこわばり、関節痛が出現した。3 週間前から両手指に紅斑が出現し、先週から38 ℃台の発熱があり紹介受診した。体温37.4 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧108/58 mmHg。前頭部に頭髪の減少を認める。顔面に紅斑を認めない。硬口蓋粘膜に発赤とびらんを認める。両側頸部、腋窩に径1 cm 未満の軽度圧痛を伴うリンパ節を触知する。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。両手指に凍瘡様皮疹を認める。右手関節と両手指近位指節間関節に腫脹と圧痛を認める。尿所見：蛋白2 ＋、糖（－）、潜血2 ＋、沈渣に赤血球10～19/HPF、変形赤血球を認める。血液所見：赤血球409 万、Hb 10.5 g/dL、Ht 34 %、白血球2,800（好中球75 %、単球7 %、リンパ球18 %）、血小板9.6 万、PT-INR 1.1（基準0.9～1.1）、APTT 43 秒（基準対照32.2）、血漿フィブリノゲン248 mg/dL（基準186～355）。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.4 g/dL、アルブミン3.0 g/dL、AST 23 U/L、ALT 15 U/L、LD 237 U/L（基準120～245）、CK 26 U/L（基準30～140）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL、血糖93 mg/dL。CRP 0.1 mg/dL。最も考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 36-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of multiple joint pains. She had had a slight fever and increased hair loss 3 months ago. She had been experiencing stiffness and joint pain in both hands for 2 months. She had developed erythema on the fingers of both hands 3 weeks ago, and had a fever of 38°C since last week, so she was referred to the hospital. Body temperature 37.4°C. Pulse rate 96 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 108/58 mmHg. Hair loss was noted on the forehead. No erythema was noted on the face. Redness and erosion were noted on the hard palate mucosa. Mildly tender lymph nodes measuring less than 1 cm in diameter were palpable in both necks and axillae. No abnormalities were noted in heart sounds and respiratory sounds. Chilblain-like rash was noted on the fingers of both hands. Swelling and tenderness were noted in the right hand joints and the proximal interphalangeal joints of both fingers. Urine findings: protein 2+, sugar (-), occult blood 2+, red blood cells 10-19/HPF, dysmorphic red blood cells in sediment.Blood findings: red blood cells 4.09 million, Hb 10.5 g/dL, Ht 34%, white blood cells 2,800 (neutrophils 75%, monocytes 7%, lymphocytes 18%), platelets 96,000, PT-INR 1.1 (normal 0.9-1.1), APTT 43 seconds (normal control 32.2), plasma fibrinogen 248 mg/dL (normal 186-355). Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 7.4 g/dL, albumin 3.0 g/dL, AST 23 U/L, ALT 15 U/L, LD 237 U/L (normal: 120-245), CK 26 U/L (normal: 30-140), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, blood glucose 93 mg/dL. CRP 0.1 mg/dL. Which of the following is most likely?

Question: 3 歳2 か月の女児。健康診査のため母親に連れられて来院した。上手に歩くことはできるが、①ひとりで階段を昇れない。上着を自分で脱ぐが、②ひとりでは着られない。同年齢の子ども達と遊べるが、③ルールのある遊びはできない。自分の名前は言えるが、④住所は言えない。物の大小はわかるが、⑤左右はわからない。①から⑤のうち発達の異常が考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 3-year-2-month-old girl was brought to the hospital by her mother for a health check. She can walk well, but ① cannot climb stairs by herself. She can take off her jacket by herself, but ② cannot put it on by herself. She can play with children her age, but ③ cannot play games with rules. She can say her name, but ④ cannot say her address. She can tell the size of objects, but ⑤ cannot tell left from right. Which of the numbered items suggests a developmental delay?

Question: 64 歳の男性。①脳出血で入院し、リハビリテーション後に、自宅に退院して1か月が経過した。現在は②右上下肢に軽度の運動麻痺が残存しており、杖歩行をしている。山間部の③過疎地域で④妻と2 人で暮らしている。⑤近所付き合いはない。退院後は自宅で農業をしながら、年金で生活している。①から⑤のうち国際生活機能分類〈ICF〉の生活機能における参加に分類されるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 64-year-old man. He was hospitalized for a ① cerebral hemorrhage, and after rehabilitation, he was discharged home one month ago. Currently,  he has ② mild motor paralysis remaining in his right upper and lower limbs, and walks with a cane. He lives in a ③ depopulated area ④ with his wife in the mountains. He has no ⑤ relationship with neighbors. Since being discharged from the hospital, he has been farming at home and living on his pension. Which of the numbered items is classified as participation in daily life functions in the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF)?

Question: 58 歳の女性。頭痛を主訴に来院した。暑い日の午前、仕事中に少しめまいを感じ、頭痛も出現したため受診した。作業中に大量に汗をかいた。最近、家族の介護が忙しく、寝不足が続いていた。仕事は空調のない自宅の作業場で、部屋を閉め切って縫製の作業をしている。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。喫煙歴と飲酒歴はない。身長155 cm、体重70 kg。BMI 29.1。体温36.4 ℃。身体診察と神経診察とに異常を認めない。 この患者に対する説明として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 58-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of a headache. She felt a little dizzy and had a headache while at work on a hot morning, so she visited the hospital. She sweated profusely while working. Recently, she has been busy caring for her family and has not been getting enough sleep. She works in a workshop at home that has no air conditioning, and does sewing work with the room closed. There is nothing notable in her medical history. She has no history of smoking or drinking. She is 155 cm tall and weighs 70 kg. BMI is 29.1. Body temperature is 36.4°C. No abnormalities were found in the physical and neurological examinations. Which of the following is the most appropriate explanation for this patient?

Question: 72 歳の男性。2 年前に喉頭癌に対して放射線治療を受け、その後再発を認めていない。喫煙は喉頭癌の診断まで20 本/日を45 年間。飲酒は焼酎200 mL/日を40年間。この患者で経過中に重複癌を生じる可能性が低い部位はどれか。
Question_EN: A 72-year-old man underwent radiation therapy for laryngeal cancer 2 years ago and has had no recurrence since then. He smoked 20 cigarettes per day for 45 years until the diagnosis of laryngeal cancer. He drank 200 mL of shochu per day for 40 years. In which part of the body is this patient least likely to develop a multiple primary cancer during his course?

Question:
50 歳の女性。発熱と強い動悸のため救急車で搬入された。
現病歴：6 日前から咽頭痛と軽度の咳嗽が出現し、自宅近くの診療所で総合感冒薬の処方を受けた。3 日前から発熱と前頸部痛が出現し、今朝から強い動悸も自覚したため娘が救急車を要請した。
既往歴：高血圧症でカルシウム拮抗薬を内服している。生活歴：夫、大学生の娘と3 人暮らし。喫煙は20 歳から30 歳まで10 本/日。飲酒歴はない。
家族歴：父が高血圧症。
現症：意識は清明。身長158 cm、体重52 kg。体温37.8 ℃。心拍数118/分、整。血圧134/74 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。口腔内と咽頭とに異常を認めない。甲状腺はびまん性に腫大しており、左葉に圧痛を認める。頸部リンパ節の腫大や頸静脈怒張を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。四肢に浮腫を認めない。
検査所見：尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖（－）、潜血（－）。赤沈62 mm/ 1 時間。血液所見：赤血球362 万、Hb 11.0 g/dL、Ht 32 %、白血球6,600、血小板18 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.2 g/dL、アルブミン4.0 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.8 mg/dL、AST 44 U/L、ALT 49 U/L、LD 207 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 262 U/L（基準38～113）、尿素窒素14 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL、血糖98 mg/dL、Na 141 mEq/L、K 3.6 mEq/L、Cl 104 mEq/L、Ca 8.8 mg/dL、TSH 0.08 μU/mL（基準0.2～4.0）、FT3 9.82 pg/mL（基準2.3～4.3）、FT4 3.92 ng/dL（基準0.8～2.2）。
免疫血清学所見：CRP 9.2 mg/dL、抗TSH 受容体抗体陰性。胸部エックス線写真で心拡大や肺血管影の増強はなく、胸水貯留を認めない。心電図は洞性頻脈でST-T 変化を認めない。
診断に最も有用な検査はどれか。
Question_EN:
A 50-year-old woman was brought in by ambulance with fever and strong palpitations.
History of current illness: She had a sore throat and mild cough for 6 days, and was prescribed a general cold medicine at a clinic near her home. She had a fever and anterior neck pain for 3 days, and this morning she was also aware of strong palpitations, so her daughter called for an ambulance.
Medical history: She has high blood pressure and is taking calcium antagonists. Lifestyle history: She lives with her husband and college-aged daughter. She smoked 10 cigarettes per day from the age of 20 to 30. She has no history of drinking alcohol.
Family history: Her father has high blood pressure.
Current illness: She is conscious and alert. Height 158 ​​cm, weight 52 kg. Body temperature 37.8°C. Heart rate 118/min, regular. Blood pressure 134/74 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20/min. SpO2 98% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the palpebral or bulbar conjunctiva. No abnormalities were found in the oral cavity or pharynx. The thyroid gland was diffusely enlarged, with tenderness in the left lobe. There was no enlargement of the cervical lymph nodes or jugular vein distension. No abnormalities were found in the heart or respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. No edema was found in the limbs.
Examination findings: Urine findings: Protein (-), sugar (-), occult blood (-). Erythrocyte sedimentation rate 62 mm/hour. Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.62 million, Hb 11.0 g/dL, Ht 32%, white blood cells 6,600, platelets 180,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.2 g/dL, albumin 4.0 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 44 U/L, ALT 49 U/L, LD 207 U/L (standard 120-245), ALP 262 U/L (standard 38-113), urea nitrogen 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, blood glucose 98 mg/dL, Na 141 mEq/L, K 3.6 mEq/L, Cl 104 mEq/L, Ca 8.8 mg/dL, TSH 0.08 μU/mL (standard 0.2-4.0), FT3 9.82 pg/mL (standard 2.3-4.3), FT4 3.92 ng/dL (standard 0.8-2.2). Immunoserological findings: CRP 9.2 mg/dL, anti-TSH receptor antibodies negative. Chest X-ray shows no cardiomegaly or increased pulmonary vascular shadows, and no pleural effusion. Electrocardiogram shows sinus tachycardia with no ST-T changes.
Which test is most useful for diagnosis?

Question:
85歳の男性。発熱と呼吸困難を主訴に家族とともに来院した。
現病歴：1年前から息切れのため自宅の階段を昇ることが困難となり、食事や飲水の際のむせが出現した。食事量も低下し、半年間で体重が5kg減少した。1週間前から咳嗽と喀痰が多くなり、2日前から38℃の発熱と呼吸困難がみられるようになったため家族に伴われて受診し、入院した。
既往歴：15年前から高血圧症に対してアンジオテンシン変換酵素〈ACE〉阻害薬を内服している。5年前から物忘れが目立つようになり、2年前にAlzheimer型認知症と診断された。
生活歴：65歳まで会社員。現在は娘の家族と同居。喫煙は65歳まで20本/日を45年間。飲酒歴はない。自宅で猫を飼育している。
家族歴：両親とも脳梗塞で死亡。
現症：意識は清明。身長160cm、体重43kg。体温38.0℃。脈拍120/分、整。血圧122/78mmHg。呼吸数28/分。眼瞼結膜に異常を認めない。口腔内の衛生状態は不良である。心音に異常を認めない。呼吸音は両側でwheezesを、右背側でcoarse cracklesを聴取する。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。浮腫を認めない。
検査所見：血液所見：赤血球412万、Hb 13.1g/dL、Ht 40%、白血球9,800（好中球82%、好酸球2%、好塩基球0%、単球7%、リンパ球9%）、血小板34万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白5.8g/dL、アルブミン2.9g/dL、総ビリルビン1.1mg/dL、AST 14U/L、ALT 10U/L、LD 230U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 64U/L（基準38～113）、尿素窒素28mg/dL、クレアチニン1.5mg/dL、尿酸6.0mg/dL、血糖135mg/dL、Na 139mEq/L、K 4.7mEq/L、Cl 106mEq/L。CRP 5.1mg/dL。動脈血ガス分析（鼻カニューラ2L/分 酸素投与下）：pH 7.33、PaCO2 58Torr、PaO2 72Torr、HCO3- 30mEq/L。新型コロナウイルス〈SARS-CoV-2〉PCR検査は陰性であった。
呼吸状態の急性増悪に対し、抗菌薬とともに用いる薬剤として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN:
An 85-year-old man visited the hospital with his family complaining of fever and dyspnea.
History of current illness: One year ago, he had difficulty climbing the stairs at home due to shortness of breath, and choked when eating or drinking. His food intake also decreased, and he lost 5 kg in weight over the past six months. One week ago, he started coughing and expectorating more, and two days ago, he started experiencing a fever of 38°C and dyspnea, so he visited the hospital accompanied by his family and was hospitalized.
Medical history: He has been taking angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors for hypertension for 15 years. He began to have noticeable forgetfulness five years ago, and was diagnosed with Alzheimer's dementia two years ago.
Life history: He was an office worker until the age of 65. He currently lives with his daughter's family. He smoked 20 cigarettes a day for 45 years until the age of 65. He has no history of drinking alcohol. He keeps a cat at home.
Family history: Both parents died of cerebral infarction.
Current symptoms: He is conscious and alert. Height 160cm, weight 43kg. Body temperature 38.0℃. Pulse 120/min, regular. Blood pressure 122/78mmHg. Respiratory rate 28/min. No abnormalities found in the palpebral conjunctiva. Oral hygiene was poor. No abnormalities found in the heart sounds. Breath sounds included wheezes on both sides and coarse crackles on the right dorsal side. The abdomen was flat and soft, with the liver and spleen not palpable. No edema was found.
Examination findings: Blood findings: RBC 4.12 million, Hb 13.1g/dL, Ht 40%, WBC 9,800 (neutrophils 82%, eosinophils 2%, basophils 0%, monocytes 7%, lymphocytes 9%), platelets 340,000. Blood biochemistry: total protein 5.8g/dL, albumin 2.9g/dL, total bilirubin 1.1mg/dL, AST 14U/L, ALT 10U/L, LD 230U/L (normal 120-245), ALP 64U/L (normal 38-113), urea nitrogen 28mg/dL, creatinine 1.5mg/dL, uric acid 6.0mg/dL, blood glucose 135mg/dL, Na 139mEq/L, K 4.7mEq/L, Cl 106mEq/L. CRP 5.1mg/dL. Arterial blood gas analysis (oxygen administered via nasal cannula at 2L/min): pH 7.33, PaCO2 58Torr, PaO2 72Torr, HCO3- 30mEq/L. The PCR test for the new coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) was negative.
Which of the following drugs would be appropriate to use in conjunction with antibiotics to treat an acute exacerbation of respiratory condition?

His food intake also decreased, and he lost 5 kg in weight over the past six months. Medical history: He has been taking angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors for hypertension for 15 years. He began to have noticeable forgetfulness five years ago, and was diagnosed with Alzheimer's dementia two years ago.
Life history: He was an office worker until the age of 65. He currently lives with his daughter's family. He smoked 20 cigarettes a day for 45 years until the age of 65. He has no history of drinking alcohol. He keeps a cat at home.
Family history: Both parents died of cerebral infarction.
Current symptoms: He is conscious and alert. Height 160cm, weight 43kg. Body temperature 38.0℃. Pulse 120/min, regular. Blood pressure 122/78mmHg. Respiratory rate 28/min. No abnormalities found in the palpebral conjunctiva. Oral hygiene was poor. No abnormalities found in the heart sounds. Breath sounds included wheezes on both sides and coarse crackles on the right dorsal side. The abdomen was flat and soft, with the liver and spleen not palpable. No edema was found.
Examination findings: Blood findings: RBC 4.12 million, Hb 13.1g/dL, Ht 40%, WBC 9,800 (neutrophils 82%, eosinophils 2%, basophils 0%, monocytes 7%, lymphocytes 9%), platelets 340,000. Blood biochemistry: total protein 5.8g/dL, albumin 2.9g/dL, total bilirubin 1.1mg/dL, AST 14U/L, ALT 10U/L, LD 230U/L (normal 120-245), ALP 64U/L (normal 38-113), urea nitrogen 28mg/dL, creatinine 1.5mg/dL, uric acid 6.0mg/dL, blood glucose 135mg/dL, Na 139mEq/L, K 4.7mEq/L, Cl 106mEq/L. CRP 5.1mg/dL. Arterial blood gas analysis (oxygen administered via nasal cannula at 2L/min): pH 7.33, PaCO2 58Torr, PaO2 72Torr, HCO3 -30mEq/L. The PCR test for the new coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) was negative.
On the third day of hospitalization, the patient's condition was improving and he no longer needed oxygen, but he suddenly tore off the respiratory and heart rate monitor, said "I'm going to work today," and tried to leave the room. He had a flat affect, and even when he explained that he was hospitalized, he did not listen, and several people had to restrain him. Which of the following approaches was incorrect?

Question: 左室駆出率が低下した心不全を増悪させる薬剤はどれか。
Question_EN: Which drug worsens heart failure with reduced left ventricular ejection fraction?

Question: てんかん発作の焦点が側頭葉に存在すると考えられる症状はどれか。
