Question: 腎障害を起こす頻度が高い薬剤はどれか。
Question_EN: Which drug most frequently causes renal impairment?

Question: 51 歳の女性。倦怠感を主訴に来院した。1 週間前から倦怠感が出現し、昨日から尿の色が濃くなったため受診した。飲酒は機会飲酒。常用している薬剤や健康食品はない。意識は清明。眼險結膜に貧血を認めない。眼球結膜に軽度黄染を認める。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知せず、圧痛を認めない。血液所見：赤血球325 万、Hb 12.0 g/dL、Ht 32 %、白血球5,300、血小板27 万、PT-INR 1.0（基準0.9～1.1）。血液生化学所見：総蛋白8.4 g/dL、アルブミン4.2 g/dL、IgG 3,131 mg/dL（基準960～1,960）、IgM 112 mg/dL（基準65～350）、総ビリルビン4.8 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン3.2 mg/dL、AST 712 U/L、ALT 824 U/L、ALP 132 U/L（基準38～113）、γ-GT 342 U/L（基準8 ～50）。免疫血清学所見：IgM型HA 抗体陰性、HBs 抗原陰性、IgM 型HBc 抗体陰性、HCV 抗体陰性、HCV-RNA 陰性、抗核抗体640 倍（基準20 以下）、抗ミトコンドリア抗体陰性。肝生検組織で門脈域の拡大と同部位に形質細胞を含む単核球細胞浸潤を認める。治療薬として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 51-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of fatigue. The fatigue had started one week ago, and her urine had become darker since yesterday, so she visited the hospital. She drinks alcohol on an occasional basis. She is not taking any medications or health foods regularly. She is conscious and alert. There is no anemia in the ocular conjunctiva. There is slight yellowing in the bulbar conjunctiva. The abdomen is flat and soft, and the liver and spleen are not palpable, and there is no tenderness. Blood findings: red blood cells 3.25 million, Hb 12.0 g/dL, Ht 32%, white blood cells 5,300, platelets 270,000, PT-INR 1.0 (normal 0.9-1.1). Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 8.4 g/dL, albumin 4.2 g/dL, IgG 3,131 mg/dL (standard 960-1,960), IgM 112 mg/dL (standard 65-350), total bilirubin 4.8 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 3.2 mg/dL, AST 712 U/L, ALT 824 U/L, ALP 132 U/L (standard 38-113), γ-GT 342 U/L (standard 8-50). Immunoserological findings: IgM type HA antibody negative, HBs antigen negative, IgM type HBc antibody negative, HCV antibody negative, HCV-RNA negative, antinuclear antibody 1:640 (standard 20 or less), antimitochondrial antibody negative. Liver biopsy tissue showed portal vein expansion and mononuclear cell infiltration including plasma cells at the same site. Which is the most appropriate treatment?

Question: 68 歳の男性。意識障害のため救急車で搬入された。家族によると、20 年前から糖尿病で内服加療中であり、最近は飲酒量が多かった。持参した糖尿病診療歴を記録したノートによると、血糖降下薬としてビグアナイド薬およびDPP-4 阻害薬を内服しており、最近の血液検査でクレアチニン1.2 mg/dL、HbA1c 6.8 % であった。意識レベルはJCSⅡ-20。身長168 cm、体重58 kg。体温36.1 ℃。心拍数88/分、整。血圧86/54 mmHg。呼吸数28/分、SpO2 98 %（room air）。皮膚は乾燥している。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。尿所見：蛋白2 ＋、糖＋、ケトン体（－）。血液生化学所見：総ビリルビン1.0 mg/dL、AST 54 U/L、ALT 46 U/L、γ-GT 168 U/L（基準8 ～50）、尿素窒素38 mg/dL、クレアチニン2.0 mg/dL、血糖128 mg/dL、HbA1c 6.6 %（基準4.6～6.2）、Na 138 mEq/L、K 3.8 mEq/L、Cl 94 mEq/L。この患者で認められるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 68-year-old man was brought in by ambulance due to impaired consciousness. According to his family, he had been taking oral medication for diabetes for the past 20 years, and had recently been drinking a lot of alcohol. According to the notebook he brought with him that records his diabetes medical history, he was taking biguanides and DPP-4 inhibitors as hypoglycemic drugs, and a recent blood test showed creatinine of 1.2 mg/dL and HbA1c of 6.8%. His level of consciousness was JCS II-20. Height 168 cm, weight 58 kg. Body temperature 36.1°C. Heart rate 88/min, regular. Blood pressure 86/54 mmHg. Respiratory rate 28/min, SpO2 98% (room air). Skin was dry. Heart and respiratory sounds were normal. Abdomen was flat and soft, and liver and spleen were not palpable. Urine findings: protein 2+, sugar +, ketone bodies (-). Blood biochemistry findings: Total bilirubin 1.0 mg/dL, AST 54 U/L, ALT 46 U/L, γ-GT 168 U/L (normal: 8-50), urea nitrogen 38 mg/dL, creatinine 2.0 mg/dL, blood glucose 128 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.6% (normal: 4.6-6.2), Na 138 mEq/L, K 3.8 mEq/L, Cl 94 mEq/L. Which of the following is present in this patient?

Question: 29 歳の女性（0 妊0 産）。腹部膨満感を主訴に来院した。半年前から体外受精－胚移植の不妊治療を受けており、4 日前に14 個採卵した。受精卵はすべて凍結保存されている。意識は清明。身長154 cm、体重52 kg（2 日で2 kg 増量）。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍80/分、整。血圧104/56 mmHg。呼吸数28/分。SpO2 96 %（room air）。腹部は軟で、膨隆し波動を認める。内診で子宮は正常大、可動性は良好である。腹部超音波検査で、径10 cm の両側卵巣腫大と多量の腹水貯留とを認める。心エコー検査で異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球565 万、Hb 16.8 g/dL、Ht 51 %、白血球11,800、血小板37 万、PT-INR 1.0（基準0.9～1.1）、血漿フィブリノゲン580 mg/dL（基準186～355）、Dダイマー2.9 μg/mL（基準1.0 以下）。血液生化学所見：総蛋白5.6 g/dL、アルブミン3.0 g/dL、尿素窒素26 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.81 mg/dL、Na 134 mEq/L、K 5.1 mEq/L、Cl 96 mEq/L。腹水貯留の原因となるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 29-year-old woman (0 pregnancies, 0 deliveries) visited the hospital complaining of abdominal distension. She had been undergoing infertility treatment with in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer for the past 6 months, and had undergone 14 oocyte retrieval 4 days ago. All fertilized eggs have been frozen and stored. She was conscious and alert. Height 154 cm, weight 52 kg (gained 2 kg in 2 days). Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse 80 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 104/56 mmHg. Respiratory rate 28 breaths/min. SpO2 96% (room air). The abdomen was soft, distended, and fluctuating. Pelvic examination revealed that the uterus was of normal size and had good mobility. Abdominal ultrasound revealed bilateral ovarian enlargement measuring 10 cm in diameter and a large amount of ascites. No abnormalities were found in echocardiography. Blood findings: Red blood cells 5.65 million, Hb 16.8 g/dL, Ht 51%, White blood cells 11,800, Platelets 370,000, PT-INR 1.0 (standard 0.9-1.1), Plasma fibrinogen 580 mg/dL (standard 186-355), D-dimer 2.9 μg/mL (standard 1.0 or less). Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 5.6 g/dL, Albumin 3.0 g/dL, Urea nitrogen 26 mg/dL, Creatinine 0.81 mg/dL, Na 134 mEq/L, K 5.1 mEq/L, Cl 96 mEq/L. Which of the following causes ascites?

Question: 65 歳の男性。ふらつきを主訴に来院した。最近ふらつくことが多くなり、家族に顔色が悪いことを指摘されるようになった。ふらつきは日中は目立たないが、夕方から夜に、特に暗い場所でひどくなる。55 歳時に胃癌で胃全摘術を受けた。再発がないため外科通院を5 年前から中断していた。脈拍96/分、整。血圧118/76 mmHg。血液所見：赤血球280 万、Hb 10.2 g/dL、MCV 114 fL、白血球4,800、血小板21 万。頭部MRI で異常所見を認めない。この患者の神経所見として正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 65-year-old man visits the hospital complaining of dizziness. He has recently become more dizzier, and his family has pointed out that he looks pale. The dizziness is not noticeable during the day, but gets worse in the evening and at night, especially in dark places. At the age of 55, he underwent a total gastrectomy for gastric cancer. As there has been no recurrence, he stopped visiting the surgical hospital five years ago. Pulse rate 96 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 118/76 mmHg. Blood findings: red blood cells 2.8 million, hemoglobin 10.2 g/dL, MCV 114 fL, white blood cells 4,800, platelets 210,000. No abnormal findings were found in a head MRI. Which of the following is the correct neurological finding for this patient?

Question: 3 歳の男児。発熱と右眼の充血を主訴に母親に連れられて来院した。2 日前から発熱があり、のどの痛みを訴えていた。本日、右眼の充血に気付いたという。体温38.8 ℃。脈拍104/分、整。呼吸数24/分。右眼瞼結膜および眼球結膜は充血し、眼脂を認める。咽頭は発赤し、口蓋扁桃に白苔の付着を認める。口腔内に水疱なし。頰粘膜に白斑なし。歯肉腫脹なし。両側の頸部に径1 cm のリンパ節を数個ずつ触知する。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。頰部を含む皮膚に皮疹を認めない。原因として最も可能性が高いウイルスはどれか。
Question_EN: A 3-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his mother complaining of fever and bloodshot right eye. He had had a fever for 2 days and complained of a sore throat. Today, he noticed his right eye was bloodshot. Temperature 38.8°C. Pulse 104 beats/min, regular. Respiratory rate 24 beats/min. The right palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva are bloodshot, and there is eye discharge. The pharynx is red, and there is white fur on the palatine tonsils. There are no blisters in the mouth. There are no white spots on the buccal mucosa. There is no gingival swelling. Several lymph nodes, each 1 cm in diameter, are palpable on both sides of the neck. No abnormalities were noted in the heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen is flat and soft, and the liver and spleen are not palpable. There is no rash on the skin, including the cheeks. Which virus is most likely to be the cause?

Question: 10 歳の男児。繰り返す鼻出血と皮下出血を主訴に母親に連れられて来院した。乳児期から同様の症状を繰り返しており、鼻出血は数時間以上止血困難なことがたびたびある。父親も出血傾向があるという。意識は清明。眼瞼結膜は軽度貧血様で、眼球結膜に黄染を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。両側下腿に紫斑を認める。血液所見：赤血球328 万、Hb 10.2 g/dL、Ht 31 %、白血球8,400、血小板35 万、出血時間10 分以上（基準7分以下）、PT-INR 1.0（基準0.9～1.1）、APTT 50.3 秒（基準対照32.2）、血漿フィブリノゲン280 mg/dL（基準186～355）、血清FDP 5 μg/mL（基準10 以下）。ADP血小板凝集能は正常。最も考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 10-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his mother complaining of repeated nosebleeds and subcutaneous bleeding. He had experienced similar symptoms since infancy, and nosebleeds were often difficult to stop for more than a few hours. His father also reported a tendency to bleed. He was conscious and alert. The palpebral conjunctiva appeared to be mildly anemic, and there was no yellowing of the bulbar conjunctiva. Heart and respiratory sounds were normal. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. Purpura was present on both lower legs. Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.28 million, Hb 10.2 g/dL, Ht 31%, White blood cells 8,400, Platelets 350,000, Bleeding time 10 minutes or more (standard 7 minutes or less), PT-INR 1.0 (standard 0.9-1.1), APTT 50.3 seconds (standard control 32.2), Plasma fibrinogen 280 mg/dL (standard 186-355), Serum FDP 5 μg/mL (standard 10 or less). ADP platelet aggregation is normal. Which is the most likely?

Question: 75 歳の男性。全身倦怠感を主訴に家族に連れられて来院した。本日起床時から倦怠感を自覚し、水分を摂取したが軽快しないため受診した。慢性腎臓病、糖尿病および高血圧症でスルホニル尿素薬、DPP-4 阻害薬、SGLT2 阻害薬、カルシウム拮抗薬および抗アルドステロン薬を内服している。身長170 cm、体重70 kg。脈拍96/分、整。血圧172/60 mmHg。胸腹部に異常を認めない。尿所見：蛋白2 ＋、ケトン体（－）、潜血（－）。血液所見：赤血球420 万、Hb 13.0 g/dL、Ht 40 %、白血球7,200、血小板35 万。血液生化学所見：尿素窒素40 mg/dL、クレアチニン2.0 mg/dL、血糖220 mg/dL、HbA1c 7.8 %（基準4.6～6.2）、Na 145 mEq/L、K 6.5 mEq/L、Cl 110 mEq/L。1 か月前の血液検査では、クレアチニン2.3 mg/dL、HbA1c 7.5 %、K 4.2 mEq/L であった。この患者の高カリウム血症の原因として最も可能性が高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 75-year-old man was brought to the hospital by his family, complaining of general fatigue. He had been feeling fatigue since waking up this morning, and although he had been drinking fluids, the fatigue had not improved, so he visited the hospital. He has chronic kidney disease, diabetes, and hypertension, and is taking sulfonylureas, DPP-4 inhibitors, SGLT2 inhibitors, calcium antagonists, and antialdosterone drugs. Height 170 cm, weight 70 kg. Pulse 96 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 172/60 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the chest and abdomen. Urine findings: protein 2+, ketone bodies (-), occult blood (-). Blood findings: red blood cells 4.2 million, Hb 13.0 g/dL, Ht 40%, white blood cells 7,200, platelets 350,000. Blood chemistry findings: urea nitrogen 40 mg/dL, creatinine 2.0 mg/dL, blood glucose 220 mg/dL, HbA1c 7.8% (normal 4.6-6.2), Na 145 mEq/L, K 6.5 mEq/L, Cl 110 mEq/L. Blood tests one month ago showed creatinine 2.3 mg/dL, HbA1c 7.5%, K 4.2 mEq/L. What is the most likely cause of this patient's hyperkalemia?

Question: 10 歳の男児。顔色不良を心配した母親に連れられて来院した。1 か月前から歩くときに息があがるようになり、最近顔色が悪いため受診した。生後7 日目に腸回転異常症に対する開腹手術を受けた既往がある。手術では壊死した腸管を切除し、十二指腸球部から40 cm の空腸と上行結腸を吻合した。1 歳時は在宅静脈栄養を行いながら外来で経過観察していたが、2 歳時には静脈栄養から離脱した。現在は家族と同じ食事を摂取している。身長121 cm（－1.8 SD）、体重19 kg（－1.7 SD）。体温36.5 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧106/50 mmHg。呼吸数15/分、SpO2 99 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球148万、Hb 6.0 g/dL、Ht 17 %、MCV 111 fL、MCH 40.6 pg、MCHC 36.5 %、白血球5,600（好中球51 %、リンパ球46 %、単球1 %、好酸球2 %）、血小板21 万、出血時間3 分（基準7 分以下）、PT-INR 1.0（基準0.9～1.1）、APTT 30 秒（基準対照32.2）。血液生化学所見：蛋白5.6 g/dL、アルブミン3.5 g/dL、総ビリルビン1.0 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン0.1 mg/dL、AST 35 U/L、ALT 32 U/L、尿素窒素4.1 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.2 mg/dL、Na 138 mEq/L、K 3.7 mEq/L、Cl 107 mEq/L。CRP 0.2 mg/dL。補うべきビタミンはどれか。
Question_EN: A 10-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his mother, who was concerned about his poor complexion. He had been out of breath when walking for the past month, and recently his complexion has been poor, so he visited the hospital. He had a history of undergoing laparotomy for intestinal malrotation on the 7th day of life. During the operation, the necrotic intestine was resected, and the jejunum 40 cm from the duodenal bulb was anastomosed to the ascending colon. At the age of 1 year, he was monitored as an outpatient while receiving home parenteral nutrition, but at the age of 2 years, he was weaned from parenteral nutrition. He is currently eating the same diet as his family. Height 121 cm (-1.8 SD), weight 19 kg (-1.7 SD). Body temperature 36.5°C. Pulse 72/min, regular. Blood pressure 106/50 mmHg. Respiratory rate 15/min, SpO2 99% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. Blood findings: RBC 1.48 million, Hb 6.0 g/dL, Ht 17%, MCV 111 fL, MCH 40.6 pg, MCHC 36.5%, WBC 5,600 (neutrophils 51%, lymphocytes 46%, monocytes 1%, eosinophils 2%), platelets 210,000, bleeding time 3 minutes (normal: 7 minutes or less), PT-INR 1.0 (normal: 0.9-1.1), APTT 30 seconds (normal control: 32.2). Blood biochemistry: Protein 5.6 g/dL, albumin 3.5 g/dL, total bilirubin 1.0 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 0.1 mg/dL, AST 35 U/L, ALT 32 U/L, urea nitrogen 4.1 mg/dL, creatinine 0.2 mg/dL, Na 138 mEq/L, K 3.7 mEq/L, Cl 107 mEq/L. CRP 0.2 mg/dL. Which vitamin should be supplemented?

Question: 10 歳の男児。体を後方にそらす運動や無意味な言葉を繰り返し発するようになり、両親に連れられて来院した。6 歳ごろから顔をゆがめる、首を振るなどの運動を繰り返し、突然声を発したり咳払いをしたりするようになった。8 歳以降は拍手やジャンプなど、より複雑な運動も繰り返すようになった。汚い言葉を繰り返し発することもあるという。 この児で最も考えられる疾患はどれか。
Question_EN: A 10-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his parents after he began leaning his body backwards and repeatedly uttering nonsensical words. From about age 6, he began repeatedly grimacing and shaking his head, and would suddenly vocalize or clear his throat. From age 8, he began repeatedly making more complex movements such as clapping and jumping. He also sometimes repeatedly utters foul language. Which of the following is the most likely illness for this child?

Question: 28 歳の男性。腹痛を主訴に来院した。1 か月前からのどが乾き、夜間に排尿のため何回も目が覚めるようになった。今朝から腹痛を自覚し、食事が摂れないため受診した。身長174 cm、体重65 kg。脈拍92/分、整。血圧88/64 mmHg。口腔内は乾燥している。尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖3 ＋、ケトン体2 ＋、潜血（－）。血液生化学所見：総蛋白8.2 g/dL、尿素窒素28 mg/dL、クレアチニン1.0 mg/dL、血糖466 mg/dL、HbA1c 9.5 %（基準4.6～6.2）、Na 128 mEq/L、K 5.5 mEq/L、Cl 88 mEq/L。生理食塩液の輸液とインスリンの静脈内投与を開始した。治療開始後数時間以内に低下が予想されるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 28-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of abdominal pain. He had been experiencing dry throat for the past month, and had been waking up several times at night to urinate. He was aware of abdominal pain since this morning and was unable to eat, so he visited the hospital. Height 174 cm, weight 65 kg. Pulse 92/min, regular. Blood pressure 88/64 mmHg. The mouth was dry. Urine findings: protein (-), glucose 3+, ketone bodies 2+, occult blood (-). Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 8.2 g/dL, urea nitrogen 28 mg/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, blood glucose 466 mg/dL, HbA1c 9.5% (normal 4.6-6.2), Na 128 mEq/L, K 5.5 mEq/L, Cl 88 mEq/L. Saline infusion and intravenous insulin administration were started. Which of the following would be expected to decrease within the first few hours of treatment?

Question: 48歳の女性。倦怠感と痒みを主訴に来院した。1週間前から倦怠感があり、3日前から全身の痒みを自覚し受診した。心窩部不快感、下痢および便秘はない。健康維持のため1年前からサプリメントを摂取していた。内服薬はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。海外渡航歴はない。生貝や生肉の摂食歴はない。意識は清明。身長158 cm、体重62 kg。体温36.3 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧116/70 mmHg。眼險結膜に貧血を認めない。眼球結膜に軽度黄染を認める。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。血液所見：赤血球490 万、Hb 14.5 g/dL、Ht 42 %、白血球6,300（好中球56 %、好酸球12 %、好塩基球1 %、単球6 %、リンパ球25 %、異型リンパ球0 %）、血小板29 万、PT-INR 1.1（基準0.9～1.1）。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.4 g/dL、アルブミン4.1 g/dL、IgG 1,210 mg/dL（基準960～1,960）、総ビリルビン5.1 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン3.8 mg/dL、AST 770 U/L、ALT 620 U/L、ALP 426 U/L（基準38～113）、γ-GT 487 U/L（基準8 ～50）、血糖96 mg/dL。免疫血清学所見：IgM 型HA 抗体陰性、HBs 抗原陰性、IgM 型HBc 抗体陰性、HCV 抗体陰性、HCV-RNA 陰性、抗核抗体陰性、抗ミトコンドリア抗体陰性。腹部超音波検査で異常を認めない。診断確定に有用な検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 48-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of fatigue and itching. She had been feeling fatigue for one week, and had noticed generalized itching for three days before visiting the hospital. She had no epigastric discomfort, diarrhea, or constipation. She had been taking supplements for the past year to maintain her health. She was taking no oral medications. She drank alcohol occasionally. She had no history of traveling abroad. She had no history of eating raw shellfish or meat. She was conscious and alert. Her height was 158 cm and her weight was 62 kg. Her body temperature was 36.3°C. Her pulse rate was 72 beats per minute and regular. Her blood pressure was 116/70 mmHg. There was no anemia in the ocular conjunctiva. There was mild yellowing in the bulbar conjunctiva. Her abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. Blood findings: RBC 4.9 million, Hb 14.5 g/dL, Ht 42%, WBC 6,300 (neutrophils 56%, eosinophils 12%, basophils 1%, monocytes 6%, lymphocytes 25%, atypical lymphocytes 0%), platelets 290,000, PT-INR 1.1 (normal: 0.9-1.1). Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.4 g/dL, albumin 4.1 g/dL, IgG 1,210 mg/dL (normal: 960-1,960), total bilirubin 5.1 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 3.8 mg/dL, AST 770 U/L, ALT 620 U/L, ALP 426 U/L (normal: 38-113), γ-GT 487 U/L (normal: 8-50), blood glucose 96 mg/dL. Immunoserological findings: IgM HA antibody negative, HBs antigen negative, IgM HBc antibody negative, HCV antibody negative, HCV-RNA negative, antinuclear antibody negative, antimitochondrial antibody negative. No abnormalities were found in abdominal ultrasound. Which test would be useful to confirm the diagnosis?

Question: 13 歳の男子。運動後の呼吸困難を主訴に救急車で搬入された。昨日、給食でうどんを食べた後、午後1 限目の体育で持久走をしたところ、全身の蕁麻疹、気分不快、咳嗽、喘鳴および呼吸困難が出現したため救急搬送され治療を受けた。1 週間前にも同様のエピソードがあったが食事制限は行われていなかった。白血球6,700（好酸球5 %）。IgE 740 IU/mL（基準170 以下）。プリックテスト：コムギ抗原液のみ強陽性。この患者に対する指導として最も適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 13-year-old boy was brought in by ambulance complaining of shortness of breath after exercise. After eating udon noodles for lunch yesterday, he ran a long distance during the first period of physical education in the afternoon. He developed hives all over his body, felt unwell, coughed, wheezing and shortness of breath, and was taken to the hospital by ambulance for treatment. He had a similar episode one week ago, but no dietary restrictions were imposed. White blood cell count: 6,700 (eosinophils: 5%). IgE: 740 IU/mL (normal: below 170). Skin prick test: Only wheat antigen solution was strongly positive. Which of the following is the most appropriate instruction for this patient?

Question: 28 歳の女性。発熱を主訴に来院した。2 週間前から咽頭痛と夕方になると39 ℃の発熱を認めるようになった。自宅近くの診療所で処方された抗菌薬を内服していたが、改善しないため紹介受診した。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。身長165 cm、体重58 kg。体温38.7 ℃。脈拍104/分、整。血圧98/68 mmHg。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。頸部と腋窩とに軽度圧痛を伴う径1 cm のリンパ節を複数触知する。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。右肋骨弓下に肝を1 cm触知する。四肢に多発する小紅斑を認める。小紅斑は、発熱時に出現し解熱後に消退するという。両側の手関節と膝関節に腫脹を認める。尿所見に異常を認めない。赤沈46 mm/ 1 時間。血液所見：赤血球465 万、Hb 13.8 g/dL、Ht 41 %、白血球18,100（好中球86 %、好酸球1 %、好塩基球1 %、リンパ球12 %）、血小板28 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.7 g/dL、アルブミン3.4 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.6 mg/dL、AST 162 U/L、ALT 134 U/L、LD 330 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 88 U/L（基準38～113）、γ-GT 32 U/L（基準8 ～50）、CK 86 U/L（基準30～140）、尿素窒素14 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL。免疫血清学所見：CRP 22 mg/dL、抗核抗体陰性、リウマトイド因子〈RF〉陰性。次に確認すべき検査値はどれか。
Question_EN: A 28-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of fever. For the past 2 weeks, she had been experiencing sore throat and a fever of 39°C in the evening. She had been taking antibiotics prescribed by a clinic near her home, but her condition did not improve, so she was referred to the hospital. There was nothing notable in her medical history. Height 165 cm, weight 58 kg. Body temperature 38.7°C. Pulse 104 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 98/68 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva. Multiple lymph nodes measuring 1 cm in diameter and accompanied by mild tenderness were palpable in the neck and axilla. No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The liver was palpable 1 cm below the right costal arch. Multiple small erythema was observed on the limbs. Small erythema appears during fever and disappears after fever subsides. Swelling was observed in both wrists and knees. No abnormalities were found in the urinary findings. Erythrocyte sedimentation rate 46 mm/1 hour. Blood findings: RBC 4.65 million, Hb 13.8 g/dL, Ht 41%, WBC 18,100 (neutrophils 86%, eosinophils 1%, basophils 1%, lymphocytes 12%), platelets 280,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.7 g/dL, albumin 3.4 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL, AST 162 U/L, ALT 134 U/L, LD 330 U/L (normal 120-245), ALP 88 U/L (normal 38-113), γ-GT 32 U/L (normal 8-50), CK 86 U/L (normal 30-140), urea nitrogen 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL. Immunoserological findings: CRP 22 mg/dL, antinuclear antibodies negative, rheumatoid factor (RF) negative. Which test value should be checked next?

Question: 62 歳の男性。左内包脳梗塞に対する薬物療法で入院中である。現在、発症後5日目である。意識は清明。血圧128/76 mmHg。ベッド上で背もたれ角度を90 度としても血圧の低下を認めず、神経徴候に変化を認めない。徒手筋力テストで左上下肢は5 、右上下肢では肘屈曲1 、手指屈曲0 、手指伸展0 、股関節屈曲1 、膝伸展0 、足関節背屈0 であった。右上下肢に軽度の感覚障害を認める。現時点で行うべきリハビリテーションはどれか。
Question_EN: A 62-year-old man is hospitalized for drug therapy for left internal capsule cerebral infarction. It is currently the fifth day since the onset of symptoms. He is conscious and alert. His blood pressure is 128/76 mmHg. Even when the bed is tilted to a 90 degree angle, there is no drop in blood pressure, and no change in neurological signs. Manual muscle testing showed that the left upper and lower limbs were 5, and the right upper and lower limbs were elbow flexion 1, finger flexion 0, finger extension 0, hip flexion 1, knee extension 0, and ankle dorsiflexion 0. There is mild sensory impairment in the right upper and lower limbs. Which rehabilitation should be performed at this point?

Question: 53 歳の女性。労作時息切れを主訴に来院した。1 か月前に自宅の階段を昇る際に息切れを自覚し、その後も症状が増悪するため受診した。眼瞼結膜は貧血様で、眼球結膜に黄染を認める。胸骨右縁第2 肋間を最強点とするLevine 2/6 の収縮期雑音を聴取する。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。圧痛を認めない。血液所見：赤血球260 万、Hb 7.8 g/dL、Ht 27 %、網赤血球4.2 %、白血球5,400（桿状核好中球5 %、分葉核好中球58 %、好酸球2 %、単球13 %、リンパ球22 %）、血小板38 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.4 g/dL、アルブミン3.8 g/dL、総ビリルビン5.5 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン0.9 mg/dL、AST 37 U/L、ALT 29 U/L、LD 740 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 66 U/L（基準38～113）、尿素窒素18 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、尿酸4.5 mg/dL、ハプトグロビン2 mg/dL（基準19～170）。免疫血清学所見：CRP 0.6 mg/dL、直接Coombs 試験陽性。この患者に行う初期治療で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 53-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of shortness of breath on exertion. One month earlier, she had become aware of shortness of breath while climbing the stairs at home, and her symptoms had worsened since then, so she visited the hospital. The palpebral conjunctiva appeared anemic, and yellowish staining was observed in the bulbar conjunctiva. A Levine 2/6 systolic murmur was heard, with the strongest point being the second intercostal space on the right sternal border. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. There was no tenderness. Blood findings: red blood cells 2.6 million, hemoglobin 7.8 g/dL, hemoglobin 27%, reticulocytes 4.2%, white blood cells 5,400 (band neutrophils 5%, segmented neutrophils 58%, eosinophils 2%, monocytes 13%, lymphocytes 22%), platelets 380,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.4 g/dL, albumin 3.8 g/dL, total bilirubin 5.5 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL, AST 37 U/L, ALT 29 U/L, LD 740 U/L (normal: 120-245), ALP 66 U/L (normal: 38-113), urea nitrogen 18 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, uric acid 4.5 mg/dL, haptoglobin 2 mg/dL (normal: 19-170). Immunoserological findings: CRP 0.6 mg/dL, direct Coombs test positive. Which of the following is the correct initial treatment for this patient?

Question: 生後1 時間の男児。在胎38 週、体重4,100 g、帝王切開で出生した。Apgar スコアは8 点（1 分）、9 点（5 分）。母親は33 歳、初産で妊娠糖尿病と診断されていたが、定期的な妊婦健康診査を受診していなかった。体温37.2 ℃。心拍数140/分、整。血圧72/48 mmHg。呼吸数50/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は軽度の膨隆を認める。肝臓を右肋骨弓下に1 cm触知するが、脾臓は触知しない。皮膚は赤く、末梢性チアノーゼを認める。直ちに行うべき検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A male infant 1 hour after birth. At 38 weeks gestation, weighing 4,100 g, he was delivered by Caesarean section. His Apgar scores were 8 (1 min) and 9 (5 min). The mother was 33 years old and a first-time mother who had been diagnosed with gestational diabetes, but had not undergone regular prenatal checkups. Body temperature 37.2°C. Heart rate 140 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 72/48 mmHg. Respiratory rate 50 beats/min. SpO2 98% (room air). No abnormalities were noted in the heart and respiratory sounds. There was mild abdominal distension. The liver was palpable 1 cm below the right costal arch, but the spleen was not palpable. The skin was red, and peripheral cyanosis was noted. Which test should be performed immediately?

Question: A 35-year-old man complained of a sudden onset of severe headache. For the past two weeks, he woke up around 3:00 a.m. due to soreness behind the left eye. His pain continued for about an hour. Today, he visited the emergency department at 5:30 a.m. His consciousness was clear, but he appeared restless. His body temperature was 36.4 ℃. Pulse rate was 84/min. Blood pressure was 136/80 mmHg. Conjunctival hyperemia and tearing of the left eye were observed. There were no meningeal signs. MRI and MRA of the head showed no abnormalities. What is the most likely diagnosis?
Question_EN: A 35-year-old man complained of a sudden onset of severe headache. For the past two weeks, he woke up around 3:00 a.m. due to soreness behind the left eye. His pain continued for about an hour. Today, he visited the emergency department at 5:30 a.m. His consciousness was clear, but he appeared restless. His body temperature was 36.4 °C. Pulse rate was 84/min. Blood pressure was 136/80 mmHg. Conjunctival hyperemia and tearing of the left eye were observed. There were no meningeal signs. MRI and MRA of the head showed no abnormalities. What is the most likely diagnosis?

Question: 22 歳の女性。初めて受けた子宮頸がん検診で異常を指摘され受診した。身長162 cm、体重56 kg。体温36.5 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。内診で子宮は正常大で可動性良好、両側付属器を触知しない。子宮腟部に肉眼的な異常を認めない。経腟超音波検査で異常を認めない。コルポスコピィで白色上皮を認めたため、同部の狙い組織診を実施したところ、軽度異形成（子宮頸部上皮内腫瘍）と診断された。患者への説明として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 22-year-old woman visited the hospital after an abnormality was detected during her first cervical cancer screening. Her height is 162 cm and her weight is 56 kg. Her body temperature is 36.5°C. Her pulse rate is 72 beats per minute and regular. A pelvic examination reveals that the uterus is of normal size and has good mobility, with no palpable adnexa on either side. No macroscopic abnormalities are found in the utero-vaginal region. No abnormalities are found on transvaginal ultrasound. Colposcopy reveals white epithelium, so a targeted biopsy of the same area was performed, which resulted in a diagnosis of mild dysplasia (cervical intraepithelial neoplasia). Which of the following is the most appropriate explanation to give to the patient?

Question: 57 歳の女性。咳嗽、呼吸困難および発熱を主訴に来院した。昨年も8 月に同様の症状で入院し、入院後治療せずに軽快している。1 週間前から症状が増悪したため救急外来を受診した。体温37.8 ℃。脈拍92/分、整。血圧112/70 mmHg。SpO2 92 %（room air）。呼吸音は両側でfine crackles を聴取する。血液所見：赤血球335 万、Hb 12.8 g/dL、Ht 33 %、白血球7,400、血小板15 万。血液生化学所見：AST 25 U/L、ALT 28 U/L、LD 280 U/L（基準120～245）、クレアチニン0.5 mg/dL。CRP 5.8 mg/dL。胸部単純CT で浸潤影、すりガラス陰影および小葉中心性陰影を認めた。この患者の所見として誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 57-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of cough, dyspnea, and fever. She had been admitted to the hospital in August last year with similar symptoms, and had recovered without treatment since then. Her symptoms had worsened one week prior, and she visited the emergency room. Body temperature 37.8°C. Pulse 92 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 112/70 mmHg. SpO2 92% (room air). Fine crackles were heard bilaterally. Blood findings: RBC 3.35 million, Hb 12.8 g/dL, Ht 33%, WBC 7,400, platelets 150,000. Blood biochemistry findings: AST 25 U/L, ALT 28 U/L, LD 280 U/L (normal 120-245), creatinine 0.5 mg/dL, CRP 5.8 mg/dL. A plain chest CT scan revealed infiltration, ground-glass opacities, and centrilobular opacities. Which of the following is not a finding for this patient?

Question: 58歳の女性（2妊1産）。不正出血を主訴に来院した。30歳の2回目妊娠時に、①胞状奇胎の診断で子宮内容除去術を受けた。42歳時に子宮頸部細胞診異常と②ヒトパピローマウイルス〈HPV〉検査陽性を指摘されたが、その後の通院を自己中断した。45歳時に子宮頸癌ⅡB期（扁平上皮癌）と診断され、③薬物による抗癌治療と④根治的放射線治療を受けている。治療後、48歳時から骨粗鬆症の診断で⑤ビスホスホネート製剤が投与されている。来院時の子宮内膜組織検査で癌肉腫と診断された。その後行った骨盤部単純MRIで子宮体部腫瘤が認められ、FDG-PETでは同部位にのみ異常集積を認めた。①から⑤のうち、今回の子宮体部癌肉腫の発生と最も関連が深いのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 58-year-old woman (2 pregnancies, 1 birth) visited the hospital complaining of irregular bleeding. At age 30, during her second pregnancy, she was diagnosed with ①hydatidiform mole and underwent uterine dilation and curettage. At age 42, she was diagnosed with abnormal cervical cytology and ②positive human papillomavirus (HPV) test, but discontinued subsequent visits to the hospital. At age 45, she was diagnosed with stage II B cervical cancer (squamous cell carcinoma) and underwent ③pharmacologic anticancer treatment and ④radical radiation therapy. After treatment, she was diagnosed with osteoporosis at age 48 and ⑤bisphosphonates were administered. An endometrial tissue test at the time of her visit revealed carcinosarcoma. A subsequent plain pelvic MRI revealed a mass in the uterine body, and FDG-PET showed abnormal accumulation only in the same area. Which of the numbered items is most closely related to the occurrence of this uterine carcinosarcoma?

Question: 74歳の女性。右股関節痛を主訴に来院した。7年前に右変形性股関節症で右人工股関節置換術を受けた。その後、問題なく経過していたが、半年前から右股関節痛が出現し、徐々に痛みが増悪し歩行困難になったため受診した。意識は清明。身長156 cm、体重46 kg。体温37.2 ℃。脈拍84/分、整。血圧132/72 mmHg。右股関節に腫脹と熱感を認め、発赤も伴っている。血液所見：赤血球370 万、Hb 10.8 g/dL、Ht 33 %、白血球12,700、血小板30 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.4 g/dL、アルブミン3.4 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.6 mg/dL、AST 17 U/L、ALT 8 U/L、LD 134 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 144 U/L（基準38～113）、γ-GT 16 U/L（基準8 ～50）、アミラーゼ70 U/L（基準37～160）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、血糖90 mg/dL、Na 143 mEq/L、K 4.0 mEq/L、Cl 105 mEq/L。CRP 6.2 mg/dL。来院時の両側股関節エックス線写真で、右人工股関節にゆるみを認めた。次に行うべきなのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 74-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of right hip pain. Seven years ago, she underwent right hip replacement surgery for right osteoarthritis of the hip. Since then, there had been no problems, but six months ago, she began to experience right hip pain, which gradually worsened and caused her to have difficulty walking, so she visited the hospital. She was conscious and alert. Height 156 cm, weight 46 kg. Body temperature 37.2°C. Pulse 84 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 132/72 mmHg. There was swelling and a feeling of heat in the right hip joint, along with redness. Blood findings: red blood cells 3.7 million, Hb 10.8 g/dL, Ht 33%, white blood cells 12,700, platelets 300,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.4 g/dL, albumin 3.4 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL, AST 17 U/L, ALT 8 U/L, LD 134 U/L (standard 120-245), ALP 144 U/L (standard 38-113), γ-GT 16 U/L (standard 8-50), amylase 70 U/L (standard 37-160), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, blood glucose 90 mg/dL, Na 143 mEq/L, K 4.0 mEq/L, Cl 105 mEq/L. CRP 6.2 mg/dL. Bilateral hip X-rays taken at the time of visit showed loosening of the right artificial hip joint. Which should be done next?

Question: 75 歳の男性。易疲労感を主訴に来院した。5 年前に再生不良性貧血と診断され免疫抑制療法を開始したが改善を認めず、4 年前からは2 週間おきに赤血球輸血を継続して受けている。身長165 cm、体重58 kg。体温36.3 ℃。脈拍100/分、整。眼瞼結膜は軽度貧血様で、眼球結膜に黄染を認めない。胸骨右縁第2 肋間を最強点とするLevine 2/6 の収縮期雑音を聴取する。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。皮膚は暗褐色。血液所見：赤血球200 万、Hb 5.8 g/dL、Ht 19 %、網赤血球0.2 %、白血球2,200（分葉核好中球8 %、好酸球2 %、好塩基球1 %、リンパ球89 %）、血小板4.0 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.2 g/dL、アルブミン2.8 g/dL、総ビリルビン1.1 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン0.8 mg/dL、AST 129 U/L、ALT 12 U/L、LD 360 U/L（基準120～245）、尿素窒素19 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、空腹時血糖90 mg/dL、Fe 250 μg/dL、フェリチン2,500 ng/mL（基準20～120）。CRP 0.2 mg/dL。腹部単純CT で肝実質CT 値の上昇を認めた。この患者への対応で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 75-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of easy fatigue. Five years ago, he was diagnosed with aplastic anemia and started immunosuppressive therapy, but there was no improvement. For the past four years, he has been receiving red blood cell transfusions every two weeks. Height: 165 cm, weight: 58 kg. Body temperature: 36.3°C. Pulse rate: 100 beats per minute, regular. The palpebral conjunctiva appeared to be mildly anemic, and there was no yellowing of the bulbar conjunctiva. A Levine 2/6 systolic murmur was heard, with the strongest point at the second intercostal space on the right sternal border. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. The skin was dark brown. Blood findings: RBC 2 million, Hb 5.8 g/dL, Ht 19%, reticulocytes 0.2%, WBC 2,200 (segmented neutrophils 8%, eosinophils 2%, basophils 1%, lymphocytes 89%), platelets 40,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.2 g/dL, albumin 2.8 g/dL, total bilirubin 1.1 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 129 U/L, ALT 12 U/L, LD 360 U/L (normal 120-245), urea nitrogen 19 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, fasting blood glucose 90 mg/dL, Fe 250 μg/dL, ferritin 2,500 ng/mL (normal 20-120). CRP was 0.2 mg/dL. Abdominal plain CT showed an increase in the liver parenchymal CT value. Which of the following is the correct treatment for this patient?

Question: 10 か月の女児。呼吸困難を主訴に母親に連れられて来院した。3 日前から鼻汁と咳嗽が続いていたが、発熱もなく機嫌が良かったので自宅で様子をみていた。夕方から咳嗽が悪化し、呼吸が苦しそうになったという。体温37.0 ℃。心拍数138/分、整。呼吸数60/分。SpO2 92 %（room air）。鼻翼呼吸、陥没呼吸および軽度の口唇チアノーゼを認める。呼吸音に左右差や減弱を認めない。両側肺でcoarse crackles は聴取しないが、呼気性喘鳴を聴取する。鼻腔RS ウイルス迅速検査は陽性だった。この患児に予測される検査所見として正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 10-month-old girl was brought to the hospital by her mother complaining of difficulty breathing. She had been suffering from a runny nose and cough for the past 3 days, but she had no fever and was in good spirits, so she was monitored at home. Her cough worsened in the evening, and she appeared to be having difficulty breathing. Body temperature 37.0°C. Heart rate 138 beats/min, regular. Respiratory rate 60 beats/min. SpO2 92% (room air). Nasal flaring, retractions, and mild cyanosis of the lips were observed. There was no difference between the left and right sides of the breath sounds, and no attenuation. No coarse crackles were heard in either lung, but expiratory wheezing was heard. A rapid nasal respiratory syncytial virus test was positive. Which of the following is a correct test finding to expect for this patient?

Question: 30 歳の男性。排尿時痛と尿道からの膿性分泌物を主訴に来院した。5 日前に性交渉を持ち、その後痛みが生じるようになったという。尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖（－）、潜血（－）、沈渣に赤血球0 ～5 /HPF、白血球50～100/HPF を認める。分泌物のGram 染色でGram 陰性双球菌を認めた。この疾患で誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 30-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of painful urination and purulent discharge from the urethra. He had sexual intercourse 5 days prior, and the pain began after that. Urine findings: protein (-), sugar (-), occult blood (-), and sediment showed 0-5 red blood cells/HPF and 50-100 white blood cells/HPF. Gram staining of the secretion revealed Gram-negative diplococci. Which of the following is incorrect regarding this disease?

Question: 介入研究はどれか。
Question_EN: Which is an intervention study?

Question: やせと続発性無月経の学生アスリートの診療で注意すべき合併症はどれか
Question_EN: Which complication should be noted in the treatment of a student athlete with underweight and secondary amenorrhea?

Question: 女性の骨盤内炎症性疾患を最も示唆する身体所見はどれか。
Question_EN: Which physical examination finding is most suggestive of pelvic inflammatory disease in women?

Question: トリアージタッグ〈識別札〉について誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect about triage tags?

Question: 瞳孔異常をきたす原因と所見の組合せで誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is an incorrect combination of cause and finding of pupil abnormality?

Question: 広範な筋肉内出血の原因となるのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following causes extensive muscle bleeding?

Question: 成人の三角筋での筋肉注射で、注射部位が遠位側にずれると起こりやすくなる合併症はどれか。
Question_EN: When an adult receives an intramuscular injection into the deltoid muscle, which complication is more likely to occur if the injection site is shifted distally?

Question: 生活習慣の改善で発症予防が期待できる疾患はどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following diseases can be prevented by improving your lifestyle?

Question: 行動変容のステージと患者へのアプローチの組合せで適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which is the most appropriate combination of stage of behavior change and approach to the patient?

Question: 成人の動脈血ガス分析を目的とした大腿動脈からの採血について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding blood sampling from the femoral artery for the purpose of arterial blood gas analysis in adults?

Question: 疾患と特徴的な症候との組合せで誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is an incorrect pairing of a disease and its characteristic symptoms?

Question: 腹部の触診で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding abdominal palpation?

Question: 視診後の腹部診察順として正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which is the correct order for examining the abdomen after visual examination?

Question: 人を対象とした介入を伴う医学研究を実施するにあたり、倫理審査前に行わなければならないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following must be done before conducting medical research involving human intervention?

Question: プロトロンビン時間の測定を行う血液検体に最も適した抗凝固剤はどれか。
Question_EN: Which anticoagulant would be most appropriate for blood samples used to measure prothrombin time?

Question: アナフィラキシーにおけるアドレナリン投与について適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is appropriate regarding the administration of adrenaline in anaphylaxis?

Question: 初発症状が肉眼的血尿とならないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following conditions would not initially result in gross hematuria?

Question: 患者の服薬アドヒアランスを向上するための医師の行動として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following actions would be appropriate for a physician to take to improve patient adherence to medication?

Question: 第一次世界大戦とほぼ時期を同じくしてパンデミックがみられた感染症はどれか。
Question_EN: Which infectious disease caused a pandemic around the same time as World War I?

Question: 標準予防策〈standard precautions〉について正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is true regarding standard precautions?

Question: 膝蓋腱反射について誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect regarding the patellar tendon reflex?

Question: 8 か月の男児。けいれんが続くため自宅でジアゼパムの坐薬を使用したが、けいれんが消失しないため救急車で搬入された。熱性けいれん重積の既往がある。来院時、呼びかけに反応せず、口から泡を吹き、上下肢の強直間代性けいれんが30 分以上持続している。体温38.6 ℃。心拍数156/分、整。呼吸数24/分。SpO2 92 %（room air）。フェイスマスクから2 L/分の酸素を投与したところSpO2 は98 % に上昇した。末梢静脈路を確保した。次に行うべき対応はどれか。
Question_EN: An 8-month-old boy. Because of continuing convulsions, diazepam suppositories were administered at home, but the convulsions did not subside, so he was brought in by ambulance. He had a history of febrile status epilepticus. On arrival at the hospital, he was unresponsive to calls, foaming at the mouth, and had been experiencing tonic-clonic convulsions of the upper and lower limbs for more than 30 minutes. Body temperature 38.6°C. Heart rate 156 beats/min, regular. Respiratory rate 24 breaths/min. SpO2 92% (room air). After administering 2 L/min of oxygen via face mask, SpO2 increased to 98%. A peripheral venous line was secured. What should be the next action?

Question: 40 歳の女性。シュノーケリング中にうつ伏せで浮かんでいるところを発見され、救急車で搬入された。救急隊が到着した際には心肺停止状態であり、適切な処置により心拍は再開したが、入院4日目の頭部単純CT で皮髄境界消失と尿崩症を認めたため、入院6日目と7日目に法的脳死判定を実施して脳死と判定された。事故の前に臓器提供に関する本人の口頭による拒否の意思表示はなかった。この患者で臓器提供ができる根拠に該当しないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 40-year-old woman was found floating face down while snorkeling and brought in by ambulance. When the ambulance arrived, she was in cardiac arrest. With appropriate treatment, her heartbeat resumed. However, a plain head CT scan on the fourth day of hospitalization revealed loss of the corticomedullary border and diabetes insipidus, so a legal brain death determination was performed on the sixth and seventh days of hospitalization and she was declared brain dead. Prior to the accident, she had not verbally expressed an intention to refuse organ donation. Which of the following is not a basis for organ donation for this patient?

Question: 83 歳の女性。腰痛を主訴に来院した。持続性の腰痛に対して、自宅近くの医院で処方されたNSAID を服用していた。一時的に疼痛は緩和したが、再び増悪したため紹介受診した。精査の結果、多発肝転移を伴う膵癌と診断された。薬物による抗癌治療などの積極的な治療を希望しなかった。食事摂取量は以前と比較し、わずかに減少している。 この患者に対する疼痛緩和としてまず行うのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 83-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of lower back pain. She had been taking NSAIDs prescribed by a clinic near her home to treat her persistent lower back pain. The pain was temporarily alleviated, but it worsened again, so she was referred to the hospital. After a detailed examination, she was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer with multiple liver metastases. She did not wish to undergo aggressive treatment, such as anti-cancer drug therapy. Her food intake has decreased slightly compared to before. Which of the following would be the first course of pain relief for this patient?

Question: 34 歳の初産婦（3 妊0 産）。妊娠13 週、妊婦健康診査のために来院した。前回妊娠は妊娠15 週に、前々回の妊娠は妊娠16 週に、いずれも胎胞が膨隆し自然流産している。これまでの精査で抗リン脂質抗体症候群や糖代謝異常は認めない。 適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 34-year-old nullipara (3 pregnancy, 0 births) visited the hospital at 13 weeks pregnant for a prenatal checkup. The previous pregnancy was at 15 weeks, and the previous pregnancy was at 16 weeks, both of which resulted in spontaneous abortions due to bulging of the amniotic sac. No evidence of antiphospholipid syndrome or abnormalities in glucose metabolism has been found in previous detailed examinations. What is the appropriate response?

Question: 4 歳の男児。自宅で径3 cm のぶどうを食べたとき、急に激しくむせて顔色が悪くなったため救急車で搬入された。救急車内では、意識はあるが両手で首をつかんで苦しそうにしており、救急隊員によりHeimlich 法が実施されたが状況は改善しなかった。病院到着直後にモニターを装着していると意識を失った。頸動脈を触知しない。直ちに行う処置として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 4-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by ambulance after suddenly choking violently and turning pale after eating a 3 cm diameter grape at home. In the ambulance, he was conscious but clutching his neck with both hands and appeared to be in pain. The ambulance staff performed the Heimlich maneuver, but his condition did not improve. Immediately after arriving at the hospital, he lost consciousness while wearing a monitor. The carotid artery could not be palpated. Which of the following is the most appropriate immediate action?

Question: 72 歳の女性。歩く速度が遅くなったことを主訴に娘とともに来院した。最近は電車やバスを利用して外出する頻度が減り、横断歩道を青信号のうちに渡りきることが困難になった。食欲が以前より減り、ふさぎ込みがちだという。骨粗鬆症で内服治療中である。身長155 cm、体重38 kg。体温36.5 ℃。研修医と指導医の会話を示す。指導医：「この患者さんの状態は、ロコモティブシンドロームと考えられます。今後、どのような問題が生じますか」研修医：「早めに対応しないと要介護の必要性が増加します」指導医：「それではどのような対応が適切でしょうか」研修医：「①上下肢の筋力訓練、②栄養指導、③こころの健康への配慮も必要です。④転倒予防の指導も重要で、⑤外出は禁止すべきです」①から⑤のうち対応のうち誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 72-year-old woman came to the hospital with her daughter complaining that her walking speed had slowed. Recently, she has been taking trains and buses less frequently and has difficulty crossing the street before the light turns green. She also has less appetite than before and tends to become depressed. She is taking oral medication for osteoporosis. Height: 155 cm, weight: 38 kg, body temperature: 36.5°C. Shown is a conversation between a medical intern and a supervising physician. Supervising physician: "This patient's condition appears to be locomotive syndrome. What problems will arise in the future?" Medical intern: "If we do not respond quickly, the patient's need for nursing care will increase." Supervising physician: "So what is the appropriate response?" Medical intern: "① Strength training for the upper and lower limbs, ② nutritional guidance, and ③ attention to mental health are also necessary. ④ Instructions on how to prevent falls are also important, and ⑤ going outside should be prohibited." Which of the numbered responses is incorrect?

Question: 78 歳の男性。心不全で入院中である。入院7 日目に心不全が改善し、退院の準備を行うこととなった。落ちていた身体機能が回復したが、移動に歩行器が必要であった。もともと大腸癌術後で10 年前から自分でストマの管理をしていたが、入院後に管理が難しくなった。妻と2 人暮らし。認知機能は問題なく、服薬管理はできる。入浴、食事および整容は自立している。要介護度は要介護1 である。退院後は通所リハビリテーション、福祉用具貸与および外来通院を予定している。退院に際して、この患者に必要な介護サービスはどれか。
Question_EN: A 78-year-old man is hospitalized with heart failure. His heart failure improves on the seventh day of hospitalization, and he is being prepared for discharge. His reduced physical functions have recovered, but he requires a walker to move around. He had been managing his stoma himself for 10 years after colon cancer surgery, but after hospitalization, it became difficult to manage. He lives with his wife. His cognitive function is fine, and he is able to manage his medication. He is independent with bathing, eating, and grooming. His level of care required is level 1. After discharge, he is scheduled to receive day rehabilitation, welfare equipment rental, and outpatient care. What nursing care services will this patient need upon discharge?

Question:
日齢28 の男児。1 か月健康診査のため両親に連れられて来院した。在胎38 週、体重3,000 g で出生した。出生後の経過は問題なく、日齢5 に体重2,800 g で産科診療所から退院した。母親は24 歳、初産のため育児に自信がなく、母乳量の不足を心配している。受診時の体重3,600 g。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟。皮膚は黄染なし。外陰部に異常を認めない。自宅で平均的な24 時間の排尿は10 回、排便は3 回、母親が記録した哺乳状況を示す。
哺乳の記録（平均的な24 時間）母乳 0：00 （10 分間） 、3：00 （15 分間）、 6：00 （10 分間）、8：00 （10 分間）、11：00 （15 分間）、13:00（15分間）、16：00（10分間）、19：00（15 分間）、22：00（10 分間）。人工乳なし。
対応で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 28-day-old male infant was brought to the hospital by his parents for a one-month health check. He was born at 38 weeks gestation and weighed 3,000 g. There were no problems after birth, and he was discharged from the obstetric clinic on day 5, weighing 2,800 g. The mother was 24 years old and was not confident about childcare as this was her first birth, and was worried about a lack of breast milk. He weighed 3,600 g at the time of the examination. No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft. The skin was not yellowed. No abnormalities were found in the vulva. The average number of urinations and defecations over a 24-hour period at home was 10 times, and 3 times, and the breastfeeding situation was recorded by the mother. Feeding record (average 24 hours) Breast milk: 0:00 (10 minutes), 3:00 (15 minutes), 6:00 (10 minutes), 8:00 (10 minutes), 11:00 (15 minutes), 13:00 (15 minutes), 16:00 (10 minutes), 19:00 (15 minutes), 22:00 (10 minutes). No formula.
Which of the following is correct?

Question: 70 歳の女性。右手の痛みを主訴に救急外来を受診した。前日に飼育している猫に手を咬まれ、自宅で消毒したが次第に発赤と疼痛が増強したため来院した。高血圧症で降圧薬を内服している。意識は清明。身長155 cm、体重60 kg。体温37.1 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧136/82 mmHg。呼吸数14/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。右手背に2 か所、右手掌に2 か所咬傷を認め、同部位に発赤、腫脹および圧痛を認める。排膿はない。運動障害と感覚障害は認めない。創部の洗浄と消毒を行った。さらに加えるべき対応で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 70-year-old woman visited the emergency room complaining of pain in her right hand. The previous day, her hand was bitten by her pet cat. She had disinfected the wound at home, but the redness and pain gradually worsened, so she visited the hospital. She has hypertension and is taking antihypertensive medication. She is conscious and alert. Height 155 cm, weight 60 kg. Body temperature 37.1°C. Pulse 72 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 136/82 mmHg. Respiratory rate 14 breaths/min. SpO2 98% (room air). There were two bite wounds on the back of the right hand and two on the palm of the right hand, and the same areas were reddened, swollen, and tender. There was no pus discharge. There were no motor or sensory disorders. The wound was cleaned and disinfected. Which of the following additional measures should be taken?

Question: 38 歳の男性。頸椎損傷の診断で3 週間入院中である。自己導尿が困難で尿道カテーテルが留置されているが、尿が混濁し閉塞をきたしたため、尿道カテーテルの交換を行うこととなった。意識は清明。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧110/64 mmHg。呼吸数12/分。尿道カテーテルの交換で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 38-year-old man has been hospitalized for three weeks with a diagnosis of cervical spine injury. He has difficulty with self-catheterization and a urethral catheter has been placed, but the urine has become cloudy and obstructed, so the urethral catheter has been replaced. The patient is conscious and alert. Body temperature is 36.8°C. Pulse rate is 72 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure is 110/64 mmHg. Respiratory rate is 12 breaths/min. Which of the following is correct regarding the replacement of a urethral catheter?

Question: 2 歳の男児。発熱と鼻汁を主訴に両親に連れられて来院した。前日の夕方から38.5 ℃の発熱を認め、右耳をさかんに触るような様子がみられ、夜間はよく眠れなかった。来院時の体温は38.2 ℃で、顔色は良好だが機嫌が悪く、母親に抱かれて診察室に入ったところ、すぐに大声で泣き出した。対応として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 2-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his parents with the main complaints of fever and runny nose. He had a fever of 38.5°C since the previous evening, was touching his right ear frequently, and had difficulty sleeping at night. When he arrived at the hospital, his body temperature was 38.2°C, his complexion was good but he was in a bad mood. When he entered the examination room in his mother's arms, he immediately began crying loudly. Which of the following is the most appropriate response?

Question:
60 歳の男性。嘔吐を主訴に来院した。

家族歴：父が胃癌のため70 歳で死亡。

この患者の嘔吐の原因として考慮すべきもので誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 60-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of vomiting.
History of current illness: He underwent total gastrectomy for gastric cancer one year ago, and continued anticancer chemotherapy as an outpatient for about eight months. Two months ago, an increase in tumor markers and liver and lung metastases were detected, and he underwent anticancer chemotherapy again, but the treatment was not effective and was discontinued. At that time, the patient and his family were informed that he had a prognosis of several months, and he requested to be treated as an outpatient at our hospital, which is closer to his home, and was transferred to this hospital. He had been experiencing no particular symptoms, but one month ago he occasionally experienced abdominal pain, and was prescribed regular oral and rescue opioids. He had been experiencing nausea for one week, and this morning he vomited, so he visited the hospital.
Past medical history: Nothing of note.
Life history: He lives with his wife. Both of his two children live outside the prefecture. He smoked 20 cigarettes per day from the age of 20 to 59. He drinks alcohol occasionally.
Family history: His father died of gastric cancer at the age of 70. Current symptoms: Consciousness is clear. Height 175 cm, weight 56 ​​kg. Temperature 36.4°C. Pulse 92 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 110/70 mmHg. Respiratory rate 26 beats/min. SpO2 96% (room air). No yellowing of the conjunctiva. No abnormalities in heart or respiratory sounds. The abdomen is slightly distended but soft, there is tenderness throughout the abdomen, and a metallic sound can be heard. The liver can be palpated in the epigastric region. Mild edema is present in both lower limbs. No abnormalities were found in neurological examination.
Test findings: Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.64 million, Hb 10.3 g/dL, Ht 32%, white blood cells 7,400, platelets 180,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 5.9 g/dL, albumin 2.4 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 152 U/L, ALT 66 U/L, LD 387 U/L (normal 120-245), ALP 189 U/L (normal 38-113), γ-GT 62 U/L (normal 8-50), CK 42 U/L (normal 30-140), urea nitrogen 28 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, blood glucose 80 mg/dL, total cholesterol 190 mg/dL, Na 143 mEq/L, K 3.5 mEq/L, Cl 92 mEq/L. Ca 10.1 mg/dL. CRP 4.5 mg/dL. Chest X-ray showed multiple small nodular shadows in both lungs. Which of the following is not a possible cause of vomiting in this patient?

Question:
68 歳の男性。眼のかすみと足の違和感を主訴に来院した。
現病歴：20 年前から健診で尿糖を指摘されていた。医療機関で生活指導を受けたが、転居を契機に通院を中断していた。10 年前に退職してからは健診を受けていない。約2 年前から両足のジンジンとした痺れを自覚していた。半年前から視力低下に気付いていたが加齢によるものと考えていた。3 日前から右眼の霧視が出現した。
既往歴：18 歳時に虫垂炎。輸血歴無し。
生活歴：60 歳から独居。1 日のほとんどを家で過ごしている。1 日に1 回か2 回コンビニエンスストアの弁当や惣菜を食べている。喫煙は15 本/日を48 年間。飲酒はビール350 mL/日または焼酎1 合程度/日を週5 、6 回。
家族歴：父は脳梗塞のため72 歳で死亡。母は老衰のため88 歳で死亡。現症：身長170 cm、体重72 kg、腹囲86 cm。血圧128/72 mmHg。胸部と腹部とに異常を認めない。両眼底に軟性白斑と新生血管、右眼に硝子体出血を認める。
検査所見：尿所見：蛋白（±）、糖3 ＋、ケトン体（－）、潜血（－）、沈渣に異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球444 万、Hb 12.9 g/dL、Ht 43 %、白血球6,000（好中球54 %、好酸球2 %、好塩基球0 %、単球8 %、リンパ球36 %）、血小板19 万。
血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.9 g/dL、アルブミン3.5 g/dL、直接ビリルビン0.3 mg/dL、AST 22 U/L、ALT 19 U/L、LD 186 U/L（基準120～245）、γ-GT 17 U/L（基準8 ～50）、アミラーゼ152 U/L（基準37～160）、CK 132 U/L（基準30～140）、尿素窒素20 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL、eGFR 72.8 mL/分/1.73 m2、尿酸4.0 mg/dL、血糖235 mg/dL、HbA1c 8.9 %（基準4.6～6.2）、総コレステロール247 mg/dL、トリグリセリド64 mg/dL、HDL コレステロール51 mg/dL、Na 140 mEq/L、K 4.4 mEq/L、Cl 105 mEq/L、Ca 9.1 mg/dL、P 3.0 mg/dL、TSH 3.0 μU/mL（基準0.2～4.0）、FT4 1.2 ng/dL（基準0.8～2.2）。
この患者の足の診察をする際、優先度の低い項目はどれか。
Question_EN:
A 68-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of blurred vision and discomfort in his legs.
History of current illness: His urine sugar had been detected during health checkups 20 years ago. He had received lifestyle advice from a medical institution, but stopped visiting the hospital after moving. He has not had a health check since he retired 10 years ago. He had been aware of a tingling sensation in both legs for about two years. He had noticed a decline in his eyesight six months ago, but thought it was due to aging. He had blurred vision in his right eye for three days.
Past medical history: Appendicitis at age 18. No history of blood transfusion.
Lifestyle history: He has lived alone since age 60. He spends most of his day at home. He eats bento boxes and prepared foods from a convenience store once or twice a day. He has smoked 15 cigarettes per day for 48 years. He drinks 350 mL of beer per day or about one cup of shochu per day, 5 or 6 times a week.
Family history: Father died of cerebral infarction at age 72. Mother died of old age at age 88. Current symptoms: Height 170 cm, weight 72 kg, abdominal circumference 86 cm. Blood pressure 128/72 mmHg. No abnormalities found in chest or abdomen. Soft white spots and neovascularization in both funduses, vitreous hemorrhage in right eye.

Examination findings: Urine findings: Protein (±), glucose 3+, ketone bodies (-), occult blood (-), no abnormalities found in sediment. Blood findings: Red blood cells 4.44 million, Hb 12.9 g/dL, Ht 43%, white blood cells 6,000 (neutrophils 54%, eosinophils 2%, basophils 0%, monocytes 8%, lymphocytes 36%), platelets 190,000.
Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.9 g/dL, albumin 3.5 g/dL, direct bilirubin 0.3 mg/dL, AST 22 U/L, ALT 19 U/L, LD 186 U/L (standard 120-245), γ-GT 17 U/L (standard 8-50), amylase 152 U/L (standard 37-160), CK 132 U/L (standard 30-140), urea nitrogen 20 mg/dL, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, eGFR 72.8 mL/min/1.73 m2, uric acid 4.0 mg/dL, blood glucose 235 mg/dL, HbA1c 8.9% (standard 4.6-6.2), total cholesterol 247 mg/dL, triglyceride 64 mg/dL, HDL cholesterol 51 mg/dL, Na 140 mEq/L, K 4.4 mEq/L, Cl 105 mEq/L, Ca 9.1 mg/dL, P 3.0 mg/dL, TSH 3.0 μU/mL (normal: 0.2-4.0), FT4 1.2 ng/dL (normal: 0.8-2.2).
When examining this patient's foot, which item would be of low priority?

Question:
56 歳の女性。乾性咳嗽と呼吸困難を主訴に救急車で搬入された。
現病歴：昨日38.3 ℃の発熱、本日、乾性咳嗽と呼吸困難が出現したため救急車を要請した。①2 日前に同居している21 歳の息子が新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）を発症した。②息子の陽性が判明した時点で、本人は無症状だったが自宅にあった③鼻腔ぬぐい液の新型コロナウイルス〈SARS-CoV-2〉抗原定性検査を自身で行い、陰性だったという。既往歴：④48 歳から高血圧症で降圧薬を内服している。新型コロナ（SARS-CoV-2）ワクチンは未接種。生活歴：⑤無職。21 歳の息子と2 人暮らしで、最近1 週間は朝食と夕食をともにしていた。喫煙歴と飲酒歴はない。家族歴：息子が新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）。
現症：意識は清明。身長158 cm、体重65 kg。体温38.5 ℃。心拍数110/分、整。血圧148/94 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 100 %（マスク5 L/分　酸素投与下）。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。咽頭に軽度発赤を認める。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部と四肢とに異常を認めない。

①〜⑤のうち、この患者の新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）の事前確率が高くなる情報はどれか。
Question_EN:
A 56-year-old woman was brought in by ambulance with complaints of dry cough and difficulty breathing.

Current medical history: Yesterday she had a fever of 38.3°C, and today she had a dry cough and difficulty breathing, so she called for an ambulance. ① Two days ago, her 21-year-old son, who lives with her, developed COVID-19. ② At the time her son's positive test was discovered, she was asymptomatic, but ③ she performed a qualitative test for the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) antigen on a nasal swab at home, which came back negative.

Medical history: ④ She has been taking antihypertensive medication since the age of 48 for hypertension. She has not been vaccinated against the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2).

Life history: ⑤ Unemployed. She lives with her 21-year-old son, and has had breakfast and dinner together for the past week. She has no history of smoking or drinking.

Family history: Her son has COVID-19.

Current symptoms: She is conscious and alert. Height 158 ​​cm, weight 65 kg. Body temperature 38.5°C. Heart rate 110 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 148/94 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20 beats/min. SpO2 100% (oxygen administered by mask 5 L/min). No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva. Slight redness was found in the pharynx. No abnormalities were found in the heart and respiratory sounds. No abnormalities were found in the abdomen and limbs.
Test findings: Urine findings: Protein (-), sugar (-), occult blood (-). Blood findings: Red blood cells 4 million, Hb 12.6 g/dL, Ht 38%, white blood cells 6,800, platelets 110,000, PT-INR 1.1 (normal 0.9-1.1). Blood biochemistry findings: LD 236 U/L (normal: 120-245), urea nitrogen 26 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, blood glucose 98 mg/dL, Na 141 mEq/L, K 4.5 mEq/L, Cl 102 mEq/L. CRP 3.0 mg/dL. No abnormalities were observed in the electrocardiogram.
Which of the numbered information would increase the prior probability of this patient having COVID-19?

現病歴：昨日38.3 ℃の発熱、本日、乾性咳嗽と呼吸困難が出現したため救急車を要請した。①2 日前に同居している21 歳の息子が新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）を発症した。②息子の陽性が判明した時点で、本人は無症状だったが自宅にあった③鼻腔ぬぐい液の新型コロナウイルス〈SARS-CoV-2〉抗原定性検査を自身で行い、陰性だったという。既往歴：④48 歳から高血圧症で降圧薬を内服している。新型コロナ（SARS-CoV-2）ワクチンは未接種。生活歴：⑤無職。21 歳の息子と2 人暮らしで、最近1 週間は朝食と夕食をともにしていた。喫煙歴と飲酒歴はない。家族歴：息子が新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）。
現症：意識は清明。身長158 cm、体重65 kg。体温38.5 ℃。心拍数110/分、整。血圧148/94 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 100 %（マスク5 L/分　酸素投与下）。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。咽頭に軽度発赤を認める。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部と四肢とに異常を認めない。
検査所見：尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖（－）、潜血（－）。血液所見：赤血球400 万、Hb 12.6 g/dL、Ht 38 %、白血球6,800、血小板11 万、PT-INR 1.1（基準0.9～1.1）。血液生化学所見：LD 236 U/L（基準120～245）、尿素窒素26 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.9 mg/dL、血糖98 mg/dL、Na 141 mEq/L、K 4.5 mEq/L、Cl 102 mEq/L。CRP 3.0 mg/dL。心電図で異常を認めない。
搬入時に再度施行した鼻咽頭ぬぐい液を用いた新型コロナウイルス〈SARS-CoV-2〉抗原定性検査は陰性だった。次に行うべき最も優先度の高い検査はどれか。

Current medical history: Yesterday she had a fever of 38.3°C, and today she had a dry cough and difficulty breathing, so she called for an ambulance. ① Two days ago, her 21-year-old son, who lives with her, developed COVID-19. ② At the time her son's positive test was discovered, she was asymptomatic, but ③ she performed a qualitative test for the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) antigen on a nasal swab at home, which came back negative.

Medical history: ④ She has been taking antihypertensive medication since the age of 48 for hypertension. She has not been vaccinated against the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2).

Life history: ⑤ Unemployed. She lives with her 21-year-old son, and has had breakfast and dinner together for the past week. She has no history of smoking or drinking.

Family history: Her son has COVID-19.

Current symptoms: She is conscious and alert. Height 158 ​​cm, weight 65 kg. Body temperature 38.5°C. Heart rate 110 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 148/94 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20 beats/min. SpO2 100% (oxygen administered by mask 5 L/min). No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva. Slight redness was found in the pharynx. No abnormalities were found in the heart and respiratory sounds. No abnormalities were found in the abdomen and limbs.
Test findings: Urine findings: Protein (-), sugar (-), occult blood (-). Blood findings: Red blood cells 4 million, Hb 12.6 g/dL, Ht 38%, white blood cells 6,800, platelets 110,000, PT-INR 1.1 (normal 0.9-1.1). Blood biochemistry findings: LD 236 U/L (normal: 120-245), urea nitrogen 26 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, blood glucose 98 mg/dL, Na 141 mEq/L, K 4.5 mEq/L, Cl 102 mEq/L. CRP 3.0 mg/dL. No abnormalities were found in the electrocardiogram.
A qualitative test for the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) antigen, which was repeated at the time of admission, was negative using a nasopharyngeal swab. Which test is the most important to perform next?

生活歴：大学生。アレルギー歴はない。
現症：意識はJCSⅡ-10。身長172 cm、体重62 kg。体温35.1 ℃。心拍数112/分、整。血圧98/62 mmHg。呼吸数28/分。SpO2 90 %（リザーバー付マスク10 L/分　酸素投与下）。前額部に挫創を認める。眼瞼結膜はやや貧血様である。口周囲に吐物が付着している。発声は可能で気道は開通している。頸静脈の怒張と頸部気管の右側偏位を認める。左胸部において、視診で胸郭膨隆、触診で握雪感、打診で鼓音および聴診で呼吸音の消失を認める。上肢に冷汗、手掌に湿潤を認める。
最も優先すべき処置はどれか。

The front part of the passenger car was completely destroyed, and the airbags were deployed. Based on the results of the ambulance's observations, the doctor at the hospital instructed the patient to administer oxygen, secure an intravenous line, and administer large amounts of fluids, and the patient was taken to the hospital.
Life history: A university student. No history of allergies.
Current symptoms: Consciousness JCS II-10. Height 172 cm, weight 62 kg. Body temperature 35.1°C. Heart rate 112 beats per minute, normal. Blood pressure 98/62 mmHg. There is distension of the jugular vein and deviation of the cervical trachea to the right. Inspection of the left chest reveals thoracic distention, palpation reveals a snowgrasping sense, tympanitic sounds on percussion, and the absence of respiratory sounds on auscultation. There is cold sweat in the upper limbs and moisture in the palms.
Which treatment should take priority?

Question:
47 歳の男性。頭痛と発熱を主訴に来院した。

生活歴：喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。
家族歴：父が高血圧症。
現症：意識は清明。身長172 cm、体重70 kg。体温39.2 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧124/70 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。口腔内と咽頭とに異常を認めない。甲状腺腫と頸部リンパ節とを触知しない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。四肢に浮腫を認めない。

A 47-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of headache and fever.
History of current illness: He had been aware of a slight fever and general fatigue for the past 3 days. He had been aware of a headache since yesterday, and his temperature had risen to over 38°C, so he had been taking over-the-counter antipyretics and analgesics. This morning, when he woke up, his headache worsened, he developed nausea, and vomited. As his fever of over 38°C continued, he walked to the hospital on his own.
Past medical history: He underwent surgery for acute appendicitis at the age of 24.
Lifestyle history: He has no history of smoking. He drinks alcohol occasionally.
Family history: His father has hypertension.
Current illness: He is conscious and alert. Height 172 cm, weight 70 kg. Body temperature 39.2°C. Pulse 96/min, regular. Blood pressure 124/70 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16/min. SpO2 98% (room air). No abnormalities are found in the palpebral or bulbar conjunctiva. No abnormalities are found in the oral cavity or pharynx. The goiter and cervical lymph nodes are not palpable. No abnormalities are found in the heart or respiratory sounds. The abdomen is flat and soft, and the liver and spleen are not palpable. There is no edema in the limbs.
Which of the following findings should be confirmed first in order to make a diagnosis?

Question_EN: A female infant aged 1 minute. She was born at 40 weeks and 5 days gestation via vaginal delivery. Her heart rate is 12 beats per 6 seconds and she is crying loudly. She is actively moving her limbs and coughing when stimulated. There is a small amount of meconium on her skin. Her entire body is dark purple. What is her Apgar score?

Question: 35 歳の女性。急性骨髄性白血病のため入院中である。寛解導入療法開始後18 日目に発熱を認めた。発熱以外の症状はない。体温38.2 ℃。脈拍112/分、整。血圧102/68 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。眼瞼結膜は貧血様である。身体所見にその他の異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球288 万、Hb 8.8 g/dL、Ht 26 %、網赤血球0.1 %、白血球500（好中球1 %、好酸球0 %、好塩基球0 %、単球0 %、リンパ球99 %）、血小板2.1 万。この時点での抗菌薬選択に際し、最も考慮すべき微生物はどれか。
Question_EN: A 35-year-old woman is hospitalized with acute myeloid leukemia. She developed a fever 18 days after starting induction therapy. She has no other symptoms. Body temperature 38.2°C. Pulse rate 112 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 102/68 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20 breaths per minute. The palpebral conjunctiva appears anemic. No other abnormalities are found in the physical examination. Blood findings: red blood cells 2.88 million, hemoglobin 8.8 g/dL, hematocrit 26%, reticulocytes 0.1%, white blood cells 500 (neutrophils 1%, eosinophils 0%, basophils 0%, monocytes 0%, lymphocytes 99%), platelets 21,000. Which microorganism should be most considered when selecting an antibiotic at this point?

Question: 4 か月の女児。活気不良と哺乳量の減少を主訴に母親に連れられて来院した。周産期に異常はなかった。1 週間前から活気が低下し、2 日前から約20 % 哺乳量が減少してきた。昨夜の便は黒っぽかった。本日も活気の回復がみられないため心配になり、自宅近くの診療所の夜間救急外来を受診した。意識は清明。体温36.8 ℃。心拍数136/分、整。呼吸数24/分。顔色はやや不良。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。頸部にリンパ節を触知しない。腹部は軽度膨隆を認める。紫斑を認めない。毛細血管再充満時間の延長はない。血液所見：赤血球209 万、Hb 5.6 g/dL、Ht 18 %、白血球950,000、血小板1.5 万。血液生化学所見：AST 34 U/L、ALT 16 U/L、LD 1,390 U/L（基準120～245）、尿酸8.6 mg/dL、Na 139 mEq/L、K 4.4 mEq/L、Cl 106 mEq/L。CRP 2.1 mg/dL。母親への説明として適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 4-month-old girl was brought to the hospital by her mother complaining of poor vitality and decreased milk intake. There were no abnormalities during the perinatal period. Her vitality had decreased 1 week ago, and milk intake had decreased by approximately 20% 2 days ago. Her stool last night was black. As her vitality had not improved today, we became concerned and visited the night emergency room of a clinic near her home. She was conscious and alert. Body temperature 36.8°C. Heart rate 136 beats per minute, regular. Respiratory rate 24 beats per minute. Her complexion was slightly poor. No abnormalities were noted in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. No lymph nodes were palpable in the neck. Mild abdominal distension was noted. No purpura was noted. There was no prolongation of capillary refill time. Blood findings: RBC 2.09 million, Hb 5.6 g/dL, Ht 18%, WBC 950,000, platelets 15,000. Blood biochemistry findings: AST 34 U/L, ALT 16 U/L, LD 1,390 U/L (normal: 120-245), uric acid 8.6 mg/dL, Na 139 mEq/L, K 4.4 mEq/L, Cl 106 mEq/L. CRP 2.1 mg/dL. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation to the mother?

Question: 52 歳の男性。労作時息切れと全身倦怠感を主訴に来院した。1 か月前から両下腿の浮腫が出現し、1 週間前から労作時息切れと全身倦怠感も自覚するようになったため受診した。15 年前から高血圧症と糖尿病で治療を受けていたが、10 か月前の転居を契機に受診を中断していた。身長176 cm、体重85 kg（2 か月前は78 kg）。脈拍92/分、整。血圧162/92 mmHg。SpO2 95 %（room air）。両下腿に圧痕性浮腫を認める。尿所見：蛋白3 ＋、糖2 ＋、ケトン体（－）、潜血（－）。随時尿の尿蛋白480 mg/dL、クレアチニン80 mg/dL。血液所見：赤血球310 万、Hb 8.6 g/dL、Ht 28 %、白血球8,600、血小板12 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白5.2 g/dL、アルブミン2.2 g/dL、尿素窒素30 mg/dL、クレアチニン1.6 mg/dL、尿酸7.6 mg/dL、血糖230 mg/dL、HbA1c 8.0 %（基準4.6～6.2）、Na 136 mEq/L、K 5.8 mEq/L、Cl 98 mEq/L、Ca 7.6 mg/dL、P 5.2 mg/dL。胸部エックス線写真で心拡大と肺うっ血を認める。この患者の治療で、まず投与すべきなのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 52-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of shortness of breath on exertion and general fatigue. He had developed edema in both lower legs one month prior, and one week prior had also developed shortness of breath on exertion and general fatigue, so he visited the hospital. He had been treated for hypertension and diabetes for 15 years, but stopped visiting the hospital after moving 10 months prior. Height 176 cm, weight 85 kg (78 kg two months prior). Pulse 92 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 162/92 mmHg. SpO2 95% (room air). Pitting edema was observed in both lower legs. Urine findings: protein 3+, glucose 2+, ketone bodies (-), occult blood (-). Random urine protein 480 mg/dL, creatinine 80 mg/dL. Blood findings: RBC 3.1 million, Hb 8.6 g/dL, Ht 28%, WBC 8,600, platelets 120,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 5.2 g/dL, albumin 2.2 g/dL, urea nitrogen 30 mg/dL, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, uric acid 7.6 mg/dL, blood glucose 230 mg/dL, HbA1c 8.0% (normal 4.6-6.2), Na 136 mEq/L, K 5.8 mEq/L, Cl 98 mEq/L, Ca 7.6 mg/dL, P 5.2 mg/dL. Chest X-ray shows cardiomegaly and pulmonary congestion. Which of the following should be administered first in the treatment of this patient?

Question: 57 歳の男性。定期受診で来院した。30 歳時に2 型糖尿病および高血圧症と診断され、自宅近くの総合病院に通院している。腎機能が徐々に悪化したため、1 か月前に妻から生体腎移植を受けた。インスリン注射、降圧薬と複数の免疫抑制薬が処方されている。身長175 cm、体重65 kg。脈拍72/分、整。血圧126/70 mmHg。頸部と胸部とに異常を認めない。腹部に手術痕を認める。両側アキレス腱反射は消失している。尿所見：蛋白（－）、潜血（－）。血液所見：赤血球350 万、Hb 10.0 g/dL、Ht 30 %、白血球6,200、血小板35 万。血液生化学所見：尿素窒素25 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、eGFR 89.8 mL/分/1.73 m2、HbA1c 6.9 %（基準4.6～6.2）、Na 143 mEq/L、K 4.8 mEq/L、Cl 105 mEq/L。この患者への説明で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 57-year-old man visited the hospital for a regular check-up. He was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and hypertension at the age of 30, and has been visiting a general hospital near his home. Due to gradual deterioration of renal function, he underwent a living donor kidney transplant from his wife one month ago. He is prescribed insulin injections, antihypertensive drugs, and multiple immunosuppressants. Height 175 cm, weight 65 kg. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 126/70 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the neck and chest. There was a surgical scar on the abdomen. Both Achilles tendon reflexes were absent. Urine findings: protein (-), occult blood (-). Blood findings: red blood cells 3.5 million, hemoglobin 10.0 g/dL, hematocrit 30%, white blood cells 6,200, platelets 350,000. Blood biochemistry findings: urea nitrogen 25 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, eGFR 89.8 mL/min/1.73 m2, HbA1c 6.9% (normal: 4.6-6.2), Na 143 mEq/L, K 4.8 mEq/L, Cl 105 mEq/L. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation for this patient?

Question: 45歳の女性。日中のだるさを主訴に来院した。第1子の出産後から体重が増え、10年で10kg増加した。健診を受けたことはない。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。就労はしておらず、運動習慣はない。身長152cm、体重65kg。血圧144/92mmHg。尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖3＋、ケトン体（－）、潜血（－）。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.4g/dL、アルブミン4.0g/dL、尿素窒素14mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7mg/dL、尿酸7.2mg/dL、血糖188mg/dL、HbA1c 8.2%（基準4.6～6.2）、総コレステロール252mg/dL、トリグリセリド220mg/dL、HDLコレステロール36mg/dL、Na 135mEq/L、K 4.6mEq/L、Cl 101mEq/L。12誘導心電図で異常を認めない。食事療法の内容で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 45-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of daytime fatigue. She had gained weight since giving birth to her first child, gaining 10 kg over the past 10 years. She had never had a medical checkup. She had no history of smoking. She drank alcohol occasionally. She was unemployed and had no exercise habits. Her height was 152 cm and her weight was 65 kg. Her blood pressure was 144/92 mmHg. Urine findings: protein (-), sugar 3+, ketone bodies (-), occult blood (-). Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 7.4g/dL, albumin 4.0g/dL, urea nitrogen 14mg/dL, creatinine 0.7mg/dL, uric acid 7.2mg/dL, blood glucose 188mg/dL, HbA1c 8.2% (normal 4.6-6.2), total cholesterol 252mg/dL, triglycerides 220mg/dL, HDL cholesterol 36mg/dL, sodium 135mEq/L, potassium 4.6mEq/L, chloride 101mEq/L. No abnormalities were found in the 12-lead electrocardiogram. Which of the following is correct regarding dietary therapy?

Question: 79 歳の女性。脂質異常症と2 型糖尿病のため定期的に通院中である。新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）の流行以前は外出を好み活動的であったが、ここ3年間は家で過ごすことが増えている。本日バスを利用して予約どおりに来院した。身だしなみは整っている。顔面に擦過傷を認めたため原因を質問したところ「最近よくつまづくようになり、3 日前に玄関先で転び顔をぶつけてしまいました」と話した。約1 か月前から、好きだった花の手入れや食事の準備が億劫になり、寝付きが悪く熟睡できないという。また、時折食事中にむせるようになり、食欲が低下し て食事量も減少傾向であるという。この患者で保たれていると考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 79-year-old woman is visiting the hospital regularly for dyslipidemia and type 2 diabetes. Before the COVID-19 pandemic, she was active and liked to go out, but for the past three years, she has been spending more time at home. She took the bus today as scheduled and came to the hospital. She is well-groomed. When asked about the cause of the abrasions on her face, she said, "I've been tripping a lot recently, and three days ago I fell at the front door and hit my face." About a month ago, she started to feel reluctant to take care of her favorite flowers and prepare meals, and she has trouble falling asleep and sleeping soundly. She also occasionally chokes during meals, her appetite has decreased, and her food intake is also decreasing. Which of the following is thought to be maintained in this patient?

Question: 58 歳の男性。定期受診で来院した。高血圧性腎硬化症による慢性腎臓病で半年前から自宅近くの診療所に通院している。喫煙は35 年前から20 本/日。飲酒はビール350 mL/日を週2 回。身長170 cm、体重84 kg。BMI 29.0。脈拍72/分、整。血圧136/88 mmHg。尿所見：蛋白2 ＋、糖（－）、潜血（－）。血液所見：赤血球392 万、Hb 12.8 g/dL、Ht 37 %、白血球5,600、血小板21 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.0 g/dL、アルブミン3.8 g/dL、尿素窒素28 mg/dL、クレアチニン1.8 mg/dL、尿酸7.8 mg/dL、Na 140 mEq/L、K 4.9 mEq/L、Cl 103 mEq/L、Ca 9.4 mg/dL、P 5.6 mg/dL。1 か月前の食事調査で蛋白質摂取量168 g/日（2.0 g/kg）、食塩摂取量9.5 g/日であった。この患者の腎機能維持に有用性が低いのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 58-year-old man visited the hospital for a regular checkup. He has been visiting a clinic near his home for the past six months for chronic kidney disease caused by hypertensive nephrosclerosis. He has smoked 20 cigarettes per day for the past 35 years. He drinks 350 mL of beer twice a week. His height is 170 cm, his weight is 84 kg, his BMI is 29.0, his pulse is 72 beats per minute, regular, his blood pressure is 136/88 mmHg. Urine findings: protein 2+, sugar (-), occult blood (-). Blood findings: red blood cells 3.92 million, hemoglobin 12.8 g/dL, hematocrit 37%, white blood cells 5,600, platelets 210,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.0 g/dL, albumin 3.8 g/dL, urea nitrogen 28 mg/dL, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL, uric acid 7.8 mg/dL, sodium 140 mEq/L, potassium 4.9 mEq/L, chloride 103 mEq/L, calcium 9.4 mg/dL, phosphorus 5.6 mg/dL. A dietary survey conducted one month ago revealed a protein intake of 168 g/day (2.0 g/kg) and salt intake of 9.5 g/day. Which of the following would be least useful in maintaining this patient's renal function?

Question: 82 歳の女性。食欲と活動性の低下を主訴に来院した。3 日前から食欲が低下し、当日の朝はいつもの時間に起床できなかったため、心配した家族に連れられて受診した。お薬手帳によると、自宅近くの診療所で1 年以上前からアンジオテンシン変換酵素〈ACE〉阻害薬、カルシウム拮抗薬、ビスホスホネート製剤およびNSAID の処方を受けており、1 週間前からベンゾジアゼピン系睡眠薬が追加されていた。意識レベルはJCSⅠ- 1 から2 程度。体温36.0 ℃。脈拍64/分、整。血圧160/96 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。血液所見：赤血球350 万、Hb 10.2 g/dL、Ht 32 %、白血球6,200、血小板22 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.0 g/dL、アルブミン3.6 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.6 mg/dL、AST 30 U/L、ALT 13 U/L、LD 220 U/L（基準120～245）、ALP 83 U/L（基準38～113）、γ-GT 13 U/L（基準8～50）、尿素窒素29 mg/dL、クレアチニン2.1 mg/dL、血糖102 mg/dL、Na 132 mEq/L、K 6.0 mEq/L、Cl 93 mEq/L、Ca 11.5 mg/dL。精査のため入院することとなった。入院後も継続可能な薬剤はどれか。
Question_EN: An 82-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of decreased appetite and activity. Her appetite had decreased for the past three days, and she was unable to wake up at her usual time that morning, so her concerned family brought her to the hospital. According to her medication record, she had been prescribed angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors, calcium antagonists, bisphosphonates, and NSAIDs at a clinic near her home for over a year, and had been taking benzodiazepine sleeping pills for the past week. Her level of consciousness was JCS I-1 to 2. Body temperature 36.0°C. Pulse 64 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 160/96 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16 breaths per minute. Blood findings: red blood cells 3.5 million, hemoglobin 10.2 g/dL, hematocrit 32%, white blood cells 6,200, platelets 220,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.0 g/dL, albumin 3.6 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL, AST 30 U/L, ALT 13 U/L, LD 220 U/L (standard 120-245), ALP 83 U/L (standard 38-113), γ-GT 13 U/L (standard 8-50), urea nitrogen 29 mg/dL, creatinine 2.1 mg/dL, blood glucose 102 mg/dL, Na 132 mEq/L, K 6.0 mEq/L, Cl 93 mEq/L, Ca 11.5 mg/dL. The patient was admitted to hospital for further examination. Which medications can be continued after admission?

Question: 52 歳の男性。咽頭痛と呼吸困難を主訴に救急外来を受診した。4 時間前から強い嚥下痛のため食事が摂れなくなった。2 時間前から声を出しにくくなり、呼吸困難を自覚するようになった。意識は清明。体温38.5 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧150/90 mmHg。呼吸数28/分。SpO2 90 %（マスク5 L/分　酸素投与下）。顔貌は苦悶様で、診察中に吸気性喘鳴が増悪した。まず行うのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 52-year-old man visited the emergency room complaining of a sore throat and difficulty breathing. He was unable to eat due to severe pain when swallowing 4 hours ago. He began to have difficulty speaking 2 hours ago and became aware of difficulty breathing. He is conscious and alert. Body temperature 38.5°C. Pulse rate 96 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 150/90 mmHg. Respiratory rate 28 breaths/min. SpO2 90% (oxygen administered via mask at 5 L/min). His face appears distressed, and his inspiratory stridor worsened during the examination. Which of the following should be done first?

Question: 1 か月の女児。1 か月健診で心雑音を指摘され、母親に連れられて来院した。普段は元気にしており、哺乳も良好だという。自宅で母乳を飲んでから約2 時間30分が経過している。身長と体重の計測をしている際に目覚め、診察を待っている間に泣き出した。診察室で胸部の聴診を試みたが、母親に抱かれていても泣き続けており、聴診は困難である。心雑音を評価するために最も適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 1-month-old girl was brought to the hospital by her mother after a heart murmur was detected during her 1-month checkup. She is usually in good health and is breastfeeding well. It has been about 2 hours and 30 minutes since she last breastfed at home. She woke up while her height and weight were being measured, and began crying while waiting to be examined. We attempted to auscultate her chest in the examination room, but she continued to cry even while being held by her mother, making auscultation difficult. What is the most appropriate response to assess the heart murmur?

Question: 32 歳の1 回経産婦（2 妊1 産）。妊娠39 週6 日、規則的な子宮収縮を主訴に来院した。これまでの妊娠経過に異常を認めない。午前1 時、10 分ごとの規則的な子宮収縮を自覚し、次第に増強したため午前4 時に入院した。内診で子宮口は4 cm開大、展退度は60 %、硬度は中、児頭下降度はSP－2 cm であった。午前8 時に破水を認めた。その時点の内診で子宮口は6 cm 開大、下降度はSP－1 cm であった。その後、陣痛周期は3 分となった。午後1 時の内診で子宮口は全開大、児頭下降度はSP＋2 cm、先進する小泉門を1 時方向に触知し、矢状縫合はほぼ母体の骨盤縦径に一致していた。この時点の陣痛周期は3 分で、持続時間は1 分であった。この産婦の分娩経過で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 32-year-old woman with one parity (2 gravidas, 1 parity) was admitted to the hospital at 39 weeks and 6 days pregnant with the chief complaint of regular uterine contractions. No abnormalities were found in her pregnancy up to that point. At 1:00 a.m., she noticed regular uterine contractions every 10 minutes, which gradually intensified, and she was admitted at 4:00 a.m. Pelvic examination revealed that the cervical os was 4 cm dilated, the effacement was 60%, the hardness was medium, and the fetal head descent was SP-2 cm. Rupture of the membranes was observed at 8:00 a.m. Pelvic examination at that time revealed that the cervical os was 6 cm dilated, and the fetal head descent was SP-1 cm. The contraction cycle then became 3 minutes. Pelvic examination at 1:00 p.m. revealed that the cervical os was fully dilated, the fetal head descent was SP+2 cm, the posterior fontanelle was palpated at 1 o'clock, and the sagittal suture was almost aligned with the vertical diameter of the maternal pelvis. The contraction cycle at this point was 3 minutes, and lasted 1 minute. Which of the following is correct regarding this woman's childbirth process?

Question: 46 歳の男性。右母趾基部の疼痛を主訴に来院した。昨年も同様の症状があり、その時は翌日軽快した。先月から高血圧症と脂質異常症に対して投薬治療を受けている。2 日前に友人とゴルフに行き、飲酒した後に疼痛が出現した。今回は症状が改善しないため受診した。身長171 cm、体重82 kg。右第一中足趾節関節に発赤と疼痛を伴う腫脹を認める。明らかな結節はない。この患者の症状出現の誘因とならないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 46-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of pain at the base of his right big toe. He had similar symptoms last year, which subsided the next day. Since last month, he has been taking medication for hypertension and dyslipidemia. Two days ago, he went golfing with friends and experienced pain after drinking alcohol. This time, he visited the hospital because his symptoms had not improved. He is 171 cm tall and weighs 82 kg. There is redness and painful swelling in the right first metatarsophalangeal joint. There is no obvious nodule. Which of the following would not be a trigger for the onset of this patient's symptoms?
ensemble_location: 右母趾基部; 右第一中足趾節関節

Question:
56 歳の女性。強い頭痛後に、意識障害を生じたため救急車で搬入された。
現病歴：自宅で家事をしていたところ、突然強い頭痛を訴えた。その後まもなく反応が無くなったため、長女が救急車を要請した。2 日前に頭痛で自宅近くの診療所を受診した際の検査結果を長女が持参している。
既往歴：12 歳時に急性虫垂炎で手術。2 日前に頭痛があり、自宅近くの診療所で処方された鎮痛薬を内服している。
生活歴：夫、長女および長男との4 人暮らし。30 年前に会社を退職した。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。
家族歴：特記すべきことはない。
現症：意識レベルはJCSⅢ-100。身長152 cm、体重56 kg。体温37.2 ℃。心拍数56/分、整。血圧192/102 mmHg。呼吸数24/分。SpO2 96 %（マスク5 L/分酸素投与下）。瞳孔径は両側3.0 mm。対光反射は両側で遅延している。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。頭部に外傷はない。口腔内と咽頭とに異常を認めない。頸静脈の怒張を認めない。甲状腺腫と頸部リンパ節とを触知しない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。浮腫を認めない。腱反射に異常を認めない。

Medical history: He had been taking antihypertensive drugs and oral antidiabetic drugs for hypertension and type 2 diabetes for one year.
Life history: He had smoked 20 cigarettes per day for 35 years and had drunk 1 cup of shochu per day for 10 years.
