Present illness: He was conscious and clear-minded. Height 171 cm, weight 70 kg. Body temperature 36.1°C. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 148/96 mmHg. SpO2 98% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctivae. No abnormalities were found in the heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat, and there was tenderness in the right hypochondrium.
Examination findings: Urine findings: Protein (-), sugar (-), ketone bodies (-), occult blood (-).
Blood findings: Red blood cells 5.8 million, Hb 15.9 g/dL, Ht 51%, white blood cells 8,400 (neutrophils 70%, eosinophils 1%, basophils 1%, monocytes 4%, lymphocytes 24%), platelets 270,000, PT-INR 0.95 (normal 0.9-1.1).
Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.6 g/dL, albumin 5.0 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 13 U/L, ALT 18 U/L, LD 120 U/L (standard 120-245), ALP 55 U/L (standard 38-113), γ-GT 16 U/L (standard 8-50), CK 50 U/L (standard 30-140), urea nitrogen 10 mg/dL, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, uric acid 6.5 mg/dL, blood glucose 95 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.8% (standard 4.6-6.2), triglyceride 207 mg/dL, HDL cholesterol 242 mg/dL, LDL cholesterol 162 mg/dL, Na 142 mEq/L, K 4.0 mEq/L, Cl 102 mEq/L, Ca 9.3 mg/dL. CRP 0.1 mg/dL. No abnormalities were found on the electrocardiogram. A chest X-ray showed a cardiothoracic ratio of 46%. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed no abnormal findings. Abdominal ultrasound, plain abdominal CT, and magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) revealed several stones measuring 5 to 8 mm in diameter in the gallbladder, but no other abnormal findings. The patient was diagnosed with cholecystolithiasis, and a laparoscopic cholecystectomy was scheduled electively.
Which of the following is incorrect regarding perioperative management?

Question:
76 歳の女性。歩行障害を主訴に来院した。
現病歴：6 年前から左上肢の動かしにくさが出現し、4 年前から歩くのが遅くなった。4 年前から自宅近くの診療所でレボドパ〈L-dopa〉を処方され症状は改善した。1 年前から内服薬の効果が持続しなくなり、歩行困難が進行した。半年前から、歩行中に足が止まってしまうことがあり、2 回転倒したため専門外来を受診した。
既往歴：脂質異常症でスタチンを内服している。
生活歴：喫煙歴、飲酒歴はない。転倒しないようにほとんど外出しない。室内のトイレ歩行などの日常生活動作は自立している。
家族歴：特記すべきことはない。
現症：意識は清明。身長158 cm、体重45 kg。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍64/分、整。血圧110/60 mmHg。胸腹部に異常を認めない。神経診察では仮面様顔貌、小声および摂食時のむせこみを認める。四肢筋強剛、動作緩慢を認める。筋力低下、感覚低下は認めない。
検査所見：血液所見：赤血球340 万、Hb 11.2 g/dL、白血球6,300、血小板13 万。
血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.3 g/dL、アルブミン4.5 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.2 mg/dL、AST 24 U/L、ALT 18 U/L、LD 160 U/L（基準120～245）、γ-GT 41 U/L（基準8 ～50）、CK 58 U/L（基準30～140）、尿素窒素18 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL、血糖98 mg/dL、Na 138 mEq/L、K 4.0 mEq/L、Cl 97 mEq/L。CRP 0.2 mg/dL。
この患者に認められる可能性が高い症候はどれか。
Question_EN:
A 76-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of walking difficulties.
History of current illness: Six years ago she began to have difficulty moving her left upper limb, and four years ago her walking became slower. Four years ago she was prescribed levodopa at a clinic near her home, which improved her symptoms. One year ago, the effects of the oral medication began to wear off, and her walking difficulties worsened. Six months ago, she would sometimes stop walking while walking, and she had fallen twice, so she visited a specialist clinic.
Medical history: She has been taking statins for dyslipidemia.
Lifestyle history: She has no history of smoking or drinking alcohol. She rarely goes out to avoid falling. She is independent in daily activities such as walking to the toilet indoors.
Family history: Nothing of note.
Current symptoms: She is conscious and clear-minded. Height 158 ​​cm, weight 45 kg. Body temperature 36.2°C. Pulse 64 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 110/60 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the chest or abdomen. Neurological examination revealed mask-like facial features, a low voice, and choking while eating. Limb rigidity and slow movement were noted. No muscle weakness or sensory deficit was noted.
Test findings: Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.4 million, Hb 11.2 g/dL, white blood cells 6,300, platelets 130,000.
Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 6.3 g/dL, albumin 4.5 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.2 mg/dL, AST 24 U/L, ALT 18 U/L, LD 160 U/L (normal: 120-245), γ-GT 41 U/L (normal: 8-50), CK 58 U/L (normal: 30-140), urea nitrogen 18 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, blood glucose 98 mg/dL, Na 138 mEq/L, K 4.0 mEq/L, Cl 97 mEq/L. CRP 0.2 mg/dL.

Which symptom is most likely to be present in this patient?

Question:
27 歳の女性。胸痛と呼吸困難を主訴に来院した。
現病歴：昨日から右前胸部痛を自覚した。息を吸うと痛みが悪化するため、深呼吸ができなかった。本日は胸痛の悪化に加え、労作時の呼吸困難も出現したため救急外来を受診した。
既往歴：3 か月前から経口避妊薬を内服している。
生活歴：パートナーと2 人暮らし。事務職。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。
家族歴：母方の祖父が癌（詳細不明）。母が糖尿病と高血圧症。
現症：意識は清明。身長163 cm、体重60 kg。体温38.0 ℃。脈拍120/分、整。血圧112/64 mmHg。呼吸数32/分。SpO2 88 %（room air）。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。頸静脈の怒張を認める。心音はⅡ音の亢進を認める。呼吸音はcrackles やwheezes はなく、胸膜摩擦音も聴取しないが、深呼吸ができていない。右下腿に浮腫を認める。
検査所見：血液所見：赤血球430 万、Hb 13.1 g/dL、Ht 38 %、白血球10,100（桿状核好中球30 %、分葉核好中球45 %、好酸球1 %、好塩基球1 %、単球6 %、リンパ球17 %）、血小板23 万。
血液生化学所見：総ビリルビン0.9 mg/dL、AST 25 U/L、ALT 12 U/L、LD 315 U/L（基準120～245）。動脈血ガス分析（room air）：pH 7.48、PaCO2 26 Torr、PaO2 52 Torr、HCO3－19.0 mEq/L。心電図は洞性頻脈、Ⅰ誘導で深いS 波、Ⅲ誘導でQ 波とT 波の陰転化を認める。
診断に有用な検査はどれか。
Question_EN:
A 27-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of chest pain and dyspnea.
History of current illness: She had been aware of right anterior chest pain since yesterday. The pain worsened when she inhaled, making it impossible for her to take a deep breath. Today, in addition to the worsening chest pain, she also experienced dyspnea on exertion, so she visited the emergency room.
Medical history: She has been taking oral contraceptives for the past 3 months.
Life history: She lives with her partner. She works in an office. She has no history of smoking. She drinks alcohol occasionally.
Family history: Her maternal grandfather had cancer (details unknown). Her mother had diabetes and hypertension.
Current illness: She is conscious and alert. Her height is 163 cm and her weight is 60 kg. Her temperature is 38.0°C. Her pulse is 120 beats per minute, and is regular. Her blood pressure is 112/64 mmHg. Her respiratory rate is 32 breaths per minute. SpO2 is 88% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva. The jugular vein was distended. Heart sounds showed an accentuated second heart sound. There were no crackles or wheezes in the respiratory sounds, and no pleural friction rub was heard, but the patient was unable to breathe deeply. Edema was observed in the right lower leg.
Laboratory findings: Blood findings: Red blood cells 4.3 million, Hb 13.1 g/dL, Ht 38%, white blood cells 10,100 (band neutrophils 30%, segmented neutrophils 45%, eosinophils 1%, basophils 1%, monocytes 6%, lymphocytes 17%), platelets 230,000.
Blood biochemistry findings: Total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL, AST 25 U/L, ALT 12 U/L, LD 315 U/L (normal 120-245). Arterial blood gas analysis (room air): pH 7.48, PaCO2 26 Torr, PaO2 52 Torr, HCO3 -19.0 mEq/L. Electrocardiogram shows sinus tachycardia, deep S waves in lead I, and negative Q and T waves in lead III.
Which test would be useful in diagnosing this condition?

Question: 32 歳の男性。右陰囊の腫大を主訴に来院した。3 か月前から右陰囊の無痛性腫大を自覚したため受診した。既往歴と家族歴に特記すべきことはない。身長170 cm、体重69 kg。体温36.1 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧122/66 mmHg。右精巣に硬結を触知し圧痛を認めない。血液所見：赤血球440 万、Hb 13.7 g/dL、Ht 42 %、白血球6,000、血小板30 万。血液生化学所見：LD 302 U/L（基準124～222）、hCG 0.1 mIU/mL（基準0.7 以下）、α-フェトプロテイン〈AFP〉5.2 ng/mL（基準20 以下）。陰囊部超音波検査で右精巣に長径5 cm の内部不均一な充実性腫瘤像を認める。胸腹部造影CT で最大径3 cm の後腹膜リンパ節腫大を認める。まず行うべき対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 32-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of right scrotum swelling. He had noticed painless swelling of the right scrotum for the past 3 months and visited the hospital. There was nothing notable in his medical history or family history. Height 170 cm, weight 69 kg. Body temperature 36.1°C. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 122/66 mmHg. A hard mass was palpable in the right testis, but there was no tenderness. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.4 million, hemoglobin 13.7 g/dL, hematocrit 42%, white blood cells 6,000, platelets 300,000. Blood biochemistry findings: LD 302 U/L (normal: 124-222), hCG 0.1 mIU/mL (normal: 0.7 or less), α-fetoprotein (AFP) 5.2 ng/mL (normal: 20 or less). Scrotal ultrasound examination reveals a heterogeneous solid mass measuring 5 cm in diameter in the right testis. Chest and abdominal contrast CT scan reveals retroperitoneal lymph node enlargement measuring 3 cm in diameter. What should be the first course of action?

Question: 20 歳の男性。胸部不快感と呼吸困難を主訴に来院した。これまでに何度か胸部不快感を自覚したが、医療機関を受診していなかった。昨日から呼吸困難が出現し、持続しているため受診した。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。家族歴は父親が20 歳台で脳静脈洞血栓症を発症。意識は清明。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧104/68 mmHg。呼吸数24/分。SpO2 94 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。下肢に軽度の浮腫を認める。血液所見：赤血球450 万、Hb 14.5 g/dL、Ht 42 %、白血球6,200（好中球62 %、好酸球1 %、単球5 %、リンパ球32 %）、血小板22 万、PT-INR 1.0（基準0.9～1.1）、活性化部分トロンボプラスチン時間〈APTT〉30 秒（基準対照32.2）、血漿フィブリノゲン288 mg/dL（基準186～355）、D ダイマー 10 μg/mL（基準1.0以下）。血液生化学所見：総ビリルビン1.1 mg/dL、LD 208 U/L（基準124～222）、尿素窒素22 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL。CRP 0.3 mg/dL。胸部エックス線写真で異常を認めない。直ちに行う検査で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 20-year-old male visited the hospital complaining of chest discomfort and dyspnea. He had previously experienced chest discomfort several times but had not visited a medical institution. He visited the hospital because dyspnea had developed yesterday and was continuing. There was nothing notable in his medical history. His father had a family history of cerebral venous sinus thrombosis in his 20s. He was alert and conscious. Body temperature 36.2°C. Pulse rate 96 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 104/68 mmHg. Respiratory rate 24 breaths/min. SpO2 94% (room air). No abnormalities were noted in the heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. There was mild edema in the lower limbs. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.5 million, Hb 14.5 g/dL, Ht 42%, white blood cells 6,200 (neutrophils 62%, eosinophils 1%, monocytes 5%, lymphocytes 32%), platelets 220,000, PT-INR 1.0 (normal 0.9-1.1), activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT) 30 seconds (normal control 32.2), plasma fibrinogen 288 mg/dL (normal 186-355), D-dimer 10 μg/mL (normal 1.0 or less). Blood biochemistry findings: total bilirubin 1.1 mg/dL, LD 208 U/L (normal 124-222), urea nitrogen 22 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL. CRP 0.3 mg/dL. Chest X-ray showed no abnormalities. Which of the following is the most appropriate immediate test?

Question: 28 歳の女性（2 妊1 産）。妊娠32 週に胎児発育不全を指摘され紹介受診した。妊娠10 週に行った妊婦初期検査では血液型O 型RhD（＋）、間接Coombs 試験陰性、HBs 抗原陰性、HCV 抗体陰性、風疹HI 抗体価 128 倍、RPR 1 倍未満、TPHA 陰性、HIV 抗原・抗体陰性であった。妊娠15 週に感冒様症状が数日続いたが、自然に軽快したためそのままにしていた。来院時の胎児超音波検査で大横径〈BPD〉73 mm（－2 SD）、腹囲〈AC〉23 cm、大腿骨長〈FL〉24 mm、推定胎児体重〈EFW〉1,368 g（－2 SD）、胎児に腹水を認める。考えられる母子感染症はどれか。
Question_EN: A 28-year-old woman (2 gravidas, 1 parity) was referred to our hospital at 32 weeks of gestation after fetal growth restriction was detected. Initial prenatal testing at 10 weeks of gestation revealed blood type O RhD (+), negative indirect Coombs test, negative HBs antigen, negative HCV antibody, rubella HI antibody titer 1:128, RPR <1:1, negative TPHA, and negative HIV antigen and antibody. At 15 weeks of gestation, cold-like symptoms continued for several days, but they subsided naturally and were left untreated. Fetal ultrasound examination at the time of visit revealed biparietal diameter (BPD) 73 mm (-2 SD), abdominal circumference (AC) 23 cm, femur length (FL) 24 mm, estimated fetal weight (EFW) 1,368 g (-2 SD), and ascites in the fetus. Which maternal-fetal infection is the most likely?

Question: 25 歳の女性（2 妊0 産）。初経は12 歳。4 日前から下腹部痛を自覚したため産科診療所を受診した。月経周期は28 日型、整、順。最終月経は10 日前から5 日間。最近2 年間に2 回人工妊娠中絶手術を受けた。身長160 cm、体重53 kg。体温37.9 ℃。脈拍100/分、整。血圧116/62 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。腹部は平坦で、下腹部に反跳痛を認める。内診で子宮は正常大で圧痛を認める。付属器は痛みのため触知できない。腟鏡診で外子宮口に黄色膿性分泌物を認める。血液所見：赤血球320 万、Hb 10.3 g/dL、Ht 30 %、白血球18,300（桿状核好中球60 %、分葉核好中球26 %、好酸球0 %、好塩基球1 %、リンパ球13 %）、血小板41 万。CRP 16 mg/dL。妊娠反応検査陰性。経腟超音波検査で左卵管のソーセージ様腫大を認め、同部が痛みの最強点となっている。まず投与すべきなのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 25-year-old woman (2 gravidas, 0 parities). Her menarche was at age 12. She had been experiencing lower abdominal pain for the past 4 days and visited an obstetric clinic. Her menstrual cycle is 28 days, regular, and regular. Her last menstrual period occurred 10 days ago and for 5 days. She had undergone two induced abortions in the past 2 years. Her height is 160 cm and her weight is 53 kg. Her body temperature is 37.9°C. Her pulse rate is 100 beats/min and regular. Her blood pressure is 116/62 mmHg. Her respiratory rate is 20 breaths/min. Her abdomen is flat and she has rebound tenderness in the lower abdomen. Pelvic examination reveals that the uterus is of normal size and tender. The adnexa cannot be palpated due to pain. Speculum examination reveals a yellow purulent discharge from the external cervical os. Blood findings: RBC 3.2 million, Hb 10.3 g/dL, Ht 30%, WBC 18,300 (band neutrophils 60%, segmented neutrophils 26%, eosinophils 0%, basophils 1%, lymphocytes 13%), platelets 410,000. CRP 16 mg/dL. Pregnancy test negative. Transvaginal ultrasound revealed sausage-like swelling of the left fallopian tube, which was the point of greatest pain. Which should be administered first?

Question: 67 歳の男性。酩酊状態のため心配した家族に付き添われて来院した。若い頃から晩酌が習慣であった。1 年前の定年退職後から飲酒量が多くなり、最近、食事を食べずに朝から夜まで飲酒している。家族によると、酔っているとき手や指の振えが止まるという。また、飲酒を控えるように言っても、隠れて酒を買いに行って飲んでしまうという。身長173 cm、体重51 kg。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧108/78 mmHg。呼吸数18/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。アルコール臭があるが、会話は可能である。眼瞼結膜は軽度貧血様である。眼球結膜に黄染を認めるが、眼球運動は正常である。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。断酒と検査目的で入院することとなった。入院後に投与すべき薬剤はどれか。
Question_EN: A 67-year-old man was accompanied by his family, who were concerned about his intoxicated state, and visited the hospital. He had been in the habit of drinking in the evening since he was young. Since he retired one year ago, his drinking has increased, and recently he has been drinking from morning to night without eating. According to his family, when he is drunk, his hands and fingers stop shaking. He also says that even when he is told to refrain from drinking, he secretly goes out to buy alcohol and drinks it. Height: 173 cm, weight: 51 kg. Body temperature: 36.8°C. Pulse rate: 72/min, regular. Blood pressure: 108/78 mmHg. Respiratory rate: 18/min. SpO2: 98% (room air). He smells of alcohol, but is able to talk. The palpebral conjunctiva appears to be mildly anemic. Yellowing of the bulbar conjunctiva is observed, but eye movement is normal. No abnormalities were observed in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The abdomen is flat and soft, and the liver and spleen are not palpable. The patient was admitted to the hospital for abstinence from alcohol and examination. Which medication should be administered after admission?

Question: 84 歳の男性。発熱を主訴に来院した。10 日前から右側胸部の痛みを自覚していた。3 日前から発熱が出現したため受診した。1 年前、脳梗塞により左不全片麻痺があり、時々食事でむせることがある。意識は清明。身長162 cm、体重46 kg。体温37.6 ℃。脈拍104/分、整。血圧110/66 mmHg。呼吸数24/分。SpO2 95 %（room air）。残存歯は数本でう歯があり口腔内は乾燥している。心音に異常を認めない。呼吸音は右下肺野にcoarse crackles を聴取する。血液所見：赤血球436 万、Hb 13.9 g/dL、Ht 42 %、白血球12,600（好中球75 %、好酸球1 %、好塩基球1 %、単球6 %、リンパ球17 %）、血小板18 万。CRP 12 mg/dL。胸部エックス線写真で右下肺野に浸潤影を認める。入院し多職種で連携してこの患者の肺炎治療サポートを行うことになった。現時点でかかわらないのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 84-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of fever. He had been aware of right-sided chest pain for the past 10 days. He was examined because he had had a fever for the past 3 days. He had a cerebral infarction one year ago, which caused left hemiparesis, and he sometimes chokes when eating. He was conscious and alert. Height 162 cm, weight 46 kg. Body temperature 37.6°C. Pulse 104 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 110/66 mmHg. Respiratory rate 24 breaths/min. SpO2 95% (room air). He had a few remaining teeth with cavities, and the mouth was dry. No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds. Coarse crackles were heard in the right lower lung field. Blood findings: RBC 4.36 million, Hb 13.9 g/dL, Ht 42%, WBC 12,600 (neutrophils 75%, eosinophils 1%, basophils 1%, monocytes 6%, lymphocytes 17%), platelets 180,000. CRP 12 mg/dL. Chest X-ray shows an infiltrative shadow in the right lower lung field. The patient is admitted to hospital and a multidisciplinary team will work together to support the treatment of pneumonia for this patient. Which of the following is not involved at this time?

Question: 70 歳の男性。全身倦怠感を主訴に来院した。2 週間前から全身倦怠感が出現し軽快しないため受診した。眼瞼結膜は貧血様で、眼球結膜に黄染を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。両下肢に点状出血を認める。血液所見：赤血球174 万、Hb 5.4 g/dL、Ht 16 %、網赤血球1 %、白血球1,800（分葉核好中球20%、好酸球1 %、単球2 %、リンパ球77 %）、血小板2.2 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.2 g/dL、アルブミン3.2 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.6 mg/dL、AST 28 U/L、ALT 34 U/L、LD 140 U/L（基準124～222）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL。末梢血塗抹標本で赤血球に異常を認めない。骨髄生検では著明な低形成所見を認める。治療で適切でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 70-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of general fatigue. He had been experiencing general fatigue for 2 weeks and was not improving when he visited the hospital. The palpebral conjunctiva appeared anemic, and there was no yellowing of the bulbar conjunctiva. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen could not be palpated. Petechia was present in both lower limbs. Blood findings: red blood cells 1.74 million, hemoglobin 5.4 g/dL, hematocrit 16%, reticulocytes 1%, white blood cells 1,800 (segmented neutrophils 20%, eosinophils 1%, monocytes 2%, lymphocytes 77%), platelets 22,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.2 g/dL, albumin 3.2 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL, AST 28 U/L, ALT 34 U/L, LD 140 U/L (normal 124-222), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL. Peripheral blood smear reveals no abnormalities in red blood cells. Bone marrow biopsy reveals significant hypoplasia. Which of the following is not an appropriate treatment?

Question: 71 歳の男性。肝炎ウイルス検診で「現在、C 型肝炎ウイルスに感染している可能性が極めて高い」と判定されて受診した。高血圧症でカルシウム拮抗薬を内服している。12 歳時に交通事故で輸血を受けた。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。意識は清明。脈拍76/分、整。血圧132/74 mmHg。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。血液所見：赤血球485 万、Hb 14.7 g/dL、白血球6,300、血小板16 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.3 g/dL、アルブミン4.5 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.7 mg/dL、AST 24 U/L、ALT 28 U/L、γ-GT 36 U/L（基準13～64）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.5 mg/dL、eGFR 82.8 mL/分/1.73 m2。免疫血清学所見：HBs 抗原陰性、HBs 抗体陰性、HBc 抗体陰性、HCV 抗体陽性、HCV-RNA 陽性。腹部超音波検査で異常を認めない。第一選択薬はどれか。
Question_EN: A 71-year-old male was examined after being diagnosed with a high possibility of being infected with hepatitis C virus. He was taking calcium antagonists for hypertension. He had received a blood transfusion after a traffic accident at the age of 12. He has no history of smoking. He drinks alcohol on an occasional basis. He was alert and conscious. His pulse rate was 76 beats per minute and was regular. His blood pressure was 132/74 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctivae. No abnormalities were found in the heart and respiratory sounds. His abdomen was flat and soft, and his liver and spleen were not palpable. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.85 million, hemoglobin 14.7 g/dL, white blood cells 6,300, platelets 160,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.3 g/dL, albumin 4.5 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.7 mg/dL, AST 24 U/L, ALT 28 U/L, γ-GT 36 U/L (normal: 13-64), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.5 mg/dL, eGFR 82.8 mL/min/1.73 m2. Immunoserological findings: HBs antigen negative, HBs antibody negative, HBc antibody negative, HCV antibody positive, HCV-RNA positive. No abnormalities were found in abdominal ultrasound. What is the first choice drug?

Question: 64 歳の女性。息苦しさを主訴に来院した。15 年前から高血圧症と糖尿病を指摘されていたが、医療機関を受診しなかった。2 か月前に発熱で自宅近くの診療所を受診し、腎機能障害を指摘された。3 週間前から食欲がなく果物だけ食べていた。一昨日の夜間就寝後から息苦しさを自覚したため受診した。意識は清明。身長166 cm、体重75 kg（2 か月前は70 kg）。脈拍92/分、整。血圧190/110 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 90 %（room air）。両下肺野にcoarse crackles を聴取する。両下腿に高度の圧痕性浮腫を認める。尿所見：蛋白3 ＋、糖2 ＋、潜血（－）。随時尿の尿蛋白188 mg/dL、クレアチニン87 mg/dL。血液所見：赤血球335 万、Hb 9.0 g/dL、Ht 31 %。血液生化学所見：総蛋白5.3 g/dL、アルブミン2.8 g/dL、尿素窒素56 mg/dL、クレアチニン3.9 mg/dL、尿酸6.8 mg/dL、血糖263 mg/dL、HbA1c 8.6 %（基準4.9～6.0）、Na 140 mEq/L、K 6.7 mEq/L、Cl 106 mEq/L、Ca 7.2 mg/dL、P 5.6 mg/dL。胸部エックス線写真で心拡大と肺うっ血を認める。心電図でテント状T 波を認める。この患者にまず投与すべき薬剤はどれか。
Question_EN: A 64-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of shortness of breath. She had been diagnosed with hypertension and diabetes for the past 15 years, but had not sought medical treatment. Two months ago, she visited a clinic near her home with a fever and was diagnosed with renal dysfunction. She had lost her appetite three weeks ago and had only eaten fruit. She visited the hospital because she had felt short of breath after going to bed the day before yesterday. She was fully conscious. Height 166 cm, weight 75 kg (70 kg two months ago). Pulse 92/min, regular. Blood pressure 190/110 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20/min. SpO2 90% (room air). Coarse crackles were heard in both lower lung fields. Severe pitting edema was observed in both lower legs. Urine findings: protein 3+, sugar 2+, occult blood (-). Random urine protein 188 mg/dL, creatinine 87 mg/dL. Blood findings: RBC 3.35 million, Hb 9.0 g/dL, Ht 31%. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 5.3 g/dL, albumin 2.8 g/dL, urea nitrogen 56 mg/dL, creatinine 3.9 mg/dL, uric acid 6.8 mg/dL, blood glucose 263 mg/dL, HbA1c 8.6% (normal 4.9-6.0), Na 140 mEq/L, K 6.7 mEq/L, Cl 106 mEq/L, Ca 7.2 mg/dL, P 5.6 mg/dL. Chest X-ray shows cardiomegaly and pulmonary congestion. Electrocardiogram shows tented T waves. Which drug should be administered to this patient first?

Question: 7 歳の男児。右前腕の痛みと右手指の運動障害を主訴に母親に連れられて夜間に来院した。同日午前にブランコから転落して右肘を強打し受診していた。診療記録によると右肘に腫脹と変形が認められ、エックス線写真で右上腕骨顆上骨折を認め、徒手整復とシーネ固定を施行していた。帰宅8 時間後に疼痛が増強し、右手指の運動ができなくなったため再度受診した。身長110 cm、体重19 kg。シーネの包帯を外して観察すると、右前腕に著しい腫脹を認めた。右手指は自動屈伸ができず、他動伸展すると激しい痛みを訴える。橈骨動脈の拍動を触知しない。この患児への対応で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 7-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his mother at night complaining of pain in his right forearm and impaired movement of the fingers of his right hand. He had fallen off a swing that morning and hit his right elbow hard, and had visited the hospital. The medical records showed swelling and deformation of the right elbow, and an X-ray showed a supracondylar fracture of the right humerus, which was corrected by manual reduction and splint fixation. Eight hours after returning home, the pain intensified and he was no longer able to move his right fingers, so he visited the hospital again. Height 110 cm, weight 19 kg. When the splint bandage was removed, significant swelling was observed in the right forearm. The fingers of his right hand were unable to bend and extend automatically, and he complained of severe pain when they were passively extended. Pulse of the radial artery could not be palpated. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment for this patient?

Question: 65 歳の女性（2 妊1 産）。乳房のしこりを主訴に来院した。10 年ほど前から左乳房のしこりを自覚していたが様子をみていた。最近になって痛みが出現したため受診した。乳癌の家族歴はない。身長160 cm、体重60 kg。体温36.0 ℃。脈拍80/分、整。血圧146/90 mmHg。左乳房に皮膚の陥凹を認め、径3 cm の腫瘤を触知する。マンモグラフィでは周囲にスピキュラを伴う高濃度腫瘤陰影と多形性の微細石灰化像を認めた。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: A 65-year-old woman (2 gravidas, 1 parity) visited the hospital complaining of a breast lump. She had been aware of a lump in her left breast for about 10 years, but had been monitoring it. She visited the hospital because she had recently experienced pain. There is no family history of breast cancer. Height: 160 cm, weight: 60 kg. Body temperature: 36.0°C. Pulse: 80 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure: 146/90 mmHg. A skin depression was noted in the left breast, and a mass 3 cm in diameter was palpable. Mammography revealed a high-density mass shadow with surrounding spicules and polymorphous microcalcifications. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 21 歳の女性。2 週間前からの鼻漏、鼻閉およびくしゃみを主訴に来院した。3年前の春から鼻漏、鼻閉およびくしゃみを自覚していた。自宅近くの診療所で抗ヒスタミン薬が処方されていた。症状は一時改善したが、3 月初旬から症状が悪化した。両側鼻粘膜は腫脹しており、水様性鼻汁を認めた。鼻汁好酸球検査は陽性。今の症状をできるだけ早く改善したいと訴えている。治療で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 21-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of nasal discharge, nasal congestion, and sneezing for the past two weeks. She had been aware of nasal discharge, nasal congestion, and sneezing since the spring of three years ago. She had been prescribed antihistamines at a clinic near her home. Her symptoms temporarily improved, but worsened from early March. Both nasal mucosa was swollen, and watery nasal discharge was observed. The nasal eosinophil test was positive. She said she wanted to improve her current symptoms as soon as possible. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

Question: 22 歳の女性。頭痛と浮腫を主訴に来院した。2 週間前から発熱と咽頭痛があり、自宅近くの診療所で扁桃炎と診断された。一昨日から頭痛および下肢の浮腫が出現し、次第に増悪したため受診した。これまでに学校と職場の健診で異常を指摘されたことはない。身長156 cm、体重45 kg。脈拍84/分、整。血圧156/76 mmHg。顔面に皮疹はない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。両下腿に浮腫を認める。神経診察に異常を認めない。尿所見：蛋白2 ＋、潜血3 ＋。この患者で認められる可能性が高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 22-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of headache and edema. She had had a fever and sore throat for the past 2 weeks and was diagnosed with tonsillitis at a clinic near her home. She had a headache and edema in her lower limbs since the day before yesterday, and these symptoms gradually worsened, so she visited the hospital. No abnormalities had been found during school or workplace health checkups. Height: 156 cm, weight: 45 kg. Pulse: 84 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure: 156/76 mmHg. There is no rash on the face. No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds or respiratory sounds. Edema was found in both lower legs. No abnormalities were found in the neurological examination. Urine findings: protein 2+, occult blood 3+. Which of the following is most likely to be found in this patient?

Question: 68 歳の男性。就寝中の行動を心配した妻に伴われて来院した。週に数回、就寝後1 時間半ほどすると大声をあげ、むっくと起き上がって何かと戦っているような行動をするようになった。妻が制止すると我に返り「夢を見ていた」と言い、再び就寝し翌朝には夢の中でのことだったと記憶している。日中の行動異常は全くない。身体的には体が固く動作が遅くなったといい、物忘れを自覚している。身長168 cm、体重60 kg。四肢に筋強剛を認める。Mini-Mental State Examination〈MMSE〉では21 点（満点30）。血液所見、血液生化学所見、脳波および頭部単純MRI に異常を認めない。この患者の睡眠障害はどれか。
Question_EN: A 68-year-old man was brought to the hospital by his wife, who was concerned about his behavior while sleeping. Several times a week, about an hour and a half after going to bed, he would start yelling, jump up, and act as if he was fighting something. When his wife tried to stop him, he came to his senses and said he was dreaming, went back to sleep, and the next morning remembered that he had been dreaming. There was no abnormality in his behavior during the day. Physically, he said that his body had become stiff and his movements had become slow, and he was aware of his forgetfulness. He was 168 cm tall and weighed 60 kg. Muscle rigidity was present in his limbs. His Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) score was 21 (out of a possible 30). No abnormalities were found in blood findings, blood biochemistry findings, electroencephalogram, or plain head MRI. What is this patient's sleep disorder?

Question: An 85-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital with a left femoral neck fracture and was confined to bed rest. On admission, muscle strength and sensation in the left lower limb were normal, but the next day, she was unable to move her left foot upwards. On examination, she was unable to dorsiflex her left ankle, with decreased sensation on the dorsal aspect of her left foot. The left lower limb was externally rotated. Select the most likely cause of her decreased ankle movement.
Question_EN: An 85-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital with a left femoral neck fracture and was confined to bed rest. On admission, muscle strength and sensation in the left lower limb were normal, but the next day, she was unable to move her left foot upwards. On examination, she was unable to dorsiflex her left ankle, with decreased sensation on the dorsal aspect of her left foot. The left lower limb was externally rotated. Select the most likely cause of her decreased ankle movement.

Question: 48 歳の女性。乳がん検診のマンモグラフィで腫瘤を指摘され、精査目的に来院した。右乳房の上外側区域に径25 mm の腫瘤を触知する。次に行う検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 48-year-old woman was diagnosed with a mass during a mammogram for breast cancer screening and visited the hospital for further examination. A mass measuring 25 mm in diameter is palpable in the upper outer area of ​​the right breast. Which of the following tests should be performed next?

Question: 73歳の男性。発熱と頭痛を主訴に来院した。最近疲れやすく、3か月間で3kgの体重減少があった。1か月前から微熱と頭痛が続き、5日前から頭痛が強くなった。トイレの場所を間違える、真夜中に食事を要求するなどの異常行動に家族が気付いていたという。意識は混濁。身長168cm、体重59kg。体温38.2℃。脈拍92/分、整。血圧140/92 mmHg。神経診察では項部硬直、右眼の外転障害、右顔面の運動麻痺を認める。脳脊髄液所見：外観は水様透明。初圧200 mmH2O（基準70～170）、細胞数250/mm3（すべて単核球）（基準0～2）、糖（定量）25 mg/dL（基準50～75）、蛋白（定量）180 mg/dL（基準15～45）、アデノシンデアミナーゼ〈ADA〉15 IU/L（基準8以下）。頭部単純CTで脳室拡大は認めない。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: A 73-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of fever and headache. He had recently become easily fatigued and had lost 3 kg in the past three months. He had been suffering from a low-grade fever and headache for one month, and the headache had intensified five days ago. His family had noticed his abnormal behavior, such as using the wrong toilet and asking for food in the middle of the night. He was confused. Height: 168 cm, weight: 59 kg. Body temperature: 38.2°C. Pulse: 92 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure: 140/92 mmHg. Neurological examination revealed neck stiffness, impaired abduction of the right eye, and motor paralysis of the right face. Cerebrospinal fluid findings: Watery and transparent in appearance. Initial pressure 200 mmH2O (standard 70-170), cell count 250/mm3 (all mononuclear cells) (standard 0-2), glucose (quantitative) 25 mg/dL (standard 50-75), protein (quantitative) 180 mg/dL (standard 15-45), adenosine deaminase (ADA) 15 IU/L (standard 8 or less). No ventricular enlargement was observed on plain head CT. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 1 か月の男児。生後20 日頃から母乳を飲むのに時間がかかるようになったことを母親が心配し、両親に連れられて自宅近くの小児科診療所を受診した。在胎40週、身長49.5 cm、体重2,850 g、頭囲33 cm で、仮死なく出生した。出生後は完全母乳栄養である。身長54.0 cm、体重3,320 g。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍124/分、整。呼吸数40/分。啼泣時の表情は正常だが、声が小さく舌が細かくぴくぴくと震えている。呼吸時に胸部と腹部が交互に上がる。手指の動きは正常だが、四肢を持ち上げる運動に乏しい。両親への説明で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 1-month-old boy. From around the 20th day after birth, his mother became concerned that he had begun to take longer to drink breast milk, so his parents took him to a pediatric clinic near their home. He was born without asphyxia at 40 weeks gestation, with a height of 49.5 cm, weight of 2,850 g, and head circumference of 33 cm. Since birth, he has been exclusively breastfed. Height 54.0 cm, weight 3,320 g. Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse rate 124 beats/min, regular. Respiratory rate 40 breaths/min. His facial expression is normal when he cries, but his voice is soft and his tongue trembles finely. When breathing, his chest and abdomen rise alternately. His fingers and hands move normally, but he has little ability to lift his limbs. Which of the following explanations would be correct for the parents?

Question: 62 歳の女性。出血斑を主訴に来院した。数か月前から四肢の出血斑に気付いた。最近、前胸部に点状出血が多数出現したため受診した。意識は清明。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍68/分、整。血圧118/72 mmHg。前胸部と四肢に点状出血を認める。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。頸部リンパ節を触知しない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。血液所見：赤血球360 万、Hb 11.0 g/dL、Ht 33 %、白血球5,100（好中球53 %、好酸球2 %、単球6 %、リンパ球39 %）、血小板2.6 万。PT-INR 1.0（基準0.9～1.1）、活性化部分トロンボプラスチン時間〈APTT〉30 秒（基準対照32.2）、血清FDP 5 μg/mL（基準10 以下）。血液生化学所見：総ビリルビン1.0 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン0.2 mg/dL、LD 210 U/L（基準124～222）、尿素窒素20 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL。末梢血塗抹標本で白血球と赤血球とに異常を認めない。骨髄塗抹標本で巨核球の軽度増加を認める。造血細胞に形態異常を認めない。治療方針の決定に有用な検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 62-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of bleeding spots. She had noticed bleeding spots on her limbs for several months. She recently visited because of numerous petechiae on her precordium. She was conscious and alert. Body temperature was 36.2°C. Pulse was 68 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure was 118/72 mmHg. Petechiae were present on the precordium and limbs. No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctivae. No cervical lymph nodes were palpable. No abnormalities were found in the heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. Blood findings: red blood cells 3.6 million, hemoglobin 11.0 g/dL, hematocrit 33%, white blood cells 5,100 (neutrophils 53%, eosinophils 2%, monocytes 6%, lymphocytes 39%), platelets 26,000. PT-INR 1.0 (normal: 0.9-1.1), activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT) 30 seconds (normal: 32.2), serum FDP 5 μg/mL (normal: less than 10). Blood biochemistry findings: total bilirubin 1.0 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 0.2 mg/dL, LD 210 U/L (normal: 124-222), urea nitrogen 20 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL. Peripheral blood smear shows no abnormalities in white blood cells or red blood cells. Bone marrow smear shows a mild increase in megakaryocytes. No morphological abnormalities are observed in hematopoietic cells. Which test is useful in determining the treatment plan?

Question: 29 歳の男性。労作時呼吸困難を主訴に来院した。数年前から職場健診で高血圧と尿検査異常を指摘されていたが、医療機関を受診しなかった。1 週間前から階段を昇る際に息切れを自覚したため受診した。意識は清明。身長172 cm、体重82 kg。体温36.4 ℃。脈拍104/分、整。血圧228/132 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 96 %（room air）。頸静脈の怒張を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。両前脛骨部に圧痕性浮腫を認める。神経診察で異常を認めない。尿所見：比重1.020、蛋白3 ＋、潜血3 ＋、沈渣に変形赤血球を多数認める。血液所見：赤血球422 万、Hb 13.7 g/dL、Ht 40 %、白血球9,800、血小板17 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.9 g/dL、アルブミン3.8 g/dL、尿素窒素52 mg/dL、クレアチニン4.0 mg/dL、Na 138 mEq/L、K 2.9 mEq/L、Cl 106 mEq/L。降圧薬治療の準備中にまず行う検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 29-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of exertional dyspnea. Several years ago, workplace health checks had revealed high blood pressure and abnormal urine test results, but he had not sought medical care. One week prior, he had become short of breath while climbing stairs, and sought medical attention. He was conscious and alert. Height 172 cm, weight 82 kg. Body temperature 36.4°C. Pulse 104 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 228/132 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20 breaths/min. SpO2 96% (room air). No jugular venous distension was noted. Heart and respiratory sounds were normal. There was pitting edema in both anterior tibial regions. No abnormalities were noted in the neurological examination. Urine findings: specific gravity 1.020, protein 3+, occult blood 3+, and numerous dysmorphic red blood cells in the sediment. Blood findings: RBC 4.22 million, Hb 13.7 g/dL, Ht 40%, WBC 9,800, platelets 170,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 6.9 g/dL, albumin 3.8 g/dL, urea nitrogen 52 mg/dL, creatinine 4.0 mg/dL, Na 138 mEq/L, K 2.9 mEq/L, Cl 106 mEq/L. Which test would be performed first when preparing for antihypertensive drug treatment?

Question: 7 か月の男児。頭部を前屈する動作を心配した両親に連れられて来院した。在胎40 週、体重3,020 g で仮死なく出生した。追視・固視を1 か月、あやし笑いを2か月、定頸を3 か月で認めた。2 週間前から両上肢を伸展挙上し、頭部を前屈する動作が出現した。約10 秒間隔で10 回以上反復し、次第に毎日みられるようになった。同時期からあやし笑いが乏しくなり、寝返りと坐位保持ができなくなった。可能性が高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 7-month-old boy was brought to the hospital by his parents who were concerned about his tendency to tilt his head forward. He was born without asphyxia at 40 weeks gestation and weighing 3,020 g. He showed signs of tracking and fixation at 1 month, social smiling at 2 months, and neck stability at 3 months. Two weeks ago, he began to show signs of extending and raising both arms and tilting his head forward. This was repeated more than 10 times at approximately 10-second intervals, and gradually became a daily occurrence. Around the same time, his social smiling became less frequent, and he was no longer able to roll over or sit up. Which of the following is most likely?

Question: 22 歳の男性。咳嗽を主訴に来院した。1 週間前から微熱と咳嗽が出現し改善しないため受診した。両親と弟と同居。2 週間前に16 歳の弟が同様の症状で百日咳と診断されている。昨日から反復性、発作性の咳嗽が持続している。咳は夜間に強い。意識は清明。体温37.1 ℃。脈拍108/分、整。血圧124/68 mmHg。呼吸数22/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。この疾患で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 22-year-old male visited the hospital complaining of a cough. He had had a slight fever and cough for the past week and these symptoms have not improved, so he visited the hospital. He lives with his parents and younger brother. Two weeks ago, his 16-year-old brother had similar symptoms and was diagnosed with whooping cough. He has been suffering from recurrent, paroxysmal coughing since yesterday. The cough is more severe at night. He is conscious and alert. Body temperature 37.1°C. Pulse rate 108 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 124/68 mmHg. Respiratory rate 22 beats/min. SpO2 98% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. Which of the following is correct regarding this disease?

Question: 72 歳の女性。①尿量の減少を主訴に来院した。4 日前から嘔吐と下痢があり食事量が低下していた。2 日前から全身倦怠感が出現し、今朝から尿量が減少したため受診した。12 年前から高血圧症で降圧薬を内服している。身長154 cm、体重48 kg（2 週間前の体重51 kg）。脈拍108/分、整。血圧100/52 mmHg。口腔内は乾燥している。胸部と腹部の診察で異常を認めない。尿所見：蛋白1 ＋、潜血（－）、沈渣に赤血球1 ～3 /HPF、白血球1 ～2 /HPF、円柱はない。尿生化学所見：②尿Na 10 mEq/L。血液所見：赤血球300 万、③Hb 10.0 g/dL、Ht 31 %、白血球9,200、血小板35 万。血液生化学所見：尿素窒素70 mg/dL、④クレアチニン2.5 mg/dL（1 か月前の採血では0.9 mg/dL）、Na 138 mEq/L、⑤K 5.5 mEq/L、Cl 98 mEq/L。①〜⑤のうち、急性腎障害の原因の鑑別に有用なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 72-year-old woman. ① She visited the hospital complaining of decreased urinary volume. She had been vomiting and diarrhea for 4 days, and her food intake had decreased. She had been feeling fatigued for 2 days, and her urinary volume had decreased since this morning, so she visited the hospital. She has been taking antihypertensive drugs for hypertension for 12 years. Height 154 cm, weight 48 kg (weight 51 kg 2 weeks ago). Pulse 108 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 100/52 mmHg. The mouth is dry. No abnormalities were found in the chest and abdominal examination. Urine findings: protein 1+, occult blood (-), 1-3 red blood cells/HPF, 1-2 white blood cells/HPF in the sediment, no casts. Urine biochemistry findings: ② Urine Na 10 mEq/L. Blood findings: Red blood cells 3 million, ③ Hb 10.0 g/dL, Ht 31%, White blood cells 9,200, Platelets 350,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Urea nitrogen 70 mg/dL, ④ Creatinine 2.5 mg/dL (Blood taken one month ago was 0.9 mg/dL), Na 138 mEq/L, ⑤ K 5.5 mEq/L, Cl 98 mEq/L. Which of the numbered items is useful in differentiating the cause of acute kidney injury?

Question: 82 歳の男性。転倒して頭部を受傷し脳挫傷と診断された。急性期治療後、回復期リハビリテーション病棟に入院した。現在、発症後30 日目である。意識レベルはJCSⅠ-2。血圧120/78 mmHg。利き手は右。徒手筋力テストで左上下肢は4 、右上肢は肘屈曲1 、手指屈曲1 、手指伸展0 、右下肢は股関節屈曲1 、膝伸展2 、足関節背屈0 であった。右上下肢に中等度の感覚障害を認める。端座位はほぼ自立。立ち上がり・立位保持には中等度の介助を要する。現時点で行うべきリハビリテーションはどれか。
Question_EN: An 82-year-old man fell and injured his head, and was diagnosed with a cerebral contusion. After acute treatment, he was admitted to a rehabilitation ward for the convalescent phase. It has now been 30 days since the onset of symptoms. His level of consciousness is JCS I-2. His blood pressure is 120/78 mmHg. He is right-handed. Manual muscle testing showed that the left upper and lower limbs were 4, the right upper limb was elbow flexion 1, finger flexion 1, finger extension 0, and the right lower limb was hip flexion 1, knee extension 2, and ankle dorsiflexion 0. There is moderate sensory impairment in the right upper and lower limbs. He is almost independent in sitting on the edge of a chair. He requires moderate assistance to stand up and maintain an upright position. What rehabilitation should be performed at this time?

Question: 55 歳の男性。嚥下困難を主訴に来院した。2 年前から右上肢の筋力低下が出現した。1 年前から足がつっぱり、つまずきやすくなった。3 か月前から食事中にむせることがある。この1 年間で体重は3 kg 減少した。意識は清明。身長168 cm、体重55 kg。体温36.5 ℃。脈拍80/分、整。血圧128/72 mmHg。眼球運動に異常を認めない。構音障害を認める。舌に萎縮を認め、線維束性収縮を認める。四肢遠位筋に筋力低下と筋萎縮を認める。腱反射は上下肢とも亢進しており、Babinski徴候は両側陽性。感覚は正常である。この患者に起こる可能性が高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 55-year-old man visits the hospital complaining of difficulty swallowing. Two years ago, he developed muscle weakness in his right upper limb. One year ago, he began to have stiff legs and tripped easily. Three months ago, he began to choke while eating. Over the past year, he has lost 3 kg of weight. He is conscious and alert. His height is 168 cm and his weight is 55 kg. His body temperature is 36.5°C. His pulse rate is 80 beats per minute and is regular. His blood pressure is 128/72 mmHg. There are no abnormalities in his eye movements. He has a speech disorder. His tongue is atrophic and has fasciculations. There is muscle weakness and atrophy in the distal muscles of his limbs. Tendon reflexes are increased in both the upper and lower limbs, and Babinski's sign is positive on both sides. Sensation is normal. Which of the following is most likely to occur in this patient?

Question: 医師の指示があっても採血できない職種はどれか。
Question_EN: Which occupation cannot draw blood even under a doctor's orders?

Question: 腹部骨盤部の触診で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding abdominal-pelvic palpation?

Question: 2 歳児のけいれんの原因で最も頻度が高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: What is the most common cause of seizures in a 2-year-old child?

Question: 腹膜炎の所見でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not a finding of peritonitis?

Question: 静脈留置針による末梢静脈路の確保手技で誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect regarding the procedure for establishing a peripheral venous access using a venous catheter?

Question: インシデントレポートで正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding incident reports?

Question: 膝関節MRI のT2 強調像で筋肉より高信号になるのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following will have a higher signal intensity than muscle on a T2-weighted MRI of the knee joint?

Question: 正常の頸部診察で触知が困難な組織はどれか。
Question_EN: Which tissues are difficult to palpate during a normal cervical examination?

Question: ランダム化比較試験〈RCT〉で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is true about randomized controlled trials (RCTs)?

Question: リハビリテーションで誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is false regarding rehabilitation?

Question: 臨床研究における患者・市民参画で誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is incorrect regarding patient and public participation in clinical research?

Question: Which of the following clinical conditions occurs in patients acutely after severe burns?
Question_EN: Which of the following clinical conditions occurs in patients acutely after severe burns?

Question: 飲酒がリスクファクターとならないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Alcohol consumption is not a risk factor for which?

Question: 高齢者のポリファーマシーの原因で誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not a cause of polypharmacy in the elderly?

Question: 体液量に占める細胞外液量の割合が最も高いのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following has the highest percentage of extracellular fluid in total body fluid volume?

Question: 診断の除外に有用なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following would be useful in ruling out a diagnosis?

Question: 解釈モデルを知るための質問で適切でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is not an appropriate question to ask about an interpretation model?

Question: 妄想はどれか。
Question_EN: Which is a delusion?

Question: 術前診察時の患者情報と周術期のリスクとの組合せで誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following combinations of patient information at the preoperative examination and perioperative risks is incorrect?

Question: 身体診察所見と病態・疾患の組合せで正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is the correct combination of physical examination findings and pathological condition/disease?

Question: 医療事故調査制度で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is correct regarding the medical accident investigation system?

Question: 社交〈社会〉不安障害の訴えで特徴的なのはどれか。
Question_EN: Which of the following is characteristic of social anxiety disorder?

Question: 16 歳未満を対象にした臨床研究を行う。対象者の理解力に合わせて説明し、研究への賛意を得るのはどれか。
Question_EN: A clinical study is being conducted on subjects under the age of 16. Which of the following would be explained to the subjects in a way that is appropriate for their level of understanding, and would enable them to consent to the study?

Question: 54 歳の女性。糖尿病の定期診察で受診している。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。専業主婦。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。51 歳で閉経。家族歴に特記すべきことはない。身長158 cm、体重80 kg。BMI 31.3。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧126/78 mmHg。呼吸数18/分。身体所見に異常を認めない。空腹時血糖は180～220 mg/dL、HbA1c は8 ～10 %（基準4.9～6.0）で推移しており、改善傾向はない。体重は2 年間で5 kg 増加した。外来担当医は血糖降下薬を推奨したが、患者は毎回「次回までに体重を必ず減らせるから、薬は始めたくない」と断っている。ただし、通院を継続する意思はある。この患者への声かけで適切でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 54-year-old woman is undergoing a regular checkup for diabetes. There is nothing of note in her medical history. She is a full-time housewife. She has no history of smoking. She drinks alcohol occasionally. She entered menopause at age 51. There is nothing of note in her family history. Height 158 ​​cm, weight 80 kg. BMI 31.3. Body temperature 36.2°C. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 126/78 mmHg. Respiratory rate 18 breaths per minute. No abnormalities were found in the physical examination. Her fasting blood glucose level is 180-220 mg/dL, and her HbA1c level is 8-10% (standard 4.9-6.0), and there is no sign of improvement. She has gained 5 kg in the past 2 years. The outpatient doctor has recommended hypoglycemic drugs, but the patient has refused each time, saying, "I don't want to start taking medication because I'm sure I'll lose weight by the next visit." However, she is willing to continue visiting the hospital. Which of the following statements to make to this patient would be inappropriate?

Question: 72 歳の男性。不眠を主訴に来院した。1 年前から肺癌の治療を受けている。6か月前に腰椎転移を指摘され、歩行、階段昇降および重い荷物を持ち上げた時に腰痛を自覚した。1 か月前から立作業の時にも時々軽い腰痛が出現した。1 週間前から痛みのため寝つきが悪くなり、睡眠不足を解消して欲しいと訴えている。まず疼痛緩和の目標とする痛みはどれか。
Question_EN: A 72-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of insomnia. He had been receiving treatment for lung cancer for the past year. Six months ago, he was diagnosed with lumbar metastasis, and noticed lower back pain when walking, climbing stairs, and lifting heavy objects. For the past month, he has occasionally experienced mild lower back pain even while standing. For the past week, he has had trouble falling asleep due to pain, and he wishes to have his lack of sleep alleviated. First, which type of pain is the goal of pain relief?

Question: 75 歳の女性。1 か月前に骨転移を伴う進行肺小細胞癌と診断された。薬物による抗癌治療などの積極的な治療は実施せず、家で穏やかに過ごしたいという本人の希望で在宅療養している。患者は月に2 回の訪問診療を受け、癌性疼痛緩和目的で数種類の内服薬を服用している。独居だが自宅では自立的な生活を維持している。本日、担当医が定期の訪問診療に訪れたところ患者から「市販のサプリメントを服用したい」と強い申し出があった。対応で誤っているのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 75-year-old woman was diagnosed with advanced small cell lung cancer with bone metastasis one month ago. She has not been receiving any aggressive treatment such as anti-cancer drug therapy, and is undergoing home care at her own request to spend her time peacefully at home. The patient receives home visits twice a month and takes several types of oral medication to relieve cancer pain. She lives alone but is able to maintain an independent lifestyle at home. Today, when the doctor in charge made a regular home visit, the patient strongly requested that she "take over-the-counter supplements." Which of the following responses is incorrect?

Question: 64 歳の男性。夜間の盗汗、微熱および持続する咳嗽を主訴に来院した。4 年前から関節リウマチで疾患修飾性抗リウマチ薬〈DMARD〉及び生物学的製剤で治療中である。1 か月前から夜間の盗汗、微熱および咳嗽が出現した。症状が持続するため自宅近くの診療所を受診した。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。胸部エックス線写真で右上肺野に空洞陰影を認めた。この患者で空気感染予防策の必要性を判断する検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 64-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of night sweats, slight fever, and persistent cough. He had been suffering from rheumatoid arthritis for the past 4 years and was being treated with disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs) and biological agents. One month ago, he started experiencing night sweats, slight fever, and cough. As these symptoms persisted, he visited a clinic near his home. No abnormalities were found in his heart sounds and respiratory sounds. A chest X-ray revealed a cavity shadow in the right upper lung field. Which test would determine the need for airborne infection precautions in this patient?

Question: 40 歳の男性。職場の健康診断で異常を指摘され来院した。持参した健康診断の結果は、BMI 31、HbA1c 7.0 %（基準4.9～6.0）であった。身長168 cm、体重90 kg。問診の際、最近、父親が糖尿病による末期腎不全で血液透析を受けるようになったこともあり減量したいが、仕事が忙しいので運動する時間がなく、外食が多くなってしまうとの話があった。この患者の行動変容ステージで有効な声がけはどれか。
Question_EN: A 40-year-old man visited the hospital after an abnormality was found during a health check at work. He brought the results of his health check with him: BMI 31, HbA1c 7.0% (normal: 4.9-6.0). Height 168 cm, weight 90 kg. During the interview, he mentioned that his father had recently been undergoing hemodialysis for end-stage renal failure caused by diabetes, and that he wanted to lose weight, but was too busy at work to have time to exercise, so he ended up eating out a lot. Which of the following statements would be effective at this patient's stage of behavioral change?

Question: 1か月の男児。不機嫌と哺乳不良とを主訴に両親に連れられて来院した。昨夜から機嫌が悪く、約50%哺乳量が減少したため夜間救急外来を受診した。周産期に異常はない。意識は清明。①体温37.1℃。②心拍数120/分、整。③血圧80/50 mmHg。④呼吸数36/分。顔色はやや不良。大泉門は平坦。頸部にリンパ節を触知しない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は軟である。⑤毛細血管再充満時間4秒。下線部のうち、迅速な対応を要する所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 1-month-old boy was brought to the hospital by his parents because of irritability and poor feeding. He had been in a bad mood since the previous night, and his feeding volume had decreased by about 50%, so he was seen in the emergency department. There were no abnormalities during the perinatal period. He was conscious and alert. 1) Body temperature 37.1°C. 2) Heart rate 120 beats/min, regular. 3) Blood pressure 80/50 mmHg. 4) Respiratory rate 36 breaths/min. His complexion was slightly poor. The anterior fontanelle was flat. No lymph nodes were palpable in the neck. No abnormalities were noted in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was soft. 5) Capillary refill time was 4 seconds. Which of the underlined findings requires prompt action?

Question: 78歳の女性。軽度の腰痛を主訴に来院した。昨年までは朝と夕とに1日30分程度のウォーキングをしていたが、最近、15分くらいしか歩行できなくなり、自宅でつまずくことが多くなった。膝の痛みはないが、軽度の腰痛があるため受診した。生来健康であり既往歴に特記すべきことはない。喫煙歴はない。飲酒はビール350mL/日を週に3回。身長153cm、体重57kg。BMI 24.4。神経診察で異常を認めない。腰椎エックス線写真で軽度の変形性脊椎症の所見を認めた。この患者に対する指導で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 78-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of mild lower back pain. Until last year, she walked for about 30 minutes a day in the morning and evening, but recently she has been able to walk only for about 15 minutes, and she has been tripping at home more often. She has no knee pain, but visited the hospital because she has mild lower back pain. She has been healthy since birth and has no notable medical history. She has no history of smoking. She drinks 350 mL of beer three times a week. She is 153 cm tall and weighs 57 kg. Her BMI is 24.4. No abnormalities were found in the neurological examination. A lumbar X-ray revealed signs of mild degenerative spondylosis. Which of the following is the most appropriate instruction for this patient?

Question: 74 歳の男性。食物のつかえ感を主訴に来院した。3 か月前から食事中のつかえ感を自覚したが、徐々に増悪し食事摂取が困難になったため受診した。意識は清明。身長170 cm、体重46 kg（3 か月で10 kg 減少）。体温37.0 ℃。脈拍64/分、整。血圧100/56 mmHg。呼吸数14/分。SpO2 96 %（room air）。皮膚は乾燥している。眼瞼結膜に貧血を認める。眼球結膜に黄染を認めない。口腔内は乾燥している。頸部リンパ節を触知しない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。上部消化管内視鏡検査で中部食道に腫瘍があり、内視鏡下生検の病理検査で扁平上皮癌と診断された。経口摂取が困難なため、経管栄養を行うこととした。胃管を鼻翼から55 cm まで挿入し、間欠的な経管栄養を開始した。翌日、経管栄養再開前に胃管が30 cm 抜けていることに看護師が気付き主治医に報告した。経管栄養再開前の対応で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 74-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of a feeling of food being stuck in his throat. He had been aware of this feeling of food being stuck in his throat while eating for the past 3 months, but it gradually worsened and he was unable to eat, so he visited the hospital. He was conscious and alert. Height 170 cm, weight 46 kg (10 kg loss in 3 months). Body temperature 37.0°C. Pulse 64 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 100/56 mmHg. Respiratory rate 14 beats/min. SpO2 96% (room air). Skin was dry. Anemia was observed in the palpebral conjunctiva. No yellowing was observed in the bulbar conjunctiva. The oral cavity was dry. No cervical lymph nodes were palpable. No abnormalities were observed in heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed a tumor in the middle esophagus, and pathological examination of an endoscopic biopsy revealed a diagnosis of squamous cell carcinoma. Because oral intake was difficult, it was decided to administer tube feeding. A gastric tube was inserted 55 cm from the nasal ala, and intermittent tube feeding was initiated. The next day, before tube feeding was resumed, the nurse noticed that the gastric tube had come out 30 cm and reported this to the attending physician. Which of the following actions would be appropriate before tube feeding was resumed?

Question: 38 歳の男性。交通外傷後の右胸部痛と呼吸困難とを主訴に救急車で搬入された。乗用車運転中に中央分離帯に正面衝突し胸部を強打した。意識は清明。体温35.4 ℃。心拍数108/分、整。血圧88/60 mmHg。呼吸数28/分。SpO2 88 %（リザーバー付マスク10 L/分 酸素投与下）。瞳孔径は両側4 mm で対光反射は正常である。発声は可能で口腔内分泌物はない。毛細血管再充満時間3 秒である。皮膚には冷汗と湿潤を認める。頸静脈の怒張がみられる。右胸部は視診で胸郭膨隆、触診で皮下気腫、打診で鼓音および聴診で呼吸音減弱を認める。心音に異常を認めない。直ちに行うべき治療はどれか。
Question_EN: A 38-year-old man was brought in by ambulance complaining of right chest pain and difficulty breathing after a traffic accident. While driving, he collided head-on with a median strip and suffered a strong blow to his chest. He was conscious and alert. Body temperature 35.4°C. Heart rate 108 beats/min, normal. Blood pressure 88/60 mmHg. Respiratory rate 28 beats/min. SpO2 88% (oxygen administered via a reservoir mask at 10 L/min). Pupil diameter was 4 mm on both sides, and light reflex was normal. He was able to speak, and there was no oral secretion. Capillary refill time was 3 seconds. There was cold sweat and moisture on the skin. The jugular vein was distended. Inspection of the right chest revealed thoracic distention, palpation revealed subcutaneous emphysema, tympanitic sounds on percussion, and decreased respiratory sounds on auscultation. No abnormalities were noted in the heart sounds. Which treatment should be performed immediately?

Question: 32 歳の女性。頸部リンパ節腫大を主訴に来院した。3 週間前から左頸部の腫れに気付いていた。その後、右頸部も腫れてきたので受診した。発熱、体重減少および盗汗はない。生来健康。ペット飼育歴とアレルギー歴はない。夫は3 か月前、陰茎に無痛性潰瘍があり治療歴がある。意識は清明。身長168 cm、体重61 kg。体温36.7 ℃。脈拍78/分、整。血圧106/68 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 100 %（room air）。手掌と足底にびまん性の一部癒合した径3 mm の紅斑・丘疹を認める。口腔内には潰瘍性病変を認めない。咽頭は発赤を認めない。左頸部に径5 cm の可動性があり、柔軟なリンパ節を1 個触知する。右頸部にも同様に径3 cm のリンパ節腫大を1 個触知する。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部に肝・脾を触知しない。最も適切な治療薬はどれか。
Question_EN: A 32-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of enlarged cervical lymph nodes. She had noticed swelling in the left side of her neck 3 weeks prior. She subsequently visited the hospital because the right side of her neck had also begun to swell. She had no fever, weight loss, or night sweats. She had been in good health since birth. She had no history of keeping pets or allergies. Her husband had a painless ulcer on his penis 3 months prior, which had been treated. She was conscious and alert. Height 168 cm, weight 61 kg. Body temperature 36.7°C. Pulse 78 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 106/68 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16 breaths/min. SpO2 100% (room air). There was diffuse, partially fused erythema and papules measuring 3 mm in diameter on the palms and soles. No ulcerative lesions were found in the oral cavity. There was no redness in the pharynx. One mobile, flexible lymph node measuring 5 cm in diameter was palpable in the left neck. Similarly, one enlarged lymph node measuring 3 cm in diameter is palpable in the right neck. No abnormalities are noted in the heart and respiratory sounds. The liver and spleen are not palpable in the abdomen. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

Question: 72 歳の女性。脳梗塞で入院治療し、リハビリテーション後に自宅退院して3 か月が経過した。現在は①マンションに一人暮らしをしている。右上下肢に軽度の運動麻痺が残存し、②長距離を歩くことができない。入院前は③おしゃべり好きで俳句教室に通うのが趣味であったが、俳句教室の入口の④階段を昇ることができないため最近は通っていない。退院してから⑤家に閉じこもりがちになっている。①〜⑤のうち、国際生活機能分類〈ICF〉の参加制約に分類されるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 72-year-old woman was hospitalized for a cerebral infarction and was discharged home after rehabilitation three months ago. Currently, she ① lives alone in an apartment. She has residual mild motor paralysis in her right upper and lower limbs and ② is unable to walk long distances. Before her hospitalization, she ③ loved to talk and enjoyed attending haiku classes as a hobby, but she has not been attending recently because she is ④ unable to climb the stairs at the entrance to the haiku classes. Since being discharged from the hospital, she ⑤ tends to stay confined to her home. Which of the numbered items is classified as a participation constraint in the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF)?

Question: 25歳の男性。尿量減少を主訴に来院した。1週間前に家族から顔のむくみを指摘された。3日前から尿量が減少したため受診した。生来健康である。身長177cm、体重74kg。脈拍72/分、整。血圧108/64mmHg。両眼瞼に浮腫を認める。胸腹部に異常を認めない。両下腿に圧痕性浮腫を認める。尿所見：蛋白4＋、糖（－）、潜血（－）、蛋白定量1,540mg/dL（基準15～45）、クレアチニン定量70mg/dL、Na 15mEq/L。血液所見：赤血球632万、Hb 19.1g/dL、Ht 55%。血液生化学所見：総蛋白3.6g/dL、アルブミン1.2g/dL、尿素窒素40mg/dL、クレアチニン1.9mg/dL、尿酸7.6mg/dL、総コレステロール521mg/dL、Na 131mEq/L、K 4.7mEq/L、Cl 100mEq/L。次に行うべき検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 25-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of decreased urinary output. A week earlier, a family member had pointed out facial swelling. He visited the hospital because his urinary output had decreased three days earlier. He had been in good health since birth. Height 177 cm, weight 74 kg. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 108/64 mmHg. Edema was noted in both eyelids. No abnormalities were noted in the chest or abdomen. Pitting edema was noted in both lower legs. Urine findings: protein 4+, sugar (-), occult blood (-), quantitative protein 1,540 mg/dL (normal range 15-45), quantitative creatinine 70 mg/dL, sodium 15 mEq/L. Blood findings: red blood cells 6.32 million, hemoglobin 19.1 g/dL, hematocrit 55%. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 3.6g/dL, albumin 1.2g/dL, urea nitrogen 40mg/dL, creatinine 1.9mg/dL, uric acid 7.6mg/dL, total cholesterol 521mg/dL, sodium 131mEq/L, potassium 4.7mEq/L, and chloride 100mEq/L. Which test should be performed next?

Question: 38 歳の初産婦（1 妊0 産）。妊娠32 週に上腹部痛のため来院した。来院前日から頭痛、眼のちかちかする感じ（眼華閃発）、心窩部不快感、手指のこわばり、全身の浮腫および尿量減少を自覚し、本日は上腹部から右季肋部にかけての疼痛、倦怠感および悪心を訴えている。脈拍84/分、整。血圧156/102 mmHg。胎児心拍数陣痛図では異常を認めない。この患者で低下していることが予測されるものはどれか。
Question_EN: A 38-year-old primipara (gravida 1, parity 0). She visited the hospital at 32 weeks pregnant because of upper abdominal pain. Since the day before visiting, she had been aware of headaches, tingling eyes (eye flashes), epigastric discomfort, stiff fingers, generalized edema, and decreased urinary output, and today she is complaining of pain from the upper abdomen to the right hypochondrium, fatigue, and nausea. Pulse rate 84 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 156/102 mmHg. No abnormalities were found on the fetal heart rate-tocogram. Which of the following would be predicted to be decreased in this patient?

血液生化学所見:総蛋白 7.0 g/dL、アルブミン3.4 g/dL、総ビリルビン 3.7 mg/dL、AST 74 U/L、ALT 52 U/L、γ-GT 63 U/L(基準 9 ~32)、コリンエステラーゼ 150 U/L(基準 201~421)、アンモニア 180 μg/dL(基準 18~48)、尿素窒素 12 mg/dL、クレアチニン 0.6 mg/dL、血糖 148 mg/dL、HbA1c 7.6 %(基準 4.9~6.0)、Na 142 mEq/L、K 3.8 mEq/L、Ca 8.8 mg/dL。
頭部単純 CT で異常を認めない。この患者にみられる神経所見はどれか。
Question_EN:
A 65-year-old woman was brought in by ambulance due to abnormal behavior.
History of current illness: She had been constipated for one week. A few days ago, when she returned home from shopping, she threw her purchases in the trash and scattered her money around. Since this morning, she has been absent-minded and unresponsive to calls, so her husband called an ambulance.
Past medical history: She has been visiting a clinic near her home for type 2 diabetes and fatty liver, and is taking a DPP-4 inhibitor.
Family history: Nothing of note.
Life history: No history of smoking or drinking.
Current symptoms: She is drowsy, but opens her eyes when called and can talk. Height 154 cm, weight 72 kg. BMI 30.4. Temperature 36.4 °C. Heart rate 80/min, regular. Blood pressure 104/64 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16/min. SpO2 98 % (room air). Yellow staining of the bulbar conjunctiva was observed. Goiter and cervical lymph nodes were not palpable. Spider vascular dilation and palmar erythema were observed on the precordium. No abnormalities were observed in the heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver was not palpable. The spleen was palpable 1 cm below the left costal arch. No edema was observed in the lower legs.

Laboratory findings: Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.96 million, Hb 12.1 g/dL, white blood cells 3,800, platelets 100,000, PT-INR 1.0 (normal 0.9-1.1).
Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.0 g/dL, albumin 3.4 g/dL, total bilirubin 3.7 mg/dL, AST 74 U/L, ALT 52 U/L, γ-GT 63 U/L (standard 9-32), cholinesterase 150 U/L (standard 201-421), ammonia 180 μg/dL (standard 18-48), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL, blood glucose 148 mg/dL, HbA1c 7.6% (standard 4.9-6.0), Na 142 mEq/L, K 3.8 mEq/L, Ca 8.8 mg/dL.
No abnormalities were found on plain head CT. Which neurological findings would be seen in this patient?

Question:
70 歳の男性。自転車で転倒したため救急車で搬入された。
現病歴：自転車で走行中に転倒し、右側頭部を打撲した。ヘルメットは装着していなかった。通行人が119 番に通報し、救急車を要請した。救急隊接触時の意識レベルはGCS14（E3V5M6）であった。
既往歴：58 歳から高血圧症で降圧薬を服用中である。生活歴：喫煙歴はなく、飲酒は機会飲酒。妻と2 人暮らし。
家族歴：父親は80 歳時に急性心筋梗塞で死亡。母親は95 歳で生来健康。
現症：受傷30 分後、搬入時の意識レベルはGCS8（E2V2M4）。身長163 cm、体重60 kg。体温36.7 ℃。心拍数80/分、整。血圧148/92 mmHg。呼吸数22/分。SpO2 93 %（リザーバー付マスク10 L/分 酸素投与下）。心音に異常を認めない。呼吸音に左右差を認めないが、舌根が沈下し、いびき様の呼吸をしている。瞳孔は右4 mm、左3 mm、対光反射は右側で遅延している。右側頭部と右手背部に擦過傷を認める。外見上、他に目立った外傷は認めないが、左不全片麻痺を認める。
検査所見：迅速簡易超音波検査〈FAST〉では異常を認めない。
優先すべき対応で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 70-year-old man was brought in by ambulance after falling off his bicycle.
History of current illness: He fell off his bicycle and sustained a bruise on the right side of his temple. He was not wearing a helmet. A passerby called 119 and requested an ambulance. His level of consciousness when the ambulance team contacted him was GCS14 (E3V5M6).
Past medical history: He has been taking antihypertensive medication since the age of 58 for hypertension. Lifestyle history: He has never smoked, and drinks alcohol occasionally. He lives with his wife.
Family history: His father died of acute myocardial infarction at the age of 80. His mother was 95 years old and healthy from birth.
Current illness: 30 minutes after injury, his level of consciousness when he was brought in was GCS8 (E2V2M4). Height 163 cm, weight 60 kg. Body temperature 36.7°C. Heart rate 80/min, normal. Blood pressure 148/92 mmHg. Respiratory rate 22/min. SpO2 93% (oxygen administered at 10 L/min via a mask with a reservoir). No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds. There was no difference between the left and right respiratory sounds, but the base of the tongue was depressed and the patient was snoring. The pupils were 4 mm on the right and 3 mm on the left, and the light reflex was delayed on the right side. There were abrasions on the right temporal region and back of the right hand. No other noticeable external injuries were found, but left hemiparesis was present.
Examination findings: A rapid simple ultrasound test (FAST) revealed no abnormalities.
Which of the following is the appropriate priority action?

Question:
36 歳の男性。胸部異常陰影を指摘され来院した。
現病歴 : 職場の健康診断で胸部異常陰影を指摘され、精査目的で受診した。咳と血痰の自覚はない。
既往歴 : 特記すべきことはない。
生活歴 : 喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。健康な妻と 2 歳の息子との 3 人暮らし。
家族歴 : 父親が 60 歳時に肺癌の手術を受けた。
現 症 : 意識は清明。身長 176 cm、体重 68 kg。体温 36.8 °C。脈拍 68/分、整。血圧 126/68 mmHg。呼吸数 16/分。SpO2 97 %(room air)。頭頸部、胸腹部および四肢に異常を認めない。
検査所見 : 血液所見:赤血球 468 万、Hb 14.2 g/dL、Ht 45 %、白血球 7,200、血小板 26 万。血液生化学所見:AST 26 U/L、ALT 18 U/L、LD 136 U/L(基準124~222)、尿素窒素 12 mg/dL、クレアチニン 0.5 mg/dL、CEA 36 ng/mL(基準5 以下)、SCC 0.8 ng/mL(基準 1.5 以下)。CRP 0.02 mg/dL。胸部エックス線写真で左上肺野の結節影、胸部 CT で左肺上葉の結節影および縦隔リンパ節の腫大を認める。
左肺腺癌と診断され、 2 週間後から根治的化学放射線療法が予定されている。職業は会社員で癌の診断後は休職している。
研修医と指導医の会話を示す。
研修医 : 「この患者さんは、治療中に仕事ができず、収入がなくなることを心
配しています。治療費が支払えないのではないかと言っています」
指導医 : 「社会保障制度があるから、本人に情報提供したらどうかな」
研修医 : 「①介護保険、②生活保護、③高額療養費制度、④指定難病医療費助成制度、⑤ひとり親家庭等医療費助成制度を考えたのですが、いかがでしょうか」
①〜⑤のうち、この患者に情報提供する制度で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN:
A 36-year-old man visited the hospital after an abnormal shadow was noted on his chest.
History of current illness: An abnormal shadow was noted on his chest during a workplace health check, and he visited for further examination. He was not aware of any cough or bloody sputum.
Past medical history: Nothing of note.
Lifestyle history: No history of smoking. Drinks alcohol occasionally. Lives with a healthy wife and 2-year-old son.
Family history: His father underwent surgery for lung cancer at age 60.
Current symptoms: Conscious and alert. Height 176 cm, weight 68 kg. Body temperature 36.8 °C. Pulse 68 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 126/68 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16 beats per minute. SpO2 97 % (room air). No abnormalities were noted in the head, neck, chest, abdomen, or limbs.
Laboratory findings: Blood findings: Red blood cells 4.68 million, Hb 14.2 g/dL, Ht 45%, White blood cells 7,200, Platelets 260,000. Blood biochemistry findings: AST 26 U/L, ALT 18 U/L, LD 136 U/L (standard 124-222), Urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, Creatinine 0.5 mg/dL, CEA 36 ng/mL (standard 5 or less), SCC 0.8 ng/mL (standard 1.5 or less). CRP 0.02 mg/dL. Chest X-ray showed a nodular shadow in the upper left lung field, and chest CT showed a nodular shadow in the upper left lung lobe and enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes.
Diagnosed with left lung adenocarcinoma, definitive chemoradiotherapy is scheduled to begin in 2 weeks. He is an office worker and has been on leave since his cancer diagnosis.

A conversation between a trainee and a supervising doctor is shown.

Trainer: "This patient is worried that he will not be able to work during treatment and will lose his income. He says he is worried he will not be able to pay the medical expenses."

Supervising doctor: "There are social security systems, so why not provide the patient with information?"

Trainer: "I was thinking about ① nursing care insurance, ② welfare assistance, ③ high-cost medical care system, ④ designated intractable disease medical expense subsidy system, and ⑤ medical expense subsidy system for single-parent families, etc. What do you think?"

Which of the numbered parts is the most appropriate system for providing information to this patient?

現病歴：約1 週間前から食事摂取が減少し一日中ベッドに横になっていることが多くなった。昨日から食事摂取が困難となったため、夫が救急車を要請した。
既往歴：約25 年前に高血圧症、約2 年前にAlzheimer 型認知症および骨粗鬆症と診断された。3 か月前に左大腿骨転子下骨折に対して手術が行われた。アンジオテンシン受容体拮抗薬〈ARB〉、カルシウム拮抗薬、活性型ビタミンD 製剤およびコリンエステラーゼ阻害薬を服用している。
生活歴：夫と2 人暮らし。喫煙歴はない。飲酒は機会飲酒。
家族歴：父が脳梗塞、母が脳出血。
現症：意識レベルはJCSⅡ-10。身長151 cm、体重46 kg。体温36.4 ℃。心拍数100/分、整。血圧108/78 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 95 %（room air）。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。四肢に異常を認めない。
検査所見：尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖（－）、潜血（－）。血液所見：赤血球320 万、Hb 10.1 g/dL、Ht 30 %、白血球7,200、血小板23 万。
血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.1 g/dL、アルブミン3.6 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.6 mg/dL、AST 23 U/L、ALT 12 U/L、LD 184 U/L（基準値124～222）、尿素窒素41 mg/dL、クレアチニン1.0 mg/dL、血糖110 mg/dL、Na 146 mEq/L、K 3.8 mEq/L、Cl 103 mEq/L、Ca 13.6 mg/dL。CRP 0.2 mg/dL。頭部単純CT で異常を認めなかった。
この患者に認められる可能性が高い所見はどれか。

A 78-year-old woman was brought in by ambulance due to loss of appetite.
History of current illness: Her food intake has decreased for about a week, and she has often been lying in bed all day. Since yesterday, she has had difficulty eating, so her husband called for an ambulance.
Past medical history: She was diagnosed with hypertension about 25 years ago, and Alzheimer's dementia and osteoporosis about 2 years ago. She underwent surgery for a subtrochanteric fracture of the left femur 3 months ago. She is taking angiotensin receptor blockers (ARBs), calcium antagonists, active vitamin D preparations, and cholinesterase inhibitors.
Life history: She lives with her husband. She has never smoked. She drinks alcohol occasionally.
Family history: Her father has had cerebral infarction, and her mother has had cerebral hemorrhage.
Current illness: Her level of consciousness is JCS II-10. She is 151 cm tall and weighs 46 kg. Her body temperature is 36.4°C. Her heart rate is 100 beats per minute, and her blood pressure is 108/78 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16/min. SpO2 95% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the palpebral or bulbar conjunctiva. No abnormalities were found in the heart or respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. No abnormalities were found in the limbs.
Test findings: Urine findings: Protein (-), sugar (-), occult blood (-). Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.2 million, Hb 10.1 g/dL, Ht 30%, white blood cells 7,200, platelets 230,000.
Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 7.1 g/dL, albumin 3.6 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL, AST 23 U/L, ALT 12 U/L, LD 184 U/L (normal range 124-222), urea nitrogen 41 mg/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, blood glucose 110 mg/dL, Na 146 mEq/L, K 3.8 mEq/L, Cl 103 mEq/L, Ca 13.6 mg/dL. CRP 0.2 mg/dL. No abnormalities were found on plain head CT.
Which finding is most likely to be seen in this patient?

Today, while commuting to work by train at around 8:00 a.m., he suddenly experienced severe pain from the left lower abdomen to the flank, and visited the hospital. He experienced nausea and vomiting on the way to the hospital. He was conscious and clear-headed. Body temperature 36.3°C. Pulse rate 80 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 158/94 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20 breaths/min. His face was pale and he was sweating cold. There was no rebound tenderness in the abdomen. There was percussion tenderness in the left costovertebral angle.
