There is a marked coldness in the extremities. The affected area is widespread, and there are many injured people who were trapped under buildings. Which color triage tag would be appropriate for this patient?

Question: 56 歳の男性。海外で多発している感染症X に罹患していることを心配し検査目的で来院した。感染症X が多発している国に半年間滞在し2 週間前に帰国した。これまで特段の症状はないという。感染症X の国外の発生動向および診断と治療に関する情報を入手したい。入手先として適切なホームページを運営しているのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 56-year-old man is concerned that he may have been infected with Infectious Disease X, which is prevalent overseas, and visits the hospital for testing. He stayed in a country where Infectious Disease X is prevalent for six months and returned to Japan two weeks ago. He says that he has not had any particular symptoms so far. He would like to obtain information on the trends of Infectious Disease X overseas as well as diagnosis and treatment. Which website operates an appropriate source of information?

Question: 14 歳の女子。るいそう及び無月経のため入院中である。小学校の成績は良好であったが、教師と友人との人間関係に悩んでいた。中学校入学後、友人に体重増加を指摘されてから食事摂取を減らすようになった。その後、食事制限に加えて屋内でも多くの時間を立位で過ごしていた。5 か月前から続発性無月経となり、1 か月前から倦怠感を強く自覚するようになった。自己誘発性の嘔吐や下剤の乱用はない。入院後も食事摂取量は少なく、「太りたくない」と訴える。身長148 cm、体重28 kg。この患者で認められる所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 14-year-old girl is hospitalized due to emaciation and amenorrhea. She had good grades in elementary school, but was troubled by her relationships with teachers and friends. After entering junior high school, she began to reduce her food intake after a friend pointed out her weight gain. After that, in addition to restricting her diet, she spent a lot of time standing indoors. She developed secondary amenorrhea five months ago, and one month ago she began to feel very fatigued. She has not self-induced vomiting or abused laxatives. Even after being hospitalized, she has been eating little and complains that she "doesn't want to gain weight." She is 148 cm tall and weighs 28 kg. Which of the following findings is observed in this patient?

Question: 36 歳の初産婦（1 妊0 産）。妊娠31 週5 日、下腹部痛と性器出血のため救急車で搬入された。これまでの妊娠経過に異常はなかった。自宅で突然強い下腹部痛と性器出血を訴え、意識は清明だがぐったりしているため、家族が救急車を要請した。31 歳時に腹腔鏡下子宮筋腫核出術を受けている。身長162 cm、体重64 kg。意識レベルはJCSⅠ-1。体温35.1 ℃。心拍数116/分、整。血圧76/54 mmHg。呼吸数28/分。SpO2 98 %（リザーバー付マスク10 L/分 酸素投与下）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は膨満している。静脈路の確保を行った。直ちに行う検査で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 36-year-old primipara (gravida 1, parity 0). At 31 weeks and 5 days pregnant, she was brought in by ambulance due to lower abdominal pain and genital bleeding. There had been no abnormalities in her pregnancy up to that point. At home, she suddenly complained of severe lower abdominal pain and genital bleeding, and although conscious, she was listless, so her family called for an ambulance. At the age of 31, she underwent laparoscopic myomectomy. She was 162 cm tall and weighed 64 kg. Her level of consciousness was JCS I-1. Her body temperature was 35.1°C. Her heart rate was 116 beats per minute, and she was in a normal state. Her blood pressure was 76/54 mmHg. Her respiratory rate was 28 beats per minute. SpO2 was 98% (oxygen was administered via a reservoir mask at 10 L/min). No abnormalities were noted in her heart sounds or respiratory sounds. Her abdomen was distended. An intravenous line was established. Which of the following tests would be appropriate to be performed immediately?

Question: 10 歳の男児。発熱および頭痛を主訴に両親に連れられて来院した。今朝から関節痛と悪寒とを自覚した。午後から頭痛および倦怠感が出現し、体温が39 ℃台であったため受診した。関節痛および頭痛は持続している。意識は清明。身長158 cm、体重48 kg。体温39.2 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧128/74 mmHg。呼吸数22/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。項部硬直を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。インフルエンザウイルス迅速抗原検査は陽性であった。患者と家族への説明で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 10-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his parents complaining of fever and headache. He had been experiencing joint pain and chills since this morning. He developed a headache and fatigue in the afternoon, and his temperature was in the 39°C range, so he visited the hospital. The joint pain and headache continue. He is conscious and alert. Height 158 ​​cm, weight 48 kg. Temperature 39.2°C. Pulse 96 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 128/74 mmHg. Respiratory rate 22 breaths/min. SpO2 98% (room air). No neck stiffness. No abnormalities were noted in heart sounds or respiratory sounds. A rapid influenza virus antigen test was positive. Which of the following is the most appropriate explanation for the patient and his family?

Question: 38 歳の初妊婦（1 妊0 産）。妊娠34 週、妊婦健康診査のため来院した。妊娠32 週までは特に異常を指摘されていない。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。体温 36.9 ℃。脈拍80/分、整。血圧152/100 mmHg。腹部は軟で子宮に圧痛を認めない。両下肢に浮腫を認める。尿所見：尿蛋白は3 ＋。尿蛋白/Cr 比は2.4 g/gCr。血液所見：Hb 11.0 g/dL、血小板18 万。血液生化学所見：AST 15 U/L、ALT 10 U/L、LD 180 U/L（基準124～222）。胎児心拍数陣痛図で、胎児はreassuring で子宮収縮は認めない。推定胎児体重は、1730 g（－1.5 SD）、臍帯血流に異常を認めない。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: A 38-year-old primigravida (1st pregnancy, 0 parity). She was 34 weeks pregnant and visited the hospital for a prenatal checkup. No abnormalities had been noted up until the 32nd week of pregnancy. There was nothing notable in her medical history. Body temperature 36.9°C. Pulse 80 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 152/100 mmHg. The abdomen was soft and there was no tenderness in the uterus. Edema was present in both lower limbs. Urine findings: urinary protein 3+. Urinary protein/Cr ratio was 2.4 g/gCr. Blood findings: Hb 11.0 g/dL, platelets 180,000. Blood biochemistry findings: AST 15 U/L, ALT 10 U/L, LD 180 U/L (normal: 124-222). A fetal cardiotocography showed that the fetus was reassuring and no uterine contractions were observed. The estimated fetal weight was 1730 g (-1.5 SD), and no abnormalities were noted in umbilical blood flow. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 43 歳の男性。いびきを主訴に来院した。2 年前から睡眠時のいびきが大きく、時々息が止まると家族に指摘されている。日中の眠気を感じている。身長172 cm、体重95 kg。血圧152/110 mmHg。咽頭の視診で軟口蓋しか観察できなかった。診断に最も有用な検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 43-year-old man visits the hospital complaining of snoring. His family has pointed out that he has been snoring loudly and occasionally stops breathing during sleep for the past two years. He feels sleepy during the day. His height is 172 cm, his weight is 95 kg, and his blood pressure is 152/110 mmHg. Inspection of the pharynx reveals only the soft palate. Which test would be most useful for making a diagnosis?

Question: 76 歳の男性。右胸痛を主訴に来院した。1 か月前から右前胸部痛を自覚し、8日前から右顔面および右上肢の腫脹を伴うようになった。意識は清明。身長159 cm、体重52 kg。体温35.9 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧138/78 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 95 %（room air）。視診と触診とで右胸部から頸部および上肢にかけて浮腫と腫脹とを認める。血液生化学所見：CEA 75 ng/mL（基準5 以下）。胸部エックス線写真で右上肺野縦隔側に腫瘤を認めた。胸腹部造影CT で腫瘍による上大静脈の圧排、肝転移と左副腎転移を認めた。肺癌と診断され、右上肺野縦隔側腫瘤への放射線治療を行うこととした。この患者に対する放射線治療で期待される効果はどれか。
Question_EN: A 76-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of right chest pain. He had been aware of right anterior chest pain for one month, and swelling of the right face and right upper extremity for the past eight days. He was conscious and alert. Height 159 cm, weight 52 kg. Body temperature 35.9°C. Pulse 96/min, regular. Blood pressure 138/78 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20/min. SpO2 95% (room air). Visual and palpable examination revealed edema and swelling from the right chest to the neck and upper extremities. Blood biochemistry findings: CEA 75 ng/mL (standard 5 or less). A chest X-ray revealed a mass in the right upper lung field on the mediastinal side. A chest and abdominal contrast CT scan revealed compression of the superior vena cava by the tumor, as well as liver and left adrenal metastases. He was diagnosed with lung cancer, and radiation therapy was decided to be performed on the right upper lung field on the mediastinal side of the mass. What effect would be expected from radiation therapy for this patient?

Question: 53 歳の男性。住宅ユニット製造工場の従事者。6 か月前に脳血管疾患に罹患した。退院後の外来リハビリテーションを終えて片麻痺の後遺症がある状態で、職場復帰について検討することになった。職場復帰するために産業医が考慮すべきことはどれか。
Question_EN: A 53-year-old man works at a housing unit manufacturing plant. He suffered from cerebrovascular disease 6 months ago. After completing outpatient rehabilitation after being discharged from the hospital, he is now considering returning to work, despite suffering from aftereffects of hemiplegia. What should the industrial physician consider in order for him to return to work?
ensemble_occupation: 住宅ユニット製造工場の従事者

Question: 48歳の男性。高血糖を主訴に来院した。事務職であり毎年会社の健診を受けてきたが、異常を指摘されたことはなかった。今年の健診で初めて高血糖を指摘された。意識は清明。身長170 cm、体重76 kg。脈拍64/分、整。血圧134/86 mmHg。皮膚に異常を認めない。頭頸部と胸腹部とに異常を認めない。四肢に浮腫を認めない。尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖（－）、ケトン体（－）。血液生化学所見：AST 28 U/L、ALT 42 U/L、空腹時血糖128 mg/dL、HbA1c 6.7 %（基準4.9～6.0）、総コレステロール280 mg/dL、トリグリセリド220 mg/dL、HDL コレステロール34 mg/dL、尿素窒素18 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、Na 138 mEq/L、K 4.6 mEq/L、Cl 98 mEq/L。この患者の病態の評価に有用な検査値はどれか。
Question_EN: A 48-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of hyperglycemia. He works in an office and has had a company health check every year, but no abnormalities have been noted. This year's health check was the first time that hyperglycemia was noted. He is conscious and alert. Height 170 cm, weight 76 kg. Pulse 64 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 134/86 mmHg. No abnormalities were noted on the skin. No abnormalities were noted in the head, neck, chest, or abdomen. No edema was noted in the limbs. Urine findings: protein (-), sugar (-), ketone bodies (-). Blood biochemistry findings: AST 28 U/L, ALT 42 U/L, fasting blood glucose 128 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.7% (normal 4.9-6.0), total cholesterol 280 mg/dL, triglycerides 220 mg/dL, HDL cholesterol 34 mg/dL, urea nitrogen 18 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, Na 138 mEq/L, K 4.6 mEq/L, Cl 98 mEq/L. Which test values ​​would be useful in assessing this patient's condition?

Question: 11 歳の男児。学校に行けないことを主訴に父親に連れられて来院した。乳幼児期の発達は順調だった。就学時から文字を書くことが苦手だったが、ひらがなとカタカナは書けており、成績も中等度を保っていた。小学3 年生から漢字の書き取りのミスが目立つようになり、何度学習しても習得できなかった。黒板を書き写すのに時間がかかるため、最近は授業についていけなくなり、次第に登校できない日が増えている。友人関係におけるトラブルはない。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: An 11-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his father because he was unable to go to school. His development as an infant was normal. He had difficulty writing since he started school, but he could write hiragana and katakana, and his grades were average. From the third grade of elementary school, he began making noticeable mistakes when writing kanji, and no matter how many times he studied, he was unable to learn. Because it takes a long time for him to copy what is written on the blackboard, he has recently been unable to keep up with his classes, and he is gradually missing more and more days of school. There are no problems with his friendships. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 56 歳の男性。高血圧症と糖尿病で治療中である。1 年前に職場で管理職に昇進しストレスを感じるようになった。徐々に飲酒量と喫煙量が増え、体重が増加している。家庭血圧は収縮期血圧140 mmHg 程度で推移している。インフルエンザワクチンの接種を予定している。喫煙は30 本/日、飲酒は日本酒2 合/日。身長168 cm、体重86 kg。尿所見：尿蛋白2 ＋、糖＋。血液生化学所見：HbA1c 7.8 %（基準4.9～6.0）、eGFR 40 mL/分/1.73 m2。この患者で三次予防とならないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 56-year-old man is being treated for hypertension and diabetes. He was promoted to a managerial position at work one year ago and has begun to feel stressed. His alcohol and smoking habits have gradually increased, and his weight is increasing. His home blood pressure has remained at around 140 mmHg systolic. He is scheduled to receive an influenza vaccine. He smokes 30 cigarettes per day and drinks 2 cups of sake per day. He is 168 cm tall and weighs 86 kg. Urine findings: urinary protein 2+, sugar +. Blood biochemistry findings: HbA1c 7.8% (normal 4.9-6.0), eGFR 40 mL/min/1.73 m2. Which of the following would not be an appropriate tertiary prevention measure for this patient?

Question: 職員500 人の工場内でX 工程に従事している職員の間で肝血管肉腫が多発しているという報告を産業医が受けた。10 年前の工場開設以来、職員の異動はなく同じ職場に継続して勤務している。直ちに全職員の肝血管肉腫検診を行うとともに人事記録を基に（A）X 工程に配置されていた職員50 人と（B）X 工程に配置されたことがない職員450 人の2 グループを特定し、過去の健康診断結果および医療機関受診状況を確認した。（A）Xグループで6 人が肝血管肉腫に罹患していたのに対し、（B）X グループで1 名が罹患していたことが明らかとなった。実施した調査の研究デザインはどれか。
Question_EN: An industrial physician received a report that there was a high incidence of hepatic angiosarcoma among employees working in process X at a factory with 500 employees. Since the factory opened 10 years ago, the employees have continued to work in the same workplace without any transfers. All employees were immediately screened for hepatic angiosarcoma, and based on personnel records, two groups were identified: 50 employees who had been assigned to process X (group A) and 450 employees who had not been assigned to process X (group B). Past health checkup results and medical examination history were confirmed. It was revealed that 6 employees in group A had hepatic angiosarcoma, while 1 employee in group B had the disease. What was the research design of the survey conducted?

Question: 40 歳の女性。帯下の増加を主訴に来院した。月経周期は30 日型、整、持続5 日間。1 か月前から新しいパートナーと2 人暮らし。身長160 cm、体重60 kg。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。内診で子宮は正常大、両側付属器に異常を認めない。腟鏡診で黄色泡沫状の帯下と腟壁の発赤とを認める。診断に有用な検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 40-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of increased vaginal discharge. Her menstrual cycle is 30 days, regular, and lasts for 5 days. She has been living with a new partner for the past month. Her height is 160 cm, her weight is 60 kg, her body temperature is 36.2°C, and her pulse rate is 72 beats per minute and regular. A pelvic examination reveals a normal uterus and no abnormalities in the adnexa on either side. A speculum examination reveals yellow, frothy vaginal discharge and redness of the vaginal wall. Which of the following tests would be useful in making a diagnosis?

Question: 34 歳の経産婦（2 妊1 産）。妊娠41 週2 日、破水感を主訴に来院した。妊娠初期から妊婦健康診査を受けていたが、特に異常は指摘されていなかった。妊娠41 週2 日、午前7 時に破水感を自覚したため午前8 時に来院した。子宮収縮の自覚はなかった。腟鏡診にて少量の羊水の流出を認めた。内診で子宮口は3 cm 開大、展退度は60 %、硬度は中等度、児頭下降度はSP －2 cm であった。入院管理とし、①午後2 時、8 分ごとの規則的な子宮収縮が開始した。②午後7 時、子宮口は10 cm 開大、展退度は100 %。その後、③児頭は顔面を母体腹壁側へ向けるように回旋した。3 回の怒責で児頭が娩出し、④続いて母体腹壁側の肩甲が、その後母体背中側の肩甲が娩出した。⑤児娩出9 分後に胎盤が娩出された。①から⑤のうち異常な分娩経過はどれか。
Question_EN: A 34-year-old multiparous woman (2 gravidas, 1 parity) visited the hospital at 41 weeks and 2 days pregnant complaining of a sensation of rupture of membranes. She had been undergoing prenatal checkups since early pregnancy, but no abnormalities were found. At 41 weeks and 2 days pregnant, she felt a sensation of rupture of membranes at 7:00 a.m. and visited the hospital at 8:00 a.m. She was not aware of uterine contractions. A speculum examination revealed a small amount of amniotic fluid leaking out. An internal examination revealed that the cervix was 3 cm dilated, 60% effacement, moderate hardness, and fetal head descent SP -2 cm. The patient was admitted to the hospital, and ① at 2:00 p.m., regular uterine contractions began every 8 minutes. ② at 7:00 p.m., the cervix was 10 cm dilated, and 100% effacement. After that, ③ the fetal head rotated so that its face was facing the maternal abdominal wall. The fetal head was delivered after three pushes, ④ followed by the scapula on the maternal abdominal wall, and then the scapula on the maternal dorsal side. ⑤ The placenta was delivered 9 minutes after the baby was delivered. Which of the numbered items is an abnormal birth process?

Question: 近隣住民から水道水の臭いについて保健所に相談があった。①水道水の検査結果を調査したところ臭いに関する項目は基準値内であった。この水道の水源である②河川の検査では、生物化学的酸素要求量〈BOD〉値が高値であった。その河川の上流には食品工場がある。①、②の検査基準の組合せで正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A local resident contacted the health center about the smell of the tap water. ① When the results of tests on the tap water were investigated, the odor-related items were found to be within the standard values. Tests on ② the river that is the source of this tap water showed a high biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) value. There is a food factory upstream of that river. Which of the combinations of test standards for the parts ① and ② is correct?

Question: 昨日午後にかかりつけの医療機関を定期受診した大腸癌終末期の患者が、今朝自宅で心肺停止状態となった。かかりつけの医療機関に搬送されて死亡確認が行われ、直接死因は大腸癌の進行と考えられた。家族が患者の解剖を希望した場合、適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A patient with terminal colon cancer who had a regular visit to his/her regular medical institution yesterday afternoon went into cardiac arrest at home this morning. The patient was transported to his/her regular medical institution, where death was confirmed, and the direct cause of death was thought to be the progression of colon cancer. If the family requests an autopsy, what is the appropriate response?

Question:
78 歳の男性。嗄声を主訴に来院した。
現病歴：1 か月前に嗄声が出現した。2 週間前から飲水時に咳嗽が出現するようになり自宅近くの診療所で鎮咳薬を処方された。咳嗽は改善せず、3 日前から喀痰に血液が混じるようになった。
既往歴：3 年前に原発性肺癌のために右肺下葉切除術が施行され経過観察となっていた。1 年前から自己判断で定期的な受診を中断していた。
生活歴：65 歳までは会社員。妻と2 人暮らし。喫煙は70 歳まで20 本/日を50年間。飲酒はビール350 mL/日。
家族歴：弟が70 歳台で胃癌。
現症：意識は清明。身長162 cm、体重54 kg。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧124/72 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。頸静脈の怒張は認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。
検査所見：尿所見：蛋白（－）、糖（－）、潜血（－）。血液所見：赤血球380 万、Hb 13.8 g/dL、Ht 35 %、白血球7,600、血小板24 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.0 g/dL、アルブミン3.0 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.7 mg/dL、AST 25 U/L、ALT 19 U/L、LD 343 U/L（基準124～222）、尿素窒素24 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL。胸部エックス線写真で右第1 弓の突出を認める。胸部造影CT で縦隔リンパ節腫大を認めた。腹部造影CT と骨シンチグラフィで異常を認めなかった。腫大した縦隔リンパ節に対して超音波内視鏡下に穿刺生検を施行し、肺腺癌術後のリンパ節再発と診断された。
次に行うべき検査はどれか。
Question_EN:
A 78-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of hoarseness.
History of current illness: Hoarseness developed 1 month ago. Two weeks ago, he began coughing when drinking water, and was prescribed a cough suppressant at a clinic near his home. The cough did not improve, and blood began to be mixed in his sputum 3 days ago.
Past medical history: Three years ago, he underwent right lower lobectomy for primary lung cancer and was placed under observation. One year ago, he stopped regular medical examinations of his own accord.
Life history: Worked as an office worker until age 65. Lived with his wife. Smoked 20 cigarettes per day for 50 years until age 70. Alcohol consumption: 350 mL of beer per day.
Family history: A younger brother had stomach cancer in his 70s.

Question: ウイルス発見以後、アフリカ各地で流行が繰り返されてきた。感染者の体液に触れるとウイルスが傷口や粘膜から体内に入り感染する。発熱、倦怠感、頭痛、筋肉痛と咽頭痛などに続いて嘔吐や下痢が出現する。病状回復後も精液内にウイルスが残存することがある。過去の流行における平均の致死率は約50%である。このウイルスはどれか。
Question_EN: Since the discovery of the virus, epidemics have occurred repeatedly in various parts of Africa. When a person comes into contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person, the virus enters the body through wounds or mucous membranes and causes infection. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, and sore throat, followed by vomiting and diarrhea. The virus may remain in semen even after recovery. The average fatality rate in past epidemics has been around 50%. Which virus is this?
ensemble_pain_type: 頭痛; 筋肉痛; 咽頭痛

Question: 32 歳の女性（0 妊0 産）。無月経を主訴に来院した。初経は13 歳。月経周期は順調であったが、29 歳から月経不順があり、31 歳から無月経となり産婦人科を受診した。6 か月前から頭痛を自覚し、2 か月前から頭痛の頻度と強さが増加した。身長165 cm、体重55 kg。体温36.3 ℃。脈拍64/分、整。血圧120/67 mmHg。呼吸数18/分。乳房は発達している。外性器は女性型で、陰毛・腋毛を認める。血液所見：赤血球350 万、Hb 12.1 g/dL、Ht 33 %、白血球3,700、血小板31 万。血液生化学所見：TSH 2.3 μU/mL（基準0.2～4.0）、プロラクチン125 ng/mL（基準15 以下）、hCG＜0.5 IU/L（基準1.0 以下）。経腟超音波検査で子宮の大きさは正常だが子宮内膜は薄い。卵巣は正常大で、内部に小卵胞を認める。次に行うべき画像検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 32-year-old woman (0 pregnancy, 0 births) visited the hospital complaining of amenorrhea. Her first menstruation was at age 13. Her menstrual cycle was regular, but she had irregular menstruation from age 29, and amenorrhea from age 31 led to her visiting an obstetrician-gynecologist. She had been noticing headaches for 6 months, and the frequency and intensity of her headaches had increased for the past 2 months. Height 165 cm, weight 55 kg. Body temperature 36.3°C. Pulse 64/min, regular. Blood pressure 120/67 mmHg. Respiratory rate 18/min. Breasts are well developed. External genitalia are female, with pubic and axillary hair. Blood findings: red blood cells 3.5 million, hemoglobin 12.1 g/dL, hematocrit 33%, white blood cells 3,700, platelets 310,000. Blood biochemistry findings: TSH 2.3 μU/mL (normal: 0.2-4.0), prolactin 125 ng/mL (normal: 15 or less), hCG < 0.5 IU/L (normal: 1.0 or less). Transvaginal ultrasound reveals that the uterus is normal in size, but the endometrium is thin. The ovaries are normal in size, and small follicles are found inside. Which imaging test should be performed next?

Question: 73 歳の女性。筋力低下と嚥下困難を主訴に来院した。2 か月前から階段昇降が困難になり、1 か月前から布団の上げ下ろしができなくなった。2 週間前から上眼瞼の浮腫および全身の紅斑が出現し、7 日前からむせのため食事摂取が困難になったため受診した。意識は清明。身長154 cm、体重40 kg。体温37.5 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧134/70 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 97 %（room air）。上眼瞼に淡い浮腫性紅斑および両手指の関節背面に紅色丘疹を認める。両耳介、前頸部、背部、上肢伸側および臀部外側に紅斑を認める。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。表在リンパ節腫大を認めない。四肢近位筋に対称性筋力低下を認める。四肢に感覚異常を認めない。尿所見に異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球372 万、Hb 11.3 g/dL、Ht 33 %、白血球5,900（好中球75 %、好酸球1 %、単球12 %、リンパ球12 %）、血小板26 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白5.6 g/dL、アルブミン3.0 g/dL、AST 108 U/L、ALT 79 U/L、LD 628 U/L（基準124～222）、γ-GT 30 U/L（基準9 ～32）、CK 1,620 U/L（基準41～153）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.4 mg/dL、血糖111 mg/dL、TSH 3.8 μU/mL（基準0.2～4.0）、FT3 2.7 pg/mL（基準2.3～4.3）、FT4 1.1 ng/dL（基準0.8～2.2）。免疫血清学所見：CRP 0.8 mg/dL、抗TIF1-γ 抗体陽性。胸部エックス線写真に異常を認めない。この患者で最も注意すべき合併症はどれか。
Question_EN: A 73-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of muscle weakness and dysphagia. She had difficulty ascending and descending stairs 2 months ago, and had been unable to lift or lower her futon 1 month ago. She had developed edema of the upper eyelids and erythema all over her body 2 weeks ago, and had difficulty eating due to choking 7 days ago, so she visited the hospital. She was conscious and alert. Height 154 cm, weight 40 kg. Body temperature 37.5°C. Pulse 96 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 134/70 mmHg. Respiratory rate 16 beats/min. SpO2 97% (room air). There was faint edematous erythema on the upper eyelids and red papules on the dorsal surface of the finger joints of both hands. Erythema was present on both ears, anterior neck, back, extensor sides of upper limbs, and lateral buttocks. Heart sounds and respiratory sounds were normal. There was no superficial lymphadenopathy. There was symmetric muscle weakness in the proximal muscles of the limbs. No abnormal sensation was observed in the limbs. No abnormalities were observed in the urine. Blood findings: Red blood cells 3.72 million, Hb 11.3 g/dL, Ht 33%, white blood cells 5,900 (neutrophils 75%, eosinophils 1%, monocytes 12%, lymphocytes 12%), platelets 260,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 5.6 g/dL, albumin 3.0 g/dL, AST 108 U/L, ALT 79 U/L, LD 628 U/L (standard 124-222), γ-GT 30 U/L (standard 9-32), CK 1,620 U/L (standard 41-153), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.4 mg/dL, blood glucose 111 mg/dL, TSH 3.8 μU/mL (standard 0.2-4.0), FT3 2.7 pg/mL (standard 2.3-4.3), FT4 1.1 ng/dL (standard 0.8-2.2). Immunoserological findings: CRP 0.8 mg/dL, anti-TIF1-γ antibody positive. No abnormalities were found on the chest X-ray. Which complication should be of most concern in this patient?

Question: 80 歳の女性。脳梗塞後、誤嚥性肺炎で入院となった。抗菌薬を7 日間投与した。肺炎は軽快傾向にあるが、1 日10 回以上の水様性下痢が出現した。意識は清明。身長154 cm、体重43 kg。体温37.3 ℃。脈拍72/分、整。血圧136/80 mmHg。呼吸数 18/分。SpO2 97 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦で、下腹部に軽い圧痛あり。血液所見：赤血球380 万、Hb 11.0 g/dL、白血球10,100、血小板21 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.3 g/dL、アルブミン3.9 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.8 mg/dL、AST 30 U/L、ALT 35 U/L、LD 140 U/L（基準124～222）、γ-GT 30 U/L（基準9 ～32）、アミラーゼ100 U/L（基準44～132）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.8 mg/dL、血糖98 mg/dL。CRP 1.2 mg/dL。腹部エックス線写真で異常を認めない。この時点で実施すべき検査はどれか。
Question_EN: An 80-year-old woman was admitted with aspiration pneumonia after cerebral infarction. Antibiotics were administered for 7 days. The pneumonia is improving, but she has watery diarrhea more than 10 times a day. She is conscious and alert. Height 154 cm, weight 43 kg. Body temperature 37.3°C. Pulse 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 136/80 mmHg. Respiratory rate 18 beats per minute. SpO2 97% (room air). No abnormalities were observed in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat, with mild tenderness in the lower abdomen. Blood findings: red blood cells 3.8 million, hemoglobin 11.0 g/dL, white blood cells 10,100, platelets 210,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 7.3 g/dL, albumin 3.9 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 30 U/L, ALT 35 U/L, LD 140 U/L (standard 124-222), γ-GT 30 U/L (standard 9-32), amylase 100 U/L (standard 44-132), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, blood glucose 98 mg/dL. CRP 1.2 mg/dL. No abnormalities were found on the abdominal X-ray. Which test should be performed at this point?

Question: 65 歳の男性。健康診査の腹部超音波検査で異常を指摘され来院した。2 年前の健康診査で肝機能異常を指摘されていたが、自覚症状はないため検査は受けていない。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。自営業。喫煙歴は20 本/日を20 年間。飲酒はビール350 mL/週を45 年間。母親が肝癌で死亡。身長170 cm、体重70 kg。脈拍96/分、整。血圧144/90 mmHg。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は右季肋下に肝を2 cm 触知する。血液生化学所見：総ビリルビン0.8 mg/dL、AST 90 U/L、ALT 85 U/L、γ-GT 60 U/L（基準13～64）、空腹時血糖98 mg/dL、HbA1c 5.6 %（基準4.9～6.0）、トリグリセリド160 mg/dL、HDL コレステロール36 mg/dL、α-フェトプロテイン〈AFP〉160,000 ng/mL（基準20 以下）。免疫血清学所見：HBs 抗原陰性、①HCV 抗体陽性。②ICG 試験（15 分値）8 %（基準10 以下）。胸腹部造影CT で肝右葉前区域に③肝内転移1 個を伴う④径5 cm の肝細胞癌を認め、⑤両側肺への転移を認めた。この患者で肝細胞癌切除手術を適応外と判断する根拠はどれか。
Question_EN: A 65-year-old man visited the hospital after an abdominal ultrasound scan revealed abnormalities during a health check. A health check 2 years ago had revealed abnormal liver function, but he had no symptoms and therefore had not undergone testing. There was nothing notable in his medical history. He is self-employed. He has a smoking history of 20 cigarettes per day for 20 years. He drinks 350 mL of beer per week for 45 years. His mother died of liver cancer. His height is 170 cm, his weight is 70 kg. His pulse is 96 beats per minute and is regular. His blood pressure is 144/90 mmHg. No abnormalities were noted in his heart sounds or respiratory sounds. The liver was palpable 2 cm below the right hypochondrium in the abdomen. Blood biochemistry findings: total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 90 U/L, ALT 85 U/L, γ-GT 60 U/L (standard: 13-64), fasting blood glucose 98 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.6% (standard: 4.9-6.0), triglyceride 160 mg/dL, HDL cholesterol 36 mg/dL, α-fetoprotein (AFP) 160,000 ng/mL (standard: 20 or less). Immunoserological findings: HBs antigen negative, ①HCV antibody positive. ②ICG test (15-minute value) 8% (standard: 10 or less). Chest and abdominal contrast CT revealed hepatocellular carcinoma ④5 cm in diameter in the anterior segment of the right hepatic lobe, ③with one intrahepatic metastasis, and ⑤metastasis to both lungs. On what basis would it be determined that surgery to remove hepatocellular carcinoma is not appropriate for this patient?

Question: 25 歳の男性。左頰部の痛みと鼻汁を主訴に来院した。5 日前から感冒症状があっ た。3 日前に左頰部の痛みを自覚し左鼻腔から膿性鼻汁が出現した。左頰部の痛み が増強したため来院した。体温37.2 ℃。頰部の皮膚に発赤および腫脹を認めな い。鼻鏡検査で左鼻腔内に膿性鼻汁を認めた。 診断はどれか。
Question_EN: A 25-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of pain in the left cheek and nasal discharge. He had cold symptoms for the past 5 days. Three days ago, he noticed pain in the left cheek and had purulent nasal discharge from the left nasal cavity. He visited the hospital because the pain in the left cheek had worsened. His body temperature was 37.2°C. There was no redness or swelling in the skin of the cheek. Rhinoscopy revealed purulent nasal discharge in the left nasal cavity. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 30 歳の女性。食後の胃もたれを主訴に来院した。高校生の頃から食後の胃もたれを自覚するようになった。大学受験や就職直後に症状が増強することがあった。3 か月前から週3 回と頻度が増えたため受診した。体重減少や発熱はない。既往歴や家族歴に特記すべきことはない。身長160 cm、体重56 kg。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍64/分、整。血圧120/70 mmHg。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、圧痛を認めない。血液所見：赤血球468 万、Hb 13.9 g/dL、Ht 42 %、白血球5,300、血小板21 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.8 g/dL、アルブミン4.3 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.9 mg/dL、AST 22 U/L、ALT 16 U/L、LD 180 U/L（基準124～222）、ALP 80 U/L（基準38～113）、γ-GT 21 U/L（基準9 ～32）、アミラーゼ92 U/L（基準44～132）、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.6 mg/dL。CRP 0.1 mg/dL。尿素呼気試験は陰性。上部消化管内視鏡検査では異常を認めない。 この患者に対する治療で用いられないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 30-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of a heavy feeling in her stomach after meals. She had been aware of this feeling since she was in high school. The symptoms would sometimes worsen immediately after taking university entrance exams or starting work. She visited the hospital because the frequency of her symptoms had increased to three times a week three months ago. She had not lost weight or had a fever. There was nothing notable about her medical history or family history. Height 160 cm, weight 56 ​​kg. Body temperature 36.2°C. Pulse 64 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 120/70 mmHg. No abnormalities were noted in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctivae. No abnormalities were noted in the heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat, soft, and not tender. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.68 million, hemoglobin 13.9 g/dL, hematocrit 42%, white blood cells 5,300, platelets 210,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.8 g/dL, albumin 4.3 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL, AST 22 U/L, ALT 16 U/L, LD 180 U/L (standard 124-222), ALP 80 U/L (standard 38-113), γ-GT 21 U/L (standard 9-32), amylase 92 U/L (standard 44-132), urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.6 mg/dL. CRP 0.1 mg/dL. Urea breath test was negative. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy showed no abnormalities. Which of the following would not be used in the treatment of this patient?

Question: 23歳の男性。職場に行けないことを主訴に来院した。2か月前に商品発注のミスで取引先の会社から苦情を受け上司からも強く叱責された。その後、気分が晴れず、仕事に前向きになれない。夜は仕事のことが頭から離れず寝つきが悪くなったが、休日には趣味のサークル活動を以前と変わらず楽しめていた。1週間前から、朝会社に行こうとすると動悸がするようになり休んでいる。既往歴と家族歴に特記すべきことはない。受診後、自宅療養することとなり動悸は軽快した。また、会社から上司が叱責したことへの謝罪を受け、取引先を変更してもらったところ、3か月後から復職が可能となった。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: A 23-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of being unable to go to work. Two months ago, he received a complaint from a client company for a mistake in ordering goods, and was severely reprimanded by his boss. Since then, he has been in a depressed mood and has been unable to be positive about work. At night, he is unable to stop thinking about work and has trouble falling asleep, but on weekends, he has been able to enjoy his club activities as much as before. For the past week, he has been experiencing palpitations when he tries to go to work in the morning, so he has been taking time off. There is nothing particularly noteworthy about his medical history or family history. After visiting the hospital, he was able to recuperate at home, and his palpitations have subsided. He also received an apology from his boss for the reprimand, and was able to return to work three months later after the company changed clients. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 日齢21 の男児。嘔吐を主訴に両親に連れられて来院した。10 日前から哺乳後の嘔吐が時々あり、2 日前から哺乳のたびに噴水状嘔吐をした。活気は不良である。体重3,550 g（日齢9 では3,450 g）。体温36.7 ℃。心拍数128/分、整。血圧90/52 mmHg。呼吸数28/分。皮膚のツルゴールは低下している。大泉門はやや陥凹。胸部に異常を認めない。上腹部に径2 cm の腫瘤を触知する。四肢末梢に軽度冷感を認める。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.8 g/dL、アルブミン4.0 g/dL、AST 20 U/L、ALT 10 U/L、尿素窒素12 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.2 mg/dL、血糖80 mg/dL、Na 135 mEq/L、K 4.0 mEq/L、Cl 90 mEq/L。静脈血ガス分析（room air）：pH 7.53、PCO2 45 Torr、HCO3－30 mEq/L。適切な初期輸液の組成はどれか。
Question_EN: A 21-day-old male infant was brought to the hospital by his parents because of vomiting. Ten days previously, he had been vomiting occasionally after feeding, and two days previously, he had been vomiting fountain-like after every feeding. His vitality was poor. Weight: 3,550 g (3,450 g at 9 days of age). Body temperature: 36.7°C. Heart rate: 128 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure: 90/52 mmHg. Respiratory rate: 28 breaths/min. Skin turgor was decreased. The anterior fontanelle was slightly depressed. No abnormalities were found in the chest. A mass measuring 2 cm in diameter was palpable in the upper abdomen. There was a slight cold sensation in the peripheral limbs. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.8 g/dL, albumin 4.0 g/dL, AST 20 U/L, ALT 10 U/L, urea nitrogen 12 mg/dL, creatinine 0.2 mg/dL, blood glucose 80 mg/dL, Na 135 mEq/L, K 4.0 mEq/L, Cl 90 mEq/L. Venous blood gas analysis (room air): pH 7.53, PCO2 45 Torr, HCO3 -30 mEq/L. What is the appropriate composition of the initial infusion?

Question: 15 歳の女子。体重減少を心配した母親に伴われて来院した。3 か月前から体重が5 kg 減少した。意識は清明。身長157 cm、体重38 kg。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍120/分、整。血圧126/68 mmHg。呼吸数24/分。SpO2 99 %（room air）。皮膚は湿潤。前頸部の腫脹を認める。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。下腿に浮腫を認めない。軽度の手指振戦を認める。血液所見：赤血球450 万、Hb 12.7 g/dL、Ht 38 %、白血球6,800、血小板26 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.8 g/dL、アルブミン3.6 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.9 mg/dL、AST 26 U/L、ALT 27 U/L、LD 220 U/L（基準124～222）、尿素窒素16 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.4 mg/dL、尿酸4.5 mg/dL、空腹時血糖96 mg/dL、HbA1c 5.0 %（基準4.9～6.0）、総コレステロール122 mg/dL、トリグリセリド140 mg/dL、Na 140 mEq/L、K 4.0 mEq/L、Cl 99 mEq/L。CRP 0.3 mg/dL。診断に必要な検査はどれか。
Question_EN: A 15-year-old girl visited the hospital accompanied by her mother, who was concerned about her weight loss. She had lost 5 kg over the past 3 months. She was conscious and alert. Height 157 cm, weight 38 kg. Body temperature 36.8°C. Pulse 120 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 126/68 mmHg. Respiratory rate 24 beats/min. SpO2 99% (room air). Skin was moist. Swelling of the anterior neck was noted. No abnormalities were noted in heart and respiratory sounds. Abdomen was flat and soft, with the liver and spleen not palpable. No edema was noted in the lower legs. Mild finger tremor was noted. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.5 million, hemoglobin 12.7 g/dL, hematocrit 38%, white blood cells 6,800, platelets 260,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 6.8 g/dL, albumin 3.6 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL, AST 26 U/L, ALT 27 U/L, LD 220 U/L (normal: 124-222), urea nitrogen 16 mg/dL, creatinine 0.4 mg/dL, uric acid 4.5 mg/dL, fasting blood glucose 96 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.0% (normal: 4.9-6.0), total cholesterol 122 mg/dL, triglycerides 140 mg/dL, Na 140 mEq/L, K 4.0 mEq/L, Cl 99 mEq/L. CRP 0.3 mg/dL. Which test is necessary for diagnosis?

Question: 56 歳の女性。腰背部および四肢の痛みを主訴に来院した。5 年前から腰背部および四肢の痛みが出現した。半年前に夫が肺癌で死去。その頃から痛みが悪化し、自宅近くの診療所で処方されたNSAID を内服したが改善しないため受診した。最近、就寝中に下肢の痛がゆい不快な感覚があり動かすと消失する。体重に増減はない。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍80/分、整。血圧120/76 mmHg。手指遠位指節間関節や近位指節間関節に骨棘を触れる。全身の関節に圧痛を認めるが、腫脹を認めない。両側僧帽筋上縁中央部や臀部上外側を含め体幹や四肢の広い範囲で、触診時に顔をしかめるような疼痛反応を認める。脊椎の可動域に異常を認めない。四肢体幹の筋力低下を認めない。四肢に運動感覚障害を認めない。尿所見に異常を認めない。赤沈8 mm/ 1 時間。血液所見：赤血球425 万、Hb 12.8 g/dL、Ht 40 %、白血球4,200、血小板19 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.0 g/dL、AST 21 U/L、ALT 16 U/L、LD 140 U/L（基準124～222）、尿素窒素10 mg/dL、クレアチニン0.4 mg/dL、CK 48 U/L（基準41～153）、TSH 3.5 μU/mL（基準0.2～4.0）、コルチゾール12.4 μg/dL（基準5.2～12.6）。免疫血清学所見：CRP 0.1 mg/dL、リウマトイド因子〈RF〉陰性、抗核抗体陰性。 この患者の全身の疼痛の原因はどれか。
Question_EN: A 56-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of pain in the lower back and limbs. The pain began 5 years ago. Her husband died of lung cancer 6 months ago. Since then, the pain has worsened, and she took NSAIDs prescribed by a clinic near her home, but there was no improvement, so she visited the hospital. Recently, she has felt an itchy and uncomfortable sensation in her lower limbs while sleeping, which disappears when she moves. There has been no change in her weight. Body temperature: 36.2°C. Pulse: 80 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure: 120/76 mmHg. Osteophytes are palpable in the distal interphalangeal joints and proximal interphalangeal joints of the fingers. There is tenderness in the joints of the entire body, but no swelling. There is a pain response of grimacing when palpated over a wide area of ​​the trunk and limbs, including the central upper border of the trapezius muscles on both sides and the upper lateral sides of the buttocks. There is no abnormality in the range of motion of the spine. There is no muscle weakness in the limbs and trunk. No motor sensory disturbance was observed in the limbs. No abnormalities were observed in the urine. Erythrocyte sedimentation rate was 8 mm/1 hour. Blood findings: RBC 4.25 million, Hb 12.8 g/dL, Ht 40%, WBC 4,200, platelets 190,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Total protein 7.0 g/dL, AST 21 U/L, ALT 16 U/L, LD 140 U/L (standard 124-222), urea nitrogen 10 mg/dL, creatinine 0.4 mg/dL, CK 48 U/L (standard 41-153), TSH 3.5 μU/mL (standard 0.2-4.0), cortisol 12.4 μg/dL (standard 5.2-12.6). Immunoserological findings: CRP 0.1 mg/dL, rheumatoid factor (RF) negative, antinuclear antibody negative. What is the cause of this patient's generalized pain?

Question: 3 歳の男児。テーブルに置かれていた加熱式たばこのスティックを食べたため救急車で搬入された。発見時に母親が口腔内のたばこ葉を吐き出させ、救急車内で2回嘔吐した。泣いているが、意識は清明。体温36.9 ℃。心拍数110/分、整。血圧100/64 mmHg。呼吸数30/分。適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 3-year-old boy was brought in by ambulance after eating a heated tobacco stick that had been placed on a table. When he was discovered, his mother made him spit out the tobacco leaves in his mouth, and he vomited twice in the ambulance. He was crying, but was fully conscious. Body temperature 36.9°C. Heart rate 110 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 100/64 mmHg. Respiratory rate 30 breaths/min. What is the appropriate response?

Question: 74 歳の女性。蛋白尿を指摘されて来院した。昨年の特定健康診査で蛋白尿を指摘されたが、症状がなかったのでそのままにしていた。今年の特定健康診査でも蛋白尿を指摘されて受診した。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。体調不良はなく就業しており、自宅で時々測定している血圧は120/70 mmHg 前後である。体重は増減なく安定しているが、両下腿にごく軽度の圧痕性浮腫を認める。尿所見：比重1.015、pH 6.0、蛋白3 ＋、糖（－）、潜血（－）、随時尿の尿蛋白/クレアチニン比は2.5 g/gCr（基準0.15 未満）。尿沈渣に赤血球1 ～4 /HPF、白血球1 ～4 /HPF、硝子円柱1 ～4 /HPF、顆粒円柱と幅広円柱を少数認める。血液生化学所見：クレアチニン0.7 mg/dL、eGFR 61.6 mL/分/1.73 m2。腹部超音波検査では腎臓に異常を認めない。最も考えられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 74-year-old woman was diagnosed with proteinuria and visited the hospital. Proteinuria was also diagnosed during last year's specific health check, but as she had no symptoms she left it untreated. This year's specific health check also diagnosed proteinuria and she visited the hospital. There is nothing notable about her medical history. She is in good health and is employed, and her blood pressure, which she measures at home from time to time, is around 120/70 mmHg. Her weight is stable with no change, but there is very slight pitting edema in both lower legs. Urine findings: specific gravity 1.015, pH 6.0, protein 3+, sugar (-), occult blood (-), spot urine protein/creatinine ratio 2.5 g/gCr (normal: less than 0.15). Urinary sediment showed 1-4 red blood cells/HPF, 1-4 white blood cells/HPF, 1-4 hyaline casts/HPF, and a small number of granular casts and broad casts. Blood biochemistry findings: Creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, eGFR 61.6 mL/min/1.73 m2. Abdominal ultrasound showed no abnormalities in the kidneys. Which of the following is most likely?

Question: 3 歳の男児。呼吸困難を主訴に母親に連れられて来院した。1 週間前から夜間の咳嗽が出現し、昨夜から呼吸困難が出現したため救急外来を受診した。意識は清明。身長92 cm、体重13 kg。体温37.2 ℃。座位で脈拍120/分、整。血圧110/78 mmHg。呼吸数36/分。SpO2 96 %（room air）。両側鎖骨上窩に径2 cm の腫瘤を触知する。心音は異常なく、胸部にstridor を聴取する。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。血液所見：赤血球450 万、Hb 12.1 g/dL、Ht 38 %、白血球20,000（芽球14 %、好中球27 %、好酸球3 %、単球6 %、リンパ球50 %）、血小板35 万。胸部エックス線写真で縦隔に大きな腫瘤陰影を認める。仰臥位で呼吸困難とチアノーゼが急速に出現し、SpO2 は74 % に低下した。座位に戻しマスク10 L/分の酸素投与でSpO2 は98 % に改善し、呼吸困難は軽減した。適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 3-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his mother complaining of dyspnea. He had been coughing at night for the past week, and dyspnea began last night, so he visited the emergency room. He was conscious and alert. Height 92 cm, weight 13 kg. Body temperature 37.2°C. Pulse rate 120 beats/min in sitting position, regular. Blood pressure 110/78 mmHg. Respiratory rate 36 beats/min. SpO2 96% (room air). Two 2 cm diameter masses were palpable in the supraclavicular fossae on both sides. Heart sounds were normal, and a stridor was heard in the chest. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. Blood findings: RBC 4.5 million, Hb 12.1 g/dL, Ht 38%, WBC 20,000 (blasts 14%, neutrophils 27%, eosinophils 3%, monocytes 6%, lymphocytes 50%), platelets 350,000. Chest X-ray shows a large mass shadow in the mediastinum. With the patient in the supine position, dyspnea and cyanosis rapidly developed, and SpO2 dropped to 74%. After returning the patient to a sitting position and administering oxygen via mask at 10 L/min, SpO2 improved to 98% and dyspnea was alleviated. Which is the appropriate response?

Question: 69 歳の女性。不随意運動を主訴に来院した。15 年前に右手の振戦が出現し、動作が遅くなったため受診したところ、Parkinson病と診断された。抗Parkinson 病薬を内服し、症状は改善した。5 年前から歩行困難が出現した。1 年前から抗Parkinson病薬の効果が持続しなくなり、時間により歩行不能が出現するようになった。抗Parkinson病薬を増量したところ、体幹や上下肢を不規則に繰り返し動かす不随意運動が出現し、座位も保てなくなった。下線部の不随意運動はどれか。
Question_EN: A 69-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of involuntary movements. 15 years ago, she developed a tremor in her right hand and movements became slower, so she visited the hospital and was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. She took anti-Parkinson's medication and her symptoms improved. Five years ago, she began to have difficulty walking. One year ago, the effects of the anti-Parkinson's medication began to wear off, and she began to be unable to walk over time. When the dosage of the anti-Parkinson's medication was increased, she began to experience involuntary movements involving repeated irregular movements of the trunk and upper and lower limbs, and she was no longer able to sit up. Which involuntary movement is underlined?

Question: 65 歳の男性。定期受診で来院した。自宅近くの診療所を糖尿病と高血圧症で通院し、ビグアナイド薬、DPP-4 阻害薬およびアンジオテンシン受容体拮抗薬が処方されている。自覚症状はない。喫煙歴と飲酒歴はない。運動に毎日7,000 歩を歩いている。身長164 cm、体重60 kg。脈拍72/分、整。血圧118/72 mmHg。家庭血圧120 台/70 台。胸部と腹部とに異常を認めない。アキレス腱反射は両側で消失している。尿所見：蛋白3 ＋、潜血（－）、沈渣に赤血球1 ～2 /HPF、白血球0 ～1 /HPF、円柱はない。随時尿の尿蛋白500 mg/dL、尿クレアチニン250 mg/dL。血液所見：赤血球300 万、Hb 10.0 g/dL、Ht 33 %、白血球6,200、血小板31 万。血液生化学所見：尿素窒素25 mg/dL、クレアチニン1.2 mg/dL、eGFR 48.0 mL/分/1.73 m2、尿酸6.0 mg/dL、血糖120 mg/dL、HbA1c 7.2 %（基準4.9～6.0）、Na 142 mEq/L、K 5.0 mEq/L、Cl 108 mEq/L。この患者の腎機能低下を抑制するために追加する薬剤はどれか。
Question_EN: A 65-year-old man visited our hospital for a routine check-up. He was visiting a clinic near his home for diabetes and hypertension, and was prescribed a biguanide drug, a DPP-4 inhibitor, and an angiotensin receptor blocker. He had no subjective symptoms. He had no history of smoking or drinking alcohol. He exercised by walking 7,000 steps per day. His height was 164 cm and his weight was 60 kg. His pulse rate was 72 beats per minute and was regular. His blood pressure was 118/72 mmHg. His home blood pressure was 120s/70s. No abnormalities were found in his chest or abdomen. His Achilles reflex was absent on both sides. Urine findings: protein 3+, occult blood (-), 1-2 red blood cells/HPF, 0-1 white blood cell/HPF in the sediment, and no casts. Random urine protein was 500 mg/dL, and urine creatinine was 250 mg/dL. Blood findings: RBC 3 million, Hb 10.0 g/dL, Ht 33%, WBC 6,200, platelets 310,000. Blood biochemistry findings: Urea nitrogen 25 mg/dL, creatinine 1.2 mg/dL, eGFR 48.0 mL/min/1.73 m2, uric acid 6.0 mg/dL, blood glucose 120 mg/dL, HbA1c 7.2% (normal 4.9-6.0), Na 142 mEq/L, K 5.0 mEq/L, Cl 108 mEq/L. Which drug should be added to prevent the decline in renal function in this patient?

Question: 3 歳の女児。3 歳児健康診査で初めて心雑音を指摘され、両親に連れられて来院した。保育園での生活に支障はないという。既往歴と家族歴に特記すべきことはない。心音はⅡ音の固定性分裂を認める。胸骨左縁第2 肋間を最強点とするLevine 2/6 の収縮期雑音と胸骨左縁下部を中心にLevine 2/6 の拡張期雑音とを聴取する。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝を触知しない。心エコー検査では直径12 mm 程度の心房中隔欠損症を認め、右心房と右心室の拡大を伴う。肺高血圧症を示唆する所見はない。心房中隔欠損症に関する両親への説明で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 3-year-old girl was brought to the hospital by her parents after a heart murmur was first detected during a 3-year-old health check. There is no disruption to her life at nursery school. There is nothing notable in her medical or family history. Heart sounds show a fixed split second heart sound. A Levine 2/6 systolic murmur is heard, with the strongest point at the second intercostal space on the left sternal border, and a Levine 2/6 diastolic murmur is heard, mainly at the lower left sternal border. The abdomen is flat and soft, and the liver cannot be palpated. Echocardiography shows an atrial septal defect measuring approximately 12 mm in diameter, with enlargement of the right atrium and right ventricle. There are no findings suggestive of pulmonary hypertension. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation for the parents regarding atrial septal defect?

Question:
30 歳の女性。夜間の息苦しさを主訴に来院した。生来健康であったが、半年前から夜中に息苦しさのため目覚めるようになった。咳、痰も半年前から毎日ある。喫煙歴はない。1 年前からネコを飼っている。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。胸部エックス線写真で異常を認めない。β2 受容体刺激薬吸入前後の呼吸機能検査の結果を表に示す。
＜吸入前＞%VC （%）：104、FEV1 （L）： 2.12、FEV1 % （%）：68
＜吸入後＞%VC （%）：114、FEV1 （L）： 2.66、FEV1 % （%）：72
診断はどれか。
Question_EN:
A 30-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of nighttime breathlessness. She had been healthy until birth, but began waking up in the middle of the night due to breathlessness six months ago. She has also been coughing and producing phlegm every day for the past six months. She has never smoked. She has kept a cat for one year. No abnormalities were found in her heart sounds or respiratory sounds. No abnormalities were found in her chest X-ray. The results of the respiratory function test before and after inhalation of a β2 receptor agonist are shown in the table below.
<Before inhalation> %VC (%): 104, FEV1 (L): 2.12, FEV1 % (%): 68
<After inhalation> %VC (%): 114, FEV1 (L): 2.66, FEV1 % (%): 72
What is the diagnosis?

Question: 19 歳の男性。白血球増多の精査を目的に来院した。1 週間前に発熱と咽頭痛が出現し自宅近くの診療所を受診した際、白血球増多を指摘されたため紹介受診した。体温37.8 ℃。脈拍92/分、整。血圧118/76 mmHg。眼瞼結膜と眼球結膜とに異常を認めない。両側扁桃の発赤と腫大があり、表面に白苔を認める。両側頸部に径2 cm の圧痛を伴うリンパ節を複数触知する。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肋骨弓下に肝を2 cm 触知する。脾は触知しない。血液所見：赤血球493 万、Hb 14.3 g/dL、Ht 44 %、白血球26,000（桿状核好中球1 %、分葉核好中球7 %、好酸球0 %、好塩基球0 %、単球2 %、リンパ球75 %、異型リンパ球15 %）、血小板18 万。血液生化学所見：総ビリルビン1.3 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン0.7 mg/dL、AST 202 U/L、ALT 268 U/L、LD 637 U/L（基準124～222）、ALP 306 U/L（基準38～113）、クレアチニン0.9 mg/dL、尿酸7.1 mg/dL。CRP 0.9 mg/dL。この患者への対応で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 19-year-old male visited our hospital for a detailed examination of leukocytosis. He had developed fever and sore throat 1 week earlier and had visited a clinic near his home where leukocytosis was diagnosed and he was referred to our hospital. Body temperature 37.8°C. Pulse 92 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure 118/76 mmHg. No abnormalities were found in the palpebral and bulbar conjunctivae. Both tonsils were red and swollen, with white fur on their surfaces. Multiple tender lymph nodes measuring 2 cm in diameter were palpable in both necks. No abnormalities were found in heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver was palpable 2 cm below the costal arch. The spleen was not palpable. Blood findings: RBC 4.93 million, Hb 14.3 g/dL, Ht 44%, WBC 26,000 (band neutrophils 1%, segmented neutrophils 7%, eosinophils 0%, basophils 0%, monocytes 2%, lymphocytes 75%, atypical lymphocytes 15%), platelets 180,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total bilirubin 1.3 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 0.7 mg/dL, AST 202 U/L, ALT 268 U/L, LD 637 U/L (normal: 124-222), ALP 306 U/L (normal: 38-113), creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, uric acid 7.1 mg/dL. CRP 0.9 mg/dL. Which of the following is the appropriate treatment for this patient?

Question: 78 歳の男性。入院中に肺炎を発症し喀痰検査を施行したところ多剤耐性緑膿菌を検出した。感染予防策で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 78-year-old man developed pneumonia during hospitalization, and a sputum test revealed multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Which of the following infection prevention measures is appropriate?

Question: 63 歳の男性。下痢を主訴に来院した。50 歳時から飲酒後に上腹部痛と背部痛を繰り返すため自宅近くの診療所に通院し、禁酒指導を受けていた。55 歳から通院を中断していた。半年前から1 日8 回の下痢が持続するため8 年ぶりに受診した。飲酒は日本酒5 合/日を43 年間。身長168 cm、体重45 kg。胸部と腹部とに異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球402 万、Hb 12.1 g/dL、Ht 40 %、白血球4,200、血小板18 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白6.8 g/dL、アルブミン3.5 g/dL、総ビリルビン0.8 mg/dL、AST 17 U/L、ALT 28 U/L、LD 199 U/L（基準124～222）、ALP　43 U/L（基準38～113）、アミラーゼ40 U/L（基準44～132）、血糖96 mg/dL、HbA1c 6.2 %（基準4.9～6.0）、CA19-9　36 U/L（基準37 以下）。腹部超音波検査で膵臓にびまん性の石灰化を認めたが、腫瘤は指摘されなかった。この患者にみられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 63-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of diarrhea. Since the age of 50, he had been experiencing repeated upper abdominal and back pain after drinking alcohol, and had been visiting a clinic near his home and receiving advice on abstinence from alcohol. He had stopped visiting the clinic at the age of 55. Six months ago, he had been experiencing persistent diarrhea eight times a day, and visited the clinic for the first time in eight years. He had been drinking five cups of sake per day for 43 years. He was 168 cm tall and weighed 45 kg. No abnormalities were found in his chest or abdomen. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.02 million, hemoglobin 12.1 g/dL, hematocrit 40%, white blood cells 4,200, platelets 180,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 6.8 g/dL, albumin 3.5 g/dL, total bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL, AST 17 U/L, ALT 28 U/L, LD 199 U/L (standard 124-222), ALP 43 U/L (standard 38-113), amylase 40 U/L (standard 44-132), blood glucose 96 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.2% (standard 4.9-6.0), CA19-9 36 U/L (standard 37 or less). Abdominal ultrasound revealed diffuse calcification in the pancreas, but no mass was noted. Which of the following is present in this patient?

Question: 24 歳の女性。職場で過量服薬を繰り返すため通院中の精神科を受診した。小学生までは生活面と成績に問題なく、教師から高い評価を受けていた。中学生ごろから学校で突然怒り出すようになり、高校生から男性と交際して別れることを繰り返すようになった。20 歳ごろから交際相手と別れ話が出るたびに自傷行為を繰り返していた。22 歳で大学卒業後、事務職として就職。精神科の通院を開始して、抗うつ薬と睡眠薬の処方を受けるようになった。職場でミスを指摘されると、一度に10 錠程度の睡眠薬を内服することを繰り返していた。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: A 24-year-old woman visited a psychiatric clinic due to repeated overdosing at work. Up until elementary school, she had no problems with her daily life or grades, and was highly praised by her teachers. From around junior high school, she began to suddenly get angry at school, and from high school, she began repeatedly dating and breaking up with men. From around the age of 20, she began to self-harm every time her boyfriend or girlfriend mentioned breaking up. After graduating from university at the age of 22, she got a job as an office worker. She began receiving treatment at a psychiatric clinic and was prescribed antidepressants and sleeping pills. Whenever a mistake she made at work was pointed out, she would repeatedly take around 10 tablets of sleeping pills at a time. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 56歳の女性。頭痛を主訴に来院した。10年前から高血圧症でカルシウム拮抗薬を内服している。2年前の冬から両手指が蒼白になることに気づいた。6か月前から両手指の腫れが出現した。2週間前から頭痛が出現し持続したため受診した。意識は清明。身長165 cm、体重52 kg。体温36.5 ℃。脈拍100/分、整。血圧176/102 mmHg（1か月前は120/80 mmHg）。呼吸数16/分。SpO2 96 %（room air）。手指から前腕まで皮膚硬化を認める。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。両下腿に圧痕性浮腫を認める。神経診察で異常を認めない。尿所見：蛋白1 ＋、潜血1 ＋。血液所見：赤血球406 万、Hb 10.9 g/dL、Ht 40 %、網赤血球1.2 %、白血球4,300（好中球69 %、好酸球1 %、好塩基球1 %、単球8 %、リンパ球21 %）、血小板15 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白7.5 g/dL、アルブミン3.6 g/dL、総ビリルビン1.1 mg/dL、AST 28 U/L、ALT 16 U/L、LD 197 U/L（基準124～222）、γ-GT 32 U/L（基準9 ～32）、CK 122 U/L（基準41～153）、尿素窒素40 mg/dL、クレアチニン1.8 mg/dL（1 か月前は0.7 mg/dL）、Na 139 mEq/L、K 4.8 mEq/L、Cl 97 mEq/L、血漿レニン活性8.6 ng/mL（基準1.2～2.5）。免疫血清学所見：CRP 0.5 mg/dL、抗核抗体160 倍（基準20 以下）、抗RNA ポリメラーゼⅢ抗体陽性。腹部超音波検査で腎尿路系に異常を認めない。この患者に適切な治療薬はどれか。
Question_EN: A 56-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of headaches. She had been taking calcium antagonists for hypertension for the past 10 years. She noticed that the fingers of both hands had turned pale in the winter two years ago. Six months ago, the fingers of both hands had become swollen. She visited the hospital because she had been suffering from a persistent headache for two weeks. She was conscious and alert. Height 165 cm, weight 52 kg. Body temperature 36.5°C. Pulse 100 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 176/102 mmHg (1 month ago 120/80 mmHg). Respiratory rate 16 beats/min. SpO2 96% (room air). Skin hardening was observed from the fingers to the forearms. Heart and respiratory sounds were normal. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. There was pitting edema in both lower legs. Neurological examination revealed no abnormalities. Urine findings: protein 1+, occult blood 1+. Blood findings: RBC 4.06 million, Hb 10.9 g/dL, Ht 40%, reticulocytes 1.2%, WBC 4,300 (neutrophils 69%, eosinophils 1%, basophils 1%, monocytes 8%, lymphocytes 21%), platelets 150,000. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 7.5 g/dL, albumin 3.6 g/dL, total bilirubin 1.1 mg/dL, AST 28 U/L, ALT 16 U/L, LD 197 U/L (standard 124-222), γ-GT 32 U/L (standard 9-32), CK 122 U/L (standard 41-153), urea nitrogen 40 mg/dL, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL (1 month ago 0.7 mg/dL), Na 139 mEq/L, K 4.8 mEq/L, Cl 97 mEq/L, plasma renin activity 8.6 ng/mL (standard 1.2-2.5). Immunoserological findings: CRP 0.5 mg/dL, antinuclear antibody 160 times (standard 20 or less), anti-RNA polymerase III antibody positive. Abdominal ultrasound examination reveals no abnormalities in the renal and urinary tract. Which of the following is the appropriate treatment for this patient?

Question: 7 歳の男児。頻回の嘔吐と全身倦怠感を主訴に母親に連れられて来院した。新学期がはじまり、易疲労感を自覚し食欲が低下していた。昨晩に嘔吐し食事を摂取できていない。今朝から頻回の嘔吐があり、元気がなくなったため受診した。6 歳から今回と同様の経過を数回繰り返し、1 か月前に入院した病院で原因を精査したが、器質的異常は指摘されていない。意識は清明。顔面蒼白。身長121 cm、体重21 kg。体温36.3 ℃。脈拍124/分、整。血圧100/68 mm/Hg。呼吸数30/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、腸蠕動音は減弱し、皮膚ツルゴールは低下している。尿所見：ケトン体3 ＋。この患者の静脈血ガス分析（room air）の所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 7-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his mother complaining of frequent vomiting and general fatigue. With the start of the new school term, he was aware of fatigue and had a decreased appetite. He vomited last night and has not been able to eat. He had been vomiting frequently since this morning and had become listless, so he visited the hospital. He had experienced a similar course of events several times since he was 6 years old, and was hospitalized one month ago for a detailed examination of the cause, but no organic abnormality was found. He was conscious and pale. Height 121 cm, weight 21 kg. Body temperature 36.3°C. Pulse 124/min, regular. Blood pressure 100/68 mm/Hg. Respiratory rate 30/min. SpO2 98% (room air). No abnormalities were noted in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, intestinal peristalsis sounds were weakened, and skin turgor was decreased. Urine findings: ketone bodies 3+. What would be the findings in this patient's venous blood gas analysis (room air)?

Question: 52 歳の男性。2 週間前から続く38 ℃台の発熱と咳嗽を主訴に来院した。気管支鏡検査を施行後に入院した。職場で咳が出るが、自宅で咳は出ない。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。喫煙歴は40 本/日を20 歳～48 歳。自宅は築30 年の一軒家。職業歴は5 年前まで会社員、5 年前からキノコの屋内栽培に従事している。意識は清明。身長163 cm、体重61 kg。体温37.3 ℃。脈拍84/分、整。血圧132/80 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 94 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。血液所見：赤血球440 万、Hb 13.6 g/dL、白血球4,200、血小板21 万。血液生化学所見：KL-6 1,300 U/mL（基準500 未満）。免疫血清学所見：CRP 3.1 mg/dL、抗核抗体陰性。胸部エックス線写真にて両側肺野に粒状影と淡い浸潤影を認めた。胸部CT で粒状影とすりガラス影を認めた。入院後、発熱と咳嗽は速やかに自然寛解した。入院7 日目、SpO2 は98 %（room air）であり帰宅試験を行ったが、症状は再燃しないため入院10 日目に退院した。この疾患で特徴的な所見はどれか。
Question_EN: A 52-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of a 2-week history of fever of 38°C and cough. He was admitted after undergoing bronchoscopy. He coughs at work but not at home. There is nothing notable about his medical history. He smoked 40 cigarettes per day from age 20 to 48. He lives in a 30-year-old house. He was an office worker until 5 years ago, and has been engaged in indoor mushroom cultivation for the past 5 years. He is conscious and alert. Height 163 cm, weight 61 kg. Body temperature 37.3°C. Pulse 84/min, regular. Blood pressure 132/80 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20/min. SpO2 94% (room air). Heart and respiratory sounds were normal. Blood findings: red blood cells 4.4 million, hemoglobin 13.6 g/dL, white blood cells 4,200, platelets 210,000. Blood biochemistry findings: KL-6 1,300 U/mL (normal: less than 500). Immunoserological findings: CRP 3.1 mg/dL, antinuclear antibodies negative. Chest X-ray showed granular shadows and faint infiltrative shadows in both lung fields. Chest CT showed granular shadows and ground-glass opacities. After hospitalization, the fever and cough quickly resolved spontaneously. On the 7th day of hospitalization, SpO2 was 98% (room air) and a discharge test was performed, but symptoms did not recur and the patient was discharged on the 10th day of hospitalization. Which of the following is a characteristic finding of this disease?

Question_EN: A 36-year-old man was diagnosed with high blood pressure during a regular health check and visited the hospital. He has no history of smoking. He drinks alcohol occasionally. His father is being treated for hypertension. His height is 168 cm, weight is 60 kg, and waist circumference is 77 cm. His pulse rate is 76 beats per minute and is regular. His blood pressure is 144/78 mmHg. Urine findings: protein (-), sugar (-). Blood biochemistry findings: fasting blood glucose 99 mg/dL, uric acid 6.8 mg/dL, total cholesterol 170 mg/dL, triglycerides 70 mg/dL, HDL cholesterol 58 mg/dL. No abnormalities were found in the electrocardiogram. Based on the dietary details he has heard from the registered dietitian, he has estimated his energy intake to be 1,900 kcal/day and his salt intake to be 15 g/day. Which of the following is the appropriate instruction?

Question: 11 歳の男児。下腹部痛を主訴に学校の先生に連れられて来院した。午後から急に下腹部痛が出現し、徐々に増強して我慢できなくなったため受診した。体温36.8 ℃。脈拍108/分、整。血圧118/62 mmHg。呼吸数18/分。SpO2 99 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦で、下腹部に軽度の圧痛を認めるが、筋性防御および反跳痛は認めない。肝・脾を触知しない。腸雑音に異常を認めない。鼠径部に腫瘤を触れない。左陰囊は右陰囊に比較して腫大し、透光性は無く、軽度の発赤と著明な圧痛を認める。カラードプラ陰囊部超音波検査で左精巣実質内の血流信号が乏しい所見が認められた。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: An 11-year-old boy was brought to the hospital by his school teacher complaining of lower abdominal pain. The pain suddenly appeared in the afternoon, gradually worsened, and he was admitted because he could no longer bear it. Temperature 36.8°C. Pulse 108 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 118/62 mmHg. Respiratory rate 18 breaths/min. SpO2 99% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the heart sounds or respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat, and there was mild tenderness in the lower abdomen, but there was no muscular guarding or rebound tenderness. The liver and spleen could not be palpated. There was no abnormality in the bowel sounds. No mass was palpable in the groin area. The left scrotum was enlarged compared to the right scrotum, was not translucent, and had mild redness and marked tenderness. Color Doppler scrotum ultrasound showed a poor blood flow signal in the left testicular parenchyma. What is the diagnosis?

If I pass out, please obtain a CT scan to rule out intracranial hemorrhage immediately. Thank you in advance.” Which test should you order next?

Question: 研修医が担当した肺炎の入院患者に対して、指導医と相談し抗菌薬で治療することになった。薬剤師がこの患者に同系統の抗菌薬でアレルギー歴があることを確認し、研修医に連絡した。研修医から「指導医と決めたことなので問題ない」と返答があったため、そのまま投与された。病棟でこの薬剤を投与中に蕁麻疹が出現した。すぐに薬剤を中止したところ、蕁麻疹は消退した。この事例の適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A trainee doctor consulted with the supervising physician and decided to treat a hospitalized patient with pneumonia with an antibiotic. The pharmacist confirmed that the patient had a history of allergies to the same type of antibiotic and contacted the trainee doctor. The trainee doctor replied, "This is what we decided with the supervising physician, so there is no problem," and the antibiotic was administered as planned. While administering the antibiotic in the ward, the patient developed hives. The antibiotic was immediately discontinued, and the hives subsided. What is the appropriate response in this case?

Question: 38 歳の女性（3 妊0 産）。強い腹痛を主訴に救急車で搬入された。月経周期は28日型、整。最終月経は7 週間前。本日から突然強い下腹部痛を自覚したため救急車を要請した。性器出血を認めない。意識は清明。体温37.1 ℃。心拍数116/分、整。血圧78/52 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。腹部は軽度膨隆し右下腹部に圧痛と反跳痛を認める。妊娠反応陽性。腹部超音波検査でMorrison 窩とDouglas 窩に低輝度の液体貯留像を認める。経腟超音波検査で子宮内膜の高輝度肥厚および右付属器領域に不整形低エコーを認める。この患者への適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 38-year-old woman (gravida 3, para 0) was brought in by ambulance complaining of severe abdominal pain. Her menstrual cycle is 28 days, regular. Her last menstrual period was 7 weeks ago. She suddenly noticed severe lower abdominal pain today and called an ambulance. There is no genital bleeding. She is conscious and alert. Body temperature is 37.1°C. Heart rate is 116 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure is 78/52 mmHg. Respiratory rate is 20 breaths/min. SpO2 is 98% (room air). There is mild abdominal distension, and there is tenderness and rebound tenderness in the right lower quadrant. The pregnancy test is positive. Abdominal ultrasound reveals low-intensity fluid accumulations in the Morrison and Douglas pouches. Transvaginal ultrasound reveals high-intensity thickening of the endometrium and irregular, hypoechoic areas in the right adnexal region. What is the appropriate response for this patient?

Question: 34 歳の女性。発熱と皮疹を主訴に来院した。昨日から咽頭痛があったが、日常生活は普通に送っていた。本日からガタガタ震える悪寒を伴う39.6 ℃の発熱、頭痛、悪心および関節痛を認める。生来健康である。意識は清明。身長165 cm、体重60 kg。体温39.8 ℃。脈拍120/分、整。血圧90/58 mmHg。呼吸数28/分。SpO2 96 %（room air）。瞳孔は左右差なく、対光反射は正常。眼球結膜に点状出血と黄染とを認める。口腔内はやや乾燥している。咽頭は発赤を認めない。頸静脈の怒張を認めない。項部硬直を認める。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、腸雑音を聴取する。肝・脾を触知しない。両上肢手掌と下肢足底とにびまん性の出血斑を認める。入院時の血液培養からグラム陰性球菌を認めた。最も可能性の高い原因微生物はどれか。
Question_EN: A 34-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital complaining of fever and skin rash. She had a sore throat since yesterday, but had been living a normal daily life. Starting today, she has a fever of 39.6°C accompanied by shaking chills, headache, nausea, and joint pain. She has always been healthy. She is conscious and alert. Height 165 cm, weight 60 kg. Body temperature 39.8°C. Pulse 120 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 90/58 mmHg. Respiratory rate 28 breaths/min. SpO2 96% (room air). There is no difference between the pupils, and the light reflex is normal. Petechia and yellowing are observed on the conjunctiva. The oral cavity is somewhat dry. There is no redness in the pharynx. The jugular vein is not distended. The neck is stiff. There are no abnormalities in the heart sounds and respiratory sounds. The abdomen is flat and soft, and bowel sounds can be heard. The liver and spleen are not palpable. Diffuse hemorrhagic spots are present on the palms of both upper limbs and the soles of the lower limbs. Gram-negative cocci were identified in blood cultures obtained at the time of admission. Which microorganism is most likely to be the causative agent?

Question: 78 歳の男性。下腹部痛と排尿ができないことを主訴に来院した。3 か月前から頻尿がある。一昨日の夕食後から感冒症状があり市販の総合感冒薬を内服している。昨日の昼から尿が出ず、下腹部痛が出現したため受診した。身長165 cm、体重60 kg。体温36.6 ℃。脈拍84/分、整。血圧154/88 mmHg。下腹部に弾性軟の腫瘤を触知し、同部に圧痛あり。直腸診で径5 cm、弾性硬の前立腺を触知し、圧痛を認めない。まず行うべき画像検査で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 78-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of lower abdominal pain and inability to urinate. He has had frequent urination for the past 3 months. He has had cold symptoms since dinner the day before yesterday and is taking an over-the-counter general cold medicine. He was unable to urinate since yesterday afternoon and experienced lower abdominal pain, so he visited the hospital. Height: 165 cm, weight: 60 kg. Body temperature: 36.6°C. Pulse: 84 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure: 154/88 mmHg. An elastic soft mass was palpated in the lower abdomen, and there was tenderness in the same area. Rectal examination revealed a 5 cm diameter elastic hard prostate, which was not tender. Which imaging test should be performed first?

Question: 28 歳の初妊婦（1 妊0 産）。妊娠18 週に高血糖を指摘され来院した。妊娠16 週時に尿糖陽性を指摘され、2 週間後の随時血糖値が162 mg/dL と高値を示したため紹介受診となった。既往歴に特記すべきことはない。身長158 cm、体重57 kg（非妊時体重54 kg）。血圧124/62 mmHg。下腿に浮腫を認めない。妊娠19 週時に75 g 経口ブドウ糖負荷試験〈OGTT〉を施行し、負荷前値112 mg/dL、1 時間値218 mg/dL、2 時間値202 mg/dL であった。超音波検査で子宮頸管長4.2 cm、推定胎児体重は190 g（0.0 SD）、羊水量は正常であった。適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 28-year-old primigravida (1 pregnancy, 0 deliveries) was diagnosed with hyperglycemia at 18 weeks of pregnancy and visited the hospital. At 16 weeks of pregnancy, urine glucose was positive, and 2 weeks later, random blood glucose was elevated at 162 mg/dL, leading to the referral. There was nothing notable in the medical history. Height 158 ​​cm, weight 57 kg (non-pregnant weight 54 kg). Blood pressure 124/62 mmHg. No edema was noted in the lower legs. At 19 weeks of pregnancy, a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) was performed, with a pre-load value of 112 mg/dL, a 1-hour value of 218 mg/dL, and a 2-hour value of 202 mg/dL. Ultrasound examination revealed a cervical length of 4.2 cm, an estimated fetal weight of 190 g (0.0 SD), and normal amniotic fluid volume. Which is the appropriate response?

Question: 88 歳の女性。腰痛を主訴に救急車で搬入された。今朝、自宅で転倒してから腰痛のため歩けなくなったため救急車を要請した。高血圧症と認知症で治療中である。改訂長谷川式簡易知能評価スケールで7 点（30 点満点）。要介護度は要介護1 である。腰椎エックス線写真で第3 腰椎の圧迫骨折を認め、疼痛管理とリハビリテーションを目的に入院となった。入院1 か月後に状態が安定したので、退院後の方針について夫と話し合いとなった。夫への説明で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 88-year-old woman was brought in by ambulance complaining of lower back pain. She had fallen at home this morning and was unable to walk due to the pain in her lower back, so she called for an ambulance. She is currently being treated for hypertension and dementia. She scored 7 (out of a possible 30) on the revised Hasegawa Dementia Scale. Her level of care required is level 1. A lumbar X-ray revealed a compression fracture of the third lumbar vertebra, and she was admitted to the hospital for pain management and rehabilitation. One month after admission, her condition stabilized, so she discussed with her husband the plan for her post-discharge. Which of the following explanations would be appropriate for her husband?

Question: 23 歳の男性。腹痛を主訴に来院した。2 日前に上腹部痛を自覚した。本日、明け方から痛みが右下腹部に移動し、悪心を伴うため自宅近くの診療所を受診した。2 日間排便がない。臍周囲から右下腹部が痛み、咳で右下腹部に痛みが響くようになったという。尿の異常は自覚していない。意識は清明。体温37.6 ℃。脈拍88/分、整。血圧108/70 mmHg。呼吸数16/分。この患者の腹部診察で正しいのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 23-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of abdominal pain. He noticed upper abdominal pain two days ago. Today, the pain moved to the right lower abdomen at dawn, and he felt nauseous, so he visited a clinic near his home. He has not had a bowel movement for two days. He has pain from around the navel to the right lower abdomen, and when he coughs, the pain radiates to the right lower abdomen. He is not aware of any abnormalities with his urine He is conscious. Body temperature is 37.6°C. Pulse rate is 88 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure is 108/70 mmHg. Respiratory rate is 16 breaths/min. Which of the following is correct regarding the abdominal examination of this patient?

Question: 80 歳の女性。1 か月前に自宅近くの病院で肺癌および多発骨転移と診断された。本人の強い希望で薬物による抗癌治療などの積極的な治療はせず、自宅にて訪問診療を受けている。トイレに行くことはできるが、日中も主にベッド上で過ごしている。65 歳時に夫と死別してから独居である。息子はいるが遠方に住んでおり、ほとんど会うことはない。表情は硬く、自宅を訪問するスタッフとも会話をすることが少ないという。ある日、訪問診療に訪れた医師に、患者は「もう終わりにしたいです」と訴えた。患者のこの言葉に対する医師の最初の返答で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: An 80-year-old woman was diagnosed with lung cancer and multiple bone metastases at a hospital near her home one month ago. At her strong request, she has not undergone aggressive treatment such as chemotherapy, and instead receives home visits from medical doctors. Although she is able to go to the toilet, she spends most of her daytime hours in bed. She has been living alone since her husband passed away at the age of 65. She has a son, but he lives far away, so she rarely sees him. Her facial expression is stiff, and she rarely speaks to the staff who visit her home. One day, when the doctor visited for home care, the patient said, "I want to end this now." Which of the following would be the doctor's most appropriate first response to the patient's words?

Question: 75 歳の男性。自転車で転倒したため救急車で搬入された。右大腿骨頸部骨折の診断で人工骨頭置換術を受けた。2 週間のリハビリテーションでつかまり立ちができる程度に回復した。本人はリハビリテーションに意欲的で自宅での生活を希望している。認知症はなく妻と2 人暮らしである。患者の退院先で適切なものはどれか。
Question_EN: A 75-year-old man was brought to the hospital by ambulance after falling off his bicycle. He was diagnosed with a right femoral neck fracture and underwent hip replacement surgery. After two weeks of rehabilitation, he recovered to the point where he could stand with support. He is enthusiastic about rehabilitation and wishes to live at home. He does not have dementia and lives with his wife. Which of the following is the appropriate destination for the patient when he is discharged from the hospital?

Question: 72 歳の女性。歩行困難を主訴に来院した。10 年前から便秘で、5 年前から嗅覚の低下を自覚している。2 年前から料理のときに右手で炒めものをかき混ぜづらくなった。症状は徐々に進行し、3 か月前から歩行が不安定となったため受診した。眼球運動は正常。仮面様顔貌と小声で早口の構語障害を認める。四肢では特に右上肢で中等度の筋強剛と静止時振戦を認める。四肢の筋力低下は認めない。Romberg 徴候は陰性で感覚障害を認めない。痙縮はなく腱反射は正常である。起立は自力でできるが、姿勢反射障害がある。頭部MRI で異常を認めない。ドパミントランスポーターSPECT で左側線条体の取込み低下を認める。この患者にみられる歩行障害はどれか。
Question_EN: A 72-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of difficulty walking. She has suffered from constipation for the past 10 years, and has been aware of a decreased sense of smell for the past 5 years. For the past 2 years, she has had difficulty stirring stir-fried foods with her right hand when cooking. The symptoms gradually progressed, and she visited the hospital 3 months ago because her walking had become unstable. Eye movement is normal. She has mask-like facies and dysarthria, with a fast, soft voice. Her limbs have moderate rigidity and resting tremor, especially in the right upper limb. There is no muscle weakness in the limbs. Romberg's sign is negative, and no sensory impairment is observed. There is no spasticity, and tendon reflexes are normal. She is able to stand on her own, but has impaired postural reflexes. Head MRI shows no abnormalities. Dopamine transporter SPECT shows decreased uptake in the left striatum. Which of the following gait disorders is observed in this patient?

Question: 74 歳の女性。①高血圧症で通院治療を受けている。1 年前から変形性膝関節症と診断され、杖をついて屋外歩行をしている。②一人暮らしで、③年金生活をしている。食事摂取、着替え、排泄および入浴は自立している。④認知機能に問題はない。膝の痛みのため掃除と洗濯ができない。要介護認定は⑤要支援1 である。介護予防ケアプランに基づいて予防給付（介護予防サービス）を受けている。予防給付（介護予防サービス）を受ける根拠はどれか。
Question_EN: A 74-year-old woman.  She is receiving ① outpatient treatment for hypertension. She was diagnosed with osteoarthritis of the knee one year ago and walks outdoors with a cane. ② She lives alone, and ③ lives on a pension. She is independent in eating, dressing, toileting, and bathing. ④ She has no problems with cognitive function. She is unable to clean or do laundry due to knee pain. Her nursing care need certification is ⑤ Support Level 1 required. She is receiving preventive benefits (nursing care prevention services) based on a nursing care prevention care plan. Which is the basis for receiving preventive benefits (nursing care prevention services)?

現病歴：今夜8 時、食事中に突然激しい頭痛と嘔吐をきたし、同居の夫が異変に気付き救急車を要請した。

現病歴：6 か月前から気分が沈み、自宅近くの内科診療所を受診し、抗うつ薬が処方された。1 か月前から遅くまで働いた後に友人と外出し、帰宅後は明け方まで電話をするようになった。毎日出社していたが、取引先とトラブルを繰り返すようになった。抗うつ薬は処方されたとおりに服用していた。

精神科受診時にこの患者にみられる症状はどれか。
Question_EN:

Respiratory rate: 15 breaths/min. SpO2 99% (room air). No abnormalities were found in the neurological examination.
Which symptom would this patient at the psychiatric visit?

既往歴：特記すべきことはない。
生活歴：喫煙歴と飲酒歴はない。
家族歴：特記すべきことはない。
現症：意識は清明。身長 168 cm、体重 60 kg。体温 36.1 ℃。脈拍 64/分、整。血圧 128/68 mmHg。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。
検査所見：尿 所 見：蛋 白（－）、糖（－）。血 液 所 見：赤 血 球 510 万、Hb 14.2g/dL、白血球 8,300、血小板 20 万。血液生化学所見：総蛋白 7.8 g/dL、総ビリルビン 0.8 mg/dL、AST 26 U/L、ALT 20 U/L、LD 180 U/L（基準 124～222）、γ-GT45 U/L（基準 13～64）、CK 70 U/L（基準 59～248）、尿素窒素 19 mg/dL、クレアチニン 0.8 mg/dL、血糖 92 mg/dL、HbA1c 5.0 %（基準 4.9～6.0）、総コレステロール 152 mg/dL、トリグリセリド 50 mg/dL、Na 140 mEq/L、K 4.0 mEq/L。心電図で異常を認めない。胸部、腹部および頸椎エックス線写真で異常を認めない。
この患者にみられるのはどれか。
