Retractions were observed in the suprasternal fossa and intercostal spaces. She was able to speak, although with difficulty. Chest X-ray showed hyperinflation of the lungs. Which of the following is present in this patient?

Question: 82 歳の女性。数日前からの呼吸困難を主訴に来院した。肺結核後遺症による慢性呼吸不全で在宅酸素療法（鼻カニューラ0.5 L/分）を受けており、3 週間前の定期受診時はSpO2　92 %（鼻カニューラ0.5 L/分　酸素投与下）であった。発熱はなく少量の痰がある。意識は清明。体温36.2 ℃。脈拍96/分、整。血圧130/88　mmHg。呼吸数24/分。SpO2　86 %（鼻カニューラ0.5 L/分　酸素投与下）。呼吸音は両側でcoarse crackles を聴取する。下腿浮腫を認める。動脈血ガス分析（鼻カニューラ0.5 L/分　酸素投与下）はpH 7.32、PaCO2 60 Torr、PaO2 55 Torr、HCO3－ 30 mEq/L であった。次に行うべき治療はどれか。
Question_EN: An 82-year-old woman visited the hospital complaining of difficulty in breathing for the past few days. She was receiving home oxygen therapy (nasal cannula 0.5 L/min) due to chronic respiratory failure caused by aftereffects of pulmonary tuberculosis, and at her regular visit 3 weeks ago, her SpO2 was 92% (oxygen administered via nasal cannula 0.5 L/min). She had no fever and was producing a small amount of sputum. She was conscious and alert. Body temperature 36.2°C. Pulse rate 96 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 130/88 mmHg. Respiratory rate 24 breaths/min. SpO2 86% (oxygen administered via nasal cannula 0.5 L/min). Coarse crackles were heard on both sides of the breath. Edema was noted in the lower legs. Arterial blood gas analysis (oxygen administered via nasal cannula at 0.5 L/min) showed pH 7.32, PaCO2 60 Torr, PaO2 55 Torr, and HCO3- 30 mEq/L. What is the next treatment?

Question: 生後1 時間の男児。身長50 cm、体重2,200 g、頭囲32 cm で出生した。この児の在胎期間の推定に用いる身体所見で適切でないのはどれか。
Question_EN: A male infant, 1 hour after birth. He was born at 50 cm in length, weighing 2,200 g, and had a head circumference of 32 cm. Which of the following physical findings would not be appropriate to use in estimating the infant's gestational age?

Question: 日齢14 の女児。夕方からの発熱を主訴に両親に連れられて夜間救急外来を受診した。活気は不良。完全母乳栄養で哺乳は減弱している。体温38.8 ℃。脈拍160/分。呼吸数60/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。大泉門は開大し軽度膨隆している。両親への説明で適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 14-day-old girl was brought to the emergency department by her parents because she had developed a fever since the evening. She was lethargic. She was exclusively breastfed, but breastfeeding had weakened. Body temperature 38.8°C. Pulse rate 160 beats/min. Respiratory rate 60 breaths/min. SpO2 98% (room air). No abnormalities were noted in the heart and respiratory sounds. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. The anterior fontanelle was dilated and slightly distended. Which of the following explanations would be appropriate for the parents?

Question: 2 か月の女児。定期診察のため母親に連れられて来院した。新生児期に心室中隔欠損症と診断されている。活気はあるが、以前に比して体重の増加が鈍っていた。身長57.0 cm、体重4,720 g。体温36.7 ℃。脈拍148/分、整。血圧90/58 mmHg。呼吸数52/分。毛細血管再充満時間1 秒。SpO2 98 %（room air）。季肋下に陥没呼吸を認める。心音はⅡ音の亢進を認め、胸骨左縁下部にLevine 5/6 の汎収縮期雑音、心尖部にLevine 2/6 の拡張期雑音を認める。胸部聴診上、両側にwheezes を聴取する。右肋骨弓下に肝を3 cm 触れる。心エコー検査で、径8 mm の心室中隔欠損孔を介する多量の左右短絡を認め、左心房と左心室は拡大している。左心室の収縮は保たれている。収縮期に心室中隔の左室側への圧排を認める。心室中隔欠損症による心不全徴候が明らかとなってきており、近日中に心室中隔欠損症の閉鎖手術が必要と判断した。 この患児に対する適切な初期対応はどれか。
Question_EN: A 2-month-old girl was brought to the hospital by her mother for a routine checkup. She had been diagnosed with ventricular septal defect in the neonatal period. She was alert, but her weight gain had slowed compared to before. Height 57.0 cm, weight 4,720 g. Body temperature 36.7°C. Pulse 148 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 90/58 mmHg. Respiratory rate 52 breaths/min. Capillary refill time 1 second. SpO2 98% (room air). Subcostal retractions were observed. Heart sounds showed an increased second heart sound, a pansystolic Levine 5/6 murmur at the left lower sternal border, and a diastolic Levine 2/6 murmur at the apex. Chest auscultation revealed wheezes on both sides. The liver was palpable 3 cm below the right costal arch. Echocardiography reveals a large amount of left-to-right shunting through an 8 mm ventricular septal defect, and the left atrium and left ventricle are enlarged. Left ventricular contraction is maintained. During systole, there is compression of the ventricular septum towards the left ventricle. Signs of heart failure due to the ventricular septal defect are becoming apparent, and it has been determined that surgery to close the ventricular septal defect will be necessary in the near future. What is the appropriate initial management for this patient?

Question: 38 歳の女性。めまいと頭痛を主訴に来院した。2 か月前に部屋の内装を改修した。改装後から帰宅するとめまい及び頭痛を自覚するようになった。天気が快晴で窓を開けていると症状は楽だが、雨の日は調子が悪い。この症状の原因と考えられる化学物質はどれか。
Question_EN: A 38-year-old woman came to the hospital complaining of dizziness and headaches. The interior of her room was renovated two months ago. Since the renovation, she has been experiencing dizziness and headaches when she returns home. Her symptoms are relieved when the weather is clear and the windows are open, but she feels unwell on rainy days. Which chemical is thought to be the cause of these symptoms?

Question:
84 歳の女性。要介護認定の申請にあたって、主治医意見書を作成するために来院した。20 年前から高血圧症の治療中である。3 か月前から物忘れや薬の飲み忘れが多くありAlzheimer 型認知症と診断された。認知症の周辺症状および問題行動はない。ゆっくり会話をすれば意思疎通はできる。長男夫婦との3 人暮らしで、日中はほとんどの時間を自宅で過ごしている。着替え、食事、排泄および入浴は自立している。薬と金銭の管理は家族の助けが必要である。改訂長谷川式簡易知能評価スケールは16 点（30 点満点）である。認知症高齢者の日常生活自立度判断基準を以下に示す。
ランクⅠ：何らかの認知症を有するが、日常生活は家庭内及び社会的にほぼ自立している。
ランクⅡ：日常生活に支障を来たすような症状・行動や意思疎通の困難さが多少見られても、誰かが注意していれば自立できる。
ランクⅢ：日常生活に支障を来たすような症状・行動や意思疎通の困難さがときどき見られ、介護を必要とする。
ランクⅣ：日常生活に支障を来たすような症状・行動や意思疎通の困難さが頻繁に見られ、常に介護を必要とする。
ランクM：著しい精神症状や問題行動あるいは重篤な身体疾患が見られ、専門医療を必要とする。
この患者の認知症高齢者の日常生活自立度ランクはどれか。
Question_EN:
An 84-year-old woman visited the hospital to have her doctor's opinion prepared for her application for nursing care certification. She has been receiving treatment for hypertension for the past 20 years. She has been forgetful and has forgotten to take her medicine for the past three months, and was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. She has no behavioral and psychological symptoms of dementia. She can communicate with others if she talks slowly. She lives with her eldest son and his wife, and spends most of her daytime hours at home. She is independent with getting dressed, eating, going to the bathroom, and bathing. She needs help from her family with managing her medicine and money. Her Revised Hasegawa Simple Cognitive Assessment Scale scores 16 points (out of 30). The following are the criteria for judging the independence level for elderly people with dementia.
Rank I: The patient has some form of dementia, but is almost independent in daily life at home and in society.
Rank II: The patient has some symptoms or behavior that interfere with daily life, and some difficulty in communication, but can be independent as long as someone is watching over them.
Rank III: Occasionally exhibits symptoms/behaviors or difficulty communicating that interfere with daily life, and requires nursing care.
Rank IV: Frequently exhibits symptoms/behaviors or difficulty communicating that interfere with daily life, and requires constant nursing care.
Rank M: Severe psychiatric symptoms, problematic behaviors, or serious physical illnesses are observed, and specialized medical care is required.
What is this patient's rank of independence in daily life as an elderly dementia patient?

Question: 48歳の女性。定期受診で来院した。20年前に糖尿病、5年前に糖尿病腎症を指摘されて自宅近くの診療所に通院している。身長154 cm、体重52 kg。体重はこの1年間変化がない。脈拍60/分、整。血圧132/72 mmHg。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。両下腿に軽度の圧痕性浮腫を認める。両側のアキレス腱反射は消失している。尿所見：蛋白3 ＋、糖1 ＋、潜血（－）。血液所見：赤血球349 万、Hb 11.3 g/dL、Ht 36 %。血液生化学所見：総蛋白5.3 g/dL、アルブミン3.0 g/dL、尿素窒素47 mg/dL、クレアチニン2.8 mg/dL、eGFR 15.3 mL/分/1.73 m2、尿酸6.0 mg/dL、血糖97 mg/dL、HbA1c 6.4 %（基準4.9～6.0）、Na 132 mEq/L、K 5.8 mEq/L、Cl 107 mEq/L。患者は1 日1.5 L の飲水を行っており、外来で行った蓄尿検査で推定される塩分摂取量は5.8 g/日、蛋白質摂取量は30 g/日、カリウム摂取量は3,500 mg/日であった。この患者の食事内容で制限すべきなのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 48-year-old woman visited the hospital for a regular check-up. She had been diagnosed with diabetes 20 years ago and diabetic nephropathy 5 years ago, and has been visiting a clinic near her home. She is 154 cm tall and weighs 52 kg. Her weight has not changed in the past year. Pulse rate is 60 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure is 132/72 mmHg. No abnormalities were noted in heart and respiratory sounds. There is mild pitting edema in both lower legs. The Achilles tendon reflex on both sides has disappeared. Urine findings: protein 3+, sugar 1+, occult blood (-). Blood findings: red blood cells 3.49 million, Hb 11.3 g/dL, Ht 36%. Blood biochemistry findings: total protein 5.3 g/dL, albumin 3.0 g/dL, urea nitrogen 47 mg/dL, creatinine 2.8 mg/dL, eGFR 15.3 mL/min/1.73 m2, uric acid 6.0 mg/dL, blood glucose 97 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.4% (normal 4.9-6.0), Na 132 mEq/L, K 5.8 mEq/L, Cl 107 mEq/L. The patient drinks 1.5 L of water per day, and a urine collection test performed in the outpatient clinic estimated salt intake to be 5.8 g/day, protein intake to be 30 g/day, and potassium intake to be 3,500 mg/day. Which of the following dietary restrictions should be imposed on this patient?

Question: 日齢3 の男児。頭部の腫瘤を主訴に新生児搬送された。在胎39 週、3,120 g で頭位自然分娩で出生した。仮死はなかった。出生直後から頭部の腫瘤を認めていた。腫瘤が増大し、黄疸と貧血とが出現して次第に増悪したため転院した。意識は清明。身長51.0 cm、体重3,080 g。体温37.0 ℃。心拍数140/分、整。血圧86/56 mmHg。呼吸数32/分。SpO2 98 %（room air）。活気不良。顔色不良。両側の頭頂側頭部に径5 cm の軟らかい腫瘤を触知する。大泉門の膨隆を認めない。眼瞼結膜に貧血を認める。眼球結膜に軽度の黄染を認める。心音と呼吸音とに異常を認めない。腹部は平坦、軟で、肝・脾を触知しない。血液所見：赤血球233 万、Hb 8.2 g/dL、Ht 23 %、白血球14,400、血小板28 万、出血時間正常、PT-INR 1.0（基準0.9～1.1）、APTT 90 秒（基準対照32.2 秒）、フィブリノゲン322 mg/dL（基準130～380）。血液生化学所見：総ビリルビン16.2 mg/dL、直接ビリルビン0.1 mg/dL、AST 45 U/L、ALT 12 U/L、LD 430 U/L（基準198～404）。児は第2 子であり、3 歳の姉がいる。両親は血族婚ではない。両親にはそれぞれ弟が1 名いる。この患者と同じ疾患を持つ可能性が最も高いのはだれか。
Question_EN: A 3-day-old male infant was brought to the hospital with the chief complaint of a mass on his head. He was born at 39 weeks gestation, weighing 3,120 g, and delivered naturally in a vertex position. There was no asphyxia. A mass on the head was noted immediately after birth. The mass grew larger, and the patient developed jaundice and anemia, which gradually worsened, leading to the patient being transferred to another hospital. The patient was conscious and alert. Height 51.0 cm, weight 3,080 g. Body temperature 37.0°C. Heart rate 140 beats/min, normal. Blood pressure 86/56 mmHg. Respiratory rate 32 breaths/min. SpO2 98% (room air). Poor vitality. Pale complexion. Soft masses measuring 5 cm in diameter were palpable on both parietal and temporal regions. No bulging of the anterior fontanelle was noted. Anemia was noted in the palpebral conjunctiva. Mild yellowing of the bulbar conjunctiva was noted. Heart and respiratory sounds were normal. The abdomen was flat and soft, and the liver and spleen were not palpable. Blood findings: RBC 2.33 million, Hb 8.2 g/dL, Ht 23%, WBC 14,400, platelets 280,000, bleeding time normal, PT-INR 1.0 (normal 0.9-1.1), APTT 90 seconds (normal control 32.2 seconds), fibrinogen 322 mg/dL (normal 130-380). Blood biochemistry findings: total bilirubin 16.2 mg/dL, direct bilirubin 0.1 mg/dL, AST 45 U/L, ALT 12 U/L, LD 430 U/L (normal 198-404). The child is the second child and has a 3-year-old sister. The parents are not consanguineous. Each parent has one younger brother. Who is most likely to have the same disease as this patient?

Question: 42 歳の男性。自殺目的で市販の睡眠薬を過量服薬し精神科病棟のない救急病院に搬入された。救急処置を終えた後、精神科にコンサルテーションしたところうつ病と診断された。1 か月前から職場には不満などないにもかかわらず休むようになり、市販の睡眠薬を服用していた。入院数日以内に希死念慮が消失したため、近隣の精神科診療所に通うことになった。本人、家族から今後の復職のためのリハビリテーションや精神症状が悪化した時の救急受診先の情報などについて相談された。相談先として案内するもので適切なのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 42-year-old man. He overdosed on over-the-counter sleeping pills with the intent of suicide and was taken to an emergency hospital with no psychiatric ward. After emergency treatment, he was consulted by a psychiatrist and diagnosed with depression. One month ago, he began taking time off from work despite having no complaints, and he began taking over-the-counter sleeping pills. His suicidal thoughts disappeared within a few days of being admitted to hospital, so he was referred to a nearby psychiatric clinic. He and his family asked for information about rehabilitation for returning to work in the future and where to go for emergency treatment if his mental symptoms worsen. Which of the following would be the most appropriate place to provide advice?

Question: 1 歳6 か月の女児。1 歳6 か月健康診査のために両親に連れられて来院した。在胎39 週、出生体重3,245 g、頭位自然分娩で出生した。身長80 cm、体重10 kg。走ることはできるが、①両足で跳ぶことはできない。手をひいて階段を昇るが、②階段を降りられない。鉛筆でなぐり書きをするが、③直線をまねしてひくことはできない。親指と人差し指で積み木をつまむことはできるが、④積み木を積むことはできない。「パパ」「ママ」と言い、犬の絵を見せて「わんわんどれ？」と聞くと指でさすが、⑤絵を見せて「これなに？」と聞いても言えない。①から⑤のうち、発達の遅れがみられるのはどれか。
Question_EN: A 1 year and 6 month old girl was brought to the hospital by her parents for her 1 year and 6 month health check. She was born at 39 weeks gestation, weighed 3,245 g at birth, and was delivered naturally in a cephalic presentation. She is 80 cm tall and weighs 10 kg. She can run, but ① cannot hop with both feet. She can climb stairs by holding onto someone's hand, but ② cannot go down stairs. She scribbles with a pencil, but ③ cannot imitate a straight line. She can pick up building blocks with her thumb and index finger, but ④ cannot stack them. She says "Daddy" and "Mummy," and when shown a picture of a dog and asked "Which one is it?" she points to it with her finger, but ⑤ when shown a picture and asked "What's this?" she cannot answer. Which of the numbered parts shows signs of developmental delay?

Question: 43 歳の男性。持続する咳、痰および労作時呼吸困難を主訴に来院した。小児期から風邪をひきやすく20 歳台から咳と痰の回数が増加した。2 年前から膿性痰が1 日中持続し息切れを自覚するようになった。自宅近くの診療所で抗菌薬を処方され症状は少し改善したが、再燃したため紹介受診した。喫煙歴はない。意識は清明。体温36.9 ℃。脈拍76/分、整。血圧116/68 mmHg。呼吸数20/分。SpO2 97 %（room air）。心音に異常を認めない。呼吸音は両側下胸部にcoarse cracklesを聴取する。胸部エックス線写真で両側中・下肺野を中心にびまん性粒状陰影を認めた。胸部単純CT でびまん性小葉中心性粒状影を認めた。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: A 43-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of persistent cough, sputum, and dyspnea on exertion. He had been prone to catching colds since childhood, and his cough and phlegm production increased in his 20s. Two years ago, he began to experience purulent phlegm and shortness of breath all day. He was prescribed antibiotics at a clinic near his home, and his symptoms improved slightly, but they recurred and he was referred to our hospital. He has no history of smoking. He is conscious and alert. Body temperature 36.9°C. Pulse rate 76 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 116/68 mmHg. Respiratory rate 20 breaths/min. SpO2 97% (room air). No abnormalities were noted in his heart sounds. Coarse crackles were heard in the lower chest on both sides of his chest. A chest X-ray showed diffuse granular shadows, mainly in the middle and lower lung fields on both sides. A plain chest CT showed diffuse centrilobular granular shadows. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 38 歳の女性。手に菌がついてしまっているのではないかと心配で仕方ないことを主訴に母親に伴われて来院した。専門学校卒業後、20 歳から美容師となり、30 歳で美容院を開業している。その頃から菌がついていると言って頻回に手を洗うようになり、数年前から家族の菌も恐れて家族を部屋に入れなくなった。最近は仕事もできなくなり、自分自身の入浴に2 時間くらいかけ、家族にも入念に体を洗うように指示するようになった。診察室では疎通性が良好で家族に迷惑をかけていることを自覚している。診断はどれか。
Question_EN: A 38-year-old woman came to the hospital accompanied by her mother, complaining of worry that she had bacteria on her hands. After graduating from a vocational school, she became a hairdresser at age 20 and opened a beauty salon at age 30. Since then, she has frequently washed her hands, saying that she had bacteria on them, and several years ago, she stopped letting her family into her room, fearing the bacteria they carried. Recently, she has been unable to work, so she spends about two hours bathing herself and has instructed her family to wash their bodies thoroughly as well. She has good communication in the examination room and is aware that she is causing trouble for her family. What is the diagnosis?

Question: 84 歳の女性。息苦しさと発熱とを主訴に家族から往診の依頼があった。5 年前に脳梗塞を発症し要介護2 と認定され訪問介護とデイサービスとを利用している。1 日のほとんどを自宅内で過ごしており、排泄、入浴および着替えには一部介助が必要である。最近、食事中にむせることが多くなった。体温38.6 ℃。脈拍104/分、整。血圧88/54 mmHg。呼吸数22/分。SpO2 89 %（room air）。口腔内と皮膚は乾燥し、呼吸音は右前胸部にcoarse crackles を聴取する。適切な対応はどれか。
Question_EN: An 84-year-old woman. Her family requested a house call complaining of shortness of breath and fever. She suffered a cerebral infarction 5 years ago and was certified as requiring nursing care level 2, and uses home care services and day care services. She spends most of her day at home and requires some assistance with excretion, bathing, and changing clothes. Recently, she has been choking more often while eating. Body temperature 38.6°C. Pulse 104 beats/min, regular. Blood pressure 88/54 mmHg. Respiratory rate 22 breaths/min. SpO2 89% (room air). The mouth and skin are dry, and coarse crackles are heard in the right anterior chest. What is the appropriate response?
